<!-- docs/BRANDS.md -->

# Thương hiệu trên Semi (brand kit)

**Bắt đầu từ đây.** Semi là brand builder: bạn định nghĩa thương hiệu một lần, mọi sản phẩm và mọi agent làm theo.
Mỗi thương hiệu (công ty con, khách hàng) có **một brand kit riêng** sinh ra từ Semi: logo, màu nút chính, font, giọng
văn, kèm một brand book để xem. Mọi sản phẩm của thương hiệu cài brand kit, nên luôn cùng nhận diện, cùng luật.

| Bạn đang ở | Gõ | Để làm gì |
|---|---|---|
| Repo brand | `/semi-brand` | Tạo hoặc sửa thương hiệu, xem brand book, ra bản |
| Thư mục trống | `/semi-new-app` | Tạo sản phẩm mới của thương hiệu |
| App có sẵn | `/semi-check` | Kiểm tra app theo brand và Semi, rồi sửa khi bạn đồng ý |
| App có sẵn | `/semi-sync` | Brand kit hoặc Semi có bản mới: kéo về |

```
Semi core (@semi/ui)              cố định cho mọi thương hiệu
  component, luật, lint, một style chung, mặt nền và chữ xám trung tính, bộ chọn chữ trên nút
        │  /semi-brand
        ▼
Brand kit (vd. @3dnoobs/brand)    lựa chọn của một thương hiệu, repo GitHub riêng
  brand.json (bạn chọn) → dist/brand.css, dist/brand.json, dist/logo/, BRAND.md, AGENTS.brand.md, brand book
        │  /semi-new-app --brand  ·  /semi-sync
        ▼
Sản phẩm (Manager, Store, …)       chỉ dùng: không tự chọn màu / font, không ghi đè token
```

- **Bạn chỉ quyết định vài thứ**, một lần, trong repo brand: brief (sản phẩm, người dùng, tính cách), logo, màu chính,
  màu phụ (tuỳ chọn), font, giọng văn. Chữ trên nút và màu hover do Semi tự chọn. Từ 1.0 màu thương hiệu **chỉ** cho nút
  chính (của trang, hộp thoại, thanh điều hướng), badge đếm cần chú ý, nhãn "Mới" và gạch chân tab lớn đang chọn; mặt
  nền, chữ, đường viền, mục đang chọn và focus là xám trung tính của Semi, giống nhau cho mọi thương hiệu (`docs/TOKENS.md`).
- **Chữ trên nút luôn đạt chuẩn đọc rõ (WCAG AA, 4.5:1):** bộ sinh chọn chữ trắng, gần đen hoặc đen, và báo lỗi nếu chữ
  bạn tự chọn (`"on"`) không đạt.
- **Sản phẩm không thể đi lệch:** `semi-lint` chặn việc ghi đè màu thương hiệu trong sản phẩm (`brand-override`),
  `/semi-check` kiểm tra sản phẩm đang dùng đúng brand kit.
- **Agent viết đúng giọng thương hiệu:** trong sản phẩm, agent hỏi `semi_brand` trước khi viết chữ, đặt màu hay logo.

---

## Ví dụ từ đầu: thương hiệu 3D Noobs và app Manager

### Phần A — Tạo thương hiệu (làm một lần)

**Bước 1. Tạo repo trống cho brand kit**

```bash
mkdir -p ~/Development/3dnoobs-brand
```

Mở thư mục đó bằng Claude Code (hoặc agent có plugin `semi-design`).
👉 *Bạn làm:* tạo thư mục, mở nó. Không cần cài gì.

**Bước 2. Gõ `/semi-brand` và trả lời vài câu**

| Agent hỏi | Ví dụ trả lời | Ghi chú |
|---|---|---|
| Sản phẩm gì, cho ai, 3 từ tính cách | Phần mềm quản lý máy in 3D · maker 18–35 tuổi, dùng cả ngày trên máy tính · chính xác, thân thiện, kỹ thuật | Brief: agent dựa vào đây để gợi ý style, font, giọng văn (kèm lý do) |
| Tên thương hiệu, tên package | 3D Noobs · `@3dnoobs/brand` | Package là tên sản phẩm sẽ cài |
| Logo | `assets/logo.svg` (+ bản nền tối, biểu tượng vuông nếu có) | SVG: agent đọc màu từ file (`brand.mjs colors`); kit copy logo vào `dist/logo/` |
| Màu chính | `#00AE42` | Mã hex, hoặc lấy từ logo |
| Màu phụ | (bỏ qua) | Tuỳ chọn: nút chính thứ hai |
| Font | Geist (+ Montserrat Alternates cho hero, tab lớn) | Font giao diện bắt buộc; font hiển thị tuỳ chọn (không có thì dùng font giao diện). Chọn trong danh sách, hoặc tên một Google Font có tiếng Việt |
| Giọng văn | Thân thiện · gọi "bạn" · không emoji | Agent soạn nháp 2 nên / 2 không nên và câu mẫu cho nút, lỗi, trạng thái trống để bạn sửa |

Đã có `brand.json` (vd. copy từ trang Brand preview của docs bằng "Copy lệnh cho agent")? Dán vào `/semi-brand`: agent
lấy mọi lựa chọn trong đó và chỉ hỏi phần còn thiếu.

👉 *Bạn làm:* chọn. *Agent làm:* tạo repo kit (`package.json`, `brand.json`, workflow GitHub Pages), cài `@semi/ui`
và Next.js (cho trang preview), sinh `dist/`.

**Bước 3. Xem trước ngay trong repo brand và chỉnh**

Agent chạy trang preview **của chính repo brand** (`npm run preview`) và gửi link local:
**http://localhost:4600**. Trang dựng bằng `@semi/ui` thật cùng `brand.css` của kit và là một **brand book** có 3 tab:

- **Thương hiệu:** bìa (logo, tên, câu tagline, 3 từ tính cách trên nền màu chính), thương hiệu này là ai, logo (hai
  nền, khoảng trống, biểu tượng ở 16–48px, và những cách **không được làm**: kéo méo, đổi màu, xoay, thêm bóng, đặt trên
  nền rối), màu theo vai trò kèm **tỉ lệ màu trên một màn hình**, chữ (mẫu font có dấu tiếng Việt, câu tagline), giọng
  văn (nên / không nên, nút, lỗi, trạng thái trống ở sáng và tối), hình ảnh.
- **Ứng dụng:** dashboard, ứng dụng điện thoại, trang giới thiệu, email, mỗi màn ở sáng và tối, chữ theo giọng văn.
- **UI kit** (cho developer): màu nút chính, chữ trên nó và màu hover, cỡ chữ, bảng
  điểm đọc rõ, tải `brand.css`, `brand.json` và logo, cùng **toàn bộ component của Semi** (ví dụ, code, API).

Cả ba phần nằm chung một dashboard (menu bên trái, thanh tab dưới trên điện thoại), như trang component. Đổi sáng / tối
ở chân menu.

👉 *Bạn làm:* mở link, nhìn và nói điều muốn đổi ("màu chính đậm hơn", "bỏ font hiển thị"). *Agent làm:* sửa
`brand.json`, sinh lại; trang đang mở tự cập nhật.

Repo kit sau bước này:

```
brand.json          lựa chọn của bạn (file duy nhất người sửa)
dist/brand.css      sinh ra: màu nút chính / phụ, chữ trên nút, hover, font (đã kiểm tra đọc rõ)
dist/brand.json     sinh ra: toàn bộ giá trị + font để sản phẩm nạp
assets/             logo (bạn đưa vào)
dist/logo/          sinh ra: logo để sản phẩm import (@3dnoobs/brand/dist/logo/full.svg)
BRAND.md            sinh ra: guideline thương hiệu (brief, logo, cách dùng màu, giọng văn, hình ảnh, màu, đọc rõ)
AGENTS.brand.md     sinh ra: luật cho agent ở mọi sản phẩm (màu, font, logo, giọng văn, câu mẫu)
package.json        "@3dnoobs/brand", phụ thuộc "@semi/ui" (+ Next.js cho trang preview)
.github/workflows/brand-pages.yml   kiểm tra mỗi pull request; build trang preview và đăng lên GitHub Pages mỗi lần push lên main
.github/workflows/semi-update.yml   mỗi thứ Hai build lại kit với @semi/ui mới nhất; mở pull request khi màu, guideline hay luật đổi
.preview/           trang preview sinh ra khi chạy (không commit)
```

**Bước 4. Chốt, phát hành và xem online**

👉 *Bạn làm:* nói "ok, publish" và tạo repo GitHub cho kit (vd. `3dnoobs/brand`) nếu chưa có.
*Agent làm:* `npm run check`, commit, push, gắn tag `v1.0.0`, bật GitHub Pages cho repo (`brand.mjs pages`, nguồn:
GitHub Actions). Workflow `brand-pages.yml` build trang preview và đăng lên **https://&lt;owner&gt;.github.io/&lt;repo&gt;/**;
mỗi lần push lên main nó build lại. Từ đây 3D Noobs có bộ nhận diện riêng, ai cũng xem được online.

> Repo private: GitHub Pages cho repo private cần gói GitHub có hỗ trợ (Pro / Team / Enterprise). Không có thì để repo
> brand public (nó chỉ chứa màu, font, guideline), hoặc chỉ xem local.

### Phần B — Tạo app Manager

**Bước 5. Tạo thư mục trống và gõ**

```text
/semi-new-app --brand github:3dnoobs/brand
```

Agent hỏi tên app ("3D Noobs Manager"), loại sản phẩm
(công cụ dùng cả ngày · ứng dụng thường · web bán hàng · trang giới thiệu: quyết định màn đầu, mật độ, cỡ chữ và theme
mặc định), cùng phiên bản Next.js và kiểu export (thường để mặc định). Không hỏi màu, font: đã có trong brand.
👉 *Bạn làm:* trả lời vài câu.

**Bước 6. Agent dựng app**

Next.js + `@semi/ui` + `@3dnoobs/brand`, rồi nối sẵn:

```css
/* app/globals.css */
@import "tailwindcss";
/* semi-design-system:start */
@import "@semi/ui/tokens.css";
@import "@semi/ui/base.css";
@import "@3dnoobs/brand/dist/brand.css";
/* semi-design-system:end */
```

Thứ tự import là bắt buộc: `brand.css` **sau** `@semi/ui/tokens.css`. Kit ghi đè biến của Semi ở cùng độ ưu tiên
(specificity), nên file nhập sau mới thắng; nhập ngược thì màu nút chính và font của brand không có tác dụng.

```tsx
// app/layout.tsx: font của brand, mật độ đã chọn, theme mặc định theo loại sản phẩm
<html data-density="compact" className={`dark ${beVietnamPro.variable} ${montserratAlternates.variable}`}>
  <ThemeScript defaultTheme="system" />
```

Cùng với `semi-lint.json` (`"brand": "@3dnoobs/brand"`), luật Semi và luật của brand trong
`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` trỏ tới nó (`@AGENTS.md`, để Claude Code đọc), màn đầu theo loại sản phẩm (app quản lý:
AppShell có logo của brand, con số chính và các mục mẫu từ `brief.sample`; web bán hàng: thanh trên, hero, bằng chứng),
rồi kiểm tra `semi-lint` + `tsc` + build.
👉 *Bạn làm:* không gì cả, đợi báo xong.

**Bước 7. Phát triển như bình thường**

Bạn nói "làm trang quản lý đơn hàng"; agent dùng component Semi, màu 3D Noobs tự áp. Nếu ai đó viết `--semi-primary`
hay `--semi-…` trong CSS của app, `semi-lint` chặn (`brand-override`): màu chỉ đến từ brand.

### Phần C — Về sau

| Chuyện | Bạn làm | Ở đâu |
|---|---|---|
| Làm thêm app **Store** | `/semi-new-app --brand github:3dnoobs/brand` | Thư mục mới |
| 3D Noobs **đổi màu chính** | `/semi-brand` → "đổi primary sang `#00C853`" → xem trước → tag mới | Repo brand |
| … rồi đưa vào các app | `/semi-sync` (đổi màu thấy rõ: agent hỏi trước) | Từng app |
| **Semi** ra bản mới | Workflow `semi-update.yml` mở pull request nếu kit đổi (chỉ đổi số phiên bản thì không); duyệt rồi `/semi-brand update` để phát hành. Không có PR nghĩa là kit vẫn đúng, không cần phát hành | Repo brand |
| … rồi đưa vào các app | `/semi-sync` | Từng app |
| Kiểm tra định kỳ | `/semi-check` | Từng app |

---

## Khi nào dùng lệnh nào

| | `/semi-brand` · `/semi-brand update` | `/semi-sync` |
|---|---|---|
| Chạy ở | Repo **brand kit** | Repo **sản phẩm** |
| Làm gì | Tạo / sửa lựa chọn thương hiệu (`/semi-brand`); sinh lại kit cho bản Semi mới, không đổi lựa chọn (`/semi-brand update`) | Đưa sản phẩm lên `@semi/ui` và brand kit mới nhất tương thích, chạy migration, `tsc` |
| Đổi lựa chọn thương hiệu | `/semi-brand`: có · `update`: không | Không bao giờ |
| Sửa code sản phẩm | Không | Có (migration) |
| Kết quả | Kit có tag mới | Sản phẩm dùng bản mới |

Luôn đi **từ trên xuống**: Semi → brand kit → sản phẩm.

**Phiên bản brand kit:**

| Mức | Khi nào | `/semi-sync` ở sản phẩm |
|---|---|---|
| patch | Sinh lại, giao diện không đổi | Tự cập nhật |
| minor | Thêm lựa chọn (màu phụ, font hiển thị, token mới) | Tự cập nhật |
| major | Màu / font thương hiệu đổi, thấy rõ | Hỏi trước (`--accept-major`) |

Brand kit ghi nó chạy với `@semi/ui` nào (`"semi"` trong `brand.json`). `semi-brand` (create / update) ghi dải
`">=X.Y.0 <1.0.0"` (ví dụ `">=0.26.0 <1.0.0"`): "từ minor này trở lên, trước major kế tiếp". Semi chỉ đổi API ở bản
major, nên minor mới của 0.x an toàn cho brand và brand không cần phát hành lại cho mỗi minor. Dải chấp nhận:
`>=X.Y[.Z] <A.B[.C]` (cách nhau bởi dấu cách), `^X.Y.Z`, `~X.Y.Z`, `X.Y.Z`. Lưu ý `^0.24.0` (kiểu cũ) ghim đúng minor 0.24.

`/semi-sync` giữ Semi trong dải của brand (bản major mới vẫn bị chặn đến khi brand cập nhật dải) và **không bao giờ hạ cấp**:
nếu dải của brand thấp hơn bản `@semi/ui` đang cài (brand cũ ghi `^0.24.0`, app đã ở 0.26.0), nó giữ bản đang cài và cảnh báo
dải của brand cùng cách sửa: chạy `/semi-brand update` trong repo brand, phát hành, rồi `/semi-sync` lại.

---

## `brand.json`

```json
{
  "name": "3D Noobs",
  "package": "@3dnoobs/brand",
  "primary": "#00AE42",
  "secondary": null,
  "fonts": { "sans": "Geist", "display": "Montserrat Alternates" },
  "brief": {
    "product": "Phần mềm quản lý máy in 3D", "audience": "Maker 18–35 tuổi, dùng cả ngày trên máy tính",
    "personality": ["chính xác", "thân thiện", "kỹ thuật"], "tagline": "In 3D chính xác ngay lần đầu",
    "sample": {
      "list": "Bản in", "items": ["Móc khoá logo PLA đen", "Giá đỡ điện thoại gập được", "Chậu cây mini xoắn ốc"],
      "metric": { "label": "Bản in đang chạy", "value": "12", "sub": "3 máy rảnh" },
      "proof": { "label": "bản in đã giao cho người mới", "value": "12.000+" }
    }
  },
  "logo": { "full": "assets/logo.svg", "fullDark": "assets/logo-dark.svg", "mark": "assets/mark.svg" },
  "voice": {
    "tone": "friendly", "address": "bạn", "we": "3D Noobs", "emoji": false,
    "do": ["Gọi đúng tên máy in và vật liệu"], "dont": ["Dùng thuật ngữ G-code trong thông báo cho người mới"],
    "examples": { "button": ["In ngay", "Thêm máy in"], "error": "Máy in mất kết nối. Kiểm tra Wi‑Fi rồi thử lại.", "empty": "Chưa có máy in nào. Thêm máy in đầu tiên để bắt đầu." }
  },
  "imagery": "Ảnh bản in thật trên nền tối, chụp gần; không ảnh stock.",
  "semi": ">=1.0.0 <2.0.0"
}
```

| Khoá | Giá trị | Quy chuẩn |
|---|---|---|
| `name`, `package` | Tên hiển thị, tên npm (`@scope/brand`) | Bắt buộc |
| `primary` | Hex, hoặc `{ "color": "#hex", "on": "#hex" }` | Bắt buộc. Màu của nút chính, badge đếm cần chú ý, nhãn "Mới", gạch chân tab lớn đang chọn. Cùng một màu ở cả hai theme. `on` (tuỳ chọn) là chữ trên nút, phải đạt 4.5:1; bỏ qua thì bộ sinh chọn |
| `secondary` | Như `primary`, hoặc `null` | Tuỳ chọn: chỉ cho nút chính thứ hai (`bg-secondary` + `text-on-secondary`). Không có thì các token `secondary` lấy giá trị của `primary` |
| `fonts.sans` | Tên Google Font | Bắt buộc: font giao diện (`font-sans`) |
| `fonts.display` | Tên Google Font | Tuỳ chọn: font hiển thị (`font-display`) cho hero, tiêu đề trang đọc, tab lớn, tiêu đề mục kiểu tạp chí. Không có thì dùng font giao diện. Tiêu đề không đậm (400 / 500): font không có bản variable cần `"weight": ["400", "500"]` |
| `semi` | Dải phiên bản `@semi/ui` | `/semi-brand update` cập nhật |
| `brief` | `product`, `audience`, `personality` (1–5 tính từ), `tagline` (một câu, ≤ 90 ký tự); `sample`: `list` (tên danh sách chính), `items` (2–5 mục thật), `metric` (`{ label, value, sub? }`, con số người dùng mở app để xem), `proof` (`{ label, value }`, bằng chứng cho trang giới thiệu) | Tuỳ chọn; vào BRAND.md và luật cho agent ("chọn chữ, hình ảnh cho họ"). Thiếu `sample` thì build nhắc: màn mẫu của brand book và trang đầu của app mới dùng chữ của sản phẩm thay cho dữ liệu cửa hàng chung chung |
| `logo` | `full` (bắt buộc khi có logo), `fullDark`, `mark`: đường dẫn trong repo kit (.svg nên dùng, .png, .webp); `clearspace` (× chiều cao, mặc định 0.5), `minWidth` (px, mặc định 80) | Build copy vào `dist/logo/full.svg` … để sản phẩm import; thiếu file là lỗi |
| `voice` | `tone`: `friendly` · `neutral` · `formal`; `address` (gọi người dùng), `we` (tự xưng), `emoji`, `do`, `dont`, `examples` (`button`, `success`, `error`, `empty`, `confirm`) | Tuỳ chọn, mặc định trung tính, gọi "bạn". Luật viết chung của Semi (nút, lỗi, trạng thái trống) luôn kèm theo |
| `imagery` | Một đoạn mô tả ảnh / minh hoạ | Tuỳ chọn |

### Mật độ và cỡ chữ

**Mật độ và cỡ chữ không thuộc thương hiệu.** Một thương hiệu có nhiều sản phẩm: 3D Noobs có dashboard quản lý (cần
gọn) và web bán hàng (cần thoáng, chữ tiêu đề lớn). Mỗi sản phẩm tự chọn khi tạo bằng `/semi-new-app` (theo loại sản
phẩm), lưu ở `semi-lint.json` (`"density"`, `"typeScale"`) và `<html data-density data-type-scale>`; đổi sau bằng lời
("gọn hơn", "chữ tiêu đề to hơn"). Tab Ứng dụng của brand book cho thấy mỗi màn với lựa chọn thường gặp của nó. Quy
tắc bố cục đi kèm (tránh giao diện "AI" chung chung): `DESIGN_SYSTEM.md` §19.

### Semi sinh gì (1.0)

Từ 1.0 bộ sinh **chỉ** làm hai việc cho mỗi màu (`primary`, `secondary`), cùng một giá trị cho theme sáng và tối:

- **Chữ trên nút** (`on-primary`, `on-secondary`): `on` của `brand.json` nếu có (phải đạt 4.5:1, không thì báo lỗi), nếu
  không thì chữ trắng, rồi gần đen `#0c0d0e`, rồi đen: cái đầu tiên đạt 4.5:1 (luôn có một cái đạt).
- **Hover** (`primary-hover`, `secondary-hover`): cùng sắc, độ sáng OKLCH lệch `hoverStep` (0.06, `brand/params.mjs`)
  ra xa chữ trên nút (tối hơn dưới chữ trắng, sáng hơn dưới chữ tối), nên chữ vẫn đạt 4.5:1.
- **Chữ của nhãn “Mới”** (`new-tag-text-dark`, `new-tag-text-light`, 1.0 #146): nhãn là màu chính 18%; chữ là màu chính nếu
  đạt 4.5:1 trên nền đó (trên canvas, app, panel và card của theme), không thì màu chữ đậm của theme.

`dist/brand.css` chỉ đặt `--semi-primary`, `--semi-primary-hover`, `--semi-on-primary`, `--semi-secondary`,
`--semi-secondary-hover`, `--semi-on-secondary`, `--semi-new-tag-text-dark`, `--semi-new-tag-text-light` (trên `:root`, `[data-theme]`, `.dark`, `.light`) và
`--font-sans-family`, `--font-display-family` (chỉ khi có `fonts.display`). Không sinh thang màu, màu trung tính, chữ màu
chính, nền chọn, focus hay màu trạng thái: đó là của Semi, giống nhau cho mọi thương hiệu (`docs/TOKENS.md`).

**Báo cáo** (`dist/brand.json` → `report`, BRAND.md, trang preview): chữ trên nút và khi hover ≥ 4.5:1 (chặn build nếu
không đạt); "nút tách khỏi nền" (canvas, app, panel của cả hai theme) ≥ 3:1 là mục *lưu ý*, không chặn build. Kit chưa
có logo có cảnh báo.

**Khoá cũ trước 1.0** (`neutral`, `primaryStyle`, `styles`, `accent`, `palettes`, `color.accent`, `color.buttonText`,
`color.secondaryRole`, `fonts.figure`) không còn tác dụng: build vẫn chạy, mỗi khoá có một cảnh báo nói nó từng làm gì;
xoá chúng khỏi `brand.json`. **Mọi brand kit phải build lại và phát hành lại cho Semi 1.0** (`/semi-brand update`, rồi
tag mới): `brand.css` cũ đặt các biến mà 1.0 không còn đọc (`--semi-accent`, thang `--color-primary-*`, màu trung tính
theo style).

Con số duy nhất của cách sinh (`hoverStep`) nằm ở `brand/params.mjs`, giống nhau cho mọi thương hiệu. Người bảo trì Semi
thử nó trên trang **Design Lab** của docs, kèm so sánh trên các brand mẫu, trước khi đổi ([LAB.md](LAB.md)); đổi nó là
thay đổi core: mọi kit đổi màu hover khi build lại.

Chi tiết kỹ thuật: bộ sinh màu nằm ở `@semi/ui/brand` (`generateBrand`), lệnh trong kit là `semi-brand build | check`
(bin của `@semi/ui`). `check` bỏ qua dòng ghi phiên bản `@semi/ui` trong file sinh ra: bản Semi mới sinh cùng màu thì
kit không cần build lại hay phát hành.


---

<!-- docs/MIGRATION-1.0.md -->

# Migrating an app to Semi 1.0

Semi 1.0 is one breaking release: one look for every brand, pure neutral surfaces, the brand colour only for main
buttons and attention marks, a new type scale, a new shell, new tabs, quieter fields, new page layouts, a pinned search
bar and motion. This page is everything an app does to move from 0.x to 1.0, in order. Rules: `DESIGN_SYSTEM.md`.
Token names and values: `TOKENS.md`.

An agent with only this repo and `/semi-sync` must reach the same result as the owner's review: nothing here depends
on a conversation, private notes or access to a reference product. If a step is unclear, the docs are wrong: file it
with `/semi-propose`.

## How to migrate

1. **Rebuild the brand kit first** (an app with `"brand"` in `semi-lint.json`): in the brand repo, `/semi-brand update`
   strips the fields 1.0 no longer reads and rates the rebuild **major** (§ T1 below). Release the kit.
2. **Run `/semi-sync`** in the app (`--accept-major` for the kit, with the user's OK). It installs 1.0, rewrites the
   Semi block of `AGENTS.md`, prints the CHANGELOG of every skipped release and runs each release migration in version
   order (`node_modules/@semi/ui/migrations/1.0.0-*.mjs`). Each migration rewrites what it can and prints the rest as
   hand fixes (`file: message`).
3. **Do the hand fixes** the migrations printed (each ticket section below lists them and how to decide).
4. **Delete the app's stand-ins** that 1.0 replaces: the table at the end says which file or CSS rule goes and what
   replaces it. All T1–T9 replacements ship together in 1.0.0.
5. **Check:** `npx semi-lint`, `npx tsc --noEmit`, the build, then each key screen at 375px and 1280px in both themes:
   the first record visible without scrolling, one `h1`, at most one filled brand button per page or modal
   (`DESIGN_SYSTEM.md` §0 "Brand colour rule"). `npx semi density <url>` and `npx semi a11y <url>` clean.

## Status of the 1.0 tickets

| Ticket | What | Status | Migration script |
|---|---|---|---|
| T1 #141 | Foundation: tokens, one look, brand schema | merged on `main` (#154), unreleased: ships in 1.0.0 | `1.0.0-foundation` |
| T1b #155 | Two UI text sizes: `text-ui` 14 content, `text-chrome` 12 chrome | merged on `main` (#156), unreleased: ships in 1.0.0 | part of `1.0.0-foundation` |
| T2 #144 | Shell: frame, RouteHeader, nav, account avatar menu, shortcuts | merged on `main` (#159), unreleased: ships in 1.0.0 | `1.0.0-app-shell` |
| T3 #145 | Lint and checks for the 1.0 rules | merged on `main` (#169), unreleased: ships in 1.0.0 | — |
| T4 #146 | Buttons and attention marks | merged on `main` (#157), unreleased: ships in 1.0.0 | `1.0.0-buttons` |
| T5 #147 | Tabs: PillTabs, SegmentedControl, big TextTabs | merged on `main` (#164), unreleased: ships in 1.0.0 | `1.0.0-tabs` |
| T6 #148 | Fields and forms | merged on `main` (#165), unreleased: ships in 1.0.0 | — |
| T7 #149 | Page layouts and lists | merged on `main` (#166), unreleased: ships in 1.0.0 | — |
| T8 #150 | StickyContextBar pinning and actions | merged on `main` (#168), unreleased: ships in 1.0.0 | — |
| T9 #151 | Motion wiring | merged on `main` (#167), unreleased: ships in 1.0.0 | — |

All T1–T9 tickets are merged on `main` and ship together in `1.0.0`. Each section below lists what changed, what its
migration rewrites, the hand fixes, and the stand-ins it replaces.

## T1: foundation tokens (merged, ships in 1.0.0)

**What changed.** One look: the Flat / Sharp / Soft styles and `data-style` are gone. Surfaces, text, lines and focus
are pure neutral greys, the same for every brand. No colour is derived from the brand: the brand fills are only
`bg-primary` / `bg-secondary` (+ `text-on-*`), for the main button of a page, a modal or the nav, attention count
badges, "Mới" tags and the active big-tab underline. Headings are not bold (`font-title` 500). New type scale and
motion tokens. Full list: CHANGELOG "Unreleased" → "1.0 foundation".

**The migration (`1.0.0-foundation`) renames** these, in classes (any variant prefix, any `/opacity`) and in CSS
variable reads (`var(--semi-…)`, `var(--color-…)`, `var(--text-…)`):

| 0.x | 1.0 |
|---|---|
| `text-contrast` (also `--color-text-contrast`, `--semi-text-contrast`, `--color-contrast`) | `text-strong` (`--color-text-strong`, `--semi-text-strong`, `--color-strong`) |
| `accent-fg` (`text-accent-fg`, `border-accent-fg` …) | `strong` (flagged: brand-coloured text is gone) |
| `accent-subtle`, `accent-subtle-hover` | `item-selected` |
| `accent-line` | `outline-line` |
| `bg-accent`, `bg-action` (and `accent-hover`, `action-hover`, `on-accent`, `on-action`) | `bg-primary`, `primary-hover`, `on-primary` (flagged) |
| `text-accent`, `text-action` (and `placeholder-`, `caret-`, `fill-`, `stroke-`) | `*-strong` |
| `border-accent`, `divide-accent`, `ring-offset-accent` | `*-outline-line` |
| `ring-accent`, `outline-accent` | `ring-focus`, `outline-focus` |
| `decoration-accent` | `decoration-primary` (the active big-tab underline) |
| `accent-accent` | `accent-primary` (flagged) |
| `text-caption`, `text-label` | `text-chrome` (`text-label` flagged) |
| `text-copy` (main only, never released) | `text-ui` |
| `text-ui-lg`, `text-title`, `text-title-lg` | `text-lead` |
| `max-sm:text-title-lg` (a field's phone size) | `max-sm:text-input` |
| `text-heading-sm`, `text-heading` | `text-section` |
| `text-heading-lg`, `text-display` | `text-tab-xl` |
| `text-kpi` | `text-figure` |
| `data-style="…"` in JSX | removed |

`text-ui` is not renamed: it keeps its 14px as the content size.

**Removed without a rename** (the migration flags them, or `/semi-check` reports them): the `primary-50…900` brand
scale (`bg-primary-500`, `ring-primary-500/50` …), `tokens/styles/*.json` and `@semi/ui/styles.json`, `z-keypad`
(→ `z-sheet`), `"style"` / `"palette"` in `semi-lint.json` and `data-style` / `data-palette` on `<html>` (ignored;
`/semi-check` foundation removes them), Montserrat Alternates as the default display face.

**Hand fixes the migration prints:**

| Flag | Decide |
|---|---|
| `bg-accent → bg-primary` | A main button (the one commit action of the page or modal), the nav's main action (`mainAction`), an attention badge or tag: keep. A checked control or an "on" mark: `bg-inverted text-on-inverted`. A selected row or option: `bg-item-selected`. |
| `text-label → text-chrome` | Shell chrome or meta (a time, a count, a hint, a toolbar's compact button): keep. A form label, help text, list row or button text is content: `text-ui`. |
| `accent-fg → strong`, `accent-accent` | Links, check marks and active tabs are neutral now; a tinted checkbox or range is `bg-inverted`. |
| `primary-50…900` | `bg-primary` (main button, attention) or a neutral token (`bg-item-selected`, `border-outline-line`, `ring-focus`). Charts use `chart-1…8`. |
| `data-style` left in an expression or a CSS selector | Remove it: there is one look. |
| `app CSS sets --semi-X` / `--color-X` | Remove the declaration (`brand-override`). A brand colour goes in the brand kit; a surface, text or line token is Semi's. A removed name (`--semi-accent:`) is left as written and now sets nothing. |

**Brand kit.** `brand.json` keeps `primary` (required) and `secondary` (optional), each `"#hex"` or
`{ "color", "on" }`, `fonts.sans`, optional `fonts.display`, logo, voice and guide. `neutral`, `primaryStyle`, `styles`,
`accent`, `color.*`, `palettes` and `fonts.figure` are ignored with a warning: `/semi-brand update` removes them.
`BRANDS.md` has the schema.

**What the app deletes** (sales-hub v0.7.0 names; other apps check for the same kind of override):
- `app/semi-pending-neutral.css` and its import, and the lint `skip` entry that allowed it: the neutral greys are
  Semi's now.
- In the `TODO(semi-pending)` tail of `app/globals.css`: the rule that set content-panel heading weights
  (`.content-actions-inverse main :is(h1, h2, h3, h4, .font-title)`): `font-title` is 500 and headings use 400 / 500.
- Any app `@theme` or `:root` block that sets a `--semi-*` / `--color-*` surface, text or line token.

## T1b: content 14, chrome 12 (merged, ships in 1.0.0)

Owner decision C-011 (#155): content text is 14px (`text-ui`), only the shell chrome is 12px (`text-chrome`).
`text-ui` did not change, so apps' content text stays as it was. `text-caption` and `text-label` became `text-chrome`
(T1 table above); a `text-label` that is content goes back to `text-ui` by hand (the migration flags every file).
Which Semi piece uses which: `TOKENS.md` "Type scale". Phones: fields you type in are 16px below `sm`
(`max-sm:text-input`); touch rows stay 14.

**What the app deletes:** nothing. If the app made its content 12px to follow an early 1.0 draft, set it back to
`text-ui`.

## T2: shell (merged, ships in 1.0.0)

**What changed** (#144, CHANGELOG "1.0 shell"). `AppShell` is the 1.0 frame: a `bg-canvas` frame (8px from `sm`, none
on phones) with the nav panel (224px, or the 72px rail) and the content column, which holds the **RouteHeader**
(crumbs left, optional `middle`, `actions` and the account avatar menu right) above the `bg-panel` content card. The
nav: logo and collapse, the **main action**, the groups split by a 24px spacer with a `raised` line, group labels on
the new `text-nav-label` token (10 / 500 uppercase faint, the nav group label only), h32 items on
`bg-item-hover` / `bg-item-selected`, and a **bottom row** of 32×32 icon tools with count badges and a ••• menu. The
rail is the default between `lg` and 1280px (`railBelow`) and always between `md` and `lg`. Nav shortcuts ⌥ / Alt +
1–9. New: `RouteHeader`, `useRecordCrumb(label)`, `AccountMenu`, `Menu header`, `navShortcutKeys`, AppShell
`page="fixed"`, `flush`, `railBelow`, `railWidth`, `header`, `tools`, `toolsMenu`.

**The migration (`1.0.0-app-shell`) renames** at the tag's top level:

| 0.x | 1.0 |
|---|---|
| AppShell `create` (type `ShellCreate`) | `mainAction` (`ShellAction`; `ShellCreate` stays a deprecated alias) |
| AppShell / DocsShell `utilities` | `tools` (`ShellTool`: same id / label / icon / onClick / href / menu) |

**Hand fixes the migration prints:**

| Flag | Do |
|---|---|
| AppShell `account` / `footer` | The nav has no account block. Move who is signed in to the route header: `header={{ account: { name, detail, items, onSignOut } }}` (the menu also holds Light / Dark / System). Actions go to `tools` / `toolsMenu`. |
| `useThemeUtility()` next to a shell | Remove the theme item from `tools`: the theme is in the account menu (keep it only if the app has no account). |
| `storageKey` | The stored value is now `"rail"` / `"full"` (was `"1"` / `"0"`); AppShell upgrades a 0.x value once on load. Only app code that reads or writes the key changes. The default key is now `semi-nav` (the 0.x `semi_sidebar_collapsed` is upgraded and removed). |
| a tag with both the old and the new prop | Merge the old one into the new one. |
| a `{...spread}` on a shell tag, or a tag the script could not read to its end | Rename `create` → `mainAction` and `utilities` → `tools` by hand. |
| DocsShell `account` / `footer` | Deprecated: drawn compact in the route header; pass `actions` instead. |

Also by hand: give `<html>` `suppressHydrationWarning` (the nav's stored choice is set on it before paint); remove a
page's own breadcrumb at the top (the route header draws one: or pass `header={{ crumbs }}` / `header={false}`); a
detail page names its record with `useRecordCrumb(label)`.

**What the app deletes** (sales-hub v0.7.0): `app/components/semi-pending/ContentHeader.tsx` and its `useRecordCrumb`
(→ RouteHeader and Semi's `useRecordCrumb`); `NavBottomRow.tsx` (→ `tools` / `toolsMenu`); `navShortcuts.ts` and the
`[data-nav-num]` rules (→ AppShell shortcuts); in the globals tail `.nav-spaced` (group spacing), `.group-label`
(→ `text-nav-label`) and the 72px rail width; the account rendered in the rail (0.37 `account` render prop).

## T3: lint and checks (merged, ships in 1.0.0, #145)

**What changed** (#145, #142). `semi-lint` adds 1.0 warning rules (`one-brand-button`, `brand-colour-use`,
`removed-token`, `heading-weight`, refined `overline-place` allowing `<legend>` and flagging `<Field labelClassName="text-overline">`)
with per-line (`// semi-lint-allow <rule>: <reason>`) and per-file (`skip` with reason) opt-in allowances, plus `#142`
piped `--json` stdout flush (> 64 KB). `semi density` (`primary-actions`) counts `bg-primary` and `bg-secondary` and
scopes the nav (`<aside>` / `<nav>`) separately from the page; `semi a11y` keeps T6's quiet field edge acceptance and
documents the 44px phone touch target. `/semi-check` (`audit.mjs`) validates the 1.0 `brand.json` schema (`brand-schema`),
detects sales-hub-style stand-ins (`semi-pending-*.css`, `components/semi-pending/*`, `TODO(semi-pending)`) pointing to
this file, and counts `StickyContextBar` pages (#139). **Replaces:** no stand-in.

## T4: buttons and attention marks (merged, ships in 1.0.0)

**What changed** (#146). Ordinary actions are neutral; the brand fill is only for the main button (`DESIGN_SYSTEM.md`
§0). `Button` variants: `subtle` (**the default**, `bg-subtle-button`), `surface` (`bg-raised`: toolbar actions),
`inverse` (`bg-inverted`: a card's or a list title row's main action; `size="xs" shape="round"` is the pill), `outline`
(transparent, 1px `outline-line`), `ghost`, `primary` / `secondary` (**brand** fills: `secondary` is the brand secondary,
the primary when the brand has none), `danger`. Sizes `xs` 24 · `sm` 28 · `md` · `modal`. Hover in 150ms, a 2px focus
outline, disabled neutral. On a phone with a touch screen every button is at least 44 × 44px as its **real size**
(`BTN_HIT`, `pointer-coarse` + `max-sm`), never a pseudo-element that could cover a neighbour. New: `CountBadge` (brand
fill, "99+", `tone="neutral"` for a plain count), Button `badge` (a count at an icon button's corner: it is
`aria-hidden`, so say the count in `aria-label`; without one, Button adds it as screen-reader-only text), `NewTag`
("Mới"), `BTN_SUBTLE`, `BTN_SURFACE`, `BTN_INVERSE`, `BTN_XS`, `MODAL_BTN_SUBTLE` / `_SURFACE` / `_INVERSE` / `_GHOST`,
`buttonClass()`.

**The migration (`1.0.0-buttons`) renames** (only literal attributes of components imported from `@semi/ui`):

| 0.x | 1.0 |
|---|---|
| `<Button variant="secondary">`, `<SplitButton variant="secondary">` (the neutral tint) | `variant="subtle"` (or drop it: `subtle` is the default) |
| `BTN_SECONDARY` | `BTN_SUBTLE` |
| `MODAL_BTN_SECONDARY` | `MODAL_BTN_SUBTLE` |

**Hand fixes the migration prints:**

| Flag | Do |
|---|---|
| a variant chosen in an expression, in a file that names `"secondary"` | `"secondary"` is now the brand secondary fill: use `"subtle"` for a neutral button. |
| a wrapper typed with `ButtonVariant` that passes the variant on | Its callers' `"secondary"` is now the brand fill: change them to `"subtle"`. |
| `Button` imported under another name (`as`, `import * as`) | Not rewritten: rename its `secondary` by hand. |
| `<X variant="secondary">` that is not a Semi Button / SplitButton | If it wraps `Button`, the same: `"subtle"` for neutral. |
| `variant="outline"` | Now transparent with a 1px `outline-line` (no field fill): check it on its surface, or use `subtle` / `surface`. |

Also by hand: keep **one** filled brand button per page or modal; a list title row's "Thêm" is `inverse` unless it is the
page's commit action; an icon button's count moves to Button `badge` (or `CountBadge`), with the count in its
`aria-label`; a "Mới" tag becomes `NewTag`.

**What the app deletes** (sales-hub v0.7.0): in the globals tail `.content-actions-inverse .bg-action` (the forced
inverse main button) and the `content-actions-inverse` class where it only served that: use `variant="inverse"`.

## T5: tabs (merged, ships in 1.0.0)

**What changed** (#147, #121). Three tab controls with one clear rule (`DESIGN_SYSTEM.md` §0, §4h):
- **`PillTabs` (new):** default for 5+ sections of a page or sections with icons (settings-like pages). No track, h30
  round pills (16px icon + 4px + 12px/600 label), sliding `item-hover` pill in 300ms (`transition-slide`), `tablist` /
  `tab` / `tabpanel` (`id`, `aria-controls`, `aria-labelledby`), roving `tabIndex`, ←/→, Home / End.
- **`SegmentedControl` (new):** 2–5 filter values shown in full, with optional tabular-nums counts. `raised` track
  (radius 8, padding 4, gap 4, h32), h24 items (12px/600), sliding solid `raised-2` pill (white in light theme) in
  300ms, `radiogroup` / `radio`, ←/→, ↑/↓, Home / End.
- **Big `TextTabs` (updated):** strictly 2–4 top-level views of a discovery or reading page. `font-display text-tab-xl
  font-normal` (24px below `sm`, 28px from `sm`, weight 400 in the brand display face), every tab in `text-strong`,
  inactive `opacity-20` (hover raises opacity in 150ms, keyboard focus restores full opacity), active 2px brand
  underline (`decoration-primary`) at 6px offset under the word only, gaps 16 / 20 / 24, 28px to the intro below.
- **Shared across all three:** sideways scroll with no scrollbar, 2px `bg-outline-line` overflow edge cue
  (`data-edges`), `activation="manual"`, sync/async `onBeforeChange(key)` honoured by both button and `href` tabs,
  **`useTabParam`** (`?tab=` URL state via `urlState.ts` without pushing a history entry per arrow key), and
  `prefers-reduced-motion` turning off sliding pills and edge-cue fades.
- **Removed in 1.0 (#173):** `Pills` → `SegmentedControl` / `PillTabs`, `PageTabsTitle` → `TextTabs`, and
  `Tabs variant="segmented"` → `SegmentedControl` (`Tabs` is now underline-only for sections of one record inside a
  card or dialog). `ViewSwitch` is **kept** (icon-only list ↔ grid + density toggle); the old `TextTabs` look is
  replaced in place.

**The migration (`1.0.0-tabs`) flags** removed `Pills`, `PageTabsTitle`, `Tabs variant="segmented"`, and any
leftover `.text-tabs-strong` stand-in rules for hand migration (because `SegmentedControl` and `PillTabs` require an
accessible `label`).

**What the app deletes** (sales-hub v0.7.0): `app/components/semi-pending/PillTabs.tsx` (note: the stand-in took `tabs={…}` while Semi 1.0 `PillTabs` takes `items={…}`),
`app/components/semi-pending/SegmentedControl.tsx`, and `.text-tabs-strong` in the `TODO(semi-pending)` tail of
`app/globals.css`.

## T6: fields and forms (merged, ships in 1.0.0)

**What changed** (#148). Every text-like field (`Input`, `NumberInput`, `Textarea`, `HintTextarea`, `CustomSelect`,
`CustomCombobox`, `MultiCombobox`, `DatePicker`, `SearchInput`, `SearchPill`, `Command`, `InputGroup`, `InputOTP`) moves
to the quiet 1.0 style (`bg-field`, 1px `border-field-line`, `rounded-control`; on focus `border-field-line-focus` +
`bg-field-focus`, no glow ring; keyboard-only 2px `outline-focus` outline). `semi a11y` accepts the quiet field edge
(< 3:1 by owner choice) when the 2px ≥ 3:1 `:focus-visible` outline exists. `text-overline` is allowed for form/detail
section labels (never a single field's `<label>`) and does not force `display: flex`. New: `MultiCombobox` (searchable
multi-select with removable chips, IME-safe/diacritic-aware search, option groups), `CustomCombobox` option groups
(`group`), `OptionCards` (`radiogroup`/`radio`, neutral `item-selected`, 8px gap), `LetterAvatar` (and `Avatar
initials={1}` / `tone="neutral"`, wired into `AccountMenu`), `Textarea` / `HintTextarea` reply-box `autoGrow` +
`resizable` top `role="separator"` edge (md+, phones auto-grow only), `HintTextarea` Popover engine (portaled at
`z-popover`, flips above) + `HintToken.insert` / `showValue` + value truncation, `Modal` / `Drawer` physical-keyboard
autofocus (`autoFocusFirstField`, opt-out `false`) and `focusFirstField(root)`.

**What the app deletes:** `app/components/semi-pending/MultiCombobox.tsx` → `MultiCombobox`; `LetterAvatar.tsx` →
`LetterAvatar`; `autofocus.ts` → `Modal` / `Drawer` autofocus + `focusFirstField(root)`; `ProviderCards` → `OptionCards`;
reply-box drag → `Textarea` / `HintTextarea` `autoGrow` + `resizable`; the `.border-control-line` override in the
globals tail.

## T7: page layouts and lists (merged, ships in 1.0.0)

**What changed** (#149, CHANGELOG "1.0 page layouts and lists"). New `Page` (`layout="work" | "reading" | "two-column"`, `fixed`, shared anatomy slots `title` / `actions` / `tabs` / `intro` / `toolbar` / `children` / `footer` owning the 32 / 28 / 32 / 16 / 8 vertical rhythm), `SubNav` (240px sub-nav card, 20 / 10 padding, `text-nav-label` group labels with optional 16px icon actions, h32 items, 1px `bg-raised` dividers), `PageSection` (20/500 heading + 16px content gap), `PageGrid` (8px `@container` grid), `ListReaderLayout` + `ReaderHeader` (two independent scrollers on `fixed` mode, `?open=`, `useRecordCrumb`, phone swap with Back, sticky one-row header with wrapping title left and `[•••]` + one main action right), and `useListSelection`. `PageTitle` becomes 18 / 400 UI sans on the action row (`variant="reading"` opts into 44 / 500 `text-title-xl` display on one-column reading pages). `FilterChipRow` and `PhoneFilterBar` gain `sort` and in-place `selection` (`"n đã chọn"` 600 + `•••` + at most one filled bulk button + `"Xong"`, zero list shift); `ResultLine` is removed in 1.0 (#173, replaced by `FilterChipRow` / `PhoneFilterBar` `sort` and `selection`); `DataTable` gains `activeRowId` (`bg-item-selected`); `Card` and `Item` gain non-nested `selectable` / `checked` / `onCheckedChange` / `selected`. `WorkspaceLayout.action` is optional, `SplitButton` gains `fullWidth`, and `PageSkeleton` gains `shape="workspace"`.

**What the app deletes** (sales-hub v0.7.0): in the globals tail the flush container (`main#main > div`), `.page-title-row` and `.content-card h1`, `.page-column*`, `.list-*`, and hand-built selection rows.

## T8: StickyContextBar pinning and URL state (merged, ships in 1.0.0)

**What changed** (#150, #129, #124, #139, CHANGELOG "1.0 StickyContextBar pin behaviour").
- **`StickyContextBar` layout-pin & focus-pin:** pins when scrolling past the bar or focusing the search text field (250ms ease-out, instant under reduced motion, cancelled by wheel/touch; works on short lists; filter chips, sort and view buttons do not pin). From `md` (768px), pins by layout (`data-sticky-host`, `--sticky-pin`, `--sticky-view`, `overscroll-behavior: contain` on `[data-page-body]` or `ListReaderLayout` panels) so trackpad momentum and flings never unpin and only a new upward wheel gesture (> 200ms idle) from the list top unpins. Filter, sort, search, selection-mode and data changes keep pinned/unpinned state. Exposes `data-stuck` and `data-searching` and clears all attributes/vars on unmount. Below `md`, keeps native scrolling and touch behaviour.
- **`BarActions` & `BarAction`:** pass `<BarActions actions={…} menu={…} />` in `SearchPill`'s `trailing` slot to show up to 2 icon-button slots with tooltips in title-row order (`[•••][main action]`, 8px apart) while pinned and not searching (150ms fade, opacity-only under reduced motion, out of flow and out of the accessibility tree when hidden).
- **URL state (`useFilterParams`, `filterParams`, `urlState`, `DataTable`):** `useFilterParams` gains `legacy` (one-time post-hydration rewrite via `replaceState`, zero history entries), `patch(values, mode)` (multi-filter change in one history entry) and URL-backed `?sort=key.dir` (`sort`, `setSort`, `sortDef` shared by `FilterChipRow`, `PhoneFilterBar`, `FilterPanel` and `DataTable`, plus `readSort`, `writeSort`, `parseSort`, `formatSort`, `SORT_PARAM`); `replaceFilters` and `writeSearch` exported from `@semi/ui`; `DataTable` gains `onResultsChange` alongside `sortRows` / `searchRows`; `FilterPanel` `single` radio groups write with `"replace"` and label `role="radiogroup"` directly; an empty `single` `FilterChip` is disabled.

**What the app deletes** (sales-hub v0.7.0): `app/components/semi-pending/BarActions.tsx`,
`app/components/semi-pending/stickyBar.ts`, and in the `TODO(semi-pending)` tail of `app/globals.css`: `.bar-actions`,
`[data-page="fixed"|"list"]` scroll rules, and `.content-card [role="search"]`.

## T9: motion wiring (merged, ships in 1.0.0)

**What changed** (#151, CHANGELOG "1.0 motion wiring"). Wires T1's motion tokens (`TOKENS.md` "Motion") across Semi components:
- **`PageEnter` & `<Page enter>`:** `display: contents` route-level wrapper (keyed by `usePathname()` or custom `routeKey`) that runs `motion-enter` (400ms, opacity + translateY 4px → 0) and `motion-stagger` (35ms per item, capped at the first 10 rows/cards) once per route — never replays on filter, search, sort or `?tab=` changes, and never animates rows arriving after `windowMs` (default 1000ms).
- **Component wiring:** `Skeleton` / `PageSkeleton` / `.shimmer` pulse quietly with `motion-pulse` (2.5s, opacity 1 → 0.6 → 1, stops under reduced motion); `Tooltip` enters with `animate-tooltip-in` (200ms, opacity + scale 0.96 → 1); `Accordion` / `Collapsible` use `--motion-disclosure` (300ms ease-out) and `--motion-disclosure-close` (300ms ease-in) with `inert` + `aria-hidden` while closed; interactive elements use `transition-hover` (150ms) instead of hard-coded durations; under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, all entrances animate opacity only and skeleton pulse stops. The shell never remounts or moves on a route change.

**What the app deletes** (sales-hub v0.7.0): `app/semi-pending-motion.css` and its local `PageEnter` stand-in (use `@semi/ui`'s `PageEnter` or `<Page enter>` and T1's motion tokens).

## Stand-ins and their replacements

The sales-hub v0.7.0 stand-ins (the app that found these gaps), one row each. Other apps look for the same kind of
local code. All T1–T9 replacements ship in `1.0.0`.

| Stand-in | Replacement | Shipped in |
|---|---|---|
| `app/semi-pending-neutral.css` (+ its lint skip) | T1 neutral tokens | T1 (merged, in 1.0.0) |
| globals tail: content-panel heading weights | `font-title` 500, headings 400 / 500 | T1 (merged, in 1.0.0) |
| `semi-pending/ContentHeader.tsx` + `useRecordCrumb` | RouteHeader, `useRecordCrumb` | T2 (merged, in 1.0.0) |
| `semi-pending/NavBottomRow.tsx` | AppShell `tools` / `toolsMenu` | T2 (merged, in 1.0.0) |
| `semi-pending/navShortcuts.ts`, `[data-nav-num]` | AppShell nav shortcuts | T2 (merged, in 1.0.0) |
| globals tail: `.nav-spaced`, `.group-label`, rail width | AppShell nav, `text-nav-label` | T2 (merged, in 1.0.0) |

<!-- docs/TOKENS.md -->

# Tokens (1.0 foundation)

The names every component and app uses from 1.0. Values live in `tokens/tokens.json` (edit there, then
`npm run build:tokens`); this page is the contract the 1.0 tickets build on. Components and apps use the semantic
utilities only, never a hex.

One look for every brand: the Flat / Sharp / Soft styles and `data-style` are gone. A brand changes only its two fills,
its fonts, its logo and its voice (`docs/BRANDS.md`).

## Surfaces: pure neutral, the same for every brand

| Utility | Role | Dark | Light |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bg-canvas` | page background, frame around the panels | #101010 | #ebebeb |
| `bg-app` | content column, holds the route header; the panel colour inside the AppShell content card (`SHELL_CARD` sets `--semi-app: var(--semi-panel)`), so sticky strips on `bg-app` match the card | #161616 | #f3f3f3 |
| `bg-panel` | nav panel, content card, sub-nav card, modal, popover | #1a1a1a | #ffffff |
| `bg-field` | input fill at rest | #222222 | #ffffff |
| `bg-field-focus` | input fill on focus (one step darker) | #161616 | #f7f7f7 |
| `bg-raised` | segmented track, toolbar buttons, nav group dividers | #2b2b2b | #e6e6e6 |
| `bg-raised-2` | active pill of a segmented control (on `raised`) | #424242 | #ffffff |

Kept from 0.x (neutral, derived from the above): `bg-panel-0…4`, `bg-card`, `bg-card-field`, `bg-tint` /
`bg-tint-hover` (until the 1.0 buttons replace them with `subtle-button`), `bg-inverted` / `bg-inverted-hover` /
`text-on-inverted` (the opposite of the page: checked controls, the inverse button).

## Text tiers

| Utility | Use | Dark | Light |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text-strong` | titles, active items, values | #f5f5f5 | #111111 |
| `text-body` | card text, body | #e3e3e3 | #2b2b2b |
| `text-muted` | descriptions, inactive tabs / nav, breadcrumb, placeholders | #b1b1b1 | #4f4f4f |
| `text-faint` | group labels, kbd hints, "Untitled" | #8a8a8a | #656565 |

Every tier reaches 4.5:1 on `panel`, `app`, `canvas` and `bg-card` in its theme; `text-strong`, `text-body` and
`text-muted` also on `bg-card-field`, `bg-raised` and on `bg-item-hover` / `bg-item-selected` / `bg-item-checked` over
the panel and over the card (a checked or selected row in a card table). The token build checks every pair
(`scripts/token-css.mjs` `aaErrors` resolves the `color-mix()` surfaces and composites the translucent fills) and a
failing value fails `npm run build:tokens` and `npm run check`. `text-faint` is for the page surfaces and the card
only: on `bg-card-field`, `bg-raised` or an item fill use `text-muted` or stronger. The muted and faint values are the
lightest (light) / darkest (dark) greys that pass all of these (worst pair about 4.55:1: muted on a selected row in a
card, faint on the card). Known limit (not checked): an item fill is only checked over panel and card; `text-muted` on `bg-item-selected`
over `bg-raised` or `bg-card-field` is about 4.0:1 in dark, so a selected row never sits on those two surfaces.

`text-strong` replaces `text-contrast`. The contrast colour itself (pure white in dark, pure black in light) is the
private `--semi-contrast`, which every line and fill below mixes; it has no utility.

## Lines and fills (from the contrast colour)

| Utility | Use | Dark | Light |
|---|---|---|---|
| `border-field-line` | input border at rest | white 10% | black 10% |
| `border-field-line-focus` | input border on focus | white 25% | black 25% |
| `border-outline-line` | outline buttons, a selected card's border | white 20% | black 20% |
| `bg-item-hover` | hover on rows, nav and sub-nav items | white 5% | black 9% |
| `bg-item-selected` | selected nav / sub-nav item, selected row (the open record), selected option | white 15% | black 15% |
| `bg-item-checked` | checked rows / cards in selection mode | white 9% | black 12% |
| `bg-subtle-button` | ordinary content button fill | white 5% | black 5% |

Light item fills step hover < checked < selected and each is visible on a card (composited black over `bg-card`
#e3e3e3, ratio against the card; over the panel about the same): hover 9% #cfcfcf 1.21:1 · checked 12% #c8c8c8
1.30:1 · selected 15% #c1c1c1 1.40:1. In 0.x / the first 1.0 draft they were 4% (1.09:1), 5% (1.11:1) and 6%
(1.14:1), hard to tell from the card and from each other; the light `text-muted` went to #4f4f4f so it still reaches
4.5:1 on a selected row in a card.

Kept: `border-line`, `border-line-hover`, `border-divider`, `border-control-line` (checkboxes, radios; the 1.0 fields
move to `field-line`). Focus is neutral: `ring-focus` / `border-focus` are the strong text colour (≥ 3:1 on every
surface), never the brand.

There is no brand-derived colour anywhere: `accent`, `accent-hover`, `on-accent`, `action*`, `accent-fg`,
`accent-subtle(-hover)`, `accent-line` and the `primary-50…900` brand scale are removed.

## Brand fills: main buttons and attention only

| Utility | Use |
|---|---|
| `bg-primary` / `hover:bg-primary-hover` / `text-on-primary` | the one main button of a page, a modal or the nav; attention count badges, "New" tags, the active big-tab underline (`decoration-primary`) |
| `bg-secondary` / `hover:bg-secondary-hover` / `text-on-secondary` | the secondary main button, only when the brand has a secondary (otherwise it equals primary) |
| `bg-new-tag` / `text-on-new-tag` | the "Mới" / "New" tag (`NewTag`, `NEW_TAG`): the primary at 18%; its text is the primary where that reaches 4.5:1 on the tag over canvas, app, panel and card, else the strong text, per theme (`new-tag-text-dark` / `-light`: the token build checks Semi's default, the brand generator picks a kit's). Semi's default green is not AA on its tint over the dark card, so the default text is the strong text in both themes |
| `COUNT_BADGE` (`CountBadge`, Button `badge`) | an attention count: `bg-primary` + `text-on-primary`, `text-badge`, "99+" cap; a plain count is `tone="neutral"` (`bg-raised` + strong text) |

Buttons (1.0, #146): `subtle` = `bg-subtle-button` (hover `tint-hover`), `surface` = `bg-raised` (hover `raised-2`), `inverse` = `bg-inverted` + `text-on-inverted`, `outline` = transparent + `border-outline-line`, `ghost` = `item-hover` on hover, `primary` / `secondary` = the brand fills, `danger` = the danger status fill (hover `danger-bg-hover`); disabled = `bg-subtle-button` + `text-muted` for every variant. The token build checks each variant's text on its fill and hover fill (and the count badge and New tag) at 4.5:1 over canvas, app, panel and card in both themes (`buttonAaErrors`).

Nothing else in Semi uses the brand colour. The brand kit sets the fills; the generator checks 4.5:1 for the text on
each and picks the on-colour. Status colours (`*-fg`, `*-bg`, `*-border`, `*-solid` for danger, success, warning, info)
and `text-tone-*` are one fixed palette for every brand. Their text (light: the 800 shade; dark: 300 / 400) reaches
4.5:1 on its own tint (`*-bg`, `bg-<hue>-500/10`) over every surface, a card and the field in a card included.

## Type scale

`text-*` sizes carry their line height (and, where noted, weight and tracking); `leading-*` / `font-*` override.

| Utility | Size | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `text-hero` | 36, 32 below sm · lh 1.1 · −0.01em | hero (`font-display`, 400) |
| `text-title-xl` | 44 · lh 1.2 · −0.01em | title of a one-column reading page (`font-display`, 500) |
| `text-tab-xl` | 28, 24 below sm · lh 1.2 · −0.01em | big text tabs (`font-display`) |
| `text-section` | 20 · 500 · lh 1.3 · −0.01em | section heading |
| `text-figure` | 18 · lh 1.25 | numeric figures; the page title in a content card (400) |
| `text-lead` | 15 · lh 24 | lead text, card titles |
| `text-input` | 16 · lh 24 | text you type in, below `sm` only (`max-sm:text-input`): iOS zooms into a field under 16px |
| `text-ui` | **14 · lh 22, the content size** (13 compact) | list and table rows, form labels and help text, field values and placeholders, buttons, menu items, dialog text, body and reading copy |
| `text-chrome` | **12 · lh 18, the shell chrome size** | nav items, group-label rows, breadcrumb, route-header and toolbar compact buttons (`BTN_SM`), meta (timestamps, counts, hints, captions), kbd and the "/" hint, tooltips, status pills and badges |
| `text-tag` | 10 · 500 · +0.02em | tags, chips |
| `text-badge` | 10 · 700 · lh 1 | count badges only |
| `text-overline` | 11 · 600 · +0.1em · uppercase | section labels |
| `text-nav-label` | 10 · 500 · normal tracking · uppercase · `text-faint` | AppShell nav and `SubNav` group labels |

Two sizes for UI text (C-011, #155): **content is 14px, only the shell chrome is 12px.** 12px suits the frame around the
work (nav, breadcrumb, toolbars, meta), but dense content at 12px reads poorly, Vietnamese diacritics most of all.
`text-ui` keeps its pre-1.0 name and size (14px), so apps' content text does not change; `text-chrome` is new. When
unsure, it is content: `text-ui`. (The 14px size is not called `text-body`: that is the body text colour, and one
Tailwind `text-*` name cannot be both a size and a colour.)

Which Semi piece uses which: **`text-chrome`**: the AppShell sidebar (nav items, sub-items, group labels, product name,
create button, utilities), Breadcrumb, Kbd and SearchPill's "/" hint, the command palette's group labels, hints and
footer, `BTN_SM`, `headerPrimary`, Badge, `STATUS_PILL` / `BADGE_BASE` / `COUNT_PILL` / `TAG`, Tooltip, the Menubar,
ThemeToggle, table header cells, chart axes and tooltip labels, calendar weekday row, counts and timers (Tabs, Item meta,
FileDrop sizes, DetailOverlay position, TaskHost timer, FilterChipRow / FilterPanel counts), menu-item descriptions and
shortcuts, Separator labels, field-row hints of HintTextarea, MobileTabBar labels. **`text-ui`**: everything else that
is UI text: buttons (`BTN_*`, `MODAL_BTN_*`), Field labels, help and errors, inputs and placeholders, select / combobox /
menu items, list and table rows (DataTable's folded column values too), dialogs and their subtitles (Modal,
DetailOverlay, the WorkspaceLayout header), a field's help line (HintTextarea's hint under the field), toasts, empty
states, disclosure, chat, NavigationMenu (the marketing nav, phone sheet included: it is not the shell), the phone
drawer of the shell (touch rows stay 14).

**Kept at 12 as chrome or compact controls** (owner's call, #155 review; say so to move one to 14): table header cells
(`TABLE_HEAD_CELL`, DataTable's head), `BTN_SM` (the compact toolbar button), `headerPrimary` (the main action in an app
header).

Weights: headings are not bold. 400 and 500 do almost everything (`font-title` is 500); 600 only for overlines and a
few emphasised labels; 700 only in count badges. Phones: fields you type in stay 16px below `sm` (`text-input`, iOS zoom) and touch
targets stay 44px.

Density and type scale (`data-density`, `data-type-scale` on `<html>`): compact sets `text-ui` 13 and `text-lead`
14; the contrast type scale raises figure 22, section 24, tab-xl 32, title-xl 52, hero 44 (hero and tab-xl still step
down below sm).

Removed sizes and their 1.0 names (the `1.0.0-foundation` migration rewrites them): `text-caption`, `text-label` →
`text-chrome` (a `text-label` is flagged: a form label, help text or row is content, `text-ui`); `text-ui` is unchanged; `text-ui-lg`, `text-title`, `text-title-lg` → `text-lead` (`max-sm:text-title-lg`, the phone size of a field, → `max-sm:text-input`); `text-heading-sm`, `text-heading` →
`text-section`; `text-heading-lg`, `text-display` → `text-tab-xl`; `text-kpi` → `text-figure`.

## Fonts

| Utility | Face |
|---|---|
| `font-sans` | the UI face (brand `fonts.sans`, default Geist) |
| `font-display` | the brand display face (`fonts.display`); without one it is the UI sans |
| `font-mono` | code |

## Shape

The one look's radii, card shadow and border, control sizes and spacing unit are the `shape` group of
`tokens/tokens.json`: `rounded-chip` 4 · `rounded-control` 8 · `rounded-card` 12 · `rounded-panel` 16, `shadow-card`
(none), `border-card` (transparent 1px), `h-control` 34, `h-field` 36, `font-title` 500, `font-figure` (big numbers, the sans), the density unit `--spacing`.

## Motion

Each token is a duration and an easing, usable in a `transition` or `animation` shorthand
(`transition: background-color var(--motion-hover)`). Components wire these tokens across hover, page enter (`PageEnter` / `Page enter`), skeletons (`Skeleton` / `PageSkeleton`), `Tooltip`, `Accordion` / `Collapsible`, `RouteHeader`, and sliding tabs (#151).

| Token | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `--motion-hover` | 150ms ease-in-out | colours on hover / active (`transition-hover`) |
| `--motion-nav` | 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) | nav active background (`transition-nav`) |
| `--motion-crumb-in` | 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) | breadcrumb entering: opacity + translateX(−6px → 0) (`animate-crumb-in`) |
| `--motion-crumb-out` | 160ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,1,1) | breadcrumb leaving |
| `--motion-enter` | 400ms cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94) | content entering: opacity + translateY(4px → 0) (`animate-enter`) |
| `--motion-stagger` | 35ms | per item, first ~10 items, once per route |
| `--motion-pulse` | 2.5s ease-in-out | skeleton opacity 1 → 0.6 → 1 (`animate-pulse`) |
| `--motion-tooltip` | 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) | opacity + scale(0.96 → 1) (`animate-tooltip-in`) |
| `--motion-disclosure` / `--motion-disclosure-close` | 300ms ease-out / ease-in | disclosure open / close |
| `--motion-slide` | 300ms ease-out | sliding active pill (`transition-slide`) |

Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` every entrance is opacity only (no translate, no scale, no slide) and skeleton pulse stops.

<!-- plugin/rules/AGENTS.md -->

<!-- semi-design-system:start -->
# Semi Design System — UI Rules

All web UI here follows the **Semi Design System** (`@semi/ui`, repo `https://github.com/hoanghuynh296/semi-nextjs-codebase`). `npx semi-lint` enforces most of this; the full rules are `node_modules/@semi/ui/docs/QUICK_REF.md` (details in `docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md`).

**Semi 1.0 in short** (`DESIGN_SYSTEM.md` §0): one look for every brand; neutral grey surfaces; **the brand colour only on the one main button of a page or modal (at most one filled brand button per page or modal), the nav's main action, the active big-tab underline, attention badges / "Mới" tags, or a case the app's owner asks for**, every other action a neutral button; headings 400 / 500, never bold; content text 14px (`text-ui`), shell chrome 12px (`text-chrome`), fields 16px on phones. Upgrading from 0.x: `docs/MIGRATION-1.0.md`.

1. **Ask Semi before writing UI.** Find the component for each need with the `semi` MCP tools (`semi_search` → `semi_docs` → `semi_example`; `semi_block` for whole pages; `semi_props` for props) or the terminal (`npx semi search "bảng có sắp xếp"`, `npx semi docs DataTable`, `npx semi example data-table`, `npx semi add dashboard`). They answer from the installed `@semi/ui`. Read *When to use*, *Use something else when* and *Accessibility*, then start from an example.
2. **Compose, never re-create.** Import from `@semi/ui` and `@semi/ui/styles` directly. No local wrappers (`components/ui.tsx`), no raw `<select>`, `<table>`, `<dialog>`, `type="date"`, `type="number"`, `window.confirm` / `alert`, no inline `<svg>` or glyph icons (`<Icon name>`, mapping in `docs/ICONS.md`). Every AI conversation is `AIChat`; agent work uses `Reasoning`, `ToolCall`, `TaskList`, `Terminal`, `Sources`; an outward-facing, paid or irreversible agent action waits for `ActionConfirmation`. Pages sit in `AppShell` (or `AppHeader` for a one-screen tool) with `PageTitle` (or the title on the toolbar row: `SubpageToolbar title`, or `TextTabs` for 2–4 sub-pages; a detail page opens with `MinimalHeader`); the shell's one brand-filled action is `mainAction`, its bottom row is `tools` (+ `toolsMenu`), the account (with the theme) is the route header's avatar menu (`header.account`; the nav has no account), and phones use its drawer; sub-views of one area go in nav `children` (closed until the parent is chosen, optional grey icon, no colour or count; check `useAppShell().submenuVisible` and add a page picker when false); a list page that people search and filter opens with `StickyContextBar` (`SearchPill` with `BarActions` in `trailing` for pinned actions, `FilterChipRow` with `sort` and `selection` on `md+` / `PhoneFilterBar` + `FilterPanel` on phones, no `ResultLine`), filter and sort state in the URL (`useFilterParams`), chips on one line, never wrapped rows (`filter-chip-wrap`, warning); dialogs are `Modal` / `Drawer` / `confirmDialog`; loading is `Skeleton`, never "Đang tải…" text, and a list, grid or table never swaps its rows for a `Spinner` (`no-spinner-in-list`, warning). `AppShell` renders once in a `layout.tsx` (never from a page), its items route by `href` (not `onSelect` + `router.push`), the session check runs once in that layout (best on the server) with `BootLoader` as the only centred spinner, and content loading is a `loading.tsx` with `PageSkeleton` inside the shell, never a skeleton gate around it. No other UI or icon library (`lucide-react`, `react-icons`, `@radix-ui`, `@mui`, a shadcn `components/ui` copy: `foreign-ui`), no own `Card` / `Badge` / `Tooltip`… (`local-primitive`), no raw `<button>`, `<input>`, `<textarea>`, `<table>` (`raw-control`), no hand-made overlay or spinner (`custom-overlay`, `custom-spinner`); a clickable card is `<Card onClick>` (keyboard-ready), never `<div onClick>` (`click-target`).
3. **Tokens only** (dual theme, any brand):
   - Colour (`docs/TOKENS.md`): surfaces `bg-canvas|app|panel|field|raised` (+ `bg-card` for a card in content, never `bg-panel`; `bg-panel-0…4`); text `text-strong|body|muted|faint` (faint only for group labels, kbd hints, "Untitled", on page surfaces and cards); lines `border-line|divider`, `border-control-line` (checkbox, radio), `border-field-line` / `border-outline-line`; neutral states `bg-item-hover` (hover), `bg-item-selected` (open record, active item, selected option), `bg-item-checked` (checked rows), `bg-inverted text-on-inverted` (checked controls), `ring-focus` / `border-focus` (focus); status `bg-*-bg border-*-border text-*-fg` (danger, success, warning, info) and tones `text-tone-*` only on tags, tiles and dots. Pages separate by tone, not borders or shadows (`<Card bordered>` only for a dense data view). **Brand fills** `bg-primary hover:bg-primary-hover text-on-primary` (and `bg-secondary` … when the brand has one) only where the brand colour rule says; selection, links, check marks, active tabs and focus are neutral. Never physical colours (`bg-white`, `text-slate-900`, `text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400`), arbitrary colours (`bg-[#…]`), `accent-*` or `primary-50…900` (removed in 1.0), gradients or glow shadows.
   - Buttons (`DESIGN_SYSTEM.md` §0, §9): ordinary actions are neutral. `Button` is `subtle` by default; `surface` for toolbar actions; `inverse` for the main action of a card or a list title row (`size="xs" shape="round"` for the pill), `outline` beside it; `ghost` for icon buttons; `primary` / `secondary` (the brand fills; `secondary` is the brand secondary, the primary when the brand has none) only for the one main button of a page or modal (its commit action), the nav's `mainAction` or a case the app's owner asks for; `danger` for destructive. Attention counts are `CountBadge` / Button `badge`, a new item is `NewTag`. Tabs (`DESIGN_SYSTEM.md` §0, §4h): `PillTabs` for 5+ sections or sections with icons (settings-like pages), `SegmentedControl` for 2–5 filter values shown in full with counts (replaces deprecated `Pills`), big `TextTabs` for 2–4 top-level views of a discovery or reading page (display face at 400, brand underline), `FilterChipRow` for filters, `Tabs` for sections of one record, `useTabParam` for `?tab=` URL state without history spam per arrow key.
   - Layouts (`DESIGN_SYSTEM.md` §4a, `Page`, `SubNav`, `ListReaderLayout`, `ReaderHeader`): **work** pages (lists, tables, workspaces) flush with no centred max-width (padding 16 / 24); **reading** pages (settings, explore, articles) one column centred at 1536px inside 16px padding + 64px bottom; **two-column** pages a 240px `SubNav` card + 4px gap + main card (padding 24, stacking below `md`); **list + reader** a list card + reader card (`ListReaderLayout` on `Page fixed` / `AppShell page="fixed"`, sticky `ReaderHeader` with wrapping title left and `[•••]` + one main action right). Rhythm 32 / 28 / 32 / 16 / 8 (`PageSection`, `PageGrid`). A work page's `PageTitle` is 18 / 400 on the row of its main action (`variant="reading"` 44 / 500 display on reading pages only); one `h1` per page. List pages omit `ResultLine` (16px under filter row), put sort + "Chọn" on `FilterChipRow` / `PhoneFilterBar`, and swap bulk actions in place on the filter row at the same height (`useListSelection`).
   - Type scale only (`docs/TOKENS.md`): `text-ui` (14, content: rows, labels, fields, buttons, body) · `text-chrome` (12, shell chrome only: nav, breadcrumb, toolbar, meta) · `text-lead` 15 · `text-figure` 18 · `text-section` 20 · `text-tab-xl` · `text-title-xl` · `text-hero` · `text-tag` / `text-badge` 10 · `text-overline` · `max-sm:text-input` 16 for fields; text colours `text-strong|body|muted|faint`; headings not bold (400 / 500, `font-title` 500; 600 only overlines, 700 only count badges), titles and big numbers `font-title` / `font-figure`; `tabular-nums` for numbers; sentence case (the one uppercase style is `text-overline`, only as a group or section label: a nav / drawer group, a palette group, a mega menu column, a section of a form or detail panel; never one field's label, a button, a link or a heading: `overline-place`). Content (list rows, table cells, field labels and help, buttons, menu items, sentences) is `text-ui` (14); only the shell chrome (nav, breadcrumb, toolbar compact buttons) and meta (a time, a count, a hint) are `text-chrome` (12). Each size sets its own line height: no `leading-*` on body text.
   - Spacing by role (scaled by density): `p-card` inside every card, popover and panel section (`<Card>` sets it; `p-card sm:p-panel` for a roomy one), `gap-stack` between items in a card or form, `gap-group` between cards, `gap-section` between page sections. `gap-1`–`gap-2`, `px-2`, `py-1` only inside one control or row. A card is never tighter than `p-card` (`card-padding`). No arbitrary spacing, z-index or opacity (`p-[13px]`, `z-[9999]`, `bg-panel/[0.05]`: `arbitrary-value`); no `shadow-sm…2xl` (`tw-shadow`), `uppercase` (`text-case`) or `leading-*` other than `leading-tight` (`leading-override`); no colours, sizes or radii in `style={{}}` (`inline-style-value`) or in `.css` (`css-raw-value`).
   - Shape and size are Semi's one look (no styles since 1.0; a leftover `data-style` does nothing): `rounded-chip|control|card|panel|full`, `shadow-card`, `h-control`, `h-field`. Never `rounded-lg`, `rounded-[Npx]`, `h-[34px]` or `[data-style]` selectors. Density and type scale are this product's (`data-density`, `data-type-scale`): never tune paddings or text sizes by hand for that.
   - Layers: `z-sticky` < `z-drawer` < `z-modal` < `z-dialog` < `z-popover` < `z-toast` < `z-tooltip`; never `z-[9999]`.
4. **Not the generic AI screen** (`DESIGN_SYSTEM.md` §19): one main block per screen (`KpiCard featured`, not four equal cards); icons neutral unless they mean a status; proof (a real number, a quote, a product shot) instead of three icon feature cards; icons only where they help scanning; sample data and empty states from this product, never "Lorem", "John Doe" or another domain.
   **Density budgets** (`DESIGN_SYSTEM.md` §4c, measured on the page by `npx semi density <url>`): at most three frames inside each other (page panel › card › tile); at most four text sizes and three colours (brand + status) in one box; one filled brand button per page or modal; text 12px from a box's sides and 8px from its top and bottom; a list row at least `h-control` tall (`Item`, `Menu`, `DataTable`); 8px or more between boxes; one line between two things (no `border-b` on a card's last row). `px-2` / `py-1` are for the inside of a control, never a row's or a box's padding.
   **Every state** (`DESIGN_SYSTEM.md` §19b, §13c): use `EmptyState` (`first-use` / `no-results`), `ErrorState`, `NotFound`, `Forbidden`, and give each route group `loading.tsx` / `error.tsx` / `not-found.tsx` (`npx semi example states`); each screen has its loading (skeleton of the real shape), empty (with the action that fills it), "no result", error (what failed + retry, loaded data kept), no-permission and too-much-data states; a destructive action is undoable (`toast.undo`) or, when irreversible, confirmed (`confirmDelete`); Escape closes, Enter submits, back works.
   **Feedback** (`DESIGN_SYSTEM.md` §14c): one toast API from `@semi/ui` (`toast.success|error|warning|info`, `toast.undo`, `toast.promise`), never a toast library or a local wrapper (`local-toast`, warning); a reversible destructive action is done at once with `toast.undo(title, restore)` (Hoàn tác, 8 s); an irreversible one asks first with `confirmDelete({ name })` (names the object, red Xoá, Huỷ); success is one toast, never a modal (`npx semi example toast`).
   **Grouped actions** (`DESIGN_SYSTEM.md` §9, G1–G12): one way to start one job (other ways to create the same thing go under the primary in a `SplitButton`, never as extra toolbar buttons); secondary page actions in the ⋯ `Menu` (at most one secondary button visible); `ButtonGroup` only for toggles or steps of one control; a table row has one inline action + ⋯, a card `CardActions` (always with `label`: `card-hover-actions-touch` is a hard error); a round icon button is `<Button iconOnly shape="round">`, never a hand-made `rounded-full` button (`raw-pill-button`, warning); danger last; one filled primary per view; 3+ icon-only buttons in a row go into ⋯. A list record opens in a `DetailOverlay` with `useDetailParam` (`?open=`), not a new page (`detail-overlay-url`, warning); the ⌘K box is one `CommandPalette` in the root layout (pages add items with `useRegisterCommands`).
   **Forms** (`DESIGN_SYSTEM.md` §9b): the action row is `FormActions` (Huỷ ghost, then Lưu / Tạo, destructive on the left, sticky on a page); `useUnsavedGuard(dirty)` so typed work is never lost; `Field kind` for email / phone / number / money / URL / search / password; errors under the field (`useFormValidation`, `FormErrorSummary`), never in a toast; page forms `max-w-2xl` (`npx semi example form-actions`).
5. **Brand** (when `semi-lint.json` has `"brand"`): ask `semi_brand` (or `npx semi brand voice|color|logo|brief`) before writing UI text or placing colour. Write in the brand's voice, use its fills only as the brand colour rule says, import the logo from the kit; never define colours, fonts or Semi tokens in the app (`brand-override`). Brand changes happen in the brand repo with `/semi-brand`, then `/semi-sync` here.
6. **Accessibility** (`DESIGN_SYSTEM.md` §18, checked on the page by `npx semi a11y <url>`): icon-only controls have `aria-label`, and a field's name comes from `Field` (a placeholder is not a label); anything clickable is a button or a link (`click-target`); custom controls keep `FOCUS_RING` or the 2px `:focus-visible` `outline-focus`, never a bare `outline-none` (`focus-hidden`); every text / background pair reaches 4.5:1 in both themes (themed text tokens, never a fixed shade on a tinted surface); text-like fields use the quiet 1.0 style (`border-field-line`, backed by the 2px `:focus-visible` outline), checkboxes and radios keep `border-control-line` (3:1); a control drawn smaller than 24px gets `HIT_AREA`; images have `alt`; never `maximum-scale` or `user-scalable=no` in the viewport.
7. **Gaps go upstream, lint is never silenced.** When `@semi/ui` cannot express a need, run `/semi-sync`, re-check the docs, then `/semi-propose`; meanwhile a minimal compliant workaround marked `// TODO(semi#<issue>)`. Never add a `skip`, disable a rule or grow `semi-lint-baseline.json` to get past lint: fix the code. The baseline only shrinks (`semi-lint --update-baseline`); `--accept-new` is for `/semi-sync` and needs the user's OK otherwise, and `semi-lint --ci` fails a pull request whose baseline or skips grew. The one per-file `skip`, with the user's OK and a reason, is for illustrations and data colours (not UI chrome): `"skip": { "literal-colour-value": { "lib/scenePalette.ts": "data colours: 3D scene" } }` (also `inline-svg-path`, `no-literal-palette`, `inline-style-value`). Shared rules change in the Semi repo, never only in this file; app-specific patterns go in `docs/UI_EXTENSIONS.md`.
8. **Before finishing:** `npx semi-lint` clean (it also checks `.css`), `npx tsc --noEmit`, the page checked in both themes and at phone width, and `npx semi density <url>` and `npx semi a11y <url>` clean when the app runs (no Playwright: evaluate their `--snippet` with a browser tool, `a11y` in each theme). CI runs `semi-lint --ci` and `tsc` (`.github/workflows/semi.yml`). Whole-app check: `/semi-check`; newer Semi or brand kit: `/semi-sync`.
<!-- semi-design-system:end -->
