<!-- docs/components/button.md -->

# Button

The action control, 1.0 variants: subtle (default) for ordinary actions, surface for toolbar actions, inverse for the main action of a card or a list title row, outline beside an inverse one, ghost for icon buttons, primary / secondary (the brand fills) only for the one main button of a page, a dialog or the nav, danger for destructive actions. Spinner shows work in progress inside the control that runs it.

## When to use

- Any action: save, create, refresh, delete, open a dialog.
- Icon-only toolbar actions (iconOnly + aria-label); an attention count on one with badge.
- Dialog footers (size="modal": 44px touch target on phones): commit primary, cancel subtle, a destructive confirm danger.
- Round icon buttons over media, in an overlay header or beside a carousel (iconOnly + shape="round"); the inverse pill of a list title row (size="xs" shape="round").

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Go to another page | next/link (styled with BTN_* from @semi/ui/styles when it must look like a button) |
| Link to another site | ExternalLink |
| Pick one of 2–5 filters | SegmentedControl |
| Turn a setting on / off | Switch |

## Import

```tsx
import { Button, Spinner } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Variants

subtle (default) for ordinary actions, surface for toolbar actions, inverse for a card's or a list title row's main action, outline beside it, ghost for quiet and icon actions, primary / secondary (brand) for the one main button of the page or dialog, danger for destructive. The second row is disabled: neutral for every variant.

```tsx
import { Button } from "@semi/ui";

const VARIANTS = ["subtle", "surface", "inverse", "outline", "ghost", "primary", "secondary", "danger"] as const;
const LABEL = { subtle: "Làm mới", surface: "Mời", inverse: "Thêm", outline: "Chia sẻ", ghost: "Xem thêm", primary: "Lưu", secondary: "Gửi", danger: "Xoá" };

export default function ButtonVariants() {
  return (
    // A specimen shows both brand fills on purpose: data-density-skip keeps it out of the one-brand-button budget.
    <div data-density-skip className="space-y-3">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        {VARIANTS.map((v) => (
          <Button key={v} variant={v}>
            {LABEL[v]}
          </Button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        {VARIANTS.map((v) => (
          <Button key={v} variant={v} disabled>
            {LABEL[v]}
          </Button>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Icon and icon-only

icon adds a leading icon; iconOnly needs an aria-label.

```tsx
import { Button } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ButtonIcons() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
      <Button variant="primary" icon="plus">
        Thêm máy in
      </Button>
      <Button icon="refresh">Làm mới</Button>
      <Button variant="danger" icon="trash">
        Xoá
      </Button>
      <Button iconOnly icon="settings" aria-label="Cài đặt" title="Cài đặt" />
      <Button iconOnly icon="download" aria-label="Tải xuống" title="Tải xuống" />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Round

shape="round" makes an icon-only button a circle (media tiles, overlay headers, carousel arrows) and a labelled one a pill; the fill, focus and size stay the variant's.

```tsx
import { Button } from "@semi/ui";

// Round icon buttons: over media, in an overlay header, beside a carousel. shape="round" keeps the variant's fill,
// the focus ring, the title and the size; only the corner changes.
export default function ButtonRound() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
      <Button iconOnly shape="round" icon="close" aria-label="Đóng" />
      <Button iconOnly shape="round" icon="copy" aria-label="Sao chép liên kết" />
      <Button iconOnly shape="round" variant="ghost" icon="more" aria-label="Thao tác khác" />
      <Button iconOnly shape="round" variant="primary" icon="plus" aria-label="Tạo mới" />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Loading

loading swaps the icon for a spinner and blocks clicks.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, Spinner } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ButtonLoading() {
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const save = () => {
    setSaving(true);
    setTimeout(() => setSaving(false), 1200);
  };
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
      <Button variant="primary" icon="check" loading={saving} onClick={save}>
        {saving ? "Đang lưu" : "Lưu"}
      </Button>
      <Spinner label="Đang đồng bộ" />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Sizes

xs (24px) for the inverse pill of a list title row, sm (28px, 12px text) for dense rows and toolbars, md (default, 14px text) for content, modal for dialog footers and a full-width commit; badge pins an attention count to an icon button.

```tsx
import { Button } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ButtonSizes() {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <Button size="xs" variant="inverse" shape="round" icon="plus">
          Thêm (xs)
        </Button>
        <Button size="sm" icon="edit">
          Sửa (sm)
        </Button>
        <Button icon="edit">Sửa (md)</Button>
        <Button variant="ghost" iconOnly icon="bell" aria-label="Thông báo, 12 chưa đọc" badge={12} />
      </div>
      <div className="flex gap-2 max-w-sm">
        <Button size="modal" className="flex-1">
          Huỷ
        </Button>
        <Button size="modal" variant="primary" className="flex-1">
          Xác nhận
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### Button

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ref` | `React.Ref<HTMLButtonElement>` |  |  |
| `variant` | `ButtonVariant` | `"subtle"` | Look of the button. `subtle` ordinary action · `surface` toolbar action · `inverse` the main action of a card or a list title row · `outline` beside an inverse one · `ghost` icon buttons, the nav bottom row · `primary` / `secondary` the brand fill, only for the one main button of a page, a dialog (its commit) or the nav, or a case the app's owner asks for (`secondary` is the brand secondary; the primary when the brand has none) · `danger`. Disabled is neutral for every variant. |
| `size` | `'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'modal'` | `"md"` | md = h-control (34px, 14px text) · sm = 28px, 12px text (dense rows, toolbars) · xs = 24px, 12px text (the inverse pill of a list title row) · modal = 44px and 15px text on phones, h-control from sm (dialog footers, a full-width commit). |
| `badge` | `number` |  | Attention count at the top-right corner (brand fill, "99+" cap), for an icon button: unread, waiting jobs. 0 hides it. The drawn badge is aria-hidden: with an `aria-label`, say the count in it ("Thông báo, 12 chưa đọc"); without one, Button adds the count as screen-reader text. |
| `icon` | `IconName` |  | Leading icon from the Semi registry. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows a spinner in place of the icon and blocks clicks (aria-busy). |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `shape` | `'default' \| 'round'` | `"default"` | `round`: fully round instead of the control radius: a circle with `iconOnly` (media tiles, overlay headers, carousel arrows), a pill otherwise (the inverse pill of a list title row, `size="xs"`). Lint `raw-pill-button` flags hand-made ones. |
| `iconOnly` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode \| undefined` |  |  |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  | Defines a string value that labels the current element. |

### Spinner

Indeterminate activity mark for a button or field running its own action (§13b: no page spinners).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `className` | `string` | `"w-4 h-4"` |  |
| `label` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- Renders a real <button type="button"> (pass type="submit" in forms).
- iconOnly requires aria-label (the types enforce it); keep a title for the tooltip. With badge, say the count in the aria-label ("Thông báo, 3 chưa đọc").
- loading sets aria-busy and blocks clicks. Keyboard focus is a 2px outline in the strong text colour on every variant; disabled is neutral for every variant.
- A 24px hit area at every size that grows to 44px on a touch screen (any-pointer-coarse), without a bigger drawn button.

<!-- docs/components/button-group.md -->

# Button group

Joins related buttons into one segmented control: shared borders, outer corners only (‹ Hôm nay ›, Lưu | ▾).

## When to use

- Previous / today / next; a primary action with its overflow menu; zoom − / +.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Choose one value | ToggleGroup or Pills |
| A main action with other ways to do it (Thêm \| ▾ Nhập từ file) | SplitButton |
| Unrelated actions side by side | Menu (⋯), G3 |

## Import

```tsx
import { ButtonGroup } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Navigation and split button

```tsx
import { Button, ButtonGroup } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ButtonGroupBasic() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
      <ButtonGroup label="Điều hướng ngày">
        <Button iconOnly icon="back" aria-label="Ngày trước" />
        <Button>Hôm nay</Button>
        <Button iconOnly icon="chevron" aria-label="Ngày sau" />
      </ButtonGroup>
      <ButtonGroup label="Thu phóng">
        <Button iconOnly icon="minus" aria-label="Thu nhỏ" />
        <Button className="tabular-nums">100%</Button>
        <Button iconOnly icon="plus" aria-label="Phóng to" />
      </ButtonGroup>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### ButtonGroup

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the group ("Điều hướng ngày"). |
| `orientation` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `"horizontal"` |  |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | `false` | Stretch the group across its container's width (`flex w-full`). |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  | Button elements (Button, or anything styled with BTN_*). |

## Accessibility

- role="group" with a label; each button keeps its own name.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/button-group/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/card-actions.md -->

# Card actions

Quick actions on a card or media tile: round icon buttons in the top right corner that show on hover or keyboard focus where the device can hover, and one always-visible ⋯ with every action on touch screens. Goes inside a `group relative` card.

## When to use

- Cards and media tiles in a grid (suppliers, products, templates, files) that open on click and have one or two quick actions.
- A card's ⋯ overflow (G4 for grids: one or two inline actions at most, the rest in ⋯, danger last).

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Actions of a table row | Menu (row ⋯) |
| Actions on several selected cards | the bulk bar (D7) |

## Import

```tsx
import { CardActions, type CardAction } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Card grid

```tsx
"use client";

import { CardActions, IconTile, Item, toast } from "@semi/ui";

const SUPPLIERS = [
  { id: "s1", name: "Gia vị Tây Nguyên", region: "Đắk Lắk" },
  { id: "s2", name: "Hồ tiêu Chư Sê", region: "Gia Lai" },
  { id: "s3", name: "Quế Trà My", region: "Quảng Nam" },
];

// Hover (or Tab into) a card: Gửi hỏi giá, Ghim and ⋯. On a touch screen only the ⋯ shows, with every action.
export default function CardActionsGrid() {
  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
      {SUPPLIERS.map((s) => (
        <div key={s.id} className="group relative rounded-card bg-card">
          <Item media={<IconTile name="store" tone="gray" size="md" />} title={s.name} description={s.region} onClick={() => toast({ title: `Mở ${s.name}` })} className="pr-24 rounded-card" />
          <CardActions
            label={`Thao tác với ${s.name}`}
            actions={[
              { icon: "send", label: "Gửi hỏi giá", onClick: () => toast({ title: `Gửi hỏi giá ${s.name}` }) },
              { icon: "pin", label: "Ghim", onClick: () => toast({ title: "Đã ghim" }) },
            ]}
            menu={[
              { label: "Sửa", icon: "edit", onSelect: () => toast({ title: "Sửa" }) },
              { label: "Ngừng hợp tác", icon: "block", danger: true, onSelect: () => toast({ title: "Đã ngừng", tone: "danger" }) },
            ]}
          />
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### CardActions

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actions` | `CardAction[]` | `[]` | One or two icon actions shown on hover (on touch they move into the ⋯ menu). |
| `menu` | `MenuItem[]` |  | The rest, in the ⋯ menu (danger last). |
| `label` * | `string` |  | Name of the ⋯ menu, with the item it acts on: "Thao tác với Gia vị Tây Nguyên". Required: on touch it is the only control. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- A group named by `label` (with the item's name); every icon button has an aria-label and a title; the hover row is in the tab order and shows on focus; on touch the ⋯ is always visible, so it never depends on hover.
- Clicks inside do not reach the card under it.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/card-actions/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/chip.md -->

# Chip

A pill-shaped toggle for filters and tags. Neutral when off; active uses the high-contrast surface, with colour only on its dot or icon (tone).

## When to use

- Several filters that can be on at once (materials, device types).
- Removable active filters above a list.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Exactly one of 2–5 options | SegmentedControl |
| A read-only status | Badge |

## Import

```tsx
import { Chip } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Toggle filters

tone colours the dot of what the chip filters; the chip itself stays neutral.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Chip } from "@semi/ui";

const MATERIALS = [
  { key: "pla", label: "PLA", tone: "green" },
  { key: "petg", label: "PETG", tone: "sky" },
  { key: "tpu", label: "TPU", tone: "pink" },
] as const;

export default function ChipToggle() {
  const [on, setOn] = useState<string[]>(["pla"]);
  const toggle = (k: string) => setOn((v) => (v.includes(k) ? v.filter((x) => x !== k) : [...v, k]));
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      {MATERIALS.map((m) => (
        <Chip key={m.key} tone={m.tone} active={on.includes(m.key)} onClick={() => toggle(m.key)}>
          {m.label}
        </Chip>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### Chip

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `active` * | `boolean` |  |  |
| `onClick` * | `() => void` |  |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `title` | `string` |  |  |
| `tone` | `SemanticTone` |  | Optional theme-matching chromatic tone when active. Defaults to neutral raised surface. |
| `className` | `string` | `""` |  |

## Accessibility

- A button with aria-pressed when it toggles; keep the text short.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/chip/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/split-button.md -->

# Split button

The main action and a ▾ that opens a Menu of the other ways to do the same job (Thêm khách hàng | ▾ Nhập từ file, Tìm trong Data Hub). One filled button in total; below sm one button opens the whole list, the main action first.

## When to use

- Two or more ways to start one job (type it in, import a file, copy from another system): G1.
- A detail header or side panel action with variants (Gửi hỏi giá | ▾ Gửi từ mẫu, Gọi điện).

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Unrelated secondary actions (export, settings, print) | Menu (⋯) |
| A toggle or the steps of one control (view mode, ‹ Hôm nay ›) | ButtonGroup |
| One action with no alternatives | Button |

## Import

```tsx
import { SplitButton } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### In a toolbar

Narrow the window below sm: one button opens Thêm khách hàng and its alternatives.

```tsx
"use client";

import { Button, SearchInput, SplitButton, toast } from "@semi/ui";

// G1: one way to start one job. The other ways to add a customer live under the ▾, not as toolbar buttons.
export default function SplitButtonToolbar() {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
      <SearchInput value="" onChange={() => undefined} placeholder="Tìm khách hàng" className="flex-1 min-w-48" />
      <Button iconOnly icon="download" aria-label="Xuất Excel" />
      <SplitButton
        label="Thêm khách hàng"
        icon="plus"
        onClick={() => toast({ title: "Mở biểu mẫu thêm khách hàng" })}
        menuLabel="Cách thêm khác"
        items={[
          { label: "Nhập từ file", icon: "upload", description: "Excel hoặc CSV", onSelect: () => toast({ title: "Chọn file" }) },
          { label: "Tìm trong Data Hub", icon: "search", onSelect: () => toast({ title: "Mở Data Hub" }) },
        ]}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Subtle, loading

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { SplitButton, toast } from "@semi/ui";

// A secondary SplitButton (a detail header that already has its primary), with a running main action.
export default function SplitButtonSecondary() {
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  return (
    <SplitButton
      variant="subtle"
      label="Mở trong IDE"
      icon="code"
      loading={busy}
      onClick={() => {
        setBusy(true);
        setTimeout(() => setBusy(false), 1200);
      }}
      menuLabel="Mở bằng cách khác"
      items={[
        { label: "Mở Terminal", icon: "terminal", onSelect: () => toast({ title: "Mở Terminal" }) },
        { label: "Mở trong Finder", icon: "folder", onSelect: () => toast({ title: "Mở Finder" }) },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

### Full width (workspace action bar)

`fullWidth` stretches the primary button across its container (e.g. WorkspaceLayout's pinned action bar) and keeps the split trigger on phones.

```tsx
"use client";

import { SplitButton, toast } from "@semi/ui";

export default function SplitButtonFullWidth() {
  return (
    <div className="max-w-sm">
      <SplitButton
        fullWidth
        label="Gửi hỏi giá"
        icon="send"
        onClick={() => toast.success("Đã gửi hỏi giá")}
        menuLabel="Cách gửi khác"
        items={[
          { label: "Gửi từ mẫu", icon: "fileText", onSelect: () => toast.info("Chọn mẫu") },
          { label: "Lưu nháp", icon: "check", onSelect: () => toast.info("Đã lưu nháp") },
        ]}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### SplitButton

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` * | `string` |  | The main action ("Thêm khách hàng"). |
| `icon` | `IconName` |  |  |
| `onClick` * | `() => void` |  |  |
| `items` * | `MenuItem[]` |  | The other ways to do the same job (manual, import, copy from another system). Danger items go last. |
| `menuLabel` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the ▾ button and of its menu (default "Thao tác khác"). |
| `variant` | `'subtle' \| 'surface' \| 'inverse' \| 'primary' \| 'secondary'` | `"primary"` | `primary` (brand) for the view's one main action (G7), `inverse` for the main action of a card or a list title row, `subtle` elsewhere; `secondary` is the brand secondary. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | `"md"` |  |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | The main action is running: spinner and no clicks on the main half; the ▾ stays usable. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables both halves. |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | `false` | Stretch to fill its container (e.g. a `WorkspaceLayout` pinned action): the main half takes `flex-1` while the ▾ keeps its width, and `collapseOnPhone` defaults to `false` so phones keep the full-width split button. |
| `collapseOnPhone` | `boolean` |  | Below `sm`, show one button (the icon, or the label with ▾) that opens a menu with the main action first. Defaults to `false` when `fullWidth` is set, otherwise `true`. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- A group named by the main label; the ▾ is a menu button (aria-haspopup=menu, aria-expanded) with its own name (menuLabel); the menu follows Menu's keyboard.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/split-button/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/toggle.md -->

# Toggle

Buttons that stay pressed. Toggle for one (pin, mute, bold); ToggleGroup for a set of icon or short options, one or several at a time (list / grid view, text styles).

## When to use

- A view mode with icons; text formatting; a pin / follow / mute switch on a toolbar.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Filter a list by text options | SegmentedControl |
| A setting saved immediately with a label | Switch |

## Import

```tsx
import { Toggle, ToggleGroup } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Toggle

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Toggle } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ToggleBasic() {
  const [pinned, setPinned] = useState(false);
  return (
    <Toggle pressed={pinned} onPressedChange={setPinned} icon="pin">
      {pinned ? "Đã ghim" : "Ghim"}
    </Toggle>
  );
}
```

### View mode (single) and styles (multiple)

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { ToggleGroup } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ToggleGroupBasic() {
  const [view, setView] = useState<("grid" | "list")[]>(["grid"]);
  const [styles, setStyles] = useState<("bold" | "italic" | "code")[]>(["bold"]);
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
      <ToggleGroup
        label="Chế độ xem"
        value={view}
        onChange={setView}
        options={[
          { key: "grid", icon: "grid", "aria-label": "Lưới" },
          { key: "list", icon: "menu", "aria-label": "Danh sách" },
        ]}
      />
      <ToggleGroup
        type="multiple"
        label="Kiểu chữ"
        value={styles}
        onChange={setStyles}
        options={[
          { key: "bold", label: "Đậm" },
          { key: "italic", label: "Nghiêng" },
          { key: "code", icon: "code", "aria-label": "Code" },
        ]}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### Toggle

One button that stays pressed (aria-pressed). Icon-only needs an aria-label.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pressed` * | `boolean` |  |  |
| `onPressedChange` * | `(pressed: boolean) => void` |  |  |
| `icon` | `IconName` |  |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  |  |
| `title` | `string` |  |  |

### ToggleGroup

A set of toggles on one track. type="single" (default) behaves like a radio group (←/→ move and select);
type="multiple" is a toolbar of independent toggles. Value is a list of keys in both cases.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `options` * | `ToggleOption<T>[]` |  |  |
| `value` * | `T[]` |  |  |
| `onChange` * | `(value: T[]) => void` |  |  |
| `type` | `'single' \| 'multiple'` | `"single"` |  |
| `label` * | `string` |  | Accessible name of the group. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- Toggle uses aria-pressed. ToggleGroup type="single" is a radio group (←/→ move and select), type="multiple" a toolbar of pressed buttons. Icon-only options need aria-label.

<!-- docs/components/calendar.md -->

# Calendar

A month grid to pick one day or a range (YYYY-MM-DD, weeks start on Monday). DatePicker shows it in a popover; place it inline for schedules and report filters.

## When to use

- Inline date selection on a page; picking a date range for a report.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A date field in a form | DatePicker |

## Import

```tsx
import { Calendar, isoDay, parseDay, type DayRange } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### One day

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Calendar } from "@semi/ui";

export default function CalendarSingle() {
  const [day, setDay] = useState("2026-11-12");
  return <Calendar value={day} onChange={setDay} min="2026-11-01" />;
}
```

### Range

Click a start day, then an end day.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Calendar, type DayRange } from "@semi/ui";

export default function CalendarRange() {
  const [range, setRange] = useState<DayRange>({ start: "2026-11-03", end: "2026-11-09" });
  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <Calendar mode="range" value={range} onChange={setRange} />
      <p className="text-ui text-muted tabular-nums">
        {range.start ?? "…"} → {range.end ?? "…"}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### Calendar

A grid of days (role="grid"): arrows move by day / week, Home / End to the start / end of the week, PageUp /
PageDown by month (Shift: by year), Enter / Space pick. Only the focused day is in the tab order.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `min` | `string` |  | Earliest / latest selectable day ("YYYY-MM-DD"). |
| `max` | `string` |  |  |
| `autoFocus` | `boolean` |  | Move focus into the grid when it mounts (DatePicker does). |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `mode` | `'single' \| 'range'` |  |  |
| `value` * | `string \| DayRange` |  |  |
| `onChange` * | `(value: string) => void \| (value: DayRange) => void` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- role="grid": arrows move by day / week, Home / End to the week's ends, PageUp / PageDown by month (Shift: year), Enter / Space pick; today has aria-current="date".

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/calendar/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/checkbox.md -->

# Checkbox

A native checkbox with label and description, checked fill in the accent, and an indeterminate state for “select all”.

## When to use

- Opt in to something in a form (accept terms, include archived).
- Select rows; “select all” with indeterminate.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A setting that applies at once | Switch |
| Exactly one option of a few | RadioGroup |

## Import

```tsx
import { Checkbox } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### With description

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Checkbox } from "@semi/ui";

export default function CheckboxBasic() {
  const [auto, setAuto] = useState(true);
  return <Checkbox checked={auto} onChange={setAuto} label="Tự động in khi rảnh" description="Máy nhận job tiếp theo trong hàng đợi." />;
}
```

### Indeterminate and disabled

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Checkbox } from "@semi/ui";

export default function CheckboxStates() {
  const [all, setAll] = useState(false);
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <Checkbox checked={all} indeterminate={!all} onChange={setAll} label="Chọn tất cả" />
      <Checkbox checked={false} onChange={() => undefined} label="Không khả dụng" disabled />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Row selection without a visible label

aria-label names each box ("Chọn đơn #1024").

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Checkbox } from "@semi/ui";

const ORDERS = ["1024", "1025", "1026"];

export default function CheckboxRowSelect() {
  const [picked, setPicked] = useState<string[]>(["1025"]);
  const toggle = (o: string, on: boolean) => setPicked(on ? [...picked, o] : picked.filter((x) => x !== o));
  return (
    <ul className="divide-y divide-divider border border-line rounded-card">
      {ORDERS.map((o) => (
        <li key={o} className="flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2.5">
          <Checkbox checked={picked.includes(o)} onChange={(on) => toggle(o, on)} aria-label={`Chọn đơn #${o}`} />
          <span className="text-ui text-body tabular-nums">Đơn #{o}</span>
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}
```

## API

### Checkbox

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `checked` * | `boolean` |  |  |
| `onChange` * | `(checked: boolean) => void` |  |  |
| `label` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Visible label; it names the checkbox and is part of the hit area. |
| `description` | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `indeterminate` | `boolean` | `false` | Mixed state ("some selected") for a select-all box. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `id` | `string` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  | Name for screen readers when there is no visible `label` (a row's select box: "Chọn đơn #1024"). `label` wins. |
| `aria-labelledby` | `string` |  | Id of the element that names the checkbox when its text is elsewhere (a table cell, a card title). `label` wins. |

## Accessibility

- A real <input type="checkbox">: Space toggles, label clicks toggle, description is linked.
- Without a visible label (row selection) give aria-label or aria-labelledby (label wins); in development a checkbox with no name logs a warning.
- On touch screens (any coarse pointer) the hit area is 44 × 44 px around the box; the visible size and layout do not change.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/checkbox/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/combobox.md -->

# Combobox

CustomCombobox: type to filter a long or grouped list (diacritic-aware, IME-safe), then pick one value or keep a new one.

## When to use

- Long or grouped lists the user searches (materials, customers, repositories, SKUs).

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A short fixed list without search | CustomSelect |
| Pick multiple values with removable chips | MultiCombobox |

## Import

```tsx
import { CustomCombobox, type CustomComboboxOption } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Searchable list

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { CustomCombobox, Field } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ComboboxBasic() {
  const [material, setMaterial] = useState("pla_matte");
  return (
    <Field label="Vật liệu">
      <CustomCombobox
        value={material}
        onChange={setMaterial}
        placeholder="Tìm loại nhựa…"
        options={[
          { value: "pla_matte", label: "eSUN PLA Matte Black" },
          { value: "petg_hf", label: "Bambu PETG-HF White" },
          { value: "abs_fire", label: "Polymaker ABS Fire Red" },
          { value: "tpu_95a", label: "Inland TPU 95A Orange" },
        ]}
      />
    </Field>
  );
}
```

### Grouped options

Pass group on consecutive options; headings stay only while one of their options matches.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { CustomCombobox, Field, type CustomComboboxOption } from "@semi/ui";

const REPOS: CustomComboboxOption[] = [
  { value: "semi-nextjs-codebase", label: "semi-nextjs-codebase", group: "Nền tảng" },
  { value: "semi-brand", label: "semi-brand", group: "Nền tảng" },
  { value: "sales-hub", label: "sales-hub", group: "Ứng dụng" },
  { value: "data-hub", label: "data-hub", group: "Ứng dụng" },
  { value: "feedback-hub", label: "feedback-hub", group: "Ứng dụng" },
];

export default function ComboboxGroups() {
  const [repo, setRepo] = useState("");
  return (
    <div className="max-w-md">
      <Field label="Kho mã nguồn">
        <CustomCombobox value={repo} onChange={setRepo} placeholder="Tìm repo…" options={REPOS} />
      </Field>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### CustomCombobox

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` * | `string` |  |  |
| `onChange` * | `(val: string) => void` |  |  |
| `options` * | `(string \| CustomComboboxOption)[]` |  |  |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  |  |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `id` | `string` |  |  |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  |  |
| `aria-describedby` | `string` |  |  |
| `aria-invalid` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` |  |

## Accessibility

- ARIA combobox: arrows move through matching enabled options (skipping group headings), Enter picks, Escape closes; works inside Field.
- Option groups use role="group" + aria-labelledby so headings are announced and not selectable; a heading disappears when none of its options match.

<!-- docs/components/date-picker.md -->

# Date picker

A date field with a Calendar popover (YYYY-MM-DD, min / max). Never type="date".

## When to use

- Schedule a job, filter by day, set a due date.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Pick on the page, or a range | Calendar |

## Import

```tsx
import { DatePicker } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Basic

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { DatePicker } from "@semi/ui";

export default function DatePickerBasic() {
  const [date, setDate] = useState("2026-11-01");
  return <DatePicker value={date} onChange={setDate} min="2026-10-01" ariaLabel="Ngày in" />;
}
```

## API

### DatePicker

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` * | `string` |  |  |
| `onChange` * | `(value: string) => void` |  |  |
| `min` | `string` |  | Earliest / latest selectable day ("YYYY-MM-DD"). |
| `max` | `string` |  |  |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` |  | Name when there is no `Field` label ("Ngày in"); the button reads "<name>: <date>". |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `id` | `string` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` | `""` |  |

## Accessibility

- The button's name includes the chosen date; the popover is a dialog with the Calendar grid (arrows, PageUp / PageDown, Enter); Escape closes and returns focus to the button.
- Inside a Field it takes the field's id, is named by the label followed by the date, and links hint / error; the calendar opens in a portal (never clipped) and closes when focus leaves it.

<!-- docs/components/field.md -->

# Field, Input, Textarea

Field gives any control a label, a hint and an error, wired for screen readers; `kind` sets the phone keyboard, autofill and Enter key of an email, phone, number, money, URL, search or password field. Input and Textarea are the standard text controls (bg-field, h-field).

## When to use

- Every form control: wrap it in Field instead of writing a <label>.
- Text, email, password, search inside forms; multi-line notes.
- An email, phone, number, money, URL, search or password field: set `kind` so phones show the right keyboard.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Numbers with a touch keypad | NumberInput |
| A date | DatePicker |
| Pick from a list | CustomSelect or CustomCombobox |
| Filter a list in a toolbar | SearchInput |
| Save / Cancel under the fields, validation timing, warn before leaving | FormActions, useFormValidation, useUnsavedGuard |

## Import

```tsx
import { Field, Input, Textarea } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Label and hint

```tsx
import { Field, Input } from "@semi/ui";

export default function FieldBasic() {
  return (
    <Field label="Tên máy in" hint="Hiện trên thẻ và trong thông báo.">
      <Input placeholder="VD: X1 Carbon xưởng A" icon="printer" />
    </Field>
  );
}
```

### Kinds

kind="email | tel | number | money | url | search | password" sets type, inputMode, autoComplete and enterKeyHint.

```tsx
import { Field, Input } from "@semi/ui";

export default function FieldKinds() {
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-stack max-w-md">
      <Field label="Email" kind="email" hint="Bàn phím có @ và dấu chấm; trình duyệt gợi ý email đã lưu.">
        <Input placeholder="ten@congty.vn" />
      </Field>
      <Field label="Số điện thoại" kind="tel">
        <Input placeholder="0901 234 567" />
      </Field>
      <Field label="Số lượng" kind="number">
        <Input defaultValue="12" />
      </Field>
      <Field label="Giá bán (₫)" kind="money">
        <Input defaultValue="250000" />
      </Field>
      <Field label="Website" kind="url">
        <Input placeholder="3dnoobs.vn" />
      </Field>
      <Field label="Mật khẩu" kind="password">
        <Input />
      </Field>
      <Field label="Tìm kiếm" kind="search">
        <Input icon="search" placeholder="Tên máy in" />
      </Field>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Error and required

Pass error to show the message under the control and mark it invalid.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Field, Input } from "@semi/ui";

export default function FieldValidation() {
  const [name, setName] = useState("ab");
  const error = name.length > 0 && name.length < 3 ? "Tên cần ít nhất 3 ký tự." : undefined;
  return (
    <Field label="Tên dự án" required error={error}>
      <Input value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} />
    </Field>
  );
}
```

### Textarea

```tsx
import { Field, Textarea } from "@semi/ui";

export default function FieldTextarea() {
  return (
    <Field label="Ghi chú">
      <Textarea rows={3} placeholder="Ghi chú cho đơn in…" />
    </Field>
  );
}
```

### Overline section labels and reply box

Use text-overline text-muted for form section labels (never for a single field), and Textarea resizable for an auto-growing reply box.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Field, Input, Textarea } from "@semi/ui";

export default function FieldSections() {
  const [model, setModel] = useState("claude-sonnet");
  const [prompt, setPrompt] = useState("");
  return (
    <div className="max-w-lg space-y-6">
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <div className="text-overline text-muted">Mô hình</div>
        <Field label="Tên mô hình">
          <Input value={model} onChange={(e) => setModel(e.target.value)} />
        </Field>
      </div>
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <div className="text-overline text-muted">Lời nhắc</div>
        <div className="h-64 flex flex-col justify-end rounded-card border border-line bg-panel p-card">
          <Field label="Nội dung trả lời">
            <Textarea
              value={prompt}
              onChange={(e) => setPrompt(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Gõ nhiều dòng để tự giãn, kéo mép trên (từ md) để đổi chiều cao…"
              autoGrow
              resizable
            />
          </Field>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### Field

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `hint` | `React.ReactNode` |  | One short helper line under the control (hidden while an error shows). |
| `error` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Error message; marks the control aria-invalid and announces the message. |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `kind` | `'number' \| 'search' \| 'email' \| 'tel' \| 'money' \| 'url' \| 'password'` |  | What the control holds: `email`, `tel`, `number`, `money`, `url`, `search` or `password`. Sets the control's `type`, `inputMode` (the phone keyboard), `autoComplete` and `enterKeyHint`; a prop on the control itself wins. |
| `id` | `string` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |

### Input

Text input on the field surface (FIELD_INPUT). For numbers use NumberInput, for dates DatePicker.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ref` | `React.Ref<HTMLInputElement>` |  |  |
| `icon` | `IconName` |  | Leading icon inside the field. |

### Textarea

Multi-line text on the field surface (FIELD_TEXTAREA), with optional reply-box auto-grow and top resize edge.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ref` | `React.Ref<HTMLTextAreaElement>` |  |  |
| `autoGrow` | `boolean` | `false` | Grow with typed text from `rows` (default 3) up to 50% of its container, then scroll inside. |
| `resizable` | `boolean` | `false` | From `md`: adds a top resize edge (`role="separator"`, drag / ArrowUp / ArrowDown ±24px / double-click reset, up to 80% of container). Phones: auto-grow only. |
| `containerRef` | `RefObject<HTMLElement \| null>` |  | Optional bounding container for 50% / 80% height caps (auto-detected when omitted). |

## Accessibility

- Field links label (htmlFor), hint and error (aria-describedby) and sets aria-invalid on error.
- The error is announced when it appears; required adds a visible mark and aria-required.
- kind sets inputMode (the keyboard), autoComplete (autofill) and enterKeyHint (the Enter key label); a prop on the control wins, e.g. autoComplete="new-password" on a sign-up password.

## Notes

- kind: email (type email, keyboard with @, autocomplete email), tel (tel keypad), number (decimal keypad), money (decimal keypad: amounts are typed with separators, parse in the app with a locale-aware parser, not Number(); inputMode="numeric" for whole numbers), url (type url: the browser rejects a bare 3dnoobs.vn on submit; next to an https:// addon pass type="text"), search (Enter reads "search"), password (autocomplete current-password, Enter reads "go"). number and money stay type="text": never a native type="number" (use NumberInput for a touch numpad; inside a Field it takes only autoComplete and enterKeyHint from the kind).
- Labels sit above the control, required fields get `*` (and "bắt buộc" for screen readers), the error shows under the field (`error`). Page forms are at most max-w-2xl (FORM_PAGE).

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/field/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/file-drop.md -->

# FileDrop

A file picker and dropzone with one row per file (size, upload progress, done, remove / retry on failure) plus DropZone, its compact dashed-tile variant for workspace panels (optional file rows). Controlled: the app owns the list and does the upload.

## When to use

- Choosing or dropping one or more files: CSV import, product photos, invoices, firmware, model files (FileDrop).
- Showing the progress of each upload and letting the user retry or remove a file.
- Attachments in a WorkspaceSection or narrow side panel where the section label carries the count (DropZone).
- Duplicates (same name and size as an item or earlier in the batch) and dropped folders are rejected too: onReject reasons are type, size, directory, duplicate, multiple.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A single progress bar not tied to files | Progress |
| A long blocking job after the files are sent | startTask + TaskHost |
| An avatar or logo picker | A Button that opens the picker, with the preview next to it |

## Import

```tsx
import { FileDrop, DropZone, type DropZoneProps } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Import with validation

accept and maxSize filter files; rejected ones go to onReject, which here feeds the Field error.

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { Field, FileDrop, type FileDropItem, type FileRejection } from "@semi/ui";

// Testing an upload (Playwright): the hidden input has the button's name, so
//   await page.getByLabel("Tệp nhập").and(page.locator('input[type="file"]')).setInputFiles("bang-gia.csv");
// (plain getByLabel("Tệp nhập") matches the button too). Or wait for the `filechooser` event after clicking the button.
export default function FileDropBasic() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<FileDropItem[]>([
    { id: "seed", name: "bang-gia-2026.xlsx", size: 48_200, status: "done" },
  ]);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string>();

  const upload = (files: File[]) => {
    setError(undefined);
    for (const file of files) {
      const id = `${file.name}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random()}`;
      setItems((cur) => [...cur, { id, name: file.name, size: file.size, status: "uploading", progress: 0 }]);
      let progress = 0;
      const timer = setInterval(() => {
        progress = Math.min(100, progress + 20);
        setItems((cur) => cur.map((i) => (i.id === id ? { ...i, progress, status: progress === 100 ? "done" : "uploading" } : i)));
        if (progress === 100) clearInterval(timer);
      }, 400);
    }
  };
  const WHY = { type: "sai định dạng", size: "quá 10 MB", directory: "là thư mục", duplicate: "đã có", multiple: "thừa" } as const;
  const reject = (rejections: FileRejection[]) => setError(rejections.map((r) => `${r.file.name}: ${WHY[r.reason]}`).join("; "));

  return (
    <Field label="Tệp nhập" error={error}>
      <FileDrop
        multiple
        accept={[".csv", ".xlsx"]}
        maxSize={10_000_000}
        hint="CSV hoặc XLSX, tối đa 10 MB"
        items={items}
        onAdd={upload}
        onReject={reject}
        onRemove={(id) => setItems((cur) => cur.filter((i) => i.id !== id))}
      />
    </Field>
  );
}
```

### Row states

Done, uploading (determinate and indeterminate), error with Retry, and a disabled drop area.

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { FileDrop, type FileDropItem } from "@semi/ui";

const initial: FileDropItem[] = [
  { id: "1", name: "anh-san-pham-01.jpg", size: 2_400_000, status: "done" },
  { id: "2", name: "anh-san-pham-02.jpg", size: 3_100_000, status: "uploading", progress: 45 },
  { id: "3", name: "hoa-don-thang-10.pdf", size: 880_000, status: "uploading" },
  { id: "4", name: "anh-san-pham-03.jpg", size: 5_900_000, status: "error", error: "Mất kết nối, thử lại." },
];

export default function FileDropStates() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState(initial);
  const retry = (id: string) => {
    setItems((cur) => cur.map((i) => (i.id === id ? { ...i, status: "uploading", error: undefined } : i)));
    setTimeout(() => setItems((cur) => cur.map((i) => (i.id === id ? { ...i, status: "done" } : i))), 800);
  };
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4 @2xl:grid-cols-2">
      <FileDrop
        multiple
        accept={["image/*", ".pdf"]}
        hint="Ảnh hoặc PDF"
        items={items}
        onAdd={() => {}}
        onRemove={(id) => setItems((cur) => cur.filter((i) => i.id !== id))}
        onRetry={retry}
      />
      <FileDrop disabled hint="Đang khoá" items={[]} onAdd={() => {}} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### One file

Without multiple, only the first valid file is added; the rest go to onReject with reason "multiple".

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { Field, FileDrop, type FileDropItem } from "@semi/ui";

export default function FileDropSingle() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<FileDropItem[]>([]);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string>();
  return (
    <Field label="Hợp đồng (PDF)" error={error}>
      <FileDrop
        accept={["application/pdf", ".pdf"]}
        hint="Một tệp PDF"
        items={items}
        onAdd={(files) => {
          setError(undefined);
          setItems(files.map((f) => ({ id: f.name, name: f.name, size: f.size, status: "done" })));
        }}
        onReject={(r) => setError(r.map((x) => x.file.name).join(", ") + " không được thêm")}
        onRemove={() => setItems([])}
      />
    </Field>
  );
}
```

### Compact workspace drop zone (DropZone)

A light dashed tile on the panel surface for WorkspaceSection attachments, with optional file rows.

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { DropZone, WorkspaceSection, type FileDropItem } from "@semi/ui";

export default function DropZoneBasic() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<FileDropItem[]>([]);
  return (
    <div className="max-w-sm rounded-panel bg-panel-3 p-4">
      <WorkspaceSection label="Quy cách đính kèm" count={items.length} max={5}>
        <DropZone
          title="Kéo tệp quy cách vào đây"
          hint="PDF, ảnh mẫu hoặc Excel, tối đa 10 MB"
          accept={[".pdf", "image/*", ".xlsx"]}
          maxSize={10_000_000}
          multiple
          items={items}
          onAdd={(files) => setItems((cur) => [...cur, ...files.map((f) => ({ id: `${f.name}-${f.size}`, name: f.name, size: f.size, status: "done" as const }))])}
          onRemove={(id) => setItems((cur) => cur.filter((i) => i.id !== id))}
        />
      </WorkspaceSection>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### FileDrop

Picker + drop area with a row per file (forms, import pages). In a narrow workspace panel use `DropZone`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` * | `FileDropItem[]` |  |  |
| `onAdd` * | `(files: File[]) => void` |  | Only the files that passed every check (see `onReject`); a batch never repeats a name + size. |
| `onReject` | `(rejections: FileRejection[]) => void` |  | Everything not added, with its reason: "type" / "size" (`accept`, `maxSize`), "directory" (a dropped folder), "duplicate" (same name + size as an item or an earlier file of the batch), "multiple" (extra files while `multiple` is off). The app decides whether to show them (e.g. as a Field error). |
| `onRemove` | `(id: string) => void` |  |  |
| `onRetry` | `(id: string) => void` |  |  |
| `accept` | `string[]` |  | MIME types, wildcards ("image/*") or extensions (".csv"). Omit to accept everything. |
| `maxSize` | `number` |  | Largest file in bytes. |
| `multiple` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Main line of the drop area (default from the locale). |
| `hint` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Second line, e.g. "CSV or XLSX, up to 10 MB". |
| `id` | `string` |  | Set by the surrounding Field when omitted. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `aria-describedby` | `string` |  |  |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  | Names the drop button and the hidden file input (wins over the Field label / title). Without it the input is named by the button (`aria-labelledby`), so `getByLabel(label)` in a test reaches the input too. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

### DropZone

Compact FileDrop for a workspace panel (`WorkspaceSection`, L12): a lighter dashed tile on the panel surface (no
field fill), smaller type, the same checks (`accept`, `maxSize`, duplicates), keyboard (Enter / Space opens the
picker) and announcements. `items` is optional.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `id` | `string` |  | Set by the surrounding Field when omitted. |
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Main line of the drop area (default from the locale). |
| `aria-describedby` | `string` |  |  |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  | Names the drop button and the hidden file input (wins over the Field label / title). Without it the input is named by the button (`aria-labelledby`), so `getByLabel(label)` in a test reaches the input too. |
| `multiple` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `onAdd` * | `(files: File[]) => void` |  | Only the files that passed every check (see `onReject`); a batch never repeats a name + size. |
| `onReject` | `(rejections: FileRejection[]) => void` |  | Everything not added, with its reason: "type" / "size" (`accept`, `maxSize`), "directory" (a dropped folder), "duplicate" (same name + size as an item or an earlier file of the batch), "multiple" (extra files while `multiple` is off). The app decides whether to show them (e.g. as a Field error). |
| `onRemove` | `(id: string) => void` |  |  |
| `onRetry` | `(id: string) => void` |  |  |
| `accept` | `string[]` |  | MIME types, wildcards ("image/*") or extensions (".csv"). Omit to accept everything. |
| `maxSize` | `number` |  | Largest file in bytes. |
| `hint` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Second line, e.g. "CSV or XLSX, up to 10 MB". |
| `invalid` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `items` | `FileDropItem[]` |  | Rows of the files already added; omit when the panel shows them elsewhere (a count in its section label). |

## Accessibility

- The drop area is a real button: Enter / Space open the file picker, with a visible focus ring.
- Inside a Field it takes the id, aria-describedby and invalid state; its label names the button.
- The hidden file input is named like the button (aria-labelledby, or the aria-label prop), so tests can find it by label: getByLabel(label).and(locator('input[type=file]')).setInputFiles(file). It is hidden, so keyboard and screen readers only meet the button.
- Added, rejected and failed files are announced in a polite live region; each progress bar and remove button names its file.

<!-- docs/components/filter-chip-row.md -->

# Filter chip row

A list page's filters as one line of chips (icon, label, chevron; solid with the value or count when on). Each chip opens a small multi-select popover, a single-choice chip a radio menu (“Hộp thư: Tất cả”), a switch chip toggles; the page's views (SegmentedControl) can lead the row; the row scrolls sideways with ‹ › when it overflows, shows “Xoá lọc” while a filter is on and ends with `sort`, zero-shift `selection` (“Chọn” via `useListSelection`) and `ViewSwitch`. State in the URL with useFilterParams or the filterParams helpers.

## When to use

- The filters of a list, grid or table page on desktop and iPad (md+), under its SearchPill in a StickyContextBar.
- Facets with a few to a few dozen values each (status, channel, owner, country), more than one value at a time.
- A single-choice facet (mailbox, folder, warehouse, workspace) with a default option: FilterSpec kind "single" with clearValue.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Filters on phones (below md) | PhoneFilterBar + FilterPanel |
| One choice among 2–5 views of the same list | SegmentedControl in FilterChipRow leading (PhoneFilterBar typeItems on phones), or TextTabs as the heading |
| A facet with hundreds of values (a customer, a product) | a Combobox in FilterPanel's children |

## Import

```tsx
import { FilterChipRow, FilterChip, FilterOptions, useFilterParams, readFilters, writeFilters, clearFilters, replaceFilters, writeSearch, readSort, writeSort } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### State in the URL, with ViewSwitch

```tsx
"use client";

import { FilterChipRow, ViewSwitch, useFilterParams, type ViewMode } from "@semi/ui";

const ORDERS = [
  { id: "1024", status: "new", channel: "shopee", paid: true },
  { id: "1025", status: "packing", channel: "web", paid: true },
  { id: "1026", status: "new", channel: "web", paid: false },
  { id: "1027", status: "shipped", channel: "shopee", paid: true },
  { id: "1028", status: "packing", channel: "store", paid: false },
];

export default function FilterChipRowUrlState() {
  // state lives in the URL (?o.status=new&o.paid=1): reload, share a link, Back / Forward all keep it
  const f = useFilterParams(
    [
      { key: "status", label: "Trạng thái", icon: "activity", options: [
        { value: "new", label: "Mới", count: 2 },
        { value: "packing", label: "Đang đóng gói", count: 2 },
        { value: "shipped", label: "Đã giao", count: 1 },
      ] },
      { key: "channel", label: "Kênh bán", icon: "store", options: [
        { value: "shopee", label: "Shopee" },
        { value: "web", label: "Website" },
        { value: "store", label: "Cửa hàng" },
      ] },
      { key: "paid", label: "Đã thanh toán", icon: "check", kind: "switch" },
    ],
    { prefix: "o." },
  );
  const view: ViewMode = f.params.get("view") === "grid" ? "grid" : "list";
  const rows = ORDERS.filter(
    (o) =>
      (!f.values.status.length || f.values.status.includes(o.status)) &&
      (!f.values.channel.length || f.values.channel.includes(o.channel)) &&
      (!f.values.paid.length || o.paid),
  );
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 w-full min-w-0">
      <FilterChipRow
        filters={f.filters}
        onChange={f.onChange}
        onClear={f.onClear}
        trailing={<ViewSwitch view={view} onViewChange={(v) => f.setParams({ view: v === "list" ? null : v }, "replace")} />}
      />
      <p className="text-ui text-muted">{rows.map((o) => `#${o.id}`).join(" · ") || "—"}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Views and single-choice filters

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { FilterChipRow, SegmentedControl, type FilterDef } from "@semi/ui";

const MAIL = [
  { id: "Báo giá tiêu đen", box: "sales", folder: "inbox", open: true },
  { id: "Đơn đặt hàng quế", box: "sales", folder: "inbox", open: false },
  { id: "Hoá đơn tháng 10", box: "billing", folder: "archive", open: false },
  { id: "Hỏi giá hồi", box: "support", folder: "inbox", open: true },
];
const VIEWS = [
  { key: "open", label: "Chưa xử lý" },
  { key: "all", label: "Tất cả" },
];

export default function FilterChipRowViews() {
  // the default view is "Chưa xử lý", not "all"
  const [view, setView] = useState("open");
  const [sel, setSel] = useState<Record<string, string[]>>({});
  const filters: FilterDef[] = [
    {
      key: "box",
      label: "Hộp thư",
      icon: "inbox",
      kind: "single",
      clearValue: "all",
      options: [
        { value: "all", label: "Tất cả" },
        { value: "sales", label: "Bán hàng", count: 2 },
        { value: "billing", label: "Kế toán", count: 1 },
        { value: "support", label: "Hỗ trợ", count: 1 },
      ],
      selected: sel.box ?? [],
    },
    {
      key: "folder",
      label: "Thư mục",
      icon: "folder",
      kind: "single",
      options: [
        { value: "inbox", label: "Hộp thư đến" },
        { value: "archive", label: "Lưu trữ" },
      ],
      selected: sel.folder ?? [],
    },
  ];
  const box = sel.box?.[0] ?? "all";
  const rows = MAIL.filter((m) => (view === "all" || m.open) && (box === "all" || m.box === box) && (!sel.folder?.length || sel.folder.includes(m.folder)));
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 w-full min-w-0">
      <FilterChipRow
        leading={<SegmentedControl label="Trạng thái thư" value={view} onChange={setView} options={VIEWS} />}
        filters={filters}
        onChange={(key, selected) => setSel({ ...sel, [key]: selected })}
        onClear={() => setSel({})}
      />
      <p className="text-ui text-muted">{rows.map((m) => m.id).join(" · ") || "—"}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### More chips than fit

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { FilterChipRow, type FilterDef } from "@semi/ui";

const SPECS: Omit<FilterDef, "selected">[] = [
  { key: "status", label: "Trạng thái", icon: "activity", options: [{ value: "new", label: "Mới" }, { value: "quoting", label: "Đang báo giá" }, { value: "won", label: "Đã chốt" }] },
  { key: "country", label: "Quốc gia", icon: "mapPin", options: [{ value: "DE", label: "Đức" }, { value: "AE", label: "UAE" }, { value: "IN", label: "Ấn Độ" }] },
  { key: "owner", label: "Phụ trách", icon: "user", options: [{ value: "ha", label: "Trần Thu Hà" }, { value: "nam", label: "Lê Hoàng Nam" }] },
  { key: "source", label: "Nguồn", icon: "database", options: [{ value: "fair", label: "Gulfood 2026" }, { value: "web", label: "Website" }] },
  { key: "mail", label: "Thư", icon: "mail", options: [{ value: "sent", label: "Đã gửi" }, { value: "replied", label: "Đã trả lời" }] },
  { key: "product", label: "Mặt hàng", icon: "box", options: [{ value: "pepper", label: "Tiêu đen" }, { value: "cinnamon", label: "Quế" }] },
  { key: "big", label: "Từ 100 tấn/năm", icon: "gauge", kind: "switch" },
];

export default function FilterChipRowMany() {
  // local state; the row scrolls sideways with ‹ › when the chips do not fit
  const [sel, setSel] = useState<Record<string, string[]>>({ country: ["DE", "AE"] });
  const filters: FilterDef[] = SPECS.map((s) => ({ ...s, selected: sel[s.key] ?? [] }));
  return (
    <div className="w-full min-w-0 max-w-xl">
      <FilterChipRow filters={filters} onChange={(key, selected) => setSel({ ...sel, [key]: selected })} onClear={() => setSel({})} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### FilterChipRow

The filter chips of a list page on one line. When they overflow, the row scrolls sideways and ‹ › buttons appear
(hidden from screen readers and the tab order: every chip is reachable by Tab, which scrolls it into view).
"Xoá lọc" shows while a filter is on; `leading` (the page's views as SegmentedControl) sits before the chips; `sort`,
`selection` ("Chọn" → in-place `"n đã chọn"` + bulk actions at the same height) and `trailing` (`ViewSwitch`) sit
at the right end.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `filters` * | `FilterDef[]` |  |  |
| `onChange` * | `(key: string, selected: string[]) => void` |  |  |
| `onClear` | `() => void` |  | Clears every filter; the "Xoá lọc" button shows while one is on. |
| `leading` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Before the chips: the page's views (`<SegmentedControl>`: Đang mở · Đã đóng · Tất cả), the md+ twin of PhoneFilterBar's `typeItems`. A view is not a filter: "Xoá lọc" leaves it alone. Keep it short (2–5 views); it does not scroll. |
| `trailing` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Extra tools at the end of the row (e.g. `ViewSwitch`). Replaced in place while `selection` is active. |
| `sort` | `SortDef` |  | Sort menu at the right end of the filter row. |
| `selection` | `ListSelection` |  | Selection mode ("Chọn") and bulk actions replacing the right side at the same height (zero list shift). |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the chip group (default "Bộ lọc"). |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

### FilterChip

One filter facet as a chip. A `multi` filter opens a popover of checkboxes (aria-expanded on the chip); a `switch`
filter toggles on click (aria-pressed); a `single` filter opens a menu of radio items (`menuitemradio`) and always
reads "Hộp thư: Tất cả". Active (a value other than `clearValue`), it turns solid (`bg-inverted`) and shows the one
value or the count.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `def` * | `FilterDef` |  |  |
| `onChange` * | `(selected: string[]) => void` |  |  |

### FilterOptions

The checkbox list of one multi filter (FilterChip's popover, FilterPanel's accordion).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `def` * | `FilterDef` |  |  |
| `onChange` * | `(selected: string[]) => void` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- Every chip is a button: a multi chip has aria-haspopup=dialog and aria-expanded (its popover traps nothing, Escape returns focus to the chip); a switch chip has aria-pressed.
- A single chip has aria-haspopup=menu; its options are menuitemradio with aria-checked, the menu opens on the checked one (↑/↓, Enter / Space pick, Escape returns to the chip). Its visible name is the filter and its value (“Hộp thư: Tất cả”).
- An active chip's name says the filter and its value (“Quốc gia: Đức”, or “Quốc gia · 2”); the options are named checkboxes in a group named after the filter.
- The ‹ › buttons are for the pointer only (aria-hidden, out of the tab order): Tab reaches every chip and scrolls it into view.

## Notes

- One line, never wrapping rows of chips (C-032 L3); more than one row → this row.
- A single filter has one value in the URL (?f.box=sales) and none while its clearValue is in effect: selected is [] then (not an active filter, “Xoá lọc” resets it), so read it as selected[0] ?? clearValue. Without clearValue nothing is checked until a value is picked.
- `leading` holds the page's views (`SegmentedControl`), the md+ twin of PhoneFilterBar typeItems. A view is not a filter: “Xoá lọc” leaves it, and it does not scroll with the chips.
- Pass `sort` (from `useFilterParams(..., { sort })`) and `selection` (`useListSelection`) on FilterChipRow so sorting and in-place bulk selection share the filter row with zero vertical shift on the list.
- URL format: one repeated param per filter (?f.status=new&f.status=won&f.big=1); unknown values from an old link are dropped. useFilterParams reads the URL after hydration (prerender-safe, no useSearchParams), writes with history.pushState(null, …) so Next's useSearchParams and router.refresh() keep the filters, pushes one history entry per change (Back undoes a filter) and follows Back / Forward, other hooks on the page and (with the Navigation API, or on the next render) a Link or router.push to the same route.
- With Next's router of your own: readFilters(useSearchParams(), specs) in, router.push(`?${writeFilters(params, { status: [...] }, specs)}`) out.
- Without the Navigation API (Firefox, Safari before 26) the hook re-reads the URL on Back / Forward, on its own writes and whenever its component renders. A hook in a component that stays mounted and does not re-render (a layout) can then miss a Link or router.push to the same route: there, read the filters with useSearchParams + readFilters (inside Suspense) and write them with writeFilters + router.push instead.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/filter-chip-row/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/filter-panel.md -->

# Filter panel

Filters on phones: one segmented pill (the page's views · Bộ lọc with the count · sort and view settings) that opens a full-screen panel: sort first, booleans as switches, one accordion per filter (a radio group for a single-choice one), “Xem N kết quả” at the bottom. From sm the panel is a side sheet, also the “Bộ lọc” panel of a page with more filters than its chip row shows.

## When to use

- Below md on every page that has a FilterChipRow on desktop (same filters, same state).
- A desktop page whose filters do not fit in chips (many facets, a date range): a Bộ lọc button opens the panel as a side sheet.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Filters on desktop and iPad | FilterChipRow |
| A form in a sheet (edit a record) | Drawer |

## Import

```tsx
import { PhoneFilterBar, FilterPanel } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Phone bar and panel

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { FilterPanel, PhoneFilterBar, activeFilterCount, type FilterDef } from "@semi/ui";

const SPECS: Omit<FilterDef, "selected">[] = [
  { key: "status", label: "Trạng thái", icon: "activity", options: [{ value: "new", label: "Mới", count: 12 }, { value: "quoting", label: "Đang báo giá", count: 5 }, { value: "won", label: "Đã chốt", count: 31 }] },
  { key: "country", label: "Quốc gia", icon: "mapPin", options: [{ value: "DE", label: "Đức" }, { value: "AE", label: "UAE" }, { value: "IN", label: "Ấn Độ" }] },
  { key: "owner", label: "Phụ trách", icon: "user", options: [{ value: "ha", label: "Trần Thu Hà" }, { value: "nam", label: "Lê Hoàng Nam" }] },
  { key: "big", label: "Từ 100 tấn/năm", icon: "gauge", kind: "switch" },
];
const VIEWS = { all: "Tất cả", pending: "Chờ duyệt", mine: "Của tôi" } as const;

export default function FilterPanelPhone() {
  const [sel, setSel] = useState<Record<string, string[]>>({ status: ["new"] });
  const [view, setView] = useState<keyof typeof VIEWS>("all");
  const [sort, setSort] = useState("recent");
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const filters: FilterDef[] = SPECS.map((s) => ({ ...s, selected: sel[s.key] ?? [] }));
  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-sm">
      <PhoneFilterBar
        typeLabel={VIEWS[view]}
        typeItems={(Object.keys(VIEWS) as (keyof typeof VIEWS)[]).map((k) => ({ label: VIEWS[k], icon: k === view ? "check" : undefined, onSelect: () => setView(k) }))}
        activeCount={activeFilterCount(filters)}
        onOpenFilters={() => setOpen(true)}
        filtersOpen={open}
        onOpenSettings={() => setOpen(true)}
      />
      <FilterPanel
        open={open}
        onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
        filters={filters}
        onChange={(key, selected) => setSel({ ...sel, [key]: selected })}
        onClear={() => setSel({})}
        sort={{ value: sort, onChange: setSort, options: [{ value: "recent", label: "Mới thêm" }, { value: "volume", label: "Sản lượng năm" }] }}
        resultCount={sel.status?.length ? 12 : 48}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### PhoneFilterBar

The filter controls of a phone list page in one row: an optional type menu (the page's views), "Bộ lọc" with the
active count (opens FilterPanel), optional `sort` menu, optional `selection` ("Chọn" → replaces the row at the same
`h-11` height with `"n đã chọn"`, •••, one bulk button and `"Xong"`), and optional settings. Show below `md` in place
of `FilterChipRow` (`md:hidden` / `max-md:hidden`).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `typeLabel` | `string` |  | The current view's name ("Tất cả"); shown with `typeItems`. |
| `typeItems` | `MenuItem[]` |  | The views to switch between (a Menu). |
| `activeCount` * | `number` |  | How many filters are on (activeFilterCount); shown on the button. |
| `onOpenFilters` * | `() => void` |  |  |
| `filtersOpen` | `boolean` |  | Whether the panel is open (aria-expanded on the button). |
| `sort` | `SortDef` |  | Sort menu right on the phone filter row (radio items). |
| `selection` | `ListSelection` |  | Selection mode ("Chọn") and bulk actions replacing the row at the same height (zero list shift). |
| `onOpenSettings` | `() => void` |  | Opens the sort and view settings; the button shows when given. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

### FilterPanel

The full filter set in a modal panel: full screen on phones, a right side sheet from `sm` (also the "Bộ lọc" panel
of a desktop page with more filters than its chip row shows). Changes apply at once (the list behind updates);
"Xem N kết quả" closes. Focus moves in, is trapped, and returns to the opener; Escape closes.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `open` * | `boolean` |  |  |
| `onClose` * | `() => void` |  |  |
| `filters` * | `FilterDef[]` |  |  |
| `onChange` * | `(key: string, selected: string[], mode?: "push" \| "replace") => void` |  |  |
| `onClear` * | `() => void` |  |  |
| `sort` | `SortDef` |  | Sort choices, shown first as a row of chips. |
| `resultCount` | `number` |  | Rows matching now, on the bottom button ("Xem 12 kết quả"); without it the button says "Đóng". |
| `title` | `string` |  | Heading (default "Bộ lọc"). |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` |  | More settings under the filters (a ViewSwitch, a date range). |

## Accessibility

- The panel is a modal dialog named “Bộ lọc”: focus moves in, Tab stays inside, Escape closes and focus returns to the button that opened it.
- The Bộ lọc button's name is its text and the count (“Bộ lọc 2”); it has aria-haspopup=dialog and aria-expanded (filtersOpen).
- Each accordion is a heading with a button (aria-expanded, aria-controls); the sort is a group of toggle buttons (aria-pressed). A single-choice filter's accordion holds a radio group; its heading shows the current value.

## Notes

- Changes apply at once (the list behind updates); “Xem N kết quả” only closes. Keep the open state in the URL (?filters=1) when Back should close it.
- The accordions of filters that are on start open (at most two).
- Phone chrome stays within 2 rows (P1): the search, then this bar; the result line may follow.
- The type menu (typeItems) lists the page's views: give its items radio: true and checked, so they are menuitemradio and the menu opens on the current one.
