<!-- docs/components/form-actions.md -->

# Form actions, unsaved guard, validation

The same form behaviour everywhere: FormActions (Huỷ then Lưu / Tạo, sticky on a page, the footer of a Modal), useUnsavedGuard (nobody loses typed work), and validation that shows on blur then follows changes, with an Alert summary for several errors.

## When to use

- Every form: the action row is FormActions, never a hand-ordered pair of buttons.
- Any form the user can lose by leaving (a page, a long modal): useUnsavedGuard(dirty).
- Validation of a form with more than one required field: useFormValidation + Field error.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| The action row of a confirmation (Xoá? Huỷ / Xoá) | confirmDialog |
| A setting that applies at once, no Save | Switch (a toast says it was saved) |
| The result of Save (saved, failed to reach the server) | toast; a problem inside a field is Field error, never a toast |
| Page-level buttons of a list (Thêm máy in) | PageActions / PageTitle |

## Import

```tsx
import { FormActions, useUnsavedGuard, useFormValidation, FormErrorSummary } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Page form

Required fields, kinds for the phone keyboard, validation on blur then change, the summary for several errors, the guard, and Huỷ / Tạo.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Field, FormActions, FormErrorSummary, Input, toast, useFormValidation, useUnsavedGuard } from "@semi/ui";

const EMPTY = { name: "", email: "", phone: "", price: "" };

export default function FormActionsPageForm() {
  const [values, setValues] = useState(EMPTY);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(EMPTY);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const set = (key: keyof typeof EMPTY) => (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => setValues((v) => ({ ...v, [key]: e.target.value }));

  // errors show after a field loses focus, then follow every change
  const form = useFormValidation(values, {
    name: (v) => (v.trim() ? undefined : "Nhập tên máy in."),
    email: (v) => (/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(v) ? undefined : "Email chưa đúng, ví dụ ten@congty.vn."),
    phone: (v) => (v && !/^0\d{9}$/.test(v) ? "Số điện thoại gồm 10 số, bắt đầu bằng 0." : undefined),
  });
  // warns on reload, tab close, a link or back while this is true
  const dirty = JSON.stringify(values) !== JSON.stringify(saved);
  const { confirmLeave } = useUnsavedGuard(dirty);
  const router = useRouter();

  // after a save, go on with confirmLeave: the form is clean, so it only drops the guard's history entry (Back stays one press)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (saved !== EMPTY) void confirmLeave(() => router.push("/components/button/"));
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [saved]);

  const save = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!form.validate()) return;
    setSaving(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setSaving(false);
      setSaved(values); // not dirty any more: leaving does not ask
      toast({ title: "Đã tạo máy in", tone: "success" });
    }, 600);
  };

  return (
    <form data-form="page-form" onSubmit={save} noValidate className="w-full max-w-2xl flex flex-col gap-stack">
      <Field label="Tên máy in" required error={form.errors.name}>
        <Input value={values.name} onChange={set("name")} onBlur={form.blur("name")} />
      </Field>
      <Field label="Email liên hệ" kind="email" required error={form.errors.email}>
        <Input value={values.email} onChange={set("email")} onBlur={form.blur("email")} />
      </Field>
      <Field label="Số điện thoại" kind="tel" hint="Không bắt buộc." error={form.errors.phone}>
        <Input value={values.phone} onChange={set("phone")} onBlur={form.blur("phone")} />
      </Field>
      <Field label="Giá bán" kind="money">
        <Input value={values.price} onChange={set("price")} />
      </Field>
      <FormErrorSummary errors={form.errors} />
      <FormActions create loading={saving} onCancel={() => confirmLeave(() => router.back())} />
    </form>
  );
}
```

### Destructive action on the left

Editing an existing record: Xoá is alone on the left, away from Lưu, and asks first (after the unsaved-changes question, if the form is dirty).

```tsx
"use client";

import { Button, confirmDelete, Field, FormActions, Input, toast, useUnsavedGuard } from "@semi/ui";
import { useState } from "react";

export default function FormActionsDestructive() {
  const [name, setName] = useState("Bambu X1C");
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState("Bambu X1C");
  const { confirmLeave } = useUnsavedGuard(name !== saved);

  const remove = async () => {
    if (await confirmDelete({ name: saved, message: "Lịch sử in của máy cũng bị xoá." })) toast.success("Đã xoá máy in");
  };

  return (
    <form
      data-form="destructive"
      className="w-full max-w-2xl flex flex-col gap-stack"
      onSubmit={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        setSaved(name);
      }}
    >
      <Field label="Tên máy in" required>
        <Input value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} />
      </Field>
      <FormActions
        onCancel={() => confirmLeave(() => setName(saved))}
        destructive={
          <Button variant="danger" icon="trash" onClick={() => confirmLeave(remove)}>
            Xoá máy in
          </Button>
        }
      />
    </form>
  );
}
```

### In a Modal footer

placement="modal": the same order, 44px buttons on phones; the primary is type="button" with onSubmit because the footer sits outside the form.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, Field, FormActions, Input, Modal } from "@semi/ui";

export default function FormActionsModal() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const close = () => setOpen(false);
  return (
    <>
      <Button icon="edit" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
        Đổi tên máy in
      </Button>
      <Modal
        open={open}
        onClose={close}
        title="Đổi tên máy in"
        closeOnBackdrop={false}
        footer={<FormActions placement="modal" onCancel={close} onSubmit={close} />}
      >
        <Field label="Tên máy in" required>
          <Input defaultValue="Bambu X1C" />
        </Field>
      </Modal>
    </>
  );
}
```

## API

### FormActions

Cancel (ghost) then Save / Create (primary), right-aligned, `destructive` on the left. Page forms stick to the bottom
of the screen, above the on-screen keyboard and the home indicator; in a Modal pass `placement="modal"` as the footer.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `onCancel` | `() => void` |  | Huỷ: leaves the form (route back, close the modal). Omit for a form that cannot be cancelled. |
| `cancelLabel` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Text of the cancel button (default "Huỷ"). |
| `submitLabel` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Text of the primary button (default "Lưu", or "Tạo" with `create`). |
| `create` | `boolean` | `false` | The form makes something new: the primary reads "Tạo" instead of "Lưu". |
| `onSubmit` | `() => void` |  | Runs when the primary is pressed. Omit it inside a `<form>`: the button is then `type="submit"` and the form's `onSubmit` handles it (Enter in a field works too). Pass it in a Modal footer, which sits outside the form. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | The save is running: the primary shows a spinner and blocks clicks. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the primary (nothing changed, or the form is invalid and the screen chose not to say so on press). |
| `destructive` | `React.ReactNode` |  | A destructive action (Xoá…) shown alone on the left, away from the primary. A `variant="danger"` Button. |
| `placement` | `'modal' \| 'page'` | `"page"` | `page` (default): sticky at the bottom of the page. `modal`: the footer of a Modal (not sticky, stretched on phones by the footer). |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

### useUnsavedGuard

`dirty` is true while the form holds changes that are not saved (compare with the loaded values; false right after a
successful save, before navigating on). Prompt texts come from the locale table (`unsavedTitle`, `unsavedChanges`,
`leave`, `stay`).

No props of its own.

### useFormValidation

No props of its own.

### FormErrorSummary

The summary of a form with several errors: an `Alert` listing them, placed above `FormActions`. One error shows only
under its field (the summary renders nothing), so a form never says the same thing twice.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `errors` * | `Record<string, string \| undefined>` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- Tab order follows the visual order: destructive action, Huỷ, then the primary; Enter in a field submits the form (the primary is type="submit").
- Buttons are 44px high (h-11) below sm; the page bar sits above the on-screen keyboard and the home-indicator inset.
- A field error is announced (role="alert") and sets aria-invalid; the Alert summary (several errors) is role="alert" too.
- useUnsavedGuard asks with confirmDialog (a focus-trapped dialog, Escape stays); reload and tab close use the browser's own prompt.

## Notes

- Order: [destructive … ] Huỷ (ghost) Lưu (primary), right-aligned. "Tạo" (`create`) when the form makes something new, "Lưu" when it edits. Page forms are at most `max-w-2xl` (`FORM_PAGE`), labels above the fields, required fields marked `*` (Field `required`).
- Sticky: on a page FormActions is `sticky bottom-0` in the page's scroll area, over `bg-app` (the panel colour inside the AppShell card) with a line above, lifted above the keyboard (visualViewport) and padded by the safe-area inset. A page that scrolls inside an `overflow` box keeps the bar at the end of that box. In a Modal pass `placement="modal"` as the footer.
- Validation timing: nothing while a field is first filled, its error on blur, then on every change (it clears the moment it is fixed). On submit `form.validate()` touches every field. One error shows only under its field; two or more also show a FormErrorSummary above FormActions.
- Guard: `dirty` must be false right after a successful save, before you navigate on. It covers reload and tab close (beforeunload), link clicks and back / forward; for a navigation your own code starts (router.push after a button, a Huỷ that goes back) wrap it: `confirmLeave(() => router.back())`. While dirty one history entry is added so back can be asked about; an agreed leave drops it first (Back stays one press, nothing asks twice), and after a save it is a spent marker: navigate on with `confirmLeave(() => router.push(x))` (clean form, no question; the spent entry is popped first so Back is one press).
- Texts (Huỷ, Lưu, Tạo, "Bạn có thay đổi chưa lưu…", Rời đi, Ở lại, "Có n mục cần sửa") are Vietnamese by default and come from SemiLocaleProvider. Mount ConfirmHost once in the root layout (useUnsavedGuard asks through it).

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/form-actions/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/hint-textarea.md -->

# Hint textarea

A text area that says what it can do (L15): a hint row under the text (“Gõ @ để nhắc nhà cung cấp · Gõ / để chèn mẫu”) and a suggestion list while the word at the caret starts with a trigger; the chosen item is inserted with a space after it.

## When to use

- A message or note where people mention a record (@ a supplier, a colleague) or insert a template or command (/).
- A prompt box of a workspace or an AI tool with a few shortcuts.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Pick one value from a list | CustomCombobox |
| A plain multi-line field | Field + textarea (FIELD_TEXTAREA) |
| An AI chat composer | ChatComposer |

## Import

```tsx
import { HintTextarea, type HintToken, type HintTrigger } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Mentions and templates

Type @ or / at the start of a word. The suggestion list portals at z-popover and flips above when there is no room below.

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { HintTextarea } from "@semi/ui";

export default function HintTextareaBasic() {
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState("Chào anh chị, bên em cần báo giá cho ");
  return (
    <div className="max-w-md">
      <HintTextarea
        label="Lời nhắn gửi nhà cung cấp"
        value={msg}
        onChange={setMsg}
        triggers={[
          {
            char: "@",
            hint: "để nhắc nhà cung cấp",
            items: [
              { value: "@taynguyen", label: "Gia vị Tây Nguyên", hint: "Đắk Lắk", icon: "truck" },
              { value: "@chuse", label: "HTX Tiêu Chư Sê", hint: "Gia Lai", icon: "truck" },
              { value: "@yenbai", label: "Hương Quế Yên Bái", hint: "Yên Bái", icon: "truck" },
            ],
          },
          {
            char: "/",
            hint: "để chèn mẫu",
            items: [
              { value: "/fob", label: "Hỏi giá FOB", hint: "Giá FOB Hải Phòng, hạn giao", icon: "fileText" },
              { value: "/mau", label: "Xin mẫu", hint: "Gửi 1 kg mẫu trước khi chốt", icon: "fileText" },
            ],
          },
        ]}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Plain-text snippets and reply box

value (or insert) replaces the trigger word with a token (@s1) or plain text (a snippet); resizable auto-grows from 3 rows to 50% and adds a top resize edge from md.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { HintTextarea, type HintToken } from "@semi/ui";

const SNIPPETS: HintToken[] = [
  {
    value: "/vat",
    insert: "Giá chưa gồm VAT 8%, giao tại kho Bình Dương.",
    label: "Giá chưa gồm VAT",
    hint: "Điều khoản thuế và giao hàng tiêu chuẩn",
    icon: "fileText",
  },
  {
    value: "/mau",
    insert: "Bên em xin nhận 1 kg mẫu kiểm tra chất lượng trước khi chốt đơn.",
    label: "Xin mẫu kiểm tra",
    hint: "Mẫu 1 kg trước khi đặt lô chính",
    icon: "fileText",
  },
];

export default function HintTextareaSnippets() {
  const [reply, setReply] = useState("");
  return (
    <div className="max-w-lg h-72 flex flex-col justify-end border border-line rounded-card p-card bg-panel">
      <HintTextarea
        label="Trả lời nhà cung cấp"
        placeholder="Nhập trả lời… gõ / để chèn ghi chú nhanh"
        value={reply}
        onChange={setReply}
        autoGrow
        resizable
        triggers={[{ char: "/", hint: "để chèn ghi chú thường dùng", items: SNIPPETS }]}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### In a Field

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { Field, HintTextarea } from "@semi/ui";

export default function HintTextareaField() {
  const [note, setNote] = useState("");
  return (
    <div className="max-w-md">
      <Field label="Ghi chú nội bộ" hint="Người được nhắc sẽ nhận thông báo.">
        <HintTextarea
          rows={3}
          placeholder="Ghi chú cho đồng nghiệp…"
          value={note}
          onChange={setNote}
          triggers={[
            {
              char: "@",
              hint: "để nhắc đồng nghiệp",
              items: [
                { value: "@ha", label: "Trần Thu Hà", hint: "Mua hàng", icon: "user" },
                { value: "@minh", label: "Lê Văn Minh", hint: "Kho", icon: "user" },
              ],
            },
          ]}
        />
      </Field>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### HintTextarea

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` * | `string` |  |  |
| `onChange` * | `(value: string) => void` |  |  |
| `triggers` * | `HintTrigger[]` |  | One per trigger character, each with its suggestions. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name when there is no surrounding `Field` label. |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  |  |
| `rows` | `number` |  | Visible row count (defaults to 3 when `autoGrow` / `resizable` is set, else 4). |
| `autoGrow` | `boolean` | `false` | Grow with typed text from `rows` (default 3) up to 50% of its container, then scroll inside. |
| `resizable` | `boolean` | `false` | From `md`: adds a top resize edge (`role="separator"`, drag / ArrowUp / ArrowDown ±24px / double-click reset, up to 80% of container). Phones: auto-grow only. |
| `containerRef` | `RefObject<HTMLElement \| null>` |  | Optional bounding container for 50% / 80% height caps (auto-detected when omitted). |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `id` | `string` |  | Set by the surrounding Field when omitted. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- The textarea is a combobox (role="combobox", aria-expanded, aria-haspopup="listbox", aria-autocomplete="list"): while the list shows, aria-controls names the listbox and aria-activedescendant the current option. ↑ / ↓ move (wrapping), Enter or Tab inserts, Escape closes the list only (not a dialog around it); a polite status says how many suggestions there are.
- Keys typed while an input method composes (Vietnamese Telex; also the keyCode 229 Enter Safari sends to confirm) are left alone. The hint row is the field's description. Named by its Field label or label.

## Notes

- `value` (or `insert` when the inserted text differs from the short key) replaces the trigger word: use it for a token (`@s1`) or plain text (a snippet or canned reply). `showValue` defaults to `false` when `insert` is set, and long values truncate so the label stays readable.
- The suggestion list uses the Popover engine (`useAnchoredPosition` + portal at `z-popover`), so it flips above near the bottom and is never clipped by a scrolling pane or modal.
- Matching ignores case and Vietnamese marks (“tay nguyen” finds “Tây Nguyên”); at most six suggestions show. Telex IME composition (`isComposing`, `keyCode` 229) is verified across Chromium, WebKit and Firefox.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/hint-textarea/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/input-group.md -->

# Input group

An input with fixed parts around it: a prefix (https://), a unit (kg, ₫), an icon or a small button (copy, show password).

## When to use

- Money and units, URLs and domains, a copy or reveal button inside the field.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Just an icon | Input with icon |

## Import

```tsx
import { InputGroup } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Prefix, unit and button

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, Field, Input, InputGroup } from "@semi/ui";

export default function InputGroupAddons() {
  const [show, setShow] = useState(false);
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4 max-w-md">
      <Field label="Website" kind="url">
        <InputGroup start="https://">
          <Input type="text" placeholder="3dnoobs.vn" />
        </InputGroup>
      </Field>
      <Field label="Giá bán" kind="money">
        <InputGroup end="₫">
          <Input defaultValue="250.000" className="tabular-nums" />
        </InputGroup>
      </Field>
      <Field label="Mật khẩu Wi-Fi máy in" kind="password">
        <InputGroup end={<Button size="sm" variant="ghost" iconOnly icon={show ? "eyeOff" : "eye"} aria-label={show ? "Ẩn" : "Hiện"} onClick={() => setShow((v) => !v)} />}>
          <Input type={show ? "text" : "password"} defaultValue="noobs-2026" />
        </InputGroup>
      </Field>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### InputGroup

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `start` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Before the input: text ("https://"), an <Icon />, a small Button. |
| `end` | `React.ReactNode` |  | After the input: a unit ("kg"), a Button (copy, show password). |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  | One Input (or Textarea / NumberInput). |

## Accessibility

- The Input inside keeps its label from Field; buttons in the group need their own aria-label.

<!-- docs/components/input-otp.md -->

# Input OTP

One-time code entry (OTP, PIN, 2FA): boxes on screen, one real input underneath, so paste, SMS autofill, screen readers and the number keypad work like a normal field.

## When to use

- Verification codes, PINs, invite codes of a fixed length.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A password | Input type="password" (+ InputGroup reveal button) |

## Import

```tsx
import { InputOTP } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### 6-digit code

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Field, InputOTP, toast } from "@semi/ui";

export default function InputOTPBasic() {
  const [code, setCode] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState(false);
  return (
    <Field label="Mã xác thực" hint="Gửi tới số điện thoại ****321" error={error ? "Mã không đúng, thử lại." : undefined}>
      <InputOTP
        value={code}
        onChange={(v) => {
          setCode(v);
          setError(false);
        }}
        onComplete={(v) => (v === "123456" ? toast({ title: "Đã xác thực", tone: "success" }) : setError(true))}
        invalid={error}
      />
    </Field>
  );
}
```

## API

### InputOTP

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` * | `string` |  |  |
| `onChange` * | `(value: string) => void` |  |  |
| `onComplete` | `(value: string) => void` |  | Called once every box is filled. |
| `length` | `number` | `6` |  |
| `type` | `'numeric' \| 'text'` | `"numeric"` | numeric: digits and the number keypad; text: letters and digits. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name (default “Mã xác thực”). Put a visible label in Field around it when you have one. |
| `groupSize` | `number` | `3` | Visual gap after every N boxes (0: none). |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Error look (wrong code). |
| `autoFocus` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- A single labelled input with autocomplete="one-time-code" and inputmode="numeric"; the boxes are decoration; invalid sets aria-invalid.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/input-otp/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/multi-combobox.md -->

# Multi combobox

Searchable multi-select: chosen values show as removable chips, an add button (default “Thêm” / “Add”) opens a portaled popover with a quiet search field and a checkbox list. Supports option groups (`group`), diacritic-aware search and Vietnamese Telex IME.

## When to use

- Picking several values from a long or grouped list in a form (supplied goods, tags, assignees, repositories).

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Pick one value with search | CustomCombobox |
| Pick one value from a short fixed list | CustomSelect |
| Filter a list page in a toolbar | FilterChipRow |

## Import

```tsx
import { MultiCombobox, type MultiComboboxOption } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Chips and searchable popover

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Field, MultiCombobox } from "@semi/ui";

const GOODS = [
  { value: "tieu-den", label: "Hạt tiêu đen Đắk Lắk" },
  { value: "que-yen-bai", label: "Quế thanh Yên Bái" },
  { value: "hoa-hoi", label: "Hoa hồi Lạng Sơn" },
  { value: "ca-phe-robusta", label: "Cà phê Robusta Gia Lai" },
  { value: "dieu-binh-phuoc", label: "Hạt điều Bình Phước" },
];

export default function MultiComboboxBasic() {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string[]>(["tieu-den", "que-yen-bai"]);
  return (
    <div className="max-w-lg">
      <Field label="Mặt hàng cung ứng">
        <MultiCombobox label="Mặt hàng cung ứng" value={selected} onChange={setSelected} options={GOODS} />
      </Field>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Grouped options

Consecutive options with the same group share a heading; headings stay only while at least one option matches and are skipped by arrow keys.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Field, MultiCombobox, type MultiComboboxOption } from "@semi/ui";

const OPTIONS: MultiComboboxOption[] = [
  { value: "tieu-den", label: "Hạt tiêu đen", group: "Gia vị Tây Nguyên" },
  { value: "tieu-trang", label: "Hạt tiêu trắng", group: "Gia vị Tây Nguyên" },
  { value: "que-yen-bai", label: "Quế thanh Yên Bái", group: "Gia vị miền Bắc" },
  { value: "hoa-hoi", label: "Hoa hồi Lạng Sơn", group: "Gia vị miền Bắc" },
  { value: "ca-phe", label: "Cà phê Robusta", group: "Nông sản khác" },
];

export default function MultiComboboxGroups() {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string[]>(["tieu-den"]);
  return (
    <div className="max-w-lg">
      <Field label="Danh mục sản phẩm">
        <MultiCombobox label="Danh mục sản phẩm" value={selected} onChange={setSelected} options={OPTIONS} />
      </Field>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### MultiCombobox

Searchable multi-select with removable chips and a portaled search + checkbox popover.
Supports option groups (`group`), diacritic-aware search and Vietnamese Telex IME composition.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` * | `string[]` |  | Selected option values (controlled). |
| `onChange` * | `(next: string[]) => void` |  |  |
| `options` * | `MultiComboboxOption[]` |  |  |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the field ("Mặt hàng cung ứng") when not inside a `Field`. |
| `addLabel` | `string` |  | Label on the button that opens the picker (defaults to "Thêm" / "Add"). |
| `searchPlaceholder` | `string` |  | Placeholder inside the popover's search input. |
| `empty` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Shown when nothing matches the search query. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `id` | `string` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- Each removable chip has a remove button with an accessible name (“Bỏ chọn <label>” / “Remove <label>”).
- Inside the popover: the search input is a combobox owning a multi-select listbox (↑/↓ skip group headings, Enter / Space toggle, Escape closes and returns focus to the add button; IME composition keys are ignored).

# Number input

NumberInput: numbers with a touch keypad (NumPadPopup) on phones and tablets, plain typing elsewhere. Never type="number".

## When to use

- Quantities, temperatures, prices, percentages.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A range picked by dragging | a slider (coming in a later release) |

## Import

```tsx
import { NumberInput, NumPadPopup, FIELD_INPUT } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### With unit

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { FIELD_INPUT, Field, NumberInput } from "@semi/ui";

export default function NumberInputBasic() {
  const [temp, setTemp] = useState("220");
  return (
    <Field label="Nhiệt độ đầu phun" hint="Trên màn hình cảm ứng mở bàn phím số.">
      <NumberInput className={FIELD_INPUT} value={temp} onChange={(e) => setTemp(e.target.value)} unit="°C" integer numpadLabel="Nhiệt độ" />
    </Field>
  );
}
```

## API

### NumberInput

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ref` | `React.Ref<HTMLInputElement>` |  |  |
| `numpadLabel` | `string` |  | Title shown on the numpad (defaults to aria-label / placeholder). |
| `unit` | `string` |  | Unit shown next to the value on the numpad. |
| `integer` | `boolean` |  | Whole numbers only (no decimal key). |

### NumPadPopup

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` * | `string` |  |  |
| `unit` | `string` |  |  |
| `initial` * | `string` |  |  |
| `integer` | `boolean` |  | whole numbers only |
| `allowPercent` | `boolean` |  | allow a trailing % (value like "15%") |
| `onCommit` * | `(value: string) => void` |  |  |
| `onClose` * | `() => void` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- inputMode="decimal" or numeric; the keypad is a dialog with focus trap and Escape.

<!-- docs/components/option-cards.md -->

# Option cards

Selectable cards with radio-group semantics (arrow keys, single tab stop): icon, name, optional description, neutral selected state (`bg-item-selected` + `border-outline-line` + `text-strong`, no brand tint) and 8px grid gap.

## When to use

- Picking one visual option from 2–6 choices (an AI provider, a shipping method, a plan) where a card with an icon or short description reads faster than a radio list.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Compact inline radio list without cards | RadioGroup |
| Pick one from a long or searchable list | CustomSelect or CustomCombobox |
| Pick multiple values with search and chips | MultiCombobox |

## Import

```tsx
import { OptionCards, type OptionCardItem } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Provider picker

Overline section label above a 2-column grid of option cards.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { OptionCards } from "@semi/ui";

export default function OptionCardsBasic() {
  const [provider, setProvider] = useState("openai");
  return (
    <div className="space-y-3 max-w-xl">
      <div className="text-overline text-muted">Nhà cung cấp AI</div>
      <OptionCards
        label="Nhà cung cấp AI"
        value={provider}
        onChange={setProvider}
        options={[
          { value: "openai", label: "OpenAI", icon: "sparkles" },
          { value: "anthropic", label: "Anthropic", icon: "cpu" },
          { value: "google", label: "Google Gemini", icon: "zap" },
          { value: "local", label: "Máy chủ nội bộ", icon: "server" },
        ]}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### With descriptions

Each card can carry a short muted description.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Field, OptionCards } from "@semi/ui";

export default function OptionCardsDescriptions() {
  const [delivery, setDelivery] = useState("warehouse");
  return (
    <div className="max-w-xl">
      <Field label="Phương thức giao hàng">
        <OptionCards
          value={delivery}
          onChange={setDelivery}
          options={[
            { value: "warehouse", label: "Giao tại kho", description: "Nhận hàng trực tiếp tại kho Bình Dương.", icon: "truck" },
            { value: "port", label: "FOB cảng Hải Phòng", description: "Nhà cung cấp chịu chi phí đến khi hàng lên tàu.", icon: "globe" },
            { value: "express", label: "Chuyển phát nhanh", description: "Chỉ áp dụng cho mẫu dưới 5 kg.", icon: "zap" },
          ]}
        />
      </Field>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### OptionCards

Selectable option cards with radio-group semantics: icon, name, optional description, 8px grid gap, neutral selected
fill (`bg-item-selected`, `border-outline-line`, `text-strong`, no brand tint). Arrow keys move selection and focus;
the group is one tab stop.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` * | `T` |  |  |
| `onChange` * | `(value: T) => void` |  |  |
| `options` * | `OptionCardItem<T>[]` |  |  |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the group when not inside a `Field` or named by `aria-labelledby`. |
| `columns` | `1 \| 2 \| 3 \| 4` | `2` | Column count from `sm` up (stacks to 1 column on phones for readability at 375px). |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  |  |
| `aria-labelledby` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- role="radiogroup" with role="radio" and aria-checked; roving tabindex gives the whole group one tab stop.
- Arrow keys (←/→/↑/↓) and Home/End move both selection and focus, wrapping around and skipping disabled cards.

<!-- docs/components/radio-group.md -->

# Radio group

Exactly one option of a few, each with an optional description; vertical by default.

## When to use

- 2–5 options where the descriptions help the choice (plans, shipping).

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A filter on a list | SegmentedControl |
| More than 5 options | CustomSelect |

## Import

```tsx
import { RadioGroup } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Plans

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { RadioGroup } from "@semi/ui";

export default function RadioGroupBasic() {
  const [plan, setPlan] = useState<"free" | "pro" | "team">("pro");
  return (
    <RadioGroup
      label="Gói dịch vụ"
      value={plan}
      onChange={setPlan}
      options={[
        { value: "free", label: "Free", description: "1 máy in" },
        { value: "pro", label: "Pro", description: "Tối đa 10 máy" },
        { value: "team", label: "Team", description: "Không giới hạn", disabled: true },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

## API

### RadioGroup

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` * | `T` |  |  |
| `onChange` * | `(value: T) => void` |  |  |
| `options` * | `RadioOption<T>[]` |  |  |
| `label` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Group label (announced for the whole group). |
| `name` | `string` |  |  |
| `direction` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `"vertical"` |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  | Accessible name for the radiogroup when no visible `label` is rendered. `label` wins. |
| `aria-labelledby` | `string` |  | Id of the element that names the radiogroup when no visible `label` is rendered. `label` wins. |

## Accessibility

- A native radio group with a group label: arrow keys move and select.

The toolbar search: an icon button that opens into a field (clear button, h-control); it collapses again when empty and focus leaves. SubpageToolbar includes one.

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";

}

### SearchInput

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |

| `placeholder` * | `string` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` | `"w-40 sm:w-48"` |  |
| `label` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

<!-- docs/components/search-pill.md -->

# Search pill

The wide pill search of a list page (one per page), with an optional `trailing` slot for `<BarActions>` when pinned in StickyContextBar. Typing is debounced (250 ms), Escape and the clear button clear at once, an optional key (/) focuses it.

## When to use

- The search of a list, grid or DataTable page, above its filter chips (inside StickyContextBar).

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A search among the toolbar's icon buttons (a small page, few rows) | SubpageToolbar onSearchChange (SearchInput) |
| Jump to any page or action from anywhere | Command |
| A search field inside a form or a popover | Input with a search icon (InputGroup) |

## Import

```tsx
import { SearchPill } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Search

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { SearchPill } from "@semi/ui";

export default function SearchPillDefault() {
  const [q, setQ] = useState("");
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 w-full">
      <SearchPill value={q} onChange={setQ} label="Tìm khách hàng" placeholder="Tìm khách, quốc gia, mặt hàng…" focusKey="/" />
      <p className="text-ui text-muted">
        Đang tìm: <span className="text-strong">{q || "—"}</span> (gõ xong 250 ms mới gửi; Esc để xoá; phím / để vào ô tìm)
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### SearchPill

The wide pill search of a list page: one per page, it feeds the list (or DataTable). Typing calls `onChange` after
`debounce` ms; the clear button and Escape clear at once. A history push of useFilterParams / useDetailParam /
openDetail during the debounce sends the pending text first, so the query stays on the entry it was typed on. `focusKey` ("/") focuses it from anywhere on the page
(not while typing in another field).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` * | `string` |  |  |
| `onChange` * | `(value: string) => void` |  | Gets the text after the debounce. For a query in the URL write it at once with `useFilterParams().setParams({ q: v }, "replace")`: a push during the debounce (opening a row, a filter chip) then keeps it on the list's entry. `router.replace`, nuqs or state + an effect land after that push. |
| `label` * | `string` |  | Accessible name ("Tìm khách hàng"); also the placeholder when none is given. |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  |  |
| `debounce` | `number` | `250` | Milliseconds to wait after the last key before `onChange` (0: every key). |
| `focusKey` | `string` |  | A key that focuses the field from anywhere on the page, e.g. "/". Shown as a key cap while the field is empty. |
| `shortcut` | `string` |  | Key cap shown while empty when the app binds the shortcut itself ("⌘K" for a command palette). |
| `trailing` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Extra tools at the right end (pinned `<BarActions />`, image search, voice). |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- label is required: it names the field (type=search) and is the placeholder when none is given.
- focusKey is ignored while typing in another field and with ⌘ / Ctrl / Alt; the key cap is hidden from screen readers.

## Notes

- Controlled: keep the query in the URL (?q=) so a reload or a shared link keeps it; the field shows a value changed from outside (Back, Xoá lọc).
- One search per page, feeding the list or DataTable (C-021 D5): never a second search in the table header.
- debounce={0} sends every key (a small local list).
- Opening a row (useDetailParam().open, openDetail) or a filter chip inside the debounce sends the pending text first, onto the list's history entry: Back keeps the query, no need for debounce={0}. Text typed before a navigation to another route is dropped. This needs an onChange that writes the URL at once: useFilterParams().setParams({ q: v }, "replace"). router.replace, nuqs or state + an effect still land after the push.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/search-pill/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/select.md -->

# Select

CustomSelect: pick one value from a list, in a field, in a toolbar, inline in a row or bare. Never the native <select>.

## When to use

- One value from a short or medium list (printers, regions).
- A compact sort / group control in a toolbar (variant="toolbar").

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A long or grouped list that needs search | CustomCombobox |
| Pick multiple values with search and removable chips | MultiCombobox |
| 2–5 visible options | SegmentedControl, RadioGroup or OptionCards |

## Import

```tsx
import { CustomSelect } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### In a form

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { CustomSelect, Field } from "@semi/ui";

export default function SelectField() {
  const [printer, setPrinter] = useState("x1c");
  return (
    <Field label="Máy in">
      <CustomSelect
        variant="field"
        value={printer}
        onChange={setPrinter}
        options={[
          { value: "x1c", label: "Bambu Lab X1-Carbon" },
          { value: "p1s", label: "Bambu Lab P1S" },
          { value: "a1", label: "Bambu Lab A1 Mini" },
        ]}
      />
    </Field>
  );
}
```

### In a toolbar

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { CustomSelect } from "@semi/ui";

export default function SelectToolbar() {
  const [sort, setSort] = useState("recent");
  return (
    <CustomSelect
      variant="toolbar"
      aria-label="Sắp xếp"
      value={sort}
      onChange={setSort}
      options={[
        { value: "recent", label: "Mới nhất" },
        { value: "name", label: "Tên A–Z" },
        { value: "status", label: "Trạng thái" },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

## API

### CustomSelect

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` * | `string` |  |  |
| `onChange` * | `(val: string) => void` |  |  |
| `options` * | `CustomSelectOption[]` |  |  |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` | `""` |  |
| `align` | `'left' \| 'right'` | `"left"` | Which edge the option list lines up with (use "right" for a select at the right edge of the screen). |
| `iconsInList` | `boolean` | `false` | Show each option's icon in the list too (default: only on the button). |
| `iconOnly` | `boolean` | `false` | The button shows only the selected option's icon (its label becomes the tooltip), e.g. the AI profile logo. |
| `variant` | `'toolbar' \| 'field' \| 'inline' \| 'bare'` | `"toolbar"` | toolbar = h-control toolbar control (34px) · field = full-width form field · inline = bare text inside a row · bare = no trigger styling (the caller passes it in buttonClassName, e.g. the automation code chips) |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `buttonClassName` | `string` | `""` | Extra classes on the button (e.g. a "modified value" colour). |
| `id` | `string` |  |  |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  | What the select chooses (e.g. "Sắp xếp") when no visible label names it. The button is announced as this name followed by the value it shows, so speech users can say what they see. |
| `title` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- A listbox button: Enter / Space / arrows open it, type-ahead jumps, Escape closes and returns focus.
- Without a visible label (toolbar, inline) pass aria-label naming what it chooses; the button is announced as that label followed by the value it shows, so speech users can say what they see.

<!-- docs/components/slider.md -->

# Slider

Pick a number in a range by dragging: one thumb, or two with range for a min–max pair.

## When to use

- Values where the position matters more than the exact number (volume, opacity, infill, price range filters).

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| An exact number | NumberInput |

## Import

```tsx
import { Slider } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Single

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Slider } from "@semi/ui";

export default function SliderSingle() {
  const [infill, setInfill] = useState(20);
  return <Slider label="Độ đặc (infill)" value={infill} onChange={setInfill} step={5} showValue format={(v) => `${v}%`} className="max-w-sm" />;
}
```

### Range

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Slider } from "@semi/ui";

export default function SliderRange() {
  const [price, setPrice] = useState<[number, number]>([100, 600]);
  return (
    <Slider
      range
      label="Khoảng giá"
      value={price}
      onChange={setPrice}
      min={0}
      max={1000}
      step={50}
      showValue
      format={(v) => `${v}k ₫`}
      className="max-w-sm"
    />
  );
}
```

## API

### Slider

One or two thumbs (role="slider"): ←/↓ and →/↑ step, PageUp / PageDown jump 10 steps, Home / End go to the ends;
drag or click the track. `value` is a number, or [low, high] with `range`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `min` | `number` |  |  |
| `max` | `number` |  |  |
| `step` | `number` |  |  |
| `label` * | `string` |  | Visible label above the track (also the accessible name). |
| `showValue` | `boolean` |  | Show the formatted value next to the label. |
| `format` | `(value: number) => string` |  | Text of a value (units, %): read by screen readers too (aria-valuetext). |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `range` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `value` * | `number \| [number, number]` |  |  |
| `onChange` * | `(value: number) => void \| (value: [number, number]) => void` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- role="slider" per thumb with aria-valuenow / aria-valuetext (format): arrows step, PageUp / PageDown jump, Home / End go to the ends.

<!-- docs/components/stepper.md -->

# Stepper

− value + for a small count (quantities, copies, seats) in a workspace panel or a card: one tap per step, a unit after the value, min and max.

## When to use

- A small whole number people nudge rather than type: tấn per line, copies, guests, 1–99.
- Inside a WorkspaceSection or a line card of a request.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A number people type (price, weight with decimals, a large count) | NumberInput |
| A value on a continuous range | Slider |

## Import

```tsx
import { Stepper } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### With a unit

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { Stepper } from "@semi/ui";

export default function StepperBasic() {
  const [tons, setTons] = useState(12);
  return (
    <div className="max-w-xs">
      <Stepper label="số tấn tiêu đen" unit="tấn" min={1} value={tons} onChange={setTons} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Limits, step, disabled

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { Stepper } from "@semi/ui";

export default function StepperLimits() {
  const [boxes, setBoxes] = useState(50);
  return (
    <div className="max-w-xs flex flex-col gap-3">
      <Stepper label="số thùng" unit="thùng" min={0} max={200} step={10} value={boxes} onChange={setBoxes} />
      <Stepper label="số bản in" value={1} onChange={() => undefined} disabled />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### Stepper

− value + for small counts (quantities, copies, seats). The value is a `spinbutton`: ↑ / → add `step`, ↓ / ← take
it away, Page Up / Page Down move ten steps, Home / End go to `min` / `max`. The − + buttons are for pointer and
touch (out of the Tab order: the keys do the same). Free typing of large numbers is `NumberInput`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` * | `number` |  |  |
| `onChange` * | `(value: number) => void` |  |  |
| `min` | `number` | `0` |  |
| `max` | `number` | `99` |  |
| `step` | `number` | `1` |  |
| `label` * | `string` |  | What is counted, lower case ("số tấn tiêu đen"): names the value and the buttons ("Giảm số tấn tiêu đen"). |
| `unit` | `string` |  | Shown after the value and read with it ("12 tấn"). |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- The value is a spinbutton (aria-valuenow / min / max, aria-valuetext with the unit) named by label: ↑ / → and ↓ / ← step, Page Up / Page Down move ten steps, Home / End go to min / max.
- The − + buttons are named (“Giảm …”, “Tăng …”) and left out of the Tab order: the keys do the same, so Tab reaches one stop per stepper.

<!-- docs/components/switch.md -->

# Switch

An on / off toggle for settings that apply immediately.

## When to use

- Settings that take effect at once (notifications, dark sync, auto-print).
- A switch on a card whose title names it: pass aria-labelledby (the title's id) or aria-label instead of a visible label.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A choice saved with a form | Checkbox |

## Import

```tsx
import { Switch } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Basic and small

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Switch } from "@semi/ui";

export default function SwitchBasic() {
  const [notify, setNotify] = useState(true);
  const [quiet, setQuiet] = useState(false);
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <Switch checked={notify} onChange={setNotify} label="Thông báo khi in xong" description="Gửi qua ứng dụng và email." />
      <Switch checked={quiet} onChange={setQuiet} size="sm" label="Chế độ im lặng" />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Named by a card title

No visible label: aria-labelledby points at the card title.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Badge, Card, Switch } from "@semi/ui";

const RULES = [
  { id: "maint", name: "Nhắc bảo trì", detail: "Mỗi 200 giờ in" },
  { id: "night", name: "Tắt máy ban đêm", detail: "23:00, khi không có job" },
];

export default function SwitchCardHeader() {
  const [on, setOn] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({ maint: true, night: false });
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-3 @lg:grid-cols-2">
      {RULES.map((r) => (
        <Card key={r.id} className="space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <span id={`rule-${r.id}`} className="text-ui font-medium text-strong">
              {r.name}
            </span>
            <Switch checked={on[r.id]} onChange={(v) => setOn({ ...on, [r.id]: v })} aria-labelledby={`rule-${r.id}`} />
          </div>
          <p className="text-ui text-muted">{r.detail}</p>
          <Badge tone={on[r.id] ? "emerald" : "gray"}>{on[r.id] ? "Đang bật" : "Đang tắt"}</Badge>
        </Card>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### Switch

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `checked` * | `boolean` |  |  |
| `onChange` * | `(checked: boolean) => void` |  |  |
| `label` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Visible label; it names the switch. |
| `description` | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | `"md"` | Visible size only: on touch screens both sizes get a 44 × 44 px hit area. |
| `id` | `string` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  | Name for screen readers when the switch has no visible `label` ("Bật automation Nhắc bảo trì"). `label` wins. |
| `aria-labelledby` | `string` |  | Id of the element that names the switch when its text is elsewhere (a card header). `label` wins. |

## Accessibility

- role="switch" with aria-checked; Space toggles; label and description are linked.
- Without a visible label give aria-label or aria-labelledby (label wins); in development a switch with no name logs a warning.
- On touch screens (any coarse pointer) the hit area is 44 × 44 px around the track; the visible size and layout do not change.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/switch/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/view-switch.md -->

# View switch

List ↔ grid and an optional density toggle, as small icon toggles at the end of the filter row (FilterChipRow trailing).

## When to use

- A collection people browse both as rows and as cards (products, files, suppliers).
- A dense list where some people want more rows on screen (density).

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Switching between different data or status slices | SegmentedControl or TextTabs |
| A table ↔ chart switch of one data set | Chart's table view |

## Import

```tsx
import { ViewSwitch } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### View and density

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { ViewSwitch, type ViewDensity, type ViewMode } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ViewSwitchDefault() {
  const [view, setView] = useState<ViewMode>("grid");
  const [density, setDensity] = useState<ViewDensity>("comfortable");
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
      <ViewSwitch view={view} onViewChange={setView} density={density} onDensityChange={setDensity} />
      <span className="text-ui text-muted">
        {view === "grid" ? "Lưới" : "Danh sách"} · {density === "compact" ? "Gọn" : "Thoáng"}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### ViewSwitch

Two toggle buttons (list, grid; aria-pressed) and an optional density toggle. Put it in FilterChipRow's `trailing`;
keep the choice in the URL (`?view=grid`) or per person (localStorage) as the page needs.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `view` * | `'grid' \| 'list'` |  |  |
| `onViewChange` * | `(view: ViewMode) => void` |  |  |
| `density` | `'comfortable' \| 'compact'` |  | Shows the density toggle when given with `onDensityChange`. |
| `onDensityChange` | `(density: ViewDensity) => void` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- A group named “Kiểu xem” of toggle buttons (aria-pressed), each with an aria-label and a title.
- The density button is pressed while the view is compact.

## Notes

- Keep the view in the URL (?view=grid, replace, not push) when people share it, or per person (localStorage) when it is a taste.
- On phones it moves into FilterPanel's children or the settings button of PhoneFilterBar.

<!-- docs/components/command.md -->

# Command

Command palette and searchable action lists: CommandPalette is the app-wide ⌘K / Ctrl+K “search or create” box (mounted once in the root layout, fed by pages with useRegisterCommands); CommandDialog is a controlled dialog with your own open state (useHotkey); Command is the inline list. Matching ignores case and Vietnamese marks.

## When to use

- Every app with more than a few pages: mount CommandPalette once in the root layout to jump to a place or record and start a create action from anywhere on ⌘K (L1).
- A SearchPill or “Tìm hoặc tạo” button in the header that opens CommandPalette (openCommandPalette).
- A palette with your own open state and no app-wide registry (CommandDialog) or a searchable action list inside a Popover (Command).

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Pick one value in a form | CustomCombobox |
| Filter the list on the page | SearchPill or SearchInput |

## Import

```tsx
import { Command, CommandDialog, CommandPalette, useRegisterCommands, openCommandPalette, useHotkey, filterCommands, normalizeSearch, type CommandItem } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### App-wide palette (CommandPalette)

Press ⌘K (Ctrl+K) or the button; type “tieu” to find the supplier by keyword.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useMemo } from "react";
import { Button, CommandPalette, Kbd, openCommandPalette, toast, useRegisterCommands, type CommandItem } from "@semi/ui";

// Mount CommandPalette once in the root layout with the app's places. A page adds its own quick actions and records
// with useRegisterCommands while it is mounted. ⌘↵ opens an item with href in a new tab.
const PLACES: CommandItem[] = [
  { id: "inbox", label: "Hộp thư", group: "Trang", icon: "mail", href: "#inbox", onSelect: () => toast({ title: "Mở Hộp thư" }) },
  { id: "suppliers", label: "Nhà cung cấp", group: "Trang", icon: "store", href: "#suppliers", onSelect: () => toast({ title: "Mở Nhà cung cấp" }) },
  { id: "settings", label: "Cài đặt", group: "Trang", icon: "settings", onSelect: () => toast({ title: "Mở Cài đặt" }) },
];

export default function CommandPaletteApp() {
  const pageItems = useMemo<CommandItem[]>(
    () => [
      { id: "new-supplier", label: "Thêm nhà cung cấp", group: "Tạo nhanh", icon: "plus", tone: "blue", shortcut: ["⌘", "N"], onSelect: () => toast({ title: "Thêm nhà cung cấp" }) },
      { id: "new-request", label: "Tạo yêu cầu mua", group: "Tạo nhanh", icon: "clipboardList", tone: "green", onSelect: () => toast({ title: "Tạo yêu cầu mua" }) },
      { id: "s1", label: "Gia vị Tây Nguyên", hint: "Nhà cung cấp · Đắk Lắk", group: "Nhà cung cấp", icon: "store", keywords: ["tieu", "pepper"], href: "#suppliers?open=s1", onSelect: () => toast({ title: "Mở Gia vị Tây Nguyên" }) },
    ],
    [],
  );
  useRegisterCommands(pageItems);
  return (
    <>
      <Button icon="search" onClick={() => openCommandPalette()}>
        Tìm hoặc tạo <Kbd keys={["⌘", "K"]} />
      </Button>
      <CommandPalette items={PLACES} />
    </>
  );
}
```

### Controlled dialog (CommandDialog)

Press ⌘J (Ctrl+J) or the button; try typing “don hang” without marks.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, CommandDialog, Kbd, toast, useHotkey, type CommandItem } from "@semi/ui";

export default function CommandPalette() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  useHotkey(() => setOpen((v) => !v), "j");
  const go = (title: string) => () => toast({ title });
  const items: CommandItem[] = [
    { id: "orders", label: "Đơn hàng", group: "Trang", icon: "bag", onSelect: go("Mở Đơn hàng") },
    { id: "printers", label: "Máy in", group: "Trang", icon: "printer", keywords: ["printer"], onSelect: go("Mở Máy in") },
    { id: "inventory", label: "Kho vật liệu", group: "Trang", icon: "box", onSelect: go("Mở Kho") },
    { id: "new-order", label: "Tạo đơn hàng", group: "Thao tác", icon: "plus", shortcut: ["⌘", "N"], onSelect: go("Tạo đơn") },
    { id: "theme", label: "Đổi giao diện sáng / tối", group: "Thao tác", icon: "moon", onSelect: go("Đổi giao diện") },
  ];
  return (
    <>
      <Button icon="search" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
        Tìm nhanh <Kbd keys={["⌘", "J"]} />
      </Button>
      <CommandDialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} items={items} />
    </>
  );
}
```

### Inline (Command)

```tsx
"use client";

import { Command, toast } from "@semi/ui";

export default function CommandInline() {
  return (
    <div className="h-72 max-w-md rounded-card border border-line bg-panel overflow-hidden">
      <Command
        items={[
          { id: "pla", label: "PLA đen", group: "Vật liệu", icon: "box", onSelect: () => toast({ title: "PLA đen" }) },
          { id: "petg", label: "PETG trong", group: "Vật liệu", icon: "box", onSelect: () => toast({ title: "PETG trong" }) },
          { id: "x1", label: "X1 Carbon 03", group: "Máy in", icon: "printer", onSelect: () => toast({ title: "X1 Carbon 03" }) },
          { id: "a1", label: "A1 Mini 01", group: "Máy in", icon: "printer", disabled: true, onSelect: () => undefined },
        ]}
        placeholder="Tìm vật liệu, máy in…"
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### Command

The searchable list itself (inside a page, a Popover or CommandDialog). The input is an ARIA combobox that owns a
listbox; the active option follows aria-activedescendant so focus never leaves the input.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` * | `CommandItem[]` |  |  |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  |  |
| `emptyText` | `React.ReactNode \| ((query: string) => React.ReactNode)` |  | Shown when nothing matches (default from the locale); a function gets the query. |
| `onEscape` | `() => void` |  | Escape on an empty query (CommandDialog closes). |
| `autoFocus` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `size` | `'md' \| 'lg'` | `"md"` | `lg`: taller rows with an icon tile and the hint line, `text-overline` group headings (CommandPalette). |
| `initialQuery` | `string` | `""` | The query when the list mounts. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the listbox (default from the locale). |
| `inputEnd` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Shown at the end of the input row (an Esc key cap). |
| `footer` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Shown under the list (a key legend). |
| `onOpenInNewTab` | `(item: CommandItem) => void` |  | ⌘↵ / Ctrl+↵ on an item with `href` (default: open `href` in a new tab). |

### CommandDialog

The command palette over the page: a modal dialog near the top, closed by Escape, a click outside or a pick.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `open` * | `boolean` |  |  |
| `onOpenChange` * | `(open: boolean) => void` |  |  |
| `items` * | `CommandItem[]` |  |  |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  |  |
| `emptyText` | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |

### CommandPalette

The app-wide "search or create" box (L1): one dialog for search and quick actions, opened with ⌘K / Ctrl+K. Mount
it once in the root layout with the app's places; pages add their own items with useRegisterCommands. Groups get
`text-overline` headings, actions a coloured tile (`tone`), records a hint line; the footer shows the keys
(↑↓ select, ↵ open, ⌘↵ new tab for items with `href`, Esc close). Uncontrolled unless `open` is given.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | `CommandItem[]` | `EMPTY` | The app's own items (places, global actions). Items registered by pages are listed first. |
| `open` | `boolean` |  | Controlled open state; leave out to let the palette (⌘K, openCommandPalette) manage it. |
| `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` |  |  |
| `hotkey` | `string \| false` | `"k"` | ⌘ / Ctrl + this key toggles the palette; `false` binds nothing. |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  |  |
| `emptyText` | `React.ReactNode \| ((query: string) => React.ReactNode)` |  |  |
| `initialQuery` | `string` |  | The query when it opens (a `?q=` deep link). |
| `onOpenInNewTab` | `(item: CommandItem) => void` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- The input is an ARIA combobox owning a listbox (aria-activedescendant), so focus stays in the input; groups are labelled by their heading, disabled items are aria-disabled; dialogs trap focus, Escape closes and focus returns.

## Notes

- A record that opens in a DetailOverlay on the current route: its `onSelect` calls `openDetail(id)` (or the page's `open(id)`), not `router.push("?open=…")` to the same route, which browsers without the Navigation API do not report to the list. Give it `href` too, for ⌘↵.
- ⌘K on Apple devices, Ctrl+K elsewhere (Ctrl+K on a Mac deletes to the end of the line in text fields); a key a widget already handled, or typed in a rich-text editor, does not open it.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/command/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/confirm-dialog.md -->

# Confirm dialog

confirmDialog() asks one yes / no question and resolves to true or false; confirmDelete({ name }) is the irreversible-action form (names the object, red Xoá). Mount ConfirmHost once in the root layout. Never window.confirm.

## When to use

- Before an irreversible action: delete, stop a print, discard changes. confirmDelete names the object.
- A reversible action does not ask: do it and offer toast.undo.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A form or several fields | Modal |
| Undo instead of asking (reversible actions) | toast.undo() |

## Import

```tsx
import { ConfirmHost, confirmDialog, confirmDelete } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Destructive confirmation

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, confirmDialog } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ConfirmDanger() {
  const [result, setResult] = useState("");
  const remove = async () => {
    const ok = await confirmDialog({
      title: "Xoá bản in mẫu?",
      message: "Tệp G-code và dữ liệu lát cắt sẽ bị xoá vĩnh viễn.",
      confirmLabel: "Xoá",
      tone: "danger",
    });
    setResult(ok ? "Đã xoá" : "Đã huỷ");
  };
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
      <Button variant="danger" icon="trash" onClick={remove}>
        Xoá bản in
      </Button>
      {result && <span className="text-ui text-muted">{result}</span>}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Irreversible delete

confirmDelete: the title names the object, the button is red and says Xoá.

```tsx
"use client";

import { Button, confirmDelete, toast } from "@semi/ui";

// An irreversible action: the dialog names the object, the button is red ("Xoá"), Huỷ is the safe default.
// Success is a toast afterwards, never a second dialog.
export default function ConfirmDeleteExample() {
  const remove = async () => {
    if (await confirmDelete({ name: "Máy in xưởng 3", message: "Lịch sử in của máy cũng bị xoá." })) toast.success("Đã xoá máy in");
  };
  return (
    <Button variant="danger" icon="trash" onClick={remove}>
      Xoá máy in
    </Button>
  );
}
```

## API

### ConfirmHost

Mounted once in the root layout; renders the dialog opened by `confirmDialog()`.

No props of its own.

## Accessibility

- An alertdialog: focus starts on the safe button (Huỷ) in a danger dialog and on the confirm button otherwise; Escape cancels.

## Notes

- <ConfirmHost /> goes once in the root layout (see Theme › Root layout); confirmDialog() works from any event handler.
- confirmDelete takes deleteTitle(name), deleteMessage and delete from the locale provider around ConfirmHost (English with locale={en}).

<!-- docs/components/context-menu.md -->

# Context menu

The menu of an area opened at the pointer: right-click, long-press on touch, or the Menu key / Shift+F10 when the area has focus.

## When to use

- Power-user shortcuts on canvases, file grids and rows, when the same actions also exist in a visible Menu or toolbar.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| The only way to reach an action | Menu (visible trigger) |

## Import

```tsx
import { ContextMenu } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### On a file card

```tsx
import { ContextMenu, IconTile, toast } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ContextMenuFile() {
  return (
    <ContextMenu
      label="Thao tác tệp"
      items={[
        { label: "Mở", icon: "external", onSelect: () => toast({ title: "Mở tệp" }) },
        { label: "Nhân bản", icon: "copy", shortcut: "⌘D", onSelect: () => toast({ title: "Đã nhân bản", tone: "success" }) },
        { label: "Xoá", icon: "trash", danger: true, separator: true, onSelect: () => toast({ title: "Đã xoá", tone: "danger" }) },
      ]}
    >
      <div className="flex w-64 items-center gap-3 rounded-card border border-line bg-field p-3">
        <IconTile name="fileCode" tone="sky" />
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <div className="text-ui font-medium text-strong truncate">vo-hop-dieu-khien.gcode</div>
          <div className="text-ui text-muted">Chuột phải (hoặc giữ) để mở menu</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </ContextMenu>
  );
}
```

## API

### ContextMenu

The menu of an area opened at the pointer: right-click, long-press on touch, or the Menu key / Shift+F10 when the
area has focus. Use for power-user shortcuts that also exist elsewhere (a row's Menu, a toolbar button).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` * | `MenuItem[]` |  |  |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the menu. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  | The area that opens the menu (it becomes focusable). |
| `sheet` | `boolean` | `true` | Below `sm` the list opens as a bottom sheet over a backdrop (P6, since 0.39); `false` keeps it at the pointer. |

## Accessibility

- The area is focusable; Menu key / Shift+F10 open the menu, which behaves like Menu (arrows, Escape returns focus).

## Notes

- Below sm the menu opens as a bottom sheet over a backdrop (a tap on the backdrop closes it); `sheet={false}` keeps it at the pointer.

<!-- docs/components/detail-overlay.md -->

# Detail overlay

An item of a list opens over the list instead of on its own page: its own URL (?open=<id> with useDetailParam, Next App Router safe), ‹ › and ← → through the current results with “n / N”, close / Esc / Back return to the list at the same scroll position. The side panel holds the actions (SplitButton, an icon row, ⋯); existing detail routes stay as deep-link targets.

## When to use

- Open a record from a list, grid or table and step through the results without losing the list (suppliers, orders, leads).
- A shared link to a record that should land over its list.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Edit a few fields of a row | SidePanel or Modal |
| A long workflow with its own sub-pages | a detail route |
| A mail or chat reader beside the list | a list + reader layout |

## Import

```tsx
import { DetailOverlay, useDetailParam, openDetail, type DetailParamState, searchRows, sortRows } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### List with ?item= in the URL

Open a row, step with ← →, press Back: the list is where you left it.

```tsx
"use client";

import { Badge, Button, DetailOverlay, Item, ItemGroup, Menu, SplitButton, toast, useDetailParam } from "@semi/ui";

const ORDERS = Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, i) => ({
  id: `DH-${1040 + i}`,
  customer: ["Cửa hàng Minh An", "Nhà sách Phú Lợi", "Quán Bếp Nhà"][i % 3],
  total: (i + 3) * 185000,
  paid: i % 4 !== 0,
}));
const vnd = (n: number) => `${n.toLocaleString("vi-VN")} ₫`;

// Click a row: the order opens over the list with ?item= in the URL. ‹ › (or ← →) go through the list, Back or Esc
// closes it and the list is where it was. Reload with ?item=DH-1045 to open it from a link.
export default function DetailOverlayList() {
  const { openId, open, show, close } = useDetailParam("item");
  const index = ORDERS.findIndex((o) => o.id === openId);
  const order = index >= 0 ? ORDERS[index] : null;
  return (
    <>
      <ItemGroup label="Đơn hàng">
        {ORDERS.map((o) => (
          <Item key={o.id} title={o.customer} description={o.id} meta={vnd(o.total)} onClick={() => open(o.id)} />
        ))}
      </ItemGroup>
      <DetailOverlay
        open={order !== null}
        onClose={close}
        title={order ? `Đơn ${order.id}` : ""}
        subtitle={order?.customer}
        index={index}
        total={ORDERS.length}
        onPrev={index > 0 ? () => show(ORDERS[index - 1].id) : undefined}
        onNext={index >= 0 && index < ORDERS.length - 1 ? () => show(ORDERS[index + 1].id) : undefined}
        onCopyLink={() => (navigator.clipboard?.writeText(window.location.href), toast({ title: "Đã sao chép liên kết" }))}
        side={
          order && (
            <>
              <SplitButton
                label="Giao hàng"
                icon="truck"
                onClick={() => toast({ title: `Giao ${order.id}` })}
                menuLabel="Cách giao khác"
                collapseOnPhone={false}
                items={[
                  { label: "Hẹn ngày giao", icon: "calendar", onSelect: () => toast({ title: "Hẹn ngày" }) },
                  { label: "Khách tự lấy", icon: "store", onSelect: () => toast({ title: "Khách tự lấy" }) },
                ]}
              />
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Button iconOnly icon="printer" aria-label="In đơn" />
                <Button iconOnly icon="copy" aria-label="Nhân bản" />
                <Menu
                  label={`Thao tác khác với ${order.id}`}
                  items={[
                    { label: "Sửa đơn", icon: "edit", onSelect: () => undefined },
                    { label: "Huỷ đơn", icon: "close", danger: true, onSelect: () => toast({ title: "Đã huỷ", tone: "danger" }) },
                  ]}
                />
              </div>
              <dl className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <dt className="text-ui text-muted">Tổng tiền</dt>
                  <dd className="text-ui text-strong tabular-nums">{vnd(order.total)}</dd>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <dt className="text-ui text-muted">Thanh toán</dt>
                  <dd>
                    <Badge tone={order.paid ? "emerald" : "amber"} dot size="sm">
                      {order.paid ? "Đã trả" : "Chưa trả"}
                    </Badge>
                  </dd>
                </div>
              </dl>
            </>
          )
        }
      >
        {order && (
          <section className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <h3 className="text-ui font-medium text-strong">Sản phẩm</h3>
            <p className="text-ui text-body">3 mặt hàng · giao trong 2 ngày.</p>
          </section>
        )}
      </DetailOverlay>
    </>
  );
}
```

### A sorted DataTable: ‹ › follow its order

Sort by a column or search, open a row: ‹ › and “n / N” walk the rows in the order the table shows them (sortRows / searchRows, all pages).

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, DataTable, DetailOverlay, SearchInput, openDetail, searchRows, sortRows, useDetailParam, type DataTableColumn, type DataTableSort } from "@semi/ui";

type Order = { id: string; customer: string; total: number };
const ORDERS: Order[] = Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, i) => ({
  id: `DH-${1040 + i}`,
  customer: ["Cửa hàng Minh An", "Nhà sách Phú Lợi", "Quán Bếp Nhà"][i % 3],
  total: 185_000 + ((i * 410_000) % 2_300_000),
}));
const vnd = (n: number) => `${n.toLocaleString("vi-VN")} ₫`;
const COLUMNS: DataTableColumn<Order>[] = [
  {
    key: "id",
    header: "Mã đơn",
    sortable: true,
    // the row opens on click; the button is the keyboard way in (and where focus returns on close)
    cell: (o) => (
      <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={(e) => (e.stopPropagation(), openDetail(o.id, "order"))}>
        {o.id}
      </Button>
    ),
  },
  { key: "customer", header: "Khách hàng", sortable: true },
  { key: "total", header: "Tổng", sortable: true, numeric: true, cell: (o) => vnd(o.total) },
];

// The overlay steps through the rows in the order the table shows them: the same search and sort, through the
// table's own helpers (sortRows / searchRows), all pages. Sort by Tổng, open a row, press → .
export default function DetailOverlayTable() {
  const { openId, open, show, close } = useDetailParam("order");
  const [q, setQ] = useState("");
  const [sort, setSort] = useState<DataTableSort | null>({ key: "total", dir: "desc" });
  const results = sortRows(searchRows(ORDERS, COLUMNS, q), COLUMNS, sort);
  const index = results.findIndex((o) => o.id === openId);
  const order = index >= 0 ? results[index] : (ORDERS.find((o) => o.id === openId) ?? null);
  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <SearchInput value={q} onChange={setQ} placeholder="Tìm mã đơn, khách hàng…" className="w-64" />
      <DataTable label="Đơn hàng" rows={ORDERS} columns={COLUMNS} getRowId={(o) => o.id} search={q} sort={sort} onSortChange={setSort} onRowClick={(o) => open(o.id)} pageSize={6} />
      <DetailOverlay
        open={order !== null}
        onClose={close}
        title={order ? `Đơn ${order.id}` : ""}
        subtitle={order?.customer}
        index={index >= 0 ? index : undefined}
        total={index >= 0 ? results.length : undefined}
        onPrev={index > 0 ? () => show(results[index - 1].id) : undefined}
        onNext={index >= 0 && index < results.length - 1 ? () => show(results[index + 1].id) : undefined}
      >
        {order && <p className="text-ui text-body tabular-nums">Tổng tiền {vnd(order.total)}</p>}
      </DetailOverlay>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### DetailOverlay

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `open` * | `boolean` |  | Drive it from the URL: `open={openId !== null}` with useDetailParam. |
| `onClose` * | `() => void` |  | Close button, Escape and a click on the backdrop. With useDetailParam pass its `close`. |
| `title` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `subtitle` | `React.ReactNode` |  | One line under the title (region, category). |
| `index` | `number` |  | Place of the item in the current result set (0-based) and its size: shows "n / N". |
| `total` | `number` |  |  |
| `onPrev` | `() => void` |  | Previous / next item of the result set; leave out at the ends (the button is disabled). ← → do the same. |
| `onNext` | `() => void` |  |  |
| `onCopyLink` | `() => void` |  | Shows a "copy link" button (the URL already opens this item). |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the dialog when `title` is not plain text. |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  | The item itself. |
| `side` | `React.ReactNode` |  | The action panel: a SplitButton, a row of icon buttons, a ⋯ Menu, then facts. Right column from `lg`, below the content before. |
| `related` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Related items, under the main content. |

## Accessibility

- A modal dialog named by its title (an h2), focus trapped and returned to the row that opened it; Escape closes.
- ‹ › are labelled (Mục trước / Mục sau, with aria-keyshortcuts) and disabled at the ends, where focus moves to the other one; “n / N” is read as “Mục n trên N”; ← → do not fire inside inputs, menus or sliders.

## Notes

- Open a record from elsewhere on the same route (a CommandPalette item, a notification) with the hook's `open(id)` or `openDetail(id)`, not `router.push("?open=…")`: browsers without the Navigation API (Firefox, Safari < 26) do not tell the hook about Next's own same-route navigation, so the overlay would not open unless the list re-renders. To another route, navigate with the param in the URL; the hook reads it when the list mounts.
- Close goes back when the entry is one this page opened (also after Back then Forward where the Navigation API exists), else it removes the param, so the list never gets a second history entry. Without the Navigation API only the entry the mounted list opened last, at that exact address, counts as its own.
- Walk the results the list shows: for a DataTable build them with its own helpers, `sortRows(searchRows(rows, columns, search), columns, sort)` (all pages, the table's comparator), never a copy of the comparator. Keep filters and the query in the URL too (useFilterParams), so ‹ › and a shared link walk the same results.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/detail-overlay/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/drawer.md -->

# Drawer

A panel that slides in from the right, left, bottom or top (a sheet), with title and footer.

## When to use

- Filters of a list, details of a row, a secondary form that keeps the page visible.
- A sheet from the top (announcements, a global search) with side="top".

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A focused task | Modal |
| A persistent tool panel beside a canvas | SidePanel |

## Import

```tsx
import { Drawer } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Filters

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, Checkbox, Drawer, Field, Input } from "@semi/ui";

export default function DrawerFilters() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [online, setOnline] = useState(true);
  return (
    <>
      <Button icon="filter" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
        Bộ lọc
      </Button>
      <Drawer
        open={open}
        onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
        title="Bộ lọc"
        footer={
          <>
            <Button size="modal" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
              Huỷ
            </Button>
            <Button size="modal" variant="primary" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
              Áp dụng
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <Field label="Từ khoá">
          <Input placeholder="Tên, mã đơn…" icon="search" />
        </Field>
        <Checkbox checked={online} onChange={setOnline} label="Chỉ máy đang online" />
      </Drawer>
    </>
  );
}
```

### Sides

side picks the edge: right (default), left, bottom (phone-style sheet) or top.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, Drawer } from "@semi/ui";

type Side = "right" | "left" | "bottom" | "top";

export default function DrawerSides() {
  const [side, setSide] = useState<Side | null>(null);
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      {(["right", "left", "bottom", "top"] as const).map((s) => (
        <Button key={s} onClick={() => setSide(s)}>
          {s}
        </Button>
      ))}
      <Drawer open={side !== null} onClose={() => setSide(null)} side={side ?? "right"} title={`Sheet: ${side ?? ""}`}>
        <p className="text-ui text-body">Nội dung phụ, trang bên dưới vẫn giữ nguyên.</p>
      </Drawer>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### Drawer

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `open` * | `boolean` |  |  |
| `onClose` * | `() => void` |  |  |
| `title` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `side` | `'left' \| 'right' \| 'bottom' \| 'top'` | `"right"` | right (default) / left: side sheet; bottom: phone-style sheet; top: a sheet from the top (announcements, search). |
| `footer` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Actions pinned to the bottom (MODAL_FOOT). |
| `autoFocusFirstField` | `boolean` | `true` | Focus the first text-like field when opening on devices with a physical keyboard (`(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)`). Touch phones keep the keyboard closed. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Width override for side drawers (e.g. "sm:max-w-lg"). |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- A modal dialog: focus trap, Escape, focus returns to the opener; the title labels it.
- Autofocuses the first field on devices with a physical keyboard ((hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)) unless autoFocusFirstField={false}; touch phones keep the on-screen keyboard closed.
