<!-- docs/components/feature-intro.md -->

# Feature intro

The first visit of a feature (L14): a small dialog with a visual, a title, one line, dots, “Bỏ qua” and “Tiếp” / “Bắt đầu”. Shown once per user per id; “seen” lives in a store (localStorage by default, pass your own to keep it per account). It waits while another dialog is open.

## When to use

- A new or reworked feature people already in the app should notice once (a new workspace, a new way to compare quotes).
- “Xem lại giới thiệu” from a Help menu (forceOpen).

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A page that is empty on first use | GuidedEmptyState or EmptyState first-use |
| A one-line tip next to a control | Tooltip or a hint line |
| A decision or a confirmation | Modal / confirmDialog |

## Import

```tsx
import { FeatureIntro, localIntroStore, type FeatureIntroSlide, type FeatureIntroStore } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Once per user

Mount it on the feature's page with an id; here a button shows it again (forceOpen).

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, FeatureIntro, IconTile } from "@semi/ui";

export default function FeatureIntroBasic() {
  const [replay, setReplay] = useState(0);
  return (
    <>
      <Button icon="sparkles" onClick={() => setReplay((n) => n + 1)}>
        Xem lại giới thiệu
      </Button>
      {replay > 0 && (
        <FeatureIntro
          key={replay}
          id="purchasing-workspace"
          forceOpen
          slides={[
            { title: "Yêu cầu mua trên một màn hình", body: "Mặt hàng, nhà cung cấp và lời nhắn ở bên trái, báo giá hiện bên phải khi về.", visual: <IconTile name="layers" size="lg" tone="gray" /> },
            { title: "So sánh từng mặt hàng", body: "Giá tốt nhất của mỗi dòng được đánh dấu, tổng tính theo số tấn bạn chọn.", visual: <IconTile name="chart" size="lg" tone="gray" /> },
            { title: "Gõ @ để nhắc nhà cung cấp", body: "Trong lời nhắn, @ gợi ý nhà cung cấp và / chèn mẫu thư có sẵn.", visual: <IconTile name="sparkles" size="lg" tone="gray" /> },
          ]}
        />
      )}
    </>
  );
}
```

### Your own store

Keep “seen” on the account instead of the browser.

```tsx
import { FeatureIntro, IconTile, type FeatureIntroStore } from "@semi/ui";

// "Seen" on the account: the app's own API (any async get / set works).
const accountStore: FeatureIntroStore = {
  get: async (id) => {
    const res = await fetch(`/api/me/intros/${id}`);
    return res.ok && (await res.json()).seen === true;
  },
  set: (id) => {
    void fetch(`/api/me/intros/${id}`, { method: "PUT" });
  },
};

export default function FeatureIntroStoreExample() {
  return (
    <FeatureIntro
      id="purchasing-workspace"
      store={accountStore}
      slides={[{ title: "Yêu cầu mua trên một màn hình", body: "Mặt hàng và nhà cung cấp bên trái, báo giá bên phải.", visual: <IconTile name="layers" size="lg" tone="gray" /> }]}
    />
  );
}
```

## API

### FeatureIntro

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` * | `string` |  | One id per feature ("purchasing-workspace"): shown once per id. |
| `slides` * | `FeatureIntroSlide[]` |  | One to four slides. |
| `store` | `FeatureIntroStore` | `localIntroStore` | Where "seen" is read and written (default `localIntroStore`). |
| `forceOpen` | `boolean` | `false` | Show it even if seen (a Help menu's "Xem lại giới thiệu", docs). Still waits for other dialogs to close. |
| `onDone` | `(how: 'finished' \| 'skipped') => void` |  | After it closes and is stored as seen: `finished` from the last slide's primary, `skipped` from Skip, Escape or the backdrop. |
| `skipLabel` | `string` |  | Default "Bỏ qua". |
| `nextLabel` | `string` |  | Default "Tiếp". |
| `doneLabel` | `string` |  | Primary on the last slide; default "Bắt đầu". |

## Accessibility

- A modal dialog named by the slide's title and described by its line: focus moves to the primary, Tab stays inside, Escape and the backdrop skip, focus returns to where it was.
- It never opens over another dialog: it waits until no aria-modal dialog is on the page, and only one FeatureIntro is open at a time (a second unseen one follows when the first closes). The step (“Bước 1 / 3”) is screen-reader text; the dots are decorative.

## Notes

- The store is read after mount only, so the server HTML never contains the dialog; blocked storage counts as seen.
- At most three slides; one sentence each. One FeatureIntro per page.

# Hover card

A preview card while the pointer rests on, or focus is on, a link: a person, a product, an order.

## When to use

- Peek at a linked record without opening it.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Anything people must act on | Popover (click) |
| A one-line label | Tooltip |

## Import

```tsx
import { HoverCard } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Person

```tsx
import { Avatar, Badge, HoverCard } from "@semi/ui";

export default function HoverCardUser() {
  return (
    <p className="text-ui text-body">
      Đơn được duyệt bởi{" "}
      <HoverCard
        trigger={
          <a href="#minh-anh" className="font-medium text-strong underline-offset-2 hover:underline">
            Minh Anh
          </a>
        }
      >
        <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
          <Avatar name="Minh Anh" />
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <div className="text-ui font-medium text-strong">Minh Anh</div>
            <div className="text-ui text-muted">Quản lý xưởng · Khu A</div>
            <Badge tone="emerald" dot size="sm">
              Đang trực
            </Badge>
          </div>
        </div>
      </HoverCard>
      .
    </p>
  );
}
```

## API

### HoverCard

A preview card while the pointer rests on (or keyboard focus is on) its trigger, usually a link. It adds detail
only: touch screens never show it, so the link must work without it.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `trigger` * | `ReactElement<unknown, string \| JSXElementConstructor<any>>` |  | A link or button; it keeps its own name and action. |
| `openDelay` | `number` | `400` |  |
| `closeDelay` | `number` | `150` |  |
| `width` | `number` | `260` |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- Opens on hover and keyboard focus, closes on Escape; touch screens never show it, so the link must work alone.

<!-- docs/components/menu.md -->

# Menu

The action menu behind a trigger: a ⋯ (or your own Button) with items that have an icon, a description line, a shortcut or hint, a check, a spinner, a link, a reason when disabled, and group headings. Danger items always go last after a divider; hidden items (and empty groups) leave the list; below sm it opens as a bottom sheet.

## When to use

- Secondary actions of a row, card or page (Đổi tên, Nhân bản, Xoá): G2, G4.
- The ⋯ overflow of a toolbar, a bulk bar or a detail header (G2, G9, G12).

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| One or two visible actions | Button |
| Other ways to start the main action (manual, import) | SplitButton |
| Actions on a card in a grid | CardActions |
| Pick a value | CustomSelect |

## Import

```tsx
import { Menu, type MenuItem } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Row actions

```tsx
"use client";

import { Menu, toast } from "@semi/ui";

export default function MenuRowActions() {
  return (
    <Menu
      label="Thao tác máy in"
      items={[
        { label: "Đổi tên", icon: "edit", onSelect: () => toast({ title: "Đổi tên" }) },
        { label: "Nhân bản", icon: "copy", onSelect: () => toast({ title: "Đã nhân bản", tone: "success" }) },
        { label: "Tạm dừng", icon: "pause", onSelect: () => undefined, disabled: true },
        { label: "Xoá", icon: "trash", danger: true, separator: true, onSelect: () => toast({ title: "Không xoá được", description: "Máy đang in.", tone: "danger" }) },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

### Groups, states and danger last

Xoá is first in the code and shows last; the hidden item is not listed; Gửi qua Zalo says why it is off.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, Menu, toast } from "@semi/ui";

export default function MenuGrouped() {
  const [compact, setCompact] = useState(false);
  const [exporting, setExporting] = useState(false);
  const exportFile = () => {
    setExporting(true);
    setTimeout(() => (setExporting(false), toast({ title: "Đã xuất 128 dòng", tone: "success" })), 1200);
  };
  return (
    <Menu
      label="Thao tác với danh sách khách hàng"
      trigger={<Button icon="more">Thao tác</Button>}
      items={[
        // danger is listed first here on purpose: Menu always shows it last, after a divider (G5)
        { label: "Xoá danh sách", icon: "trash", danger: true, onSelect: () => toast({ title: "Đã xoá", tone: "danger" }) },
        { label: "Xuất Excel", icon: "download", group: "Xuất", description: "128 dòng đang lọc", loading: exporting, onSelect: exportFile },
        { label: "In danh sách", icon: "printer", group: "Xuất", shortcut: "⌘P", onSelect: () => window.print() },
        { label: "Gửi qua Zalo", icon: "send", group: "Xuất", disabled: "Chưa kết nối Zalo OA", onSelect: () => undefined },
        { label: "Chỉ quản trị viên", icon: "lock", group: "Xuất", hidden: true, onSelect: () => undefined },
        { label: "Hiển thị gọn", group: "Xem", checked: compact, onSelect: () => setCompact((v) => !v) },
        { label: "Mở trang cài đặt", icon: "settings", group: "Xem", href: "#settings" },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

## API

### Menu

Action menu behind a trigger button (row / card overflow actions). ↑/↓ move, Enter / Space pick, Escape closes and
returns focus. Default trigger: icon-only "more" button; pass `trigger` (an element) to use your own.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` * | `MenuItem[]` |  | The actions. Danger items are listed last, hidden ones left out (see MenuItem). |
| `header` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Text above the items that is not an item (an account menu's name and role). It sits outside the `role="menu"` list, so arrows and type-ahead skip it. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the default trigger. |
| `align` | `'left' \| 'right'` | `"right"` |  |
| `trigger` | `ReactElement<unknown, string \| JSXElementConstructor<any>>` |  |  |
| `sheet` | `boolean` | `true` | Below `sm` the list opens as a bottom sheet over a backdrop (P6, since 0.39). `false` keeps the anchored dropdown on phones too. |

## Accessibility

- WAI-ARIA menu button: Enter / Space / ↓ open on the first item, ↑ on the last; arrows, Home, End move; a letter jumps to the next item starting with it; Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger; Tab closes.
- A check makes the item menuitemcheckbox with aria-checked (with radio: menuitemradio, and the menu opens on the checked item); a disabled item with a reason stays reachable (aria-disabled) and its reason is its description; a group is role=group named by its heading.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/menu/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/modal.md -->

# Modal

The shared dialog: full screen on phones, a centred panel from sm up, with title, description, body and footer. Focus is trapped and returns to the opener.

## When to use

- A short task that needs the user's full attention (edit settings, create an item).

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Yes / no before a destructive action | confirmDialog() |
| Filters or details beside the page | Drawer |
| A short message after an action | toast() |

## Import

```tsx
import { Modal } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Form in a modal

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, Field, Input, Modal } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ModalBasic() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  return (
    <>
      <Button icon="sliders" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
        Cấu hình in
      </Button>
      <Modal
        open={open}
        onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
        title="Cấu hình in nâng cao"
        description="Áp dụng cho các bản in tiếp theo."
        footer={
          <>
            <Button size="modal" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
              Huỷ
            </Button>
            <Button size="modal" variant="primary" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
              Lưu
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <Field label="Tốc độ lớp đầu">
          <Input defaultValue="50 mm/s" />
        </Field>
        <Field label="Độ dày lớp">
          <Input defaultValue="0.20 mm" />
        </Field>
      </Modal>
    </>
  );
}
```

### A select and a popover inside a modal

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, CustomSelect, Field, Modal, Popover } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ModalLayers() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [material, setMaterial] = useState("pla");
  return (
    <>
      <Button icon="sliders" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
        Chọn vật liệu
      </Button>
      <Modal
        open={open}
        onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
        title="Vật liệu in"
        footer={
          <Button size="modal" variant="primary" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
            Xong
          </Button>
        }
      >
        <Field label="Vật liệu">
          <CustomSelect
            variant="field"
            value={material}
            onChange={setMaterial}
            options={[
              { value: "pla", label: "PLA" },
              { value: "petg", label: "PETG" },
              { value: "abs", label: "ABS" },
            ]}
          />
        </Field>
        <Popover label="Nhiệt độ gợi ý" trigger={<Button>Nhiệt độ gợi ý</Button>}>
          <p className="text-ui text-body">PLA 200–220 °C, PETG 230–250 °C.</p>
          <Button>Áp dụng</Button>
        </Popover>
      </Modal>
    </>
  );
}
```

## API

### Modal

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `open` * | `boolean` |  |  |
| `onClose` * | `() => void` |  |  |
| `title` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `description` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Optional one-line description under the title (announced with the dialog). |
| `footer` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Action buttons rendered inside MODAL_FOOT (use MODAL_BTN_PRIMARY / MODAL_BTN_SUBTLE / MODAL_BTN_DANGER or <Button size="modal">). |
| `maxWidth` | `string` | `"max-w-lg"` | Width class on >= sm screens (e.g. "max-w-md", "max-w-lg", "max-w-2xl"). |
| `closeOnBackdrop` | `boolean` | `true` | Close when the backdrop is clicked (turn off for forms that would lose input). |
| `autoFocusFirstField` | `boolean` | `true` | Focus the first text-like field when opening on devices with a physical keyboard (`(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)`). Touch phones keep the keyboard closed. |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- role="dialog" + aria-modal, labelled by the title; Escape and the close button close it; focus trap and focus return built in; page scroll is locked.
- Autofocuses the first field on devices with a physical keyboard ((hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)) unless autoFocusFirstField={false}; touch phones keep the on-screen keyboard closed.
- Layers inside it (CustomSelect, Popover, Menu, DatePicker, Tooltip) handle Escape first: Escape closes the open layer, a second Escape closes the Modal. Tab in a portaled layer stays with that layer; focus that leaves the Modal comes back.

<!-- docs/components/popover.md -->

# Popover

A small non-modal panel under its trigger for interactive content: a quick form, filters, a picker.

## When to use

- Quick edits without leaving the page (rename, set a limit), compact filter forms.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A list of actions | Menu |
| A focused multi-step task | Modal |
| A read-only preview on hover | HoverCard |
| A one-line hint | Tooltip |

## Import

```tsx
import { Popover } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Quick edit

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, Field, Input, Popover } from "@semi/ui";

export default function PopoverQuickEdit() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [name, setName] = useState("X1 Carbon 03");
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(name);
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
      <span className="text-ui font-medium text-strong">{name}</span>
      <Popover
        label="Đổi tên máy in"
        open={open}
        onOpenChange={(o) => {
          setOpen(o);
          if (o) setDraft(name);
        }}
        trigger={<Button size="sm" icon="edit">Đổi tên</Button>}
      >
        <form
          className="space-y-3"
          onSubmit={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            setName(draft);
            setOpen(false);
          }}
        >
          <Field label="Tên máy in">
            <Input value={draft} onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)} />
          </Field>
          <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
            <Button size="sm" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
              Huỷ
            </Button>
            <Button size="sm" variant="primary" type="submit">
              Lưu
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </Popover>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### Popover

A non-modal dialog under its trigger. Focus moves into it; Escape, a click outside or tabbing out closes it, and
Escape returns focus to the trigger. Controlled with `open` + `onOpenChange`, or on its own.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `trigger` * | `ReactElement<unknown, string \| JSXElementConstructor<any>>` |  | The element that toggles it (usually a Button). |
| `label` * | `string` |  | Accessible name of the panel. |
| `align` | `'left' \| 'right' \| 'center'` | `"left"` |  |
| `width` | `number` | `280` | Minimum width in px (it grows with its content up to the viewport). |
| `open` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- A labelled dialog: focus moves in, Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger, clicking outside or tabbing out closes it.

<!-- docs/components/toast.md -->

# Toast

One toast API for feedback after an action: toast.success / error / warning / info, toast.undo for a reversible destructive action, toast.promise for work in progress. Irreversible actions ask first (confirmDelete). Mount ToastHost once in the root layout.

## When to use

- Confirm an action happened (Đã lưu): toast.success, shown once, never a modal.
- Right after a reversible destructive action (archive, remove from a list, move): toast.undo with Hoàn tác.
- Work that takes a moment (save, import, send): toast.promise.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A message that must stay on the page | Alert |
| Ask before an irreversible action (delete, disconnect) | confirmDelete() / confirmDialog() |
| A problem inside a field | Field error |

## Import

```tsx
import { ToastHost, toast, updateToast, dismissToast } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Tones and actions

```tsx
"use client";

import { Button, toast } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ToastTones() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <Button onClick={() => toast({ title: "Đã lưu thay đổi", tone: "success", action: { label: "Hoàn tác", onClick: () => toast({ title: "Đã hoàn tác" }) } })}>
        Thành công + hoàn tác
      </Button>
      <Button onClick={() => toast({ title: "Mất kết nối máy in", description: "Thử lại sau vài giây.", tone: "warning" })}>Cảnh báo</Button>
      <Button onClick={() => toast({ title: "Tệp sẽ được gửi khi máy rảnh", tone: "info", duration: 0 })}>Không tự tắt</Button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Undo after a reversible delete

The row goes at once; the toast offers Hoàn tác for 8 seconds.

```tsx
"use client";

import { Button, toast } from "@semi/ui";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";

// A reversible destructive action: do it at once, then offer "Hoàn tác" for 8 seconds. No question first.
// onCommit runs when the window closes without an undo: that is where a real app deletes on the server, and its
// undo must restore on the server too (it can run after this component is gone).
export default function ToastUndo() {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState(["Bản in mẫu A", "Bản in mẫu B", "Bản in mẫu C"]);
  const [gone, setGone] = useState(0);
  const router = useRouter();

  // delete on a detail page, then back to the list: the toast shown just before the navigation stays, and Hoàn tác works
  const archiveAndLeave = () => {
    toast.undo('Đã lưu trữ "Bản in mẫu D"', () => toast.success("Đã khôi phục bản in mẫu D"));
    router.push("/components/confirm-dialog/");
  };

  const archive = (name: string, index: number) => {
    setRows((r) => r.filter((x) => x !== name));
    toast.undo(`Đã lưu trữ "${name}"`, () => setRows((r) => [...r.slice(0, index), name, ...r.slice(index)]), { onCommit: () => setGone((n) => n + 1) });
  };

  return (
    <ul data-undo-list className="w-full max-w-sm flex flex-col gap-2">
      {rows.map((name, i) => (
        <li key={name} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-control border border-line bg-panel px-3 py-2 text-ui text-strong">
          {name}
          <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" icon="trash" onClick={() => archive(name, i)}>
            Lưu trữ
          </Button>
        </li>
      ))}
      {rows.length === 0 && <li className="text-ui text-muted">Đã lưu trữ hết, bấm Hoàn tác để khôi phục.</li>}
      <li>
        <Button size="sm" variant="subtle" onClick={archiveAndLeave}>
          Lưu trữ rồi chuyển trang
        </Button>
      </li>
      <li data-committed className="text-ui text-muted">
        Đã chốt: {gone}
      </li>
    </ul>
  );
}
```

### Promise toast

A spinner toast that turns into the result.

```tsx
"use client";

import { Button, toast, updateToast } from "@semi/ui";

const save = (fail: boolean) => new Promise<number>((resolve, reject) => setTimeout(() => (fail ? reject(new Error("offline")) : resolve(12)), 1500));
const forever = () => new Promise<number>(() => {});

// toast.promise: one toast follows the work, then becomes the result (success once, or the failure with the reason).
// `timeout` (default 30 s) ends the wait with the error text. updateToast changes a toast in place, by its id.
export default function ToastPromise() {
  const progress = () => {
    const id = toast({ title: "Đang gửi 0/3", tone: "info", duration: 0 });
    [1, 2, 3].forEach((n) => setTimeout(() => updateToast(id, n === 3 ? { title: "Đã gửi 3/3", tone: "success", duration: 6000 } : { title: `Đang gửi ${n}/3` }), n * 300));
    return id;
  };
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <Button onClick={() => toast.promise(save(false), { loading: "Đang lưu…", success: (n) => `Đã lưu ${n} dòng`, error: "Không lưu được" })}>Lưu</Button>
      <Button variant="subtle" onClick={() => toast.promise(save(true), { loading: "Đang lưu…", success: "Đã lưu", error: (e) => `Không lưu được: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : "lỗi"}` }).catch(() => {})}>
        Lưu (lỗi)
      </Button>
      <Button variant="subtle" onClick={() => toast.promise(forever(), { timeout: 1500, loading: "Đang kết nối…", success: "Đã kết nối", error: "Quá thời gian chờ" })}>
        Kết nối (treo)
      </Button>
      <Button variant="subtle" onClick={progress}>
        Tiến độ
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### ToastHost

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hotkey` | `string \| false` | `"Alt+T"` | Keyboard shortcut that focuses the newest toast's action (default "Alt+T"; `false` turns it off). Modifiers `Alt` `Ctrl` `Shift` `Meta` plus one letter. It is ignored while typing (inputs, textareas, contenteditable) and during IME composition. Firefox on Windows and Linux may open its Alt menu bar on Alt+letter; choose `"Ctrl+Alt+T"` or turn it off there. |
| `durationScale` | `number` | `1` | Multiplies every auto-dismiss time (WCAG 2.2.1, "time to read"): 2 doubles them, for a product whose users read slowly or use a screen magnifier. Default 1; 0 keeps every toast until it is dismissed. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Name of the notification region (default: locale `notifications`, "Thông báo"). Change it when a page section has the same name, e.g. a "Thông báo" settings group, so the two landmarks can be told apart. |

## Accessibility

- A live region (polite, assertive for danger); toasts with an action stay until dismissed or wait longer.
- The stack is a region named by the locale's notifications string with two sibling live regions (danger assertive, the rest polite), never nested. Auto-dismiss pauses on hover and on keyboard focus.
- A toast with an action or undo waits 8 s (and while hovered or focused); undo is a real button, so it is reachable by keyboard. A pending (promise) toast has no timer until it settles.
- Alt+T (ToastHost hotkey, false turns it off; ignored while typing and in IME composition; Firefox's Alt menu is a caveat) moves keyboard focus to the newest toast's action; focus pauses its timer. ToastHost durationScale multiplies every auto-dismiss time (WCAG 2.2.1).

## Notes

- <ToastHost /> goes once in the root layout (see Theme › Root layout); every toast() call anywhere shows there. No <Suspense> is needed around it: the route-change watcher inside ToastHost has its own boundary, so it is safe in a root layout that prerenders dynamic routes.
- Feedback rule (§14c): reversible destructive action → toast.undo; irreversible → confirmDelete (names the object, red Xoá, Huỷ); success is one toast, never a modal. The same text still showing is replaced, not stacked.
- `toast(opts)` keeps working; `toast.success(title, opts | ms)` etc. are shorthands. Use `updateToast(id, patch)` to change a toast that is still showing.
- Undo: `onUndo` must restore on the server too (it can run after the component is gone); `onCommit` runs when the window closes without an undo (also on pagehide: best effort, use keepalive / sendBeacon; commit first, undo restores). Undo toasts already showing close on a route change; one shown just before the action's own navigation stays. `toast.promise` has `timeout` (default 30 s: a neutral "Vẫn đang xử lý…", not an error). `updateToast` keeps the id.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/toast/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/tooltip.md -->

# Tooltip

A short label on hover or focus, mostly for icon-only buttons.

## When to use

- Name an icon-only control; add a short hint to a truncated value.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Information people must read | visible text or an Alert |

## Import

```tsx
import { Tooltip } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### On an icon button

```tsx
import { Button, Tooltip } from "@semi/ui";

export default function TooltipIconButton() {
  return (
    <div className="flex gap-2">
      <Tooltip content="Đồng bộ lại dữ liệu">
        <Button iconOnly icon="refresh" aria-label="Làm mới" />
      </Tooltip>
      <Tooltip content="Tải báo cáo" side="bottom">
        <Button iconOnly icon="download" aria-label="Tải báo cáo" />
      </Tooltip>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### Tooltip

Short hint for an icon-only control (one line, no interactive content). The trigger keeps its own aria-label;
the tooltip is linked with aria-describedby. Touch screens show nothing: never put essential text in a tooltip.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `content` * | `React.ReactNode` |  | The hint. `null`, `false` or `""` turns the tooltip off and keeps the trigger as it is (same element, no remount). |
| `children` * | `ReactElement<unknown, string \| JSXElementConstructor<any>>` |  |  |
| `side` | `'right' \| 'bottom' \| 'top'` | `"top"` | Where the hint shows; `right` is for a vertical icon rail (AppShell's collapsed sidebar). |

## Accessibility

- Shown on focus too, linked with aria-describedby; never the only place of essential information.
- The pointer can move onto the tooltip without it closing; Escape hides it (WCAG 1.4.13).
- Enters with `animate-tooltip-in` (200ms, opacity + scale 0.96 → 1); opacity-only under prefers-reduced-motion.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/tooltip/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/app-header.md -->

# App header

The top bar of a stand-alone tool app: logo + title go home, the module name, and one primary action on the right. No Home button.

## When to use

- Single-screen tools: 3D editors, slicers, colour tools.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| An app with several pages | AppShell |

## Import

```tsx
import { AppHeader, HEADER_ICON_BTN, HEADER_ICON_OFF, headerPrimary } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Tool app

```tsx
import { AppHeader, HEADER_ICON_BTN, HEADER_ICON_OFF, Icon, headerPrimary } from "@semi/ui";

export default function AppHeaderTool() {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-card border border-line overflow-hidden">
      <AppHeader title="Phối màu" productName="3D Noobs" logoIcon="palette" homeHref="#">
        <button type="button" className={`${HEADER_ICON_BTN} ${HEADER_ICON_OFF}`} aria-label="Trợ lý AI" title="Trợ lý AI">
          <Icon name="sparkles" className="w-4 h-4" />
        </button>
        <button type="button" className={headerPrimary(true)}>
          Xong
        </button>
      </AppHeader>
      <div className="h-32 bg-canvas flex items-center justify-center text-ui text-muted">Canvas</div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### AppHeader

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | `string` |  | Stand-alone app title; without it the bar is the home page's logo bar. |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Right-hand side (app actions). Wrap in a `flex-1` element to centre something. |
| `onHome` | `() => void` |  | Click on the logo + title. Default: plain link to `/`. |
| `hideTitleOnPhone` | `boolean` | `false` | Only the logo on phones (dense toolbars). |
| `className` | `string` | `""` |  |
| `productName` | `string` | `"Semi"` | Product name shown on the home bar (no `title`). |
| `logo` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Custom logo node; replaces the default icon tile. |
| `logoIcon` | `IconName` | `"sparkles"` | Icon of the default logo tile. |
| `homeHref` | `string` | `"/"` | Where the logo + title link goes. |
| `homeLabel` | `string` |  | Tooltip / aria text of the logo link. |

## Accessibility

- A banner landmark; the home link is labelled; icon buttons need aria-label.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/app-header/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/app-shell.md -->

# App shell

The 1.0 frame of a multi-page app: a canvas frame with the nav panel (main action, groups, pinned, a bottom row of icon tools) and the content column (the RouteHeader with crumbs, actions and the account avatar menu, then the content card). The nav is the 72px rail first when width runs short (always md–lg, by default lg–1280, the user's toggle remembered), then the phone drawer. Alt + 1…9 opens a nav item. This docs site is an AppShell; the full example runs at /demo/app-shell/.

## When to use

- Every app with several pages (dashboards, admin, store back office).
- An area with its own sub-views that people switch between often (mailbox folders, saved views): sub-items under one nav item.
- An area with many destinations in a few groups (a catalogue): a nav item with mega (MegaMenu).

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A single-screen tool or editor (3D, canvas) | AppHeader |
| 2–4 sibling views of one page that do not need a place in the menu | PageTabsTitle |
| Filters of a list (status, owner) | Pills or CustomSelect in SubpageToolbar |

## Import

```tsx
import { AppShell, RouteHeader, AccountMenu, MobileTabBar } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Main action, tools, header, account menu

The whole shell in one screen, opened full screen at /demo/app-shell/ of this site: main action menu, sub-items, a mega menu, a pinned group, tools with a count and a ••• menu, a header action with its own state and the account avatar menu.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import {
  AppShell,
  Button,
  Card,
  PageTitle,
  TextTabs,
  Tooltip,
  type ShellNavItem,
  type ShellNavSection,
} from "@semi/ui";

// The whole 1.0 shell in one screen: main action, groups, sub-items, a mega menu, a pinned group, the bottom row of
// tools, and the route header with an action and the account avatar menu (theme, account, sign-out). A real app renders AppShell in layout.tsx and gives page items an
// `href` (shell-nav-href); this demo keeps everything on one page with onSelect so it can run anywhere.
const SECTIONS: ShellNavSection[] = [
  {
    items: [
      { id: "inbox", label: "Hộp thư", icon: "inbox", right: <span className="px-1 text-chrome text-muted tabular-nums">3</span> },
      {
        id: "orders",
        label: "Đơn hàng",
        icon: "bag",
        href: "#orders",
        children: [
          { id: "orders-open", label: "Đang xử lý" },
          { id: "orders-done", label: "Đã giao" },
        ],
      },
      {
        id: "catalog",
        label: "Sản phẩm",
        icon: "box",
        mega: {
          columns: [
            {
              title: "Danh mục",
              items: [
                { id: "printers", label: "Máy in", icon: "printer", href: "#", hint: "Máy in 3D và phụ kiện" },
                { id: "filament", label: "Nhựa in", icon: "layers", href: "#", hint: "PLA, PETG, TPU" },
              ],
            },
            {
              title: "Bán hàng",
              items: [
                { id: "prices", label: "Bảng giá", icon: "tag", href: "#" },
                { id: "bundles", label: "Combo", icon: "package", href: "#", isNew: true },
              ],
            },
          ],
          seeAll: { href: "#" },
        },
      },
      { id: "suppliers", label: "Nhà cung cấp", icon: "truck" },
      { id: "customers", label: "Khách hàng", icon: "users" },
    ],
  },
];

const PINNED = {
  label: "Đã ghim",
  items: [
    { id: "pin-late", label: "Đơn trễ hạn", icon: "clock" },
    { id: "pin-vip", label: "Khách VIP", icon: "star" },
  ] satisfies ShellNavItem[],
};

const PRICE = new Intl.NumberFormat("vi-VN", { style: "currency", currency: "VND" });

const TABS = [
  { key: "open", label: "Đang xử lý" },
  { key: "done", label: "Đã giao" },
  { key: "all", label: "Tất cả" },
] as const;

/** A header action with its own state: a slot is rendered as a component, so it may hold state and call hooks. */
function StarAction() {
  const [on, setOn] = useState(false);
  return (
    <Tooltip content={on ? "Bỏ ghim trang" : "Ghim trang"}>
      <Button variant="ghost" iconOnly icon="star" aria-label="Ghim trang" aria-pressed={on} onClick={() => setOn(!on)} className="!w-8 !h-8" />
    </Tooltip>
  );
}

export default function FullShell() {
  const [active, setActive] = useState("orders-open");
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<(typeof TABS)[number]["key"]>("open");

  return (
    <AppShell
      productName="Sales Hub"
      logoIcon="bag"
      sections={SECTIONS}
      activeId={active}
      onSelect={setActive}
      mainAction={{
        label: "Tạo mới",
        items: [
          // not available on this plan: shown, but disabled (the phone drawer focuses the first enabled row)
          { label: "Báo giá", icon: "fileText", disabled: true, onSelect: () => {} },
          { label: "Đơn hàng", icon: "bag", onSelect: () => setActive("orders-open") },
          { label: "Khách hàng", icon: "users", onSelect: () => setActive("customers") },
          { label: "Sản phẩm", icon: "box", onSelect: () => {} },
          { label: "Phiếu nhập", icon: "receipt", onSelect: () => {} },
        ],
      }}
      pinned={PINNED}
      tools={[
        { id: "notifications", label: "Thông báo", icon: "bell", count: 12, onClick: () => {} },
        { id: "help", label: "Trợ giúp", icon: "info", onClick: () => {} },
      ]}
      toolsMenu={[
        { label: "Cài đặt", icon: "settings", onSelect: () => {} },
        { label: "Phím tắt", icon: "layers", onSelect: () => {} },
      ]}
      header={{
        actions: <StarAction />,
        account: {
          name: "Lan Phạm",
          detail: "Cửa hàng Quận 1",
          items: [{ label: "Tài khoản", icon: "user", onSelect: () => {} }],
          onSignOut: () => {},
        },
      }}
    >
      <PageTitle
        title="Đơn hàng"
        actions={
          <Button variant="inverse" icon="plus">
            Tạo đơn
          </Button>
        }
      />
      <TextTabs label="Đơn hàng" items={[...TABS]} value={tab} onChange={setTab}>
        <div className="@container">
        <div className="grid gap-group @2xl:grid-cols-2 @5xl:grid-cols-3">
          {["DH-1042", "DH-1041", "DH-1039", "DH-1037", "DH-1036", "DH-1033"].map((id, i) => (
            <Card key={id} className="flex flex-col gap-stack">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 min-w-0">
                <span className="text-ui font-medium text-strong truncate">{id}</span>
                <span className="text-ui text-muted tabular-nums shrink-0">{PRICE.format((i + 2) * 450_000)}</span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-ui text-body truncate">{["Bambu Lab A1 mini", "PLA Basic 1kg × 4", "Combo AMS Lite", "PETG HF 1kg × 2", "Bàn in PEI", "TPU 95A 1kg"][i]}</p>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>
        </div>
      </TextTabs>
    </AppShell>
  );
}
```

### Root layout

AppShell fills the viewport, so it is shown as code: this very page is the live example.

```tsx
"use client";

import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { AppShell, type ShellNavSection } from "@semi/ui";

const SECTIONS: ShellNavSection[] = [
  {
    label: "Quản lý",
    items: [
      { id: "overview", label: "Tổng quan", icon: "grid", href: "/" },
      { id: "printers", label: "Máy in", icon: "printer", href: "/printers" },
      { id: "orders", label: "Đơn hàng", icon: "bag", href: "/orders" },
    ],
  },
  { label: "Hệ thống", items: [{ id: "settings", label: "Cài đặt", icon: "settings", href: "/settings" }] },
];

export default function Shell({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const path = usePathname();
  const active = SECTIONS.flatMap((s) => s.items).find((i) => i.href !== "/" && path.startsWith(i.href ?? ""))?.id ?? "overview";
  return (
    <AppShell
      productName="3D Noobs Manager"
      logoIcon="printer"
      sections={SECTIONS}
      activeId={active}
      tools={[{ id: "help", label: "Trợ giúp", icon: "info", href: "/help" }]}
      // the account avatar menu holds the theme (Light / Dark / System), the app's items and sign-out
      header={{ account: { name: "Minh Trần", detail: "minh@example.com", items: [{ label: "Tài khoản", icon: "user", href: "/account" }], onSignOut: () => {} } }}
    >
      {children}
    </AppShell>
  );
}
```

### Session gate in the layout

A client-only app checks the session once in the route-group layout and shows BootLoader until it knows whether to render the shell or go to login.

```tsx
"use client";

// app/(app)/layout.tsx of a client-only app: the session check runs once here, never per page.
// With a server session (proxy / async server layout) drop the gate: render AppShell straight away.
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { usePathname, useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { AppShell, BootLoader, type ShellNavSection } from "@semi/ui";

const SECTIONS: ShellNavSection[] = [
  {
    label: "Dữ liệu",
    items: [
      { id: "search", label: "Tìm kiếm", icon: "search", href: "/search" },
      { id: "companies", label: "Doanh nghiệp", icon: "store", href: "/companies" },
      { id: "import", label: "Nhập file", icon: "upload", href: "/import" },
    ],
  },
];

export default function AppLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const path = usePathname();
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    fetch("/api/session")
      .then((r) => (r.ok ? setReady(true) : router.replace("/login")))
      .catch(() => router.replace("/login"));
  }, [router]);

  // Before the layout is known: a centred spinner, not a page skeleton that may never appear.
  if (!ready) return <BootLoader />;
  const active = SECTIONS[0].items.find((i) => path.startsWith(i.href ?? ""))?.id ?? "search";
  return (
    <AppShell productName="Data Hub" logoIcon="database" sections={SECTIONS} activeId={active}>
      {children}
    </AppShell>
  );
}
```

### Content loading

A route loading.tsx beside the layout: the shell stays mounted and only the content area shimmers.

```tsx
// app/(app)/loading.tsx: Next.js shows it inside the layout, so the shell stays and only the content shimmers.
import { PageSkeleton } from "@semi/ui";

export default function Loading() {
  return <PageSkeleton />;
}
```

### Sub-items

A mailbox with folders as sub-items, and the page's own folder picker when the sidebar cannot show them.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { AppShell, CustomSelect, PageTitle, useAppShell, type ShellNavSection } from "@semi/ui";

const FOLDERS = [
  { id: "mail:inbox", label: "Hộp thư đến", icon: "inbox" as const },
  { id: "mail:starred", label: "Gắn sao", icon: "star" as const },
  { id: "mail:sent", label: "Đã gửi", icon: "send" as const },
  { id: "mail:failed", label: "Thất bại", icon: "alert" as const },
];

const SECTIONS: ShellNavSection[] = [
  {
    label: "Làm việc",
    hideLabel: true,
    items: [
      // Choosing "Hộp thư" opens its sub-items; choosing another item closes them.
      { id: "mail", label: "Hộp thư", icon: "mail", children: FOLDERS },
      { id: "customers", label: "Khách hàng", icon: "users" },
    ],
  },
  { label: "Hệ thống", hideLabel: true, items: [{ id: "settings", label: "Cấu hình", icon: "settings" }] },
];

function MailPage({ folder, onFolder }: { folder: string; onFolder: (id: string) => void }) {
  // In the rail and on phones the sidebar hides sub-items: the page offers the same choice itself.
  const { submenuVisible } = useAppShell();
  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <PageTitle title="Hộp thư" />
      {!submenuVisible && (
        <CustomSelect
          aria-label="Thư mục"
          value={folder}
          onChange={onFolder}
          options={FOLDERS.map((f) => ({ value: f.id, label: f.label }))}
        />
      )}
      <p className="text-ui text-body">{FOLDERS.find((f) => f.id === folder)?.label}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function AppShellSubmenu() {
  const [active, setActive] = useState("customers");
  // The parent alone opens its first sub-item.
  const select = (id: string) => setActive(id === "mail" ? "mail:inbox" : id);
  return (
    <AppShell productName="Sales Hub" logoIcon="chart" sections={SECTIONS} activeId={active} onSelect={select}>
      {active.startsWith("mail") ? <MailPage folder={active} onFolder={setActive} /> : <PageTitle title="Khách hàng" />}
    </AppShell>
  );
}
```

## API

### AppShell

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `productName` * | `string` |  | Product title shown next to the logo (e.g. "3D Noobs Studio", "Auton"). |
| `logoIcon` | `IconName` | `"sparkles"` | Icon inside the default brand tile. |
| `logo` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Optional custom logo element replacing the default brand tile (32px tall). |
| `sections` * | `ShellNavSection[]` |  | Nav groups, separated by a 24px spacer with a line. |
| `activeId` * | `string` |  | Currently active item id (or route path). |
| `onSelect` | `(id: string) => void` |  | Called with the item id when an item is clicked. Items with `href` stay `next/link` links either way, so use it to react to a click (close a sheet, track), not to route: give page items an `href` (`shell-nav-href`). |
| `mainAction` | `ShellAction \| ShellSlot` |  | The nav's one main action, the only brand-filled control in the nav: data (label + icon, a menu, a link or an action) drawn as an ordinary primary button, or your own slot. In the rail: the icon with a Tooltip. The phone drawer shows the data form as a row; a slot keeps its one instance in the nav, so give phones its action elsewhere. |
| `primaryCta` | `{ label: string; icon: IconName; href?: string; external?: boolean; onClick?: () => void; }` |  | Optional quiet launcher under the main action (another app, a docs link). |
| `navSearch` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Optional quick-search field rendered above the nav sections in the expanded sidebar and phone drawer (hidden in the rail). |
| `pinned` | `ShellPinned` |  | A group under the main nav (saved views, frequent records). |
| `tools` | `ShellTool[]` | `[]` | The bottom row of the nav: 32×32 ghost icon buttons (help, notifications), stacked in the rail. |
| `toolsMenu` | `MenuItem[]` | `[]` | The rest of the bottom row, in a ••• Menu after the tools. |
| `header` | `false \| ShellHeader` |  | The route header (crumbs, middle, actions, account). Default: shown with the default crumbs. `false`: none. |
| `page` | `'scroll' \| 'fixed'` | `"scroll"` | `scroll` (default): the content card scrolls. `fixed`: the card fills the column and does not scroll; the page's panels scroll inside it (list + reader, a pinned bar). Give the page `h-full min-h-0 flex flex-col`. |
| `flush` | `boolean` | `false` | No centred max-width container and no padding around the page: the page layout decides (T7). |
| `railBelow` | `number` | `1280` | Below this width (px, at least 1024) the nav starts as the rail while the user has not chosen; from it, expanded. Between md and lg it is always the rail. Default 1280. |
| `railWidth` | `number` | `72` | Width of the rail in px (default 72; the icons stay 32px, centred). |
| `shortcuts` | `boolean` | `true` | ⌥ / Alt + 1…9 opens the nth nav item (⌘ / Ctrl + digit in an installed app). Default true. |
| `mobileNav` | `'drawer' \| 'tabs'` |  | Phone navigation: `drawer` (a full-screen menu from the header's menu button) or `tabs` (MobileTabBar, the items in `mobileTabIds`). Default: `tabs` when `mobileTabIds` is set, else `drawer`. |
| `mobileTabIds` | `string[]` |  | With `mobileNav="tabs"`: the ids of the items on the tab bar (up to 5; the rest go in its More sheet). |
| `storageKey` | `string` | `"semi-nav"` | localStorage key of the user's collapse choice ("rail" / "full"; one value for every width). A 0.x value ("1" / "0", in this key or in the old default key `semi_sidebar_collapsed`) is upgraded once on load. |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `containerClassName` | `string` | `""` | Classes added to the page container inside the content card. |

### RouteHeader

The route header: h60 from `lg` (56 below), padding 0 8px (16px from `sm`), the column's full width. Crumbs enter with
`motion-crumb-in` and leave with `motion-crumb-out` (opacity only under reduced motion); the row itself never moves.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `crumbs` * | `RouteCrumb[]` |  | The trail: group (a link), page, record. Every crumb is muted; the trail never wraps and long crumbs truncate. |
| `middle` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Optional middle: a search field on a search page, a small info banner. Hidden below `md`. In its own Suspense. |
| `actions` | `React.ReactNode` |  | The page's action icon buttons (32×32, ghost or outline); keep room for a future AI chat button. In its own Suspense. |
| `account` | `ShellAccount \| React.ReactNode` |  | The account avatar menu: the who-is-signed-in data, or your own element. |
| `onMenu` | `() => void` |  | Phones: the menu button that opens the nav drawer (shown below `md` when set). |
| `menuExpanded` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

### AccountMenu

The account avatar menu of the route header: a one-letter avatar (32px) whose Menu has a header (name, role or email),
then the theme (Light / Dark / System), the app's items and sign-out.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` * | `string` |  | The person's name: the avatar shows its first letter, the menu header shows it whole. |
| `detail` | `string` |  | One line under the name in the menu header: a role or an email. |
| `avatarSrc` | `string` |  | A photo in place of the letter. |
| `items` | `MenuItem[]` | `[]` | The app's own items (Tài khoản, Cài đặt…), between the theme choices and sign-out. |
| `onSignOut` | `() => void` |  | Adds the last item, "Đăng xuất" (locale `signOut`), after a divider. |
| `theme` | `boolean` | `true` | Light / Dark / System as radio items at the top (default true). Turn off only when the app pins one theme. |

### MobileTabBar

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tabs` * | `MobileTabItem[]` |  |  |
| `active` * | `string` |  |  |
| `onSelect` | `(id: string) => void` |  |  |
| `moreOpen` | `boolean` | `false` | When the app has more routes than fit on the bottom bar, show a final "Menu" tab that opens a sheet. |
| `onToggleMore` | `() => void` |  |  |
| `moreLabel` | `string` | `"Menu"` |  |

## Accessibility

- The nav is a complementary landmark named after the product with nav landmarks inside; the active item has aria-current; the collapse choice is one stored value (storageKey).
- In the rail every item keeps its name (the label is visually hidden, never removed) and shows it in a Tooltip on the right with its shortcut, on hover and focus.
- The route header's trail is a navigation named "Đường dẫn" with aria-current on the last crumb; the account avatar is a named button opening a menu (a header that is not an item, radio items for the theme, account items, sign-out) by keyboard.
- An item with sub-items has aria-expanded; its sub-items are a list named after it. A mega item has aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-expanded.
- Bottom-row tools are named with their count ("Thông báo (12)"); the badge itself is hidden from assistive tech.
- Nav shortcuts (Alt + digit) click the link, so the router and an unsaved-changes guard run; ignored while composing (IME), in fields and editors, and when the app already took the key.
- The phone drawer is a modal dialog: focus moves in, Tab stays in, Escape goes back a level or closes, and focus returns to the menu button.

## Notes

- Render it once in the root layout (or a route group layout); pages render only their content. It never remounts on a route change or a resize.
- Page items take an href: they stay next/link links even when onSelect is set (onSelect then only reports the click). Never route with onSelect + router.push (shell-nav-href).
- Never gate the shell behind a page skeleton (shell-gate): a route loading.tsx next to the layout shimmers the content only, and the boot / session check before the layout is known renders BootLoader once in the layout. A page never renders AppShell or imports a component that does (app-shell-in-page).
- Top to bottom: logo + collapse, mainAction (the one brand-filled button: label + icon, a Menu with items), primaryCta (an optional quiet launcher), sections, pinned, then tools (32×32 icons with a count) and toolsMenu (•••).
- header: crumbs (default from the active item; useRecordCrumb(label) in a detail page adds its record), middle (search field, banner; hidden below md), actions (32×32 ghost icon buttons) and account ({ name, detail, items, onSignOut }: the theme is in that menu). header={false} drops the row.
- Slots (mainAction, header.middle / actions / account) are an element or a function of { collapsed, rail } rendered as one stable component: it may call hooks and keeps its state across a collapse, a resize and a route change. rail is exact after mount only.
- railBelow (default 1280, at least 1024) sets where the nav starts expanded; between md and lg it is always the rail. railWidth (default 72) sets the rail width.
- page="fixed": the card does not scroll; give the page h-full min-h-0 flex flex-col and let its panels scroll. flush: no centred max-width container or padding.
- 1.0 breaking: create → mainAction and utilities → tools (the 1.0.0-app-shell migration renames them); account / footer are gone from the nav (move the account to header.account); the stored collapse key is now semi-nav (a 0.x choice is upgraded once on load).
- Phones use the drawer (the header's menu button) unless the app sets mobileNav="tabs", with mobileTabIds naming the items on MobileTabBar. In the drawer a parent with its own href is the first row of its level.
- Sub-items (children) open under their parent while the parent or one of them is the activeId. The rail and widths below lg never show them: read useAppShell().submenuVisible and give the page its own picker when it is false.
- Pinned items in the rail: give each a distinct icon, or none so the rail shows its initials (shortLabel to choose them).
- Shortcut hints in a CommandPalette: shortcut: useAppShell().shortcuts[id] inside the shell, or navShortcutKeys(n) outside it.
- The nav's stored choice is set on <html> (data-semi-nav) by an inline script before paint: give <html> suppressHydrationWarning, as ThemeScript already asks. A slot main action is not repeated in the phone drawer (one instance): give phones its action elsewhere, or pass the data form.

<!-- docs/components/breadcrumb.md -->

# Breadcrumb

Where the page sits: a trail of links ending with the current page. Long trails collapse their middle into a “…” menu.

## When to use

- Detail pages deep in a hierarchy (Kho › Vật liệu › PLA đen).

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Top-level pages of an app | AppShell navigation |
| Sibling views | TextTabs |

## Import

```tsx
import { Breadcrumb } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Trail

```tsx
import { Breadcrumb } from "@semi/ui";

export default function BreadcrumbBasic() {
  return (
    <Breadcrumb
      items={[
        { label: "Kho", href: "/inventory", icon: "box" },
        { label: "Vật liệu", href: "/inventory/materials" },
        { label: "PLA đen 1kg" },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

### Collapsed

More items than maxItems keep the first and the last two; the rest open from “…”.

```tsx
import { Breadcrumb } from "@semi/ui";

export default function BreadcrumbCollapsed() {
  return (
    <Breadcrumb
      maxItems={3}
      aria-label="Đường dẫn máy in" // a second trail on the same page needs its own name
      items={[
        { label: "Xưởng", href: "/" },
        { label: "Khu A", href: "/a" },
        { label: "Dãy 2", href: "/a/2" },
        { label: "Máy in", href: "/a/2/printers" },
        { label: "X1 Carbon 03" },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

## API

### Breadcrumb

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` * | `BreadcrumbItem[]` |  |  |
| `maxItems` | `number` | `4` | More items than this collapse the middle ones into a "…" menu (first + last two stay). |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  | Name of the trail (default: locale `breadcrumb`, "Đường dẫn"). Only needed when a page has two trails, so their landmarks differ. |

## Accessibility

- A nav landmark (“Đường dẫn”) with an ordered list; the last item has aria-current="page".

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/breadcrumb/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/list-reader.md -->

# List + reader

A list card beside a reader card (`ListReaderLayout`) with a sticky one-row `ReaderHeader` (wrapping title left, [•••] then one main action right, top-aligned, identical button height). Each panel scrolls independently on `AppShell page="fixed"` / `Page fixed` with zero hand-tuned `calc()`. Open item lives in `?open=` (`useDetailParam`) and `RouteHeader` breadcrumbs (`useRecordCrumb`); below `lg` the reader replaces the list with a Back button.

## When to use

- Mail inboxes, support tickets, chat queues, notification centres or log viewers where people scan a list and read items side by side.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A table or card grid where opening a record shows a modal overlay | DetailOverlay + useDetailParam |
| A tool with a 380px control panel and live result | WorkspaceLayout |

## Import

```tsx
import { ListReaderLayout, ReaderHeader } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Mail inbox (list + reader)

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Item, ListReaderLayout, ReaderHeader, toast, useDetailParam } from "@semi/ui";

type Thread = { id: string; subject: string; from: string; time: string; preview: string; paragraphs: string[] };

const THREADS: Thread[] = Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, i) => ({
  id: `m-${i + 1}`,
  subject:
    i === 0
      ? "Báo giá hạt tiêu đen hữu cơ xuất khẩu quý 4 và lịch giao container tại cảng Cát Lái"
      : `Trao đổi đơn hàng #${1040 + i} — xác nhận quy cách đóng gói`,
  from: ["Gia vị Tây Nguyên", "HTX Chư Sê", "Hương Quế Yên Bái", "Nông sản Đắk Lắk"][i % 4],
  time: `${9 + (i % 9)}:${String((i * 13) % 60).padStart(2, "0")}`,
  preview: "Gửi anh chị bảng giá cập nhật theo lô 10 tấn và chứng từ kiểm định mới nhất.",
  paragraphs: Array.from(
    { length: 8 },
    (_, p) =>
      `Đoạn ${p + 1}: Chúng tôi đã kiểm tra tồn kho và lịch tàu dự kiến trong tuần tới. Vui lòng xác nhận số lượng cuối cùng trước 15:00 để bộ phận kho giữ hàng và chuẩn bị hồ sơ xuất xưởng.`,
  ),
}));

export default function ListReaderInboxExample() {
  const detail = useDetailParam("mail");
  const [fallbackId, setFallbackId] = useState<string | null>(THREADS[0].id);
  const openId = detail.openId ?? fallbackId;
  const active = THREADS.find((t) => t.id === openId) ?? null;

  return (
    <div className="h-[440px] flex flex-col min-h-0">
      <ListReaderLayout
        open={active !== null}
        openKey={active?.id}
        recordTitle={active?.subject}
        onClose={() => {
          setFallbackId(null);
          if (detail.openId) detail.close();
        }}
        listLabel="Danh sách thư"
        readerLabel="Nội dung thư"
        list={THREADS.map((item) => (
          <Item
            key={item.id}
            title={item.subject}
            description={`${item.from} · ${item.preview}`}
            meta={item.time}
            selected={active?.id === item.id}
            onClick={() => {
              setFallbackId(item.id);
              detail.open(item.id);
            }}
          />
        ))}
        reader={
          active && (
            <>
              <ReaderHeader
                title={active.subject}
                meta={`${active.from} · ${active.time}`}
                moreActions={[
                  { label: "Chuyển tiếp", icon: "send", onSelect: () => toast({ title: "Chuyển tiếp thư" }) },
                  { label: "Lưu trữ", icon: "folder", onSelect: () => toast({ title: "Đã lưu trữ" }) },
                  { label: "Xoá thư", icon: "trash", danger: true, onSelect: () => toast({ title: "Đã xoá", tone: "danger" }) },
                ]}
                action={{
                  label: "Trả lời",
                  icon: "send",
                  onClick: () => toast({ title: `Trả lời ${active.from}` }),
                }}
              />
              <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 flex flex-col gap-3">
                {active.paragraphs.map((text, idx) => (
                  <p key={idx} className="text-ui text-body">
                    {text}
                  </p>
                ))}
              </div>
            </>
          )
        }
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### In AppShell page="fixed"

Full-height list + reader inside AppShell page="fixed" and Page layout="two-column" fixed (zero calc()). Full screen at /demo/list-reader/.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { AppShell, Button, Item, ListReaderLayout, Page, ReaderHeader, SubNav, toast, useDetailParam, type SubNavSection } from "@semi/ui";

type Thread = { id: string; subject: string; from: string; time: string; paragraphs: string[] };

const THREADS: Thread[] = Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, i) => ({
  id: `m-${i + 1}`,
  subject:
    i === 0
      ? "Báo giá hạt tiêu đen hữu cơ xuất khẩu quý 4 và lịch giao container tại cảng Cát Lái"
      : `Trao đổi đơn hàng #${1040 + i} — xác nhận quy cách đóng gói`,
  from: ["Gia vị Tây Nguyên", "HTX Chư Sê", "Hương Quế Yên Bái", "Nông sản Đắk Lắk"][i % 4],
  time: `${9 + (i % 9)}:${String((i * 13) % 60).padStart(2, "0")}`,
  paragraphs: Array.from(
    { length: 18 },
    (_, p) =>
      `Đoạn ${p + 1}: Chúng tôi đã kiểm tra tồn kho và lịch tàu dự kiến trong tuần tới. Vui lòng xác nhận số lượng cuối cùng trước 15:00 để bộ phận kho giữ hàng và chuẩn bị hồ sơ xuất xưởng.`,
  ),
}));

/** Full-height ListReaderLayout inside AppShell page="fixed" + Page layout="two-column" fixed (zero calc()). */
export default function ListReaderInShell() {
  const detail = useDetailParam("open");
  const [folder, setFolder] = useState("inbox");
  const [fallbackId, setFallbackId] = useState<string | null>(THREADS[0].id);
  const openId = detail.openId ?? fallbackId;
  const active = THREADS.find((t) => t.id === openId) ?? null;

  const sections: SubNavSection[] = [
    {
      label: "Thư mục",
      items: [
        { id: "inbox", label: "Hộp thư đến", icon: "inbox", meta: THREADS.length },
        { id: "sent", label: "Đã gửi", icon: "send" },
        { id: "archive", label: "Lưu trữ", icon: "folder" },
      ],
    },
  ];

  return (
    <AppShell
      page="fixed"
      productName="Sales Hub"
      logoIcon="mail"
      activeId="inbox"
      sections={[
        {
          items: [
            { id: "inbox", label: "Hộp thư", icon: "mail", href: "/demo/list-reader/" },
            { id: "orders", label: "Đơn hàng", icon: "bag", href: "/demo/list-reader/" },
          ],
        },
      ]}
      header={{ account: { name: "Hoàng Huỳnh", detail: "Quản trị" } }}
    >
      <Page
        layout="two-column"
        fixed
        subNav={<SubNav sections={sections} activeId={folder} onSelect={setFolder} label="Thư mục hộp thư" />}
        title="Hộp thư"
        actions={
          <Button variant="inverse" icon="plus" onClick={() => toast.info("Soạn thư mới")}>
            Soạn thư
          </Button>
        }
      >
        <ListReaderLayout
          open={active !== null}
          openKey={active?.id}
          recordTitle={active?.subject}
          onClose={() => {
            setFallbackId(null);
            if (detail.openId) detail.close();
          }}
          listLabel="Danh sách thư"
          readerLabel="Nội dung thư"
          list={THREADS.map((item) => (
            <Item
              key={item.id}
              title={item.subject}
              description={item.from}
              meta={item.time}
              selected={active?.id === item.id}
              onClick={() => {
                setFallbackId(item.id);
                detail.open(item.id);
              }}
            />
          ))}
          reader={
            active && (
              <>
                <ReaderHeader
                  title={active.subject}
                  meta={`${active.from} · ${active.time}`}
                  moreActions={[
                    { label: "Chuyển tiếp", icon: "send", onSelect: () => toast.info("Chuyển tiếp") },
                    { label: "Lưu trữ", icon: "folder", onSelect: () => toast.info("Đã lưu trữ") },
                  ]}
                  action={{ label: "Trả lời", icon: "send", onClick: () => toast.success("Mở khung trả lời") }}
                />
                <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 flex flex-col gap-3">
                  {active.paragraphs.map((p, idx) => (
                    <p key={idx} className="text-ui text-body">
                      {p}
                    </p>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </>
            )
          }
        />
      </Page>
    </AppShell>
  );
}
```

## API

### ListReaderLayout

List + reader layout (#149, #118): a list card on the left and a reader card on the right, each its own independent
scroll container (`overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain`), filling the remaining height of `AppShell page="fixed"` /
`Page fixed` with zero hand-tuned `calc()`. Drive `open` and `onClose` from `useDetailParam()` (`?open=`, Back
closes); pass `recordTitle` to add the open record to `RouteHeader` breadcrumbs via `useRecordCrumb`.
Below `lg`, opening an item swaps the reader in place of the list (with `ReaderHeader`'s Back button).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `list` * | `React.ReactNode` |  | List items (e.g. `Item` rows with `selected={openId === id}`). Scrolls inside the list card. |
| `reader` * | `React.ReactNode` |  | The open record (`<ReaderHeader … />` + body). Shown when `open` is true. |
| `open` * | `boolean` |  | True while an item is open (`openId !== null` from `useDetailParam()`). |
| `openKey` | `null \| string` |  | Identifier of the open item (resets reader scroll to top when switching items). |
| `onClose` | `() => void` |  | Close handler (`useDetailParam().close`, wired to `ReaderHeader`'s below-`lg` Back button). |
| `recordTitle` | `null \| string` |  | Open record label pushed into `RouteHeader` breadcrumbs via `useRecordCrumb` while `open` is true. |
| `empty` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Empty state shown in the reader card on `lg+` when no item is open. |
| `listWidth` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `"md"` | Width of the list card from `lg`: `"sm"` 288px, `"md"` 352px (default), `"lg"` 400px. |
| `listLabel` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the list region (default locale `listLabel`). |
| `readerLabel` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the reader region (default locale `readerLabel`). |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

### ReaderHeader

Sticky one-row header of a reader pane (general pattern for mail, tickets, chat; owner decision 2026-11-23):
- Left: below-`lg` Back button (wired automatically from `ListReaderLayout`'s `onClose`) + wrapping `title` (never
  truncated) and optional muted `meta` line underneath.
- Right: `[•••]` `Menu` (all secondary / overflow actions) then one main `action`, top-aligned (`items-start`),
  both buttons at identical `md` (`h-control`) height.
- Stays sticky (`sticky top-0 z-sticky bg-app`) while the reader body scrolls underneath.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` * | `React.ReactNode` |  | Subject or record title on the left; wraps cleanly onto multiple lines. |
| `meta` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Optional quiet meta line directly under the title (sender, timestamp, ticket id). |
| `action` | `ReaderMainAction \| React.ReactNode` |  | The one main action on the right (e.g. Trả lời / Reply), or a custom button element at `size="md"`. |
| `moreActions` | `MenuItem[]` |  | Every other reader action (Chuyển tiếp, Lưu trữ, Đóng ticket, Xoá…) goes into this `•••` Menu. |
| `moreLabel` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the `•••` menu (default locale `moreActions`). |
| `onBack` | `() => void` |  | Back handler below `lg` (defaults to the enclosing `ListReaderLayout`'s `onClose`). |
| `backLabel` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the phone Back button (default locale `backToList`). |
| `headingLevel` | `1 \| 2 \| 3` | `2` | Heading level for the reader title (default 2: the page `h1` sits above). |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- List and reader are named <section> landmarks; the open item marks aria-current="true" on its row; below lg the Back button returns to the list and closes ?open=.
- ReaderHeader keeps [•••] and the main action top-aligned at identical height with every secondary action inside •••.

## Notes

- General pattern for every list + reader (mail, tickets, chat): title on the left (wraps), [•••] plus one main action on the right of the same row; every other action goes into •••.
- Pass `recordTitle` to `ListReaderLayout` so the open record is appended to `RouteHeader` breadcrumbs via `useRecordCrumb`.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/list-reader/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/mega-menu.md -->

# Mega menu

A flyout of links in category columns: a text-overline header per column, links with a grey icon, a hint and a New badge, and a See all link. AppShell opens it beside the sidebar from a nav item with mega; an app can open it from its own trigger.

## When to use

- One sidebar item leads to many destinations of one area that fall into 2–4 groups (a catalogue, tools, reports).
- A top-bar item of an app with that kind of area (placement="bottom").

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| 2–6 views of one area that people switch between often | AppShell sub-items (children) |
| Actions (create, export), not places | Menu |
| Top navigation of a website | NavigationMenu |

## Import

```tsx
import { MegaMenu } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### From a button

placement="bottom" under its own trigger; in AppShell it opens beside the sidebar.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Button, MegaMenu } from "@semi/ui";

export default function MegaMenuFlyout() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const anchor = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  return (
    <div ref={anchor} className="inline-flex">
      <Button icon="box" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded={open} onClick={() => setOpen((v) => !v)}>
        Sản phẩm
      </Button>
      <MegaMenu
        open={open}
        onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
        anchorRef={anchor}
        placement="bottom"
        label="Sản phẩm"
        columns={[
          {
            title: "Danh mục",
            items: [
              { id: "printers", label: "Máy in", icon: "printer", href: "#", hint: "Máy in 3D và phụ kiện" },
              { id: "filament", label: "Nhựa in", icon: "layers", href: "#", hint: "PLA, PETG, TPU" },
            ],
          },
          {
            title: "Bán hàng",
            items: [
              { id: "prices", label: "Bảng giá", icon: "tag", href: "#" },
              { id: "bundles", label: "Combo", icon: "package", href: "#", isNew: true },
            ],
          },
        ]}
        seeAll={{ href: "#" }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### MegaMenu

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `open` * | `boolean` |  |  |
| `onClose` * | `() => void` |  | Called on Escape, a click outside, Tab out of the panel or a link chosen. |
| `anchorRef` * | `RefObject<HTMLElement \| null>` |  | The element the panel is placed against (a sidebar for `right`, a top-bar button for `bottom`). |
| `triggerRef` | `RefObject<HTMLElement \| null>` |  | Where focus returns when the menu closes; defaults to the element focused when it opened. |
| `label` * | `string` |  | Accessible name of the panel (the nav item's label). |
| `placement` | `'right' \| 'bottom'` | `"right"` | `right` beside the anchor (a sidebar), `bottom` under it (a top bar). |
| `onNavigate` | `(id: string) => void` |  | Called with the item id when a link is chosen (the link still navigates). |
| `columns` * | `MegaMenuColumn[]` |  |  |
| `seeAll` | `{ href: string; label?: string \| undefined; }` |  | Link to the full list; `label` defaults to the locale's `seeAll`. |

## Accessibility

- A non-modal dialog named after its trigger; the trigger has aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-expanded.
- Focus moves to the first link; ↑/↓ move between links; Escape or a click outside closes it and focus returns to the trigger; Tab out of the panel closes it.
- Column headers are headings (h2) and each column is a labelled section.

## Notes

- In AppShell give the nav item `mega: { columns, seeAll }`: on phones the drawer shows the same links as a drill-down level.
- Column titles are written in sentence case: text-overline renders them uppercase (C-032, the only place besides sidebar and palette group labels).
- Give every link an icon, or none; at most one New badge per column.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/mega-menu/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/menubar.md -->

# Menubar

The menu bar of a desktop-style tool (Tệp · Sửa · Xem): menus that open from a bar and behave like Menu.

## When to use

- Editors and tool apps with many commands (3D, slicer, image tools), next to an AppHeader.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Page navigation | NavigationMenu or AppShell |
| A few actions | Buttons or one Menu |

## Import

```tsx
import { Menubar, type MenubarMenu } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Editor menus

```tsx
import { Menubar, toast } from "@semi/ui";

const run = (title: string) => () => toast({ title });

export default function MenubarEditor() {
  return (
    <Menubar
      label="Lệnh của trình chỉnh sửa"
      menus={[
        {
          label: "Tệp",
          items: [
            { label: "Mở…", icon: "folderOpen", shortcut: "⌘O", onSelect: run("Mở tệp") },
            { label: "Lưu", icon: "check", shortcut: "⌘S", onSelect: run("Đã lưu") },
            { label: "Xuất G-code", icon: "download", separator: true, onSelect: run("Xuất G-code") },
          ],
        },
        {
          label: "Sửa",
          items: [
            { label: "Hoàn tác", shortcut: "⌘Z", onSelect: run("Hoàn tác") },
            { label: "Làm lại", shortcut: "⇧⌘Z", onSelect: run("Làm lại"), disabled: true },
          ],
        },
        {
          label: "Xem",
          items: [
            { label: "Vừa khung hình", icon: "focus", onSelect: run("Vừa khung hình") },
            { label: "Hiện lưới", icon: "grid", onSelect: run("Hiện lưới") },
          ],
        },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

## API

### Menubar

The menu bar of a desktop-style tool (Tệp · Sửa · Xem): ←/→ move between menus (and switch the open one), ↓ / Enter
open, the menus behave like Menu. For page navigation use NavigationMenu or AppShell instead.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `menus` * | `MenubarMenu[]` |  |  |
| `label` * | `string` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- role="menubar": ←/→ move between menus (and switch the open one), ↓ / Enter open, Escape closes and returns focus; one tab stop for the bar.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/menubar/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/minimal-header.md -->

# Minimal header

The top row of a detail or settings page inside AppShell: where the page sits on the left (a Breadcrumb), one text link and one primary action on the right. The page's own heading follows it.

## When to use

- A detail page (one order, one customer) or a settings page reached from a list.
- A page with one main action and at most one secondary link.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A list page: its title, create action and refresh | PageTitle actions (then StickyContextBar or SubpageToolbar) |
| A stand-alone tool app (no sidebar) | AppHeader |
| Several actions of a record | MinimalHeader primary + Menu in the page |

## Import

```tsx
import { MinimalHeader } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Detail page

```tsx
"use client";

import { Breadcrumb, Button, MinimalHeader } from "@semi/ui";

export default function MinimalHeaderDetail() {
  return (
    <MinimalHeader
      left={<Breadcrumb items={[{ label: "Đơn hàng", href: "#" }, { label: "DH-1042" }]} />}
      link={<a href="#" className="text-strong hover:underline">Xem lịch sử</a>}
      primary={
        <Button variant="primary" icon="check">
          Xác nhận đơn
        </Button>
      }
    />
  );
}
```

## API

### MinimalHeader

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `left` * | `React.ReactNode` |  | Left side: a `Breadcrumb` (usual) or a short title. Truncates, never wraps the row. |
| `link` | `React.ReactNode` |  | One text link (a `Link` / `ExternalLink`: "Hướng dẫn", "Xem lịch sử"). Hidden below `sm`, so do not put the only way to something here. |
| `primary` | `React.ReactNode` |  | One primary action (`<Button variant="primary">`); a second action belongs in the page or a `Menu`. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- A header element; the Breadcrumb is its own nav landmark.
- The link is hidden below sm: never make it the only way to reach something.

## Notes

- One primary (Button variant="primary") at most: a second filled button on the screen breaks the one-primary rule (§4b, §4c).
- It sits above the page heading (PageTitle or TextTabs), inside AppShell's content container.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/minimal-header/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/navigation-menu.md -->

# Navigation menu

Top navigation of a website or landing page: links, and items that open a panel of links with descriptions. Below md it becomes one menu button with a sheet.

## When to use

- Marketing sites, storefronts, docs headers.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Navigation of an app with many pages | AppShell |
| Commands of a tool (Tệp, Sửa) | Menubar |

## Import

```tsx
import { NavigationMenu, type NavigationItem } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Site header

```tsx
import { NavigationMenu } from "@semi/ui";

export default function NavigationMenuSite() {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-card border border-line bg-panel px-3 py-2">
      <span className="text-ui font-medium text-strong">3D Noobs</span>
      <NavigationMenu
        label="Điều hướng chính"
        current="/pricing"
        items={[
          {
            label: "Sản phẩm",
            links: [
              { label: "In theo yêu cầu", href: "/print", description: "Gửi file, nhận bản in trong 48 giờ", icon: "printer" },
              { label: "Vật liệu", href: "/materials", description: "PLA, PETG, TPU và nhựa kỹ thuật", icon: "box" },
              { label: "Studio", href: "/studio", description: "Thiết kế và lát cắt ngay trên web", icon: "sparkles" },
            ],
          },
          { label: "Bảng giá", href: "/pricing" },
          { label: "Liên hệ", href: "/contact" },
        ]}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### NavigationMenu

Disclosure navigation (buttons with aria-expanded, not an ARIA menu): Enter / Space / ↓ open a panel, Escape closes
it and returns focus, a click outside closes it; the current page link gets aria-current.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` * | `NavigationItem[]` |  |  |
| `label` * | `string` |  | Accessible name of the nav ("Điều hướng chính"). |
| `current` | `string` |  | href of the current page (marked with aria-current="page"). |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- A nav landmark with disclosure buttons (aria-expanded), not an ARIA menu: Tab moves through links, Escape closes a panel and returns focus; the current page link has aria-current.
