<!-- docs/components/page-actions.md -->

# Page actions

Lets a page put its actions into a slot of the shared header: PageActionsProvider wraps the layout, PageActionsSlot marks where they render, PageActions sends them from the page.

## When to use

- A layout owns the header row but the page decides the actions (TextTabs + “+”).

## Import

```tsx
import { PageActions, PageActionsProvider, PageActionsSlot } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Actions in the header slot

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, PageActions, PageActionsProvider, PageActionsSlot, TextTabs } from "@semi/ui";

export default function PageActionsSlotExample() {
  const [view, setView] = useState<"printers" | "jobs">("printers");
  return (
    <PageActionsProvider>
      <div className="flex items-end gap-3">
        <TextTabs
          label="Chế độ xem"
          value={view}
          onChange={setView}
          items={[
            { key: "printers", label: "Máy in" },
            { key: "jobs", label: "Job in" },
          ]}
        />
        <PageActionsSlot className="ml-auto" />
      </div>
      {/* Declared by the page content, shown in the slot above */}
      <PageActions>
        <Button variant="inverse" iconOnly icon="plus" aria-label={view === "printers" ? "Thêm máy in" : "Tạo job"} />
      </PageActions>
    </PageActionsProvider>
  );
}
```

## API

### PageActions

Renders its children in the page header slot (inline when the page has no slot).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |

### PageActionsProvider

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |

### PageActionsSlot

Where the actions appear: the right end of the page header row.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `className` | `string` | `""` |  |

## Accessibility

- Rendered through a portal into the slot, so tab order follows the header.

<!-- docs/components/page.md -->

# Page layouts

Shared 1.0 page anatomy and three layouts inside AppShell's content card: work (flush, padding 16 / 24), reading (centred max 1536px inside 16px card padding, 64px bottom), and two-column (240px sub-nav card + 4px gap + main card, stacking below md). Owns vertical rhythm (32 / 28 / 32 / 16 / 8).

## When to use

- Every page inside AppShell: lists and workspaces (work), settings / explore / articles (reading), areas with sub-pages or mailbox folders (two-column).
- Shared page slots (title, actions, tabs, intro, toolbar, content, footer) so pages set no margins between blocks.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A tool with a 380px control panel and live result | WorkspaceLayout inside Page layout="work" |
| A list and open record side by side | ListReaderLayout inside Page fixed |

## Import

```tsx
import { Page, PageEnter, SubNav, PageSection, PageGrid } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Work layout (flush)

```tsx
"use client";

import { Button, Card, KpiCard, Page, PageGrid, PageSection, toast } from "@semi/ui";

export default function PageWorkExample() {
  return (
    <Page
      layout="work"
      title="Tổng quan xưởng in"
      actions={
        <Button variant="inverse" icon="plus" onClick={() => toast({ title: "Tạo lệnh in" })}>
          Tạo lệnh in
        </Button>
      }
    >
      <PageSection title="Hôm nay">
        <PageGrid columns={3}>
          <KpiCard label="Đang in" value="8 máy" sub="2 máy sắp xong" featured />
          <KpiCard label="Hoàn thành" value="24 đơn" sub="+4 so với hôm qua" />
          <KpiCard label="Chờ duyệt" value="3 đơn" sub="Cần kiểm tra file" />
        </PageGrid>
      </PageSection>
      <PageSection title="Ghi chú vận hành">
        <Card>
          <p className="text-ui text-body">Ca chiều ưu tiên các đơn giao trong ngày trước 17:00.</p>
        </Card>
      </PageSection>
    </Page>
  );
}
```

### Reading layout (centred 1536px + 44px title)

```tsx
"use client";

import { Card, Page, PageGrid, PageSection } from "@semi/ui";

const ITEMS = [
  { title: "Nhựa PLA+", detail: "Dễ in, ít cong vênh cho mô hình trưng bày." },
  { title: "Nhựa PETG", detail: "Chịu nhiệt tốt hơn, phù hợp vỏ thiết bị." },
  { title: "Nhựa ABS", detail: "Bền cơ học cao, cần buồng in kín." },
];

export default function PageReadingExample() {
  return (
    <Page
      layout="reading"
      title="Thư viện vật liệu"
      titleVariant="reading"
      intro="Chọn đúng vật liệu giúp bản in bền và ổn định kích thước ngay từ lần đầu."
    >
      <PageSection title="Vật liệu phổ biến" editorial>
        <PageGrid columns={3}>
          {ITEMS.map((item) => (
            <Card key={item.title} className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <h3 className="text-lead font-medium text-strong">{item.title}</h3>
              <p className="text-ui text-muted">{item.detail}</p>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </PageGrid>
      </PageSection>
    </Page>
  );
}
```

### Two-column layout (SubNav + main card)

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, Card, Page, PageSection, SubNav, toast, type SubNavSection } from "@semi/ui";

export default function PageTwoColumnExample() {
  const [active, setActive] = useState("inbox");
  const sections: SubNavSection[] = [
    {
      label: "Thư mục",
      items: [
        { id: "inbox", label: "Hộp thư đến", icon: "inbox", meta: 12 },
        { id: "sent", label: "Đã gửi", icon: "send" },
        { id: "archive", label: "Lưu trữ", icon: "folder" },
      ],
    },
    {
      label: "Nhóm thư",
      actions: [{ label: "Tạo nhóm thư", icon: "plus", onClick: () => toast({ title: "Tạo nhóm thư mới" }) }],
      items: [
        { id: "suppliers", label: "Nhà cung cấp", icon: "tag", meta: 4 },
        { id: "quotes", label: "Báo giá", icon: "fileText", meta: 7 },
      ],
    },
  ];
  const current = sections.flatMap((s) => s.items).find((i) => i.id === active);
  return (
    <Page
      layout="two-column"
      subNav={<SubNav sections={sections} activeId={active} onSelect={setActive} label="Thư mục hộp thư" />}
      title={current?.label ?? "Hộp thư"}
      actions={
        <Button variant="inverse" icon="plus" onClick={() => toast({ title: "Soạn thư mới" })}>
          Soạn thư
        </Button>
      }
    >
      <PageSection title="Danh sách gần đây">
        <Card>
          <p className="text-ui text-body">Đang xem mục: {current?.label}.</p>
        </Card>
      </PageSection>
    </Page>
  );
}
```

## API

### Page

Shared 1.0 page anatomy and layout inside `AppShell`'s content card (#149, #71):
- `layout="work"` (default): flush, no centred max-width, card padding 16 / 24 (`px-4 sm:px-6`).
- `layout="reading"`: centred at max 1536px (`max-w-screen-2xl`) inside 16px card padding, 64px bottom padding.
- `layout="two-column"`: 240px (`md:w-60`) sub-nav card + 4px gap + main card (padding 24); stacks below `md`.

Owns the vertical rhythm from the card top (32px to the header block, 28px from title or tabs to intro / toolbar,
16px from filter toolbar to list, 32px between content blocks), so pages set no margins on those joins.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `layout` | `'work' \| 'reading' \| 'two-column'` | `"work"` | Page layout inside the content card: `"work"` (flush, 16 / 24), `"reading"` (centred max 1536px inside 16px card padding, 64px bottom), or `"two-column"` (240px sub-nav card + 4px gap + main card). |
| `fixed` | `boolean` | `false` | Fixed-height page: fills the content column without scrolling the card so inner panels (`ListReaderLayout`, a pinned list) scroll independently. Works inside `<AppShell page="fixed">` or a shared `<AppShell>`. |
| `enter` | `string \| boolean` | `false` | Run `motion-enter` + `motion-stagger` on the page's top blocks and first ~10 rows / cards once per route (`PageEnter`). Pass `true` to key by pathname, or a string for a custom route key. Adds no layout box. |
| `subNav` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Sub-navigation card for `layout="two-column"` (`<SubNav sections={…} activeId={…} />`). |
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Page heading: a string / node rendered via `PageTitle` (18/400 UI sans by default), or leave out when `tabs` is big `TextTabs`. |
| `titleVariant` | `'work' \| 'reading'` | `"work"` | On a `"reading"` page, `"reading"` opts into the 44 / 500 display title (`text-title-xl`). Ignored on other layouts. |
| `actions` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Actions at the right end of the title row (one `inverse` or `primary` action, optional `•••` `Menu` / `RefreshButton`). |
| `tabs` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Optional tab bar (`PillTabs`, `Tabs`, `SegmentedControl`, `TextTabs`). |
| `intro` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Optional lead intro under the title or tabs (28px below). |
| `toolbar` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Optional sticky toolbar / filter row (`StickyContextBar`, `SubpageToolbar`); content sits 16px below it. |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  | Page blocks (spaced 32px apart; in `fixed` mode, fills the remaining height). |
| `footer` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Optional page footer (`Pagination`, `FormActions`). |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

### PageEnter

Runs `motion-enter` + `motion-stagger` (first ~10 rows / cards) once per route without adding a layout box
(`display: contents`). Wrap `{children}` inside `AppShell` (or pass `enter` on `<Page>`) so the shell stays still
and only page content rises in on route changes. Filter, search, sort and `?tab=` changes never replay it, and rows
arriving after `windowMs` do not animate. Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, entrance is opacity only.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `routeKey` | `string` |  | Key that triggers a new entrance when it changes. Defaults to `usePathname()` (ignores query string changes). |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable the enter animation completely. |
| `windowMs` | `number` | `DEFAULT_ENTER_WINDOW_MS` | Milliseconds after route mount before the enter window closes so late-arriving rows do not animate. |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |

### SubNav

The 240px sub-navigation card of a `two-column` page (`Page layout="two-column" subNav={<SubNav … />}`):
padding 20 / 10, sections separated by a 1px `bg-raised` line, group labels in `text-nav-label` (10 / 500 uppercase
faint, row h32, optional 16px icon actions on the right), and items (h32, `rounded-control`, padding 4 / 16,
`text-chrome` 12 / 500, 16px icon, 2px apart; inactive `text-muted`, hover `bg-item-hover`, active
`bg-item-selected text-strong`).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sections` * | `SubNavSection[]` |  |  |
| `activeId` * | `string` |  |  |
| `onSelect` | `(id: string) => void` |  |  |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the sub-nav landmark (default locale `subNav`). |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

### PageSection

One content section inside `<Page>`: a 20 / 500 heading (`text-section`) spaced 16px (`gap-4`) above its content,
with optional actions on the heading row. Multiple `PageSection`s inside `<Page>` sit 32px apart automatically.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `editorial` | `boolean` | `false` | Use `font-display` on the 20px section heading (discovery / editorial reading pages only). |
| `actions` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Optional quiet control or link on the right of the heading row. |
| `description` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Optional short muted line under the heading. |
| `headingLevel` | `2 \| 3` | `2` |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

### PageGrid

Compact 8px (`gap-2`) grid inside a `<PageSection>` or `<Card>`, sized by `@container` width (§4a rhythm).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `columns` | `2 \| 3 \| 4` | `3` |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- Page renders one h1 via PageTitle, groups its header in <header>, and SubNav is an <aside> landmark with <nav> lists and aria-current on the active item.
- SubNav icon actions carry aria-label, Tooltip, HIT_AREA and FOCUS_RING.

## Notes

- Inside AppShell, a direct-child Page automatically overrides the default 1440px container and switches two-column / fixed modes in CSS without remounting AppShell (also works when wrapped in PageEnter).
- Wrap AppShell children in PageEnter (or pass enter on Page) to run motion-enter + motion-stagger on top blocks and the first ~10 rows / cards once per route. PageEnter renders display: contents so fixed-height chains and inner scrollers keep working; filter, search, sort and ?tab= changes never replay it.
- Vertical rhythm from the card top: 32px to the header block, 28px title/tabs to intro or toolbar, 16px toolbar to list, 32px between blocks, 16px heading to content (PageSection), 8px inside grids (PageGrid).

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/page/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/page-title.md -->

# Page title

PageTitle is the 18 / 400 UI sans heading of a work page on the same row as the page's main action (`actions`), with `variant="reading"` (44 / 500 display face, text-title-xl) for one-column reading pages only.

## When to use

- The first line of every page (PageTitle).
- A list page's title row: the title and the page's action (one `inverse` or `primary` button, plus RefreshButton or ⋯ Menu) above a StickyContextBar (PageTitle actions).

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| 2–4 top-level views as the page heading | TextTabs |
| 5+ sections of a page, or sections with icons | PillTabs |
| 2–5 filter values shown in full, with counts | SegmentedControl |
| Tabs inside a card or panel | Tabs |
| The top row of a detail or settings page (a Breadcrumb and one action) | MinimalHeader |

## Import

```tsx
import { PageTitle } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### PageTitle

```tsx
import { PageTitle } from "@semi/ui";

export default function PageTitleBasic() {
  return <PageTitle title="Máy in" />;
}
```

### With the page's action

```tsx
"use client";

import { Button, PageTitle, RefreshButton, toast } from "@semi/ui";

export default function PageTitleActions() {
  // 1.0 work-page title row: 18/400 UI sans title on the same row as the page's inverse main action
  return (
    <PageTitle
      title="Yêu cầu mua"
      actions={
        <>
          <RefreshButton onRefresh={() => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 600))} />
          <Button variant="inverse" icon="plus" onClick={() => toast({ title: "Tạo yêu cầu" })}>
            Tạo yêu cầu
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    />
  );
}
```

### Reading page (44 / 500 display)

```tsx
"use client";

import { PageTitle } from "@semi/ui";

export default function PageTitleReading() {
  return <PageTitle title="Khám phá mẫu in" variant="reading" />;
}
```

## API

### PageTitle

The page's heading (`h1`). By default (`variant="work"`) it is 18 / 400 in the UI sans on the same row as `actions`
(wrapping only when the row runs out of room). Pass `variant="reading"` on a one-column reading page for the 44 / 500
display title (`text-title-xl`). Inside `<Page title={…}>`, `<Page>` owns the spacing below this row.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `actions` | `React.ReactNode` |  | The page's own action at the right end of the title row: one `<Button variant="inverse">` (or `primary` when it is the page's one commit action) with an icon and text, optionally a `RefreshButton` or `•••` `Menu` before it. Leave it out on a page whose `SubpageToolbar` carries the actions. |
| `variant` | `'work' \| 'reading'` | `"work"` | `"work"` (default): 18 / 400 UI sans (`text-figure`), for lists, workspaces and two-column pages. `"reading"`: 44 / 500 display face (`text-title-xl`, lh 1.2, −0.01em), for one-column reading pages only. |
| `className` | `string` | `""` |  |

## Accessibility

- PageTitle is the page h1; its actions follow it in the reading and tab order.

## Notes

- No subtitle under the title. Title-row actions are one `inverse` button (or `primary` when it is the page's commit action) with icon and text, optionally a RefreshButton before it; more actions go in a ⋯ Menu. Filters never go on the title row: they belong in the StickyContextBar or SubpageToolbar under it.
- Actions stay on the same row as the title and wrap only when out of width.
- A page whose SubpageToolbar carries the actions leaves `actions` out.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/page-title/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/pagination.md -->

# Pagination

Page numbers with previous / next for long tables. For card lists prefer auto-loading with “Xem thêm”.

## When to use

- Server-paged tables and reports.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A feed or card grid | auto-load near the end + a “Xem thêm” Button |

## Import

```tsx
import { Pagination, pageWindow } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Basic

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Pagination } from "@semi/ui";

export default function PaginationBasic() {
  const [page, setPage] = useState(3);
  return <Pagination page={page} pages={12} onChange={setPage} />;
}
```

## API

### Pagination

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `page` * | `number` |  | Current page, 1-based. |
| `pages` * | `number` |  |  |
| `onChange` * | `(page: number) => void` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` | `""` |  |

## Accessibility

- A nav landmark; the current page has aria-current="page"; arrows are labelled.

<!-- docs/components/pill-tabs.md -->

# Pill tabs

Default section tabs for pages with 5+ sections or sections with icons (settings-like pages): no track, h30 round pills with 16px icons and 12px/600 labels, and one item-hover pill that slides to the active tab in 300ms ease-out.

## When to use

- 5+ sections of one page, or sections with icons (Cấu hình: Hộp thư, Nhóm thư, Nguồn khách, Mặt hàng, Mẫu thư, Data Hub, Doanh nghiệp, Người dùng).
- Section switching that needs URL state (?tab=) or an unsaved-changes guard (onBeforeChange).

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| 2–5 filter values shown in full, often with counts | SegmentedControl |
| 2–4 top-level views of a discovery or reading page | TextTabs |
| Filters of a list (status, owner, date) | FilterChipRow |
| Sections of one record inside a card or dialog | Tabs |

## Import

```tsx
import { PillTabs, useTabParam } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Settings sections with icons

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Card, PillTabs, type PillTabItem } from "@semi/ui";

const SECTIONS = [
  { key: "mail", label: "Hộp thư", icon: "mail", summary: "Kết nối IMAP / SMTP và chu kỳ đồng bộ thư đến." },
  { key: "groups", label: "Nhóm thư", icon: "layers", summary: "Quy tắc tự động gán thư theo nhà cung cấp và từ khoá." },
  { key: "sources", label: "Nguồn khách", icon: "filter", summary: "Kênh tiếp nhận yêu cầu báo giá từ hội chợ, web và đại lý." },
  { key: "items", label: "Mặt hàng", icon: "tag", summary: "Danh mục nguyên liệu, quy cách đóng gói và đơn vị tính." },
  { key: "templates", label: "Mẫu thư", icon: "fileText", summary: "Mẫu hỏi giá và phản hồi nhanh có biến trộn." },
  { key: "datahub", label: "Data Hub", icon: "database", summary: "Khoá kết nối đồng bộ danh mục với hệ thống trung tâm." },
  { key: "company", label: "Doanh nghiệp", icon: "settings", summary: "Tên pháp nhân, mã số thuế và chữ ký mặc định." },
  { key: "users", label: "Người dùng", icon: "user", summary: "Thành viên phòng mua hàng và quyền phê duyệt." },
] as const satisfies readonly (PillTabItem & { summary: string })[];

export default function PillTabsSections() {
  const [section, setSection] = useState<(typeof SECTIONS)[number]["key"]>("mail");
  const current = SECTIONS.find((s) => s.key === section) ?? SECTIONS[0];

  return (
    <PillTabs
      label="Cấu hình"
      value={section}
      onChange={(next) => setSection(next)}
      items={[...SECTIONS]}
    >
      <Card className="flex flex-col gap-stack">
        <h2 className="text-section text-strong">{current.label}</h2>
        <p className="text-ui text-muted">{current.summary}</p>
      </Card>
    </PillTabs>
  );
}
```

### URL ?tab=, manual activation and guard

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Card, PillTabs, Switch, useTabParam } from "@semi/ui";

const TABS = [
  { key: "general", label: "Chung", icon: "settings" },
  { key: "notifications", label: "Thông báo", icon: "bell" },
  { key: "members", label: "Thành viên", icon: "users" },
  { key: "audit", label: "Nhật ký", icon: "clock" },
] as const;

const KEYS = TABS.map((t) => t.key);

export default function PillTabsGuarded() {
  const [tab, setTab] = useTabParam<(typeof TABS)[number]["key"]>("general", { param: "section", values: KEYS });
  const [dirty, setDirty] = useState(false);
  const [manual, setManual] = useState(false);
  const [blocked, setBlocked] = useState<string | null>(null);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-group">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-group">
        <Switch checked={dirty} onChange={(v) => (setDirty(v), setBlocked(null))} label="Có thay đổi chưa lưu" />
        <Switch checked={manual} onChange={setManual} label="Chuyển bằng Enter / Space (manual)" />
      </div>
      <PillTabs
        label="Cấu hình khu vực"
        value={tab}
        onChange={(next, meta) => {
          setBlocked(null);
          setTab(next, meta);
        }}
        onBeforeChange={(next) => {
          if (dirty) {
            setBlocked(TABS.find((t) => t.key === next)?.label ?? next);
            return false;
          }
          return true;
        }}
        activation={manual ? "manual" : "automatic"}
        items={[...TABS]}
      >
        <Card className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          <p className="text-ui text-strong">Mục đang mở: {TABS.find((t) => t.key === tab)?.label}</p>
          <p className="text-ui text-muted">
            {blocked
              ? `Đã chặn chuyển sang "${blocked}" vì còn thay đổi chưa lưu.`
              : "Phím mũi tên cập nhật ?section= bằng replaceState nên không sinh thêm lịch sử mỗi lần bấm."}
          </p>
        </Card>
      </PillTabs>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### When to use which: all three side by side

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { PillTabs, SegmentedControl, Separator, TextTabs } from "@semi/ui";

export default function TabsWhenToUseWhich() {
  const [section, setSection] = useState<"mail" | "groups" | "sources" | "items" | "templates" | "users">("mail");
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<"all" | "open" | "quoting" | "done">("open");
  const [view, setView] = useState<"discover" | "templates" | "collections">("discover");

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-section">
      <div data-density-view="" className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <div className="text-overline text-muted">PillTabs · 5+ mục hoặc có biểu tượng</div>
        <PillTabs
          label="Cấu hình hệ thống"
          value={section}
          onChange={(v) => setSection(v)}
          panelClassName="pt-3"
          items={[
            { key: "mail", label: "Hộp thư", icon: "mail" },
            { key: "groups", label: "Nhóm thư", icon: "layers" },
            { key: "sources", label: "Nguồn khách", icon: "filter" },
            { key: "items", label: "Mặt hàng", icon: "tag" },
            { key: "templates", label: "Mẫu thư", icon: "fileText" },
            { key: "users", label: "Người dùng", icon: "user" },
          ]}
        >
          <p className="text-ui text-muted">Cấu hình máy chủ thư và chu kỳ đồng bộ tự động mỗi 5 phút.</p>
        </PillTabs>
      </div>

      <Separator />

      <div data-density-view="" className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <div className="text-overline text-muted">SegmentedControl · 2–5 giá trị lọc</div>
        <div>
          <SegmentedControl
            label="Trạng thái yêu cầu"
            value={status}
            onChange={(v) => setStatus(v)}
            options={[
              { key: "all", label: "Tất cả", count: 128 },
              { key: "open", label: "Đang mở", count: 24 },
              { key: "quoting", label: "Đang báo giá", count: 9 },
              { key: "done", label: "Đã chốt", count: 95 },
            ]}
          />
        </div>
        <p className="text-ui text-muted">Hiển thị các yêu cầu ở trạng thái đã chọn ngay trong danh sách hiện tại.</p>
      </div>

      <Separator />

      <div data-density-view="" className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <div className="text-overline text-muted">TextTabs · 2–4 góc nhìn lớn</div>
        <TextTabs
          label="Thư viện mẫu"
          heading={false}
          className="mb-0"
          value={view}
          onChange={(v) => setView(v)}
          items={[
            { key: "discover", label: "Khám phá" },
            { key: "templates", label: "Mẫu sẵn" },
            { key: "collections", label: "Bộ sưu tập" },
          ]}
        >
          <p className="text-lead text-muted">Tổng hợp các mẫu thiết kế được cộng đồng in nhiều nhất tuần này.</p>
        </TextTabs>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### PillTabs

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` * | `PillTabItem<T>[]` |  |  |
| `value` * | `T` |  |  |
| `onChange` | `(key: T, meta: TabChangeMeta) => void` |  | Called when the active tab changes; receives `{ via }` so URL state hooks can replace on arrow keys. |
| `onBeforeChange` | `TabBeforeChange<T>` |  | Guard run before switching (button AND href tabs); return or resolve `false` to stay on the current tab. |
| `activation` | `'automatic' \| 'manual'` | `"automatic"` | `"automatic"` (default) switches as arrows move; `"manual"` moves focus with arrows and commits on Enter / Space. |
| `label` * | `string` |  | Accessible name of the tab list ("Cấu hình"). |
| `idPrefix` | `string` |  | Optional id prefix when the page renders its own `role="tabpanel"` below: tab `${idPrefix}-tab-${key}` controls panel `${idPrefix}-panel`. Omit when passing `children` or item `content` (ids are generated automatically). |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Active panel content; omit to use per-item `content` or render the panel yourself. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `panelClassName` | `string` | `"pt-7"` |  |

## Accessibility

- WAI-ARIA tablist / tab / tabpanel with id, aria-controls and aria-labelledby; roving tabindex; ←/→, Home and End.
- activation="manual" moves focus with arrows and switches on Enter or Space; default "automatic" switches button tabs on arrow keys once onBeforeChange approves.
- Overflowing rows scroll sideways with no scrollbar, keep the active tab in view and show a 2px edge cue; sliding and fades turn off under prefers-reduced-motion.

## Notes

- Keep the section in the URL with `const [tab, setTab] = useTabParam("mail", { values })` (or `useFilterParams().setParams({ tab }, "replace")`): arrow keys replace the entry so they never stack history entries.
- Pass `idPrefix` when the page renders its own `role="tabpanel"` below (`${idPrefix}-panel` labelled by `${idPrefix}-tab-${key}`).
- When to use which: PillTabs for 5+ sections or sections with icons · SegmentedControl for 2–5 filter values shown in full with counts · TextTabs for 2–4 top-level views of a discovery or reading page · FilterChipRow for filters.

# Resizable panels

Panels side by side or stacked with handles to resize them (an editor beside a preview, a list beside details). Sizes are percentages and can be remembered.

## When to use

- Tools where people tune the space between two or three areas.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A collapsible tool panel beside a canvas | SidePanel |
| A temporary detail view | Drawer |

## Import

```tsx
import { ResizablePanels } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### List and details

```tsx
import { ResizablePanels } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ResizableEditor() {
  return (
    <ResizablePanels defaultSizes={[35, 65]} className="h-64">
      <div className="p-4 text-ui text-muted">Danh sách đơn</div>
      <div className="p-4 text-ui text-muted">Chi tiết đơn đang chọn</div>
    </ResizablePanels>
  );
}
```

### Stacked, three panels

```tsx
import { ResizablePanels } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ResizableVertical() {
  return (
    <ResizablePanels direction="vertical" defaultSizes={[50, 30, 20]} className="h-80">
      <div className="p-4 text-ui text-muted">Khung xem 3D</div>
      <div className="p-4 text-ui text-muted">Lớp</div>
      <div className="p-4 text-ui text-muted">Nhật ký</div>
    </ResizablePanels>
  );
}
```

## API

### ResizablePanels

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `direction` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `"horizontal"` |  |
| `defaultSizes` | `number[]` |  | Starting sizes in %, one per panel (default: equal). |
| `minSize` | `number` | `15` | Smallest size of a panel in %. |
| `storageKey` | `string` |  | Remember the sizes in localStorage under this key. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Height for direction="vertical" (e.g. "h-96"). |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  | One child per panel (2 or more). |

## Accessibility

- Each handle is a focusable separator with aria-valuenow; ←/→ (↑/↓ when stacked) resize, Shift for bigger steps.

<!-- docs/components/scroll-area.md -->

# Scroll area

A fixed-size scrolling region (a long list in a card, a log). Semi hides scrollbars, so it marks the edges that have more content, can show a thin scrollbar, and is reachable by keyboard.

## When to use

- A list or log inside a card that must keep its height.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A wide table | Table (scrolls sideways by itself) |

## Import

```tsx
import { ScrollArea } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Log in a card

```tsx
import { Card, ScrollArea } from "@semi/ui";

const LINES = Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, i) => `12:${String(i).padStart(2, "0")}  Lớp ${i + 120}/310 · đầu phun 220°C`);

export default function ScrollAreaLog() {
  return (
    <Card padding="none" className="max-w-md">
      <ScrollArea label="Nhật ký in" className="h-48">
        <ul className="p-3 space-y-1 text-ui text-body tabular-nums">
          {LINES.map((l) => (
            <li key={l}>{l}</li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </ScrollArea>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

## API

### ScrollArea

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` * | `string` |  | Accessible name of the region (it is focusable when it scrolls, so keyboard users can scroll it). |
| `orientation` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical' \| 'both'` | `"vertical"` |  |
| `scrollbar` | `boolean` | `false` | Show a thin scrollbar (hidden everywhere else in Semi). |
| `className` | `string` |  | Give it a size here: "h-64", "max-h-80", "w-full". |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- A labelled region that becomes focusable when it scrolls, so arrow keys scroll it.

<!-- docs/components/segmented-control.md -->

# Segmented control

Small single-choice filter sets shown in full (2–5 values, often with tabular-nums counts): a `raised` track (h32, radius 8, padding 4, gap 4) with h24 items (12px/600) and one solid `raised-2` pill (white in light theme) sliding in 300ms ease-out.

## When to use

- 2–5 filter values shown in full, often with counts (Tất cả · Đang mở · Đang báo giá · Đã chốt).
- Leading view switch of a FilterChipRow (`leading`) when a list splits into a few status slices.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| 5+ sections of a page, or sections with icons (settings-like pages) | PillTabs |
| 2–4 top-level views of a discovery or reading page | TextTabs |
| Facet filters (supplier, owner, date, multiple active at once) | FilterChipRow |
| List ↔ grid and density icon toggles | ViewSwitch |

## Import

```tsx
import { SegmentedControl } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Status filter with counts

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Badge, Item, ItemGroup, SegmentedControl } from "@semi/ui";

const REQUESTS = [
  { id: "YC-204", title: "Hạt nhựa PLA Basic trắng 1kg × 40", status: "open" as const, statusLabel: "Đang mở", tone: "sky" as const },
  { id: "YC-203", title: "Đầu phun thép tôi 0.4mm × 12", status: "quoting" as const, statusLabel: "Đang báo giá", tone: "amber" as const },
  { id: "YC-201", title: "Bàn nhiệt PEI nhám 256×256 × 8", status: "done" as const, statusLabel: "Đã chốt", tone: "emerald" as const },
  { id: "YC-199", title: "Cuộn PETG HF xám 1kg × 24", status: "open" as const, statusLabel: "Đang mở", tone: "sky" as const },
];

export default function SegmentedControlCounts() {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<"all" | "open" | "quoting" | "done">("all");
  const visible = status === "all" ? REQUESTS : REQUESTS.filter((r) => r.status === status);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-group">
      <div>
        <SegmentedControl
          label="Trạng thái mua hàng"
          value={status}
          onChange={(v) => setStatus(v)}
          options={[
            { key: "all", label: "Tất cả", count: REQUESTS.length },
            { key: "open", label: "Đang mở", count: REQUESTS.filter((r) => r.status === "open").length },
            { key: "quoting", label: "Đang báo giá", count: REQUESTS.filter((r) => r.status === "quoting").length },
            { key: "done", label: "Đã chốt", count: REQUESTS.filter((r) => r.status === "done").length },
          ]}
        />
      </div>
      <ItemGroup label="Danh sách yêu cầu">
        {visible.map((r) => (
          <Item key={r.id} title={r.title} description={r.id} meta={<Badge tone={r.tone}>{r.statusLabel}</Badge>} />
        ))}
      </ItemGroup>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Manual activation, guard and narrow scroll

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { SegmentedControl, Switch } from "@semi/ui";

const OPTIONS = [
  { key: "all", label: "Tất cả kho", count: 312 },
  { key: "hcm", label: "TP. Hồ Chí Minh", count: 148 },
  { key: "bd", label: "Bình Dương", count: 86 },
  { key: "dn", label: "Đà Nẵng", count: 34 },
  { key: "hn", label: "Hà Nội", count: 44 },
] as const;

export default function SegmentedControlOverflow() {
  const [warehouse, setWarehouse] = useState<(typeof OPTIONS)[number]["key"]>("all");
  const [manual, setManual] = useState(false);
  const [locked, setLocked] = useState(false);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-group">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-group">
        <Switch checked={manual} onChange={setManual} label="Chuyển bằng Enter / Space (manual)" />
        <Switch checked={locked} onChange={setLocked} label="Khoá bộ lọc đang chọn" />
      </div>
      <div>
        <SegmentedControl
          label="Kho hàng"
          value={warehouse}
          onChange={(v) => setWarehouse(v)}
          onBeforeChange={() => !locked}
          activation={manual ? "manual" : "automatic"}
          options={[...OPTIONS]}
        />
      </div>
      <p className="text-ui text-muted">
        Đang xem: {OPTIONS.find((o) => o.key === warehouse)?.label}
        {locked ? " · Đang khoá chuyển đổi." : "."}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### SegmentedControl

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `options` * | `SegmentOption<T>[]` |  |  |
| `value` * | `T` |  |  |
| `onChange` * | `(value: T, meta: TabChangeMeta) => void` |  | Called when the chosen option changes; receives `{ via }` so URL state hooks can replace on arrow keys. |
| `onBeforeChange` | `TabBeforeChange<T>` |  | Guard run before switching; return or resolve `false` to keep the current option. |
| `activation` | `'automatic' \| 'manual'` | `"automatic"` | `"automatic"` (default) switches as arrows move; `"manual"` moves focus with arrows and commits on Enter / Space. |
| `label` * | `string` |  | Accessible name of the radio group ("Trạng thái"). |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- WAI-ARIA radiogroup / radio with aria-checked and roving tabindex; ←/→, ↑/↓, Home and End.
- activation="manual" moves focus with arrows and selects on Enter or Space; onBeforeChange can refuse a switch.
- Scrolls sideways on phones with a 2px edge cue and keeps the active segment in view; sliding and fades turn off under prefers-reduced-motion.

## Notes

- Replaces the removed 0.x `Pills` component in 1.0.
- When to use which: PillTabs for 5+ sections or sections with icons · SegmentedControl for 2–5 filter values shown in full with counts · TextTabs for 2–4 top-level views of a discovery or reading page · FilterChipRow for filters.

<!-- docs/components/side-panel.md -->

# Side panel

A 320px tool panel beside a canvas that collapses to a 48px rail; SidePanelToggle is its collapse button.

## When to use

- Settings or layers beside a 3D view, map or editor.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Temporary filters or details | Drawer |

## Import

```tsx
import { SidePanel, SidePanelToggle } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Beside a canvas

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { SidePanel, SidePanelToggle, Skeleton } from "@semi/ui";

export default function SidePanelCanvas() {
  const [collapsed, setCollapsed] = useState(false);
  return (
    <div className="h-64 flex rounded-card border border-line overflow-hidden bg-canvas">
      <SidePanel collapsed={collapsed} onToggleCollapse={() => setCollapsed((v) => !v)}>
        <div className="p-3 space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-ui font-medium text-muted">Cài đặt lát cắt</span>
            <SidePanelToggle onClick={() => setCollapsed(true)} />
          </div>
          <Skeleton className="h-8" />
          <Skeleton className="h-8" />
        </div>
      </SidePanel>
      <div className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center text-ui text-muted">Canvas / 3D view</div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### SidePanel

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` |  |  |
| `collapsed` * | `boolean` |  |  |
| `onToggleCollapse` * | `() => void` |  |  |
| `width` | `number` | `SIDE_PANEL_WIDTH` |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |

### SidePanelToggle

The collapse toggle placed at the top of the panel content (next to the first label).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `onClick` * | `() => void` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- The toggle is labelled from the locale and keeps focus; the collapsed rail stays reachable.

<!-- docs/components/sticky-context-bar.md -->

# Sticky context bar

The top of a list page that pins on scroll or search focus (250ms ease-out), holds against trackpad momentum and flings, and moves up to 2 page actions into SearchPill via BarActions while pinned. Pins by layout from md+ with independent overscroll-contained list/reader scrollers; keeps native touch scrolling below md.

## When to use

- A list, grid or table page with a search and filters people change while they scroll (customers, suppliers, products).
- In place of a SubpageToolbar when the page needs the wide search and the chip row.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A page with one or two filters and a few actions | SubpageToolbar |
| The page's create action and refresh | PageTitle actions, above this bar |
| Actions of one record | MinimalHeader or PageActions |

## Import

```tsx
import { StickyContextBar, BarActions } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Suppliers list

```tsx
"use client";

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import {
  Button,
  FilterChipRow,
  FilterPanel,
  Item,
  PageTitle,
  PhoneFilterBar,
  SearchPill,
  StickyContextBar,
  ViewSwitch,
  toast,
  type FilterDef,
  type ViewMode,
} from "@semi/ui";

const SUPPLIERS = [
  { name: "Hợp tác xã Tiêu Chư Sê", region: "highlands", item: "pepper", certified: true },
  { name: "Công ty Quế Văn Yên", region: "north", item: "cinnamon", certified: true },
  { name: "Hồi Lạng Sơn Xanh", region: "north", item: "anise", certified: false },
  { name: "Nông trại Tiêu Phú Quốc", region: "south", item: "pepper", certified: false },
  { name: "Gia vị Bình Phước", region: "south", item: "pepper", certified: true },
  { name: "Quế Trà My", region: "central", item: "cinnamon", certified: false },
];
const SPECS: Omit<FilterDef, "selected">[] = [
  { key: "item", label: "Mặt hàng", icon: "box", options: [{ value: "pepper", label: "Tiêu" }, { value: "cinnamon", label: "Quế" }, { value: "anise", label: "Hồi" }] },
  { key: "region", label: "Vùng", icon: "mapPin", options: [{ value: "north", label: "Miền Bắc" }, { value: "central", label: "Miền Trung" }, { value: "highlands", label: "Tây Nguyên" }, { value: "south", label: "Miền Nam" }] },
  { key: "certified", label: "Có chứng nhận", icon: "badgeCheck", kind: "switch" },
];
const SORTS = [
  { value: "name", label: "Tên A–Z" },
  { value: "recent", label: "Mới thêm" },
];

export default function StickyContextBarListPage() {
  const [q, setQ] = useState("");
  const [sel, setSel] = useState<Record<string, string[]>>({});
  const [sort, setSort] = useState("name");
  const [view, setView] = useState<ViewMode>("list");
  const [panel, setPanel] = useState(false);
  const filters: FilterDef[] = SPECS.map((s) => ({ ...s, selected: sel[s.key] ?? [] }));
  const onChange = (key: string, selected: string[]) => setSel({ ...sel, [key]: selected });
  const rows = useMemo(() => {
    const r = SUPPLIERS.filter(
      (s) =>
        s.name.toLocaleLowerCase("vi").includes(q.toLocaleLowerCase("vi")) &&
        (!sel.item?.length || sel.item.includes(s.item)) &&
        (!sel.region?.length || sel.region.includes(s.region)) &&
        (!sel.certified?.length || s.certified),
    );
    return sort === "name" ? [...r].sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name, "vi")) : r;
  }, [q, sel, sort]);
  const sortDef = { value: sort, onChange: setSort, options: SORTS };
  const active = filters.filter((f) => f.selected.length > 0).length;
  return (
    // the scrolling content panel of the page: STICKY_TOOLBAR bleeds into its side padding (px-4 sm:px-6, as AppShell's)
    <div className="w-full min-w-0 h-96 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain rounded-card bg-panel px-4 sm:px-6 pt-2.5 pb-4">
      {/* the title row scrolls away with the page's action; the bar under it stays */}
      <PageTitle
        title="Nhà cung cấp"
        actions={
          <Button variant="inverse" icon="plus" onClick={() => toast({ title: "Thêm nhà cung cấp" })}>
            Thêm nhà cung cấp
          </Button>
        }
      />
      <StickyContextBar label="Tìm và lọc nhà cung cấp">
        <SearchPill value={q} onChange={setQ} label="Tìm nhà cung cấp" placeholder="Tìm tên nhà cung cấp…" focusKey="/" />
        <FilterChipRow
          className="max-md:hidden"
          filters={filters}
          onChange={onChange}
          onClear={() => setSel({})}
          sort={sortDef}
          trailing={<ViewSwitch view={view} onViewChange={setView} />}
        />
        <PhoneFilterBar className="md:hidden" activeCount={active} onOpenFilters={() => setPanel(true)} filtersOpen={panel} sort={sortDef} />
      </StickyContextBar>
      <ul className={view === "grid" ? "grid grid-cols-2 gap-group" : "flex flex-col"}>
        {rows.map((s) => (
          <li key={s.name}>
            <Item title={s.name} description={`${SPECS[0].options?.find((o) => o.value === s.item)?.label} · ${SPECS[1].options?.find((o) => o.value === s.region)?.label}`} />
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      <FilterPanel open={panel} onClose={() => setPanel(false)} filters={filters} onChange={onChange} onClear={() => setSel({})} sort={sortDef} resultCount={rows.length} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### StickyContextBar

The search and filter bar of a list page, pinned to the top of the scrolling content while the rows scroll under it.

Pin behaviour (#150):
- Pins when the scroller scrolls past the bar, or when the search text field gets focus (250ms ease-out, instant
  under reduced motion, cancelled by wheel/touch; works on short lists too; chips/sort/view buttons do not pin).
- From `md` (768px), pins by layout: the scroller's exact scroll range equals `--sticky-pin` and the list area (or
  each `ListReaderLayout` panel) scrolls independently with `overscroll-behavior: contain`. Only a new upward wheel
  gesture starting at the list top unpins; momentum and flings never unpin. Below `md`, keeps native touch scrolling.
- Exposes `data-stuck` and `data-searching` on the bar and `--sticky-pin` / `--sticky-view` on the scroller, clearing
  them on unmount.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  | Usually SearchPill (with optional BarActions in `trailing`), then FilterChipRow (PhoneFilterBar on phones). The list sits 16px under the filter row. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the region ("Tìm và lọc khách hàng"); leave it out when the bar holds only a search. |
| `pin` | `boolean` | `true` | Enable trackpad-proven layout pinning, focus-pin and `data-stuck` / `data-searching` state (default `true`). |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

### BarActions

Page actions that move inside `SearchPill`'s `trailing` slot while `StickyContextBar` is pinned (`data-stuck`) and
hide while the search field has focus (`data-searching`, 150ms fade, out of the accessibility tree and taking zero
layout space when hidden so the `"/"` shortcut hint never shifts).

Always renders at most **2 slots**, in the title row's order (`[•••][main action]`, 8px apart, last button inset
matching the `"/"` hint): with more than two actions (or any `menu` items), the main action stays on the right and
the rest collapse into `•••` on the left.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actions` * | `BarAction[]` |  | Primary and secondary page actions (in title-row order: secondary left, `primary` last). |
| `menu` | `BarAction[]` |  | Extra overflow items always placed inside the `•••` menu. |
| `moreLabel` | `string` |  | Accessible name and tooltip of the `•••` overflow button (default locale `moreActions`). |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- With label it is a search landmark (role=search) named for the page, so screen-reader users jump to it.
- BarActions hides its icon buttons out of flow and out of the accessibility tree while unpinned or while the search field has focus.

## Notes

- One per page, right under the page heading: PageTitle with `actions` (the page's one `inverse` or `primary` action + `•••` / RefreshButton) or TextTabs. Pass `<BarActions actions={…} menu={…} />` in SearchPill's `trailing` slot so up to 2 icon buttons (`[•••][main action]`) appear inside the pinned search bar when the title row scrolls out of view.
- 1.0 list pages have no result-count row: the list sits 16px under the filter row, and `sort` + `selection` ("Chọn", managed with `useListSelection`) live on FilterChipRow / PhoneFilterBar.
- Desktop and iPad show FilterChipRow (max-md:hidden on the phone bar's sibling), phones PhoneFilterBar (md:hidden): same filters, same state.
- The page's views (Đang mở · Đã đóng · Tất cả) are `SegmentedControl` in FilterChipRow `leading` on md+ and PhoneFilterBar `typeItems` (radio items) on phones: same state, usually a plain param (?view=) written with useFilterParams().setParams. The default view may be other than “all”; leave it out of the URL.
- Phone chrome: at most 2 rows (search + PhoneFilterBar), under 25% of the viewport (P1).

<!-- docs/components/subpage-toolbar.md -->

# Subpage toolbar

The sticky row with a page's filters on the left and search, refresh and the icon-only primary action on the right: under the page title, or with the title on the same row (title). RefreshButton spins while its promise runs.

## When to use

- Every list or grid page.
- A page whose filters and actions fit beside its title (one or two filters, a few actions): pass title and drop the PageTitle, so the content starts higher.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Actions of a tool app | AppHeader |
| Many filters, or filters that need the full width | PageTitle above, SubpageToolbar on its own row (no title) |

## Import

```tsx
import { SubpageToolbar, RefreshButton } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### List page

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { SegmentedControl, SubpageToolbar, toast } from "@semi/ui";

export default function SubpageToolbarListPage() {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState("all");
  const [q, setQ] = useState("");
  return (
    <SubpageToolbar
      left={
        <SegmentedControl
          label="Trạng thái máy in"
          value={status}
          onChange={setStatus}
          options={[
            { key: "all", label: "Tất cả" },
            { key: "printing", label: "Đang in" },
            { key: "idle", label: "Chờ lệnh" },
          ]}
        />
      }
      searchValue={q}
      onSearchChange={setQ}
      searchPlaceholder="Tìm máy in…"
      onRefresh={() => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 800))}
      onPrimaryAction={() => toast({ title: "Thêm máy in" })}
      primaryActionLabel="Thêm máy in"
    />
  );
}
```

### Title on the toolbar row

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, CustomSelect, SubpageToolbar, toast } from "@semi/ui";

export default function SubpageToolbarTitleRow() {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState("all");
  const [q, setQ] = useState("");
  return (
    // The title shares the row with the filter and actions; the page has no PageTitle above.
    <SubpageToolbar
      title="Khách hàng"
      left={
        <CustomSelect
          aria-label="Lọc theo trạng thái"
          value={status}
          onChange={setStatus}
          options={[
            { value: "all", label: "Mọi trạng thái" },
            { value: "new", label: "Mới" },
            { value: "replied", label: "Đã trả lời" },
          ]}
        />
      }
      right={
        <Button icon="upload" onClick={() => toast({ title: "Nhập file" })}>
          Nhập file
        </Button>
      }
      searchValue={q}
      onSearchChange={setQ}
      searchPlaceholder="Tìm khách…"
      onPrimaryAction={() => toast({ title: "Thêm khách" })}
      primaryActionLabel="Thêm khách"
    />
  );
}
```

### Typed filters and secondary actions (phone layout)

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { SubpageToolbar, toast, type FilterDef } from "@semi/ui";

const SPECS: Omit<FilterDef, "selected">[] = [
  { key: "group", label: "Nhóm", options: [{ value: "retail", label: "Bán lẻ" }, { value: "wholesale", label: "Bán sỉ" }] },
  { key: "region", label: "Khu vực", options: [{ value: "hn", label: "Hà Nội" }, { value: "hcm", label: "TP.HCM" }, { value: "dn", label: "Đà Nẵng" }] },
  { key: "owner", label: "Phụ trách", options: [{ value: "ha", label: "Thu Hà" }, { value: "nam", label: "Hoàng Nam" }] },
  { key: "debt", label: "Còn nợ", kind: "switch" },
];

export default function SubpageToolbarPhone() {
  const [sel, setSel] = useState<Record<string, string[]>>({ region: ["hn"] });
  const [q, setQ] = useState("");
  return (
    <SubpageToolbar
      title="Khách hàng"
      filters={{
        filters: SPECS.map((s) => ({ ...s, selected: sel[s.key] ?? [] })),
        onChange: (key, selected) => setSel({ ...sel, [key]: selected }),
        onClear: () => setSel({}),
        resultCount: 42,
      }}
      secondaryActions={[
        { label: "Nhập tệp", icon: "upload", onSelect: () => toast({ title: "Nhập tệp" }) },
        { label: "Xuất Excel", icon: "download", onSelect: () => toast({ title: "Xuất Excel" }) },
      ]}
      searchValue={q}
      onSearchChange={setQ}
      searchPlaceholder="Tìm khách hàng…"
      onPrimaryAction={() => toast({ title: "Thêm khách hàng" })}
      primaryActionLabel="Thêm khách hàng"
    />
  );
}
```

### RefreshButton

```tsx
import { RefreshButton } from "@semi/ui";

export default function RefreshButtonBasic() {
  return <RefreshButton onRefresh={() => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1000))} />;
}
```

## API

### SubpageToolbar

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` |  | The page title, on the same row as the filters and actions (the page then has no PageTitle). A string becomes the page's h1 in PageTitle type; pass a `TextTabs` for sibling views. Leave it out to keep the title on its own row above (PageTitle + SubpageToolbar). On narrow screens the filters and actions wrap below the title. |
| `left` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Filter controls on the left (SegmentedControl, Chip, CustomSelect). |
| `right` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Optional extra controls on the right (placed before the primary icon button). |
| `onPrimaryAction` | `() => void` |  | Click handler for the icon-only primary CTA button (e.g. "Thêm"). |
| `primaryActionLabel` | `string` |  | Accessible title & aria-label for the icon-only primary CTA button. |
| `primaryActionIcon` | `IconName` | `"plus"` | Icon for the primary CTA button (default: "plus"). |
| `searchValue` | `string` |  | Search query value (renders a SearchInput when onSearchChange is provided). |
| `onSearchChange` | `(val: string) => void` |  | Search change handler. |
| `searchPlaceholder` | `string` |  | Placeholder for SearchInput. |
| `onRefresh` | `() => unknown` |  | Async or sync reload callback (renders RefreshButton when provided). |
| `filters` | `ToolbarFilters` |  | Typed filters (C-026): up to two show as chips; with more, and always below `sm`, a "Bộ lọc · N" button opens a FilterPanel and the active ones show as chips beside it. Use instead of hand-made chips in `left`. |
| `collapseFilters` | `boolean` | `false` | Below `sm`, move `left` into a bottom sheet opened by a "Bộ lọc" button (above `sm` it renders as before). |
| `filterCount` | `number` |  | Active filters in `left`, shown on that button ("Bộ lọc · 2") when `collapseFilters` is set. |
| `secondaryActions` | `MenuItem[]` |  | Text actions that are not the primary one: buttons from `sm`, a ⋯ menu below it (the primary stays visible). |
| `className` | `string` | `""` |  |

### RefreshButton

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `onRefresh` * | `() => unknown` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` | `""` |  |
| `label` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- The primary action is icon-only, so primaryActionLabel is required (aria-label + title).
- The Bộ lọc button says the active count (“Bộ lọc · 2”) and opens a modal FilterPanel (or a bottom Drawer for collapseFilters): focus trap, Escape, focus back to the button; the ⋯ menu is named “Thao tác khác”.

## Notes

- Two layouts, both valid: PageTitle + SubpageToolbar (title on its own row), or SubpageToolbar with title (one row). Pick one per page, never both.
- With title, a string becomes the page h1 in PageTitle type; a TextTabs works too. Narrow screens wrap the filters and actions below the title.
- Text buttons belong in right (secondary actions); the title itself stays text only and the primary action stays icon-only.
- Phone layout (#57): with filters (typed, FilterDef[]) or collapseFilters (for left), below sm the toolbar is two rows at most: the title, then Bộ lọc · N, ⋯ (secondaryActions), the primary, the search. Above sm it is the row it always was; more than two typed filters collapse into Bộ lọc with the active ones as chips beside it (C-026).

<!-- docs/components/tabs.md -->

# Tabs

Switch between panels of content inside a card or dialog with underline tabs, icons and counts.

## When to use

- Sections of one object inside a card or dialog: Tổng quan / Hoạt động / Cài đặt.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| 5+ sections of a page, or sections with icons (settings-like pages) | PillTabs |
| 2–4 top-level views of a discovery or reading page | TextTabs |
| 2–5 filter values shown in full, with counts | SegmentedControl |

## Import

```tsx
import { Tabs } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Underline with panels

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Tabs } from "@semi/ui";

export default function TabsUnderline() {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<"overview" | "activity" | "settings">("overview");
  return (
    <Tabs
      label="Chi tiết máy in"
      value={tab}
      onChange={setTab}
      items={[
        { key: "overview", label: "Tổng quan", icon: "gauge", content: <p className="text-ui text-body">Nhiệt độ, tiến độ và camera.</p> },
        { key: "activity", label: "Hoạt động", count: 12, content: <p className="text-ui text-body">12 sự kiện trong 24 giờ qua.</p> },
        { key: "settings", label: "Cài đặt", icon: "settings", content: <p className="text-ui text-body">Tên, nhóm và quyền truy cập.</p> },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

## API

### Tabs

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` * | `TabItem<T>[]` |  |  |
| `value` * | `T` |  |  |
| `onChange` * | `(key: T) => void` |  |  |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the tab list. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `panelClassName` | `string` | `"pt-4"` |  |

## Accessibility

- tablist / tab / tabpanel; ←/→, Home, End move; the panel is linked to its tab.

<!-- docs/components/text-tabs.md -->

# Text tabs

Big display tabs (`font-display text-tab-xl`, 24px below sm / 28px from sm, weight 400) for 2–4 top-level views of a discovery or reading page: every tab in strong text colour, inactive at opacity 0.2 (raised on hover in 150ms), active with a 2px brand underline at 6px offset under the word only.

## When to use

- 2–4 top-level views of a discovery or reading page, rendered as the page heading (Khám phá / Mẫu sẵn / Cảm hứng).
- Views people link to or reload into: pass `href` on each item or keep `?tab=` with `useTabParam`.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| 5+ sections of one page, or sections with icons (settings-like pages) | PillTabs |
| 2–5 filter values shown in full, often with counts | SegmentedControl |
| Filters of a list | FilterChipRow |
| Sections of one record inside a card or dialog | Tabs |
| A page with one title | PageTitle |

## Import

```tsx
import { TextTabs, useTabParam } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Page heading with intro and panel

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { TextTabs } from "@semi/ui";

const VIEWS = [
  { key: "discover", label: "Khám phá", intro: "Các mẫu in 3D nổi bật được cộng đồng hoàn thiện trong tuần qua." },
  { key: "use-cases", label: "Ứng dụng", intro: "Bộ gá xưởng, hộp điện tử và phụ kiện bàn làm việc sẵn thông số in." },
  { key: "collections", label: "Bộ sưu tập", intro: "Tuyển tập theo vật liệu PLA, PETG chịu nhiệt và TPU đàn hồi." },
] as const;

export default function TextTabsHeading() {
  const [view, setView] = useState<(typeof VIEWS)[number]["key"]>("discover");
  const current = VIEWS.find((v) => v.key === view) ?? VIEWS[0];

  return (
    <TextTabs
      label="Thư viện cộng đồng"
      value={view}
      onChange={(next) => setView(next)}
      items={[...VIEWS]}
    >
      <p className="text-lead text-muted">{current.intro}</p>
    </TextTabs>
  );
}
```

### URL-driven href tabs with guard

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Switch, TextTabs } from "@semi/ui";

/** URL-driven: each tab is a link; `onBeforeChange` blocks link navigation when there are unsaved edits. */
export default function TextTabsLinked() {
  const [dirty, setDirty] = useState(false);
  const [refused, setRefused] = useState(false);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-group">
      <Switch
        checked={dirty}
        onChange={(v) => {
          setDirty(v);
          setRefused(false);
        }}
        label="Có thay đổi chưa lưu (chặn chuyển link)"
      />
      <TextTabs
        label="Mua hàng"
        heading={false}
        className="mb-0"
        value="suppliers"
        onBeforeChange={() => {
          if (dirty) {
            setRefused(true);
            return false;
          }
          setRefused(false);
          return true;
        }}
        items={[
          { key: "requests", label: "Yêu cầu", href: "?view=requests" },
          { key: "suppliers", label: "Nhà cung cấp", href: "?view=suppliers" },
          { key: "quotes", label: "Báo giá", href: "?view=quotes" },
        ]}
      >
        <p className="text-ui text-muted">
          {refused
            ? "Đã giữ nguyên trang Nhà cung cấp vì biểu mẫu còn thay đổi chưa lưu."
            : "Mỗi tab là một liên kết Next.js; phím ←/→ di chuyển tiêu điểm, Enter hoặc Space mở liên kết."}
        </p>
      </TextTabs>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### TextTabs

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` * | `TextTabItem<T>[]` |  |  |
| `value` * | `T` |  | The current tab (read it from the URL for linked tabs, or via `useTabParam`). |
| `onChange` | `(key: T, meta: TabChangeMeta) => void` |  | Called with the tab chosen; tabs with `href` call it too, then navigate unless `onBeforeChange` refuses. |
| `onBeforeChange` | `TabBeforeChange<T>` |  | Guard run before switching (button AND href tabs); return or resolve `false` to keep the current tab. |
| `activation` | `'automatic' \| 'manual'` | `"automatic"` | `"automatic"` (default) switches button tabs as arrows move; `"manual"` moves focus with arrows and commits on Enter / Space. |
| `label` * | `string` |  | Accessible name of the tab list ("Khám phá"). |
| `heading` | `boolean` | `true` | Wrap the tabs in the page's `h1` (default): they are the page heading. Set false when the page has its own h1. |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` |  | The current tab's content, rendered in the tab panel (28px below the tab row by default). Omit to render content below. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `panelClassName` | `string` | `"pt-7"` |  |

## Accessibility

- WAI-ARIA tabs: tablist / tab / tabpanel, ←/→, Home and End move and the current tab is the only tab stop.
- Buttons switch as focus moves (or wait for Enter / Space with `activation="manual"`); linked tabs (`href`) move focus on arrows and navigate on Enter or Space.
- `onBeforeChange` guards both button tabs and `href` link tabs (sync boolean or Promise<boolean>).
- Inactive tabs use `text-strong` at `opacity-20` (explicit owner exception for the 24–28px display tab heading; hover raises opacity, keyboard `:focus-visible` restores full contrast).

## Notes

- Only for 2–4 sub-pages. For 5+ sections or sections with icons, use `PillTabs`.
- Weight is 400 (`font-normal`) in `font-display`: never force 600–800 bold on top of a heavy display face.
- Gaps are 16 / 20 / 24px (`base` / `sm` / `md`) with 28px from the tab row to the intro text below.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/text-tabs/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/workspace-layout.md -->

# Workspace layout

Page type “workspace” (L12): a control panel on the left (segmented tabs, back + tool name, sections with a text-overline label and a counter like “3/8”, drop zones, steppers, a message box) with the main action pinned at its bottom, and the result on the right. Phones stack the panel above the result with the action at the bottom of the screen.

## When to use

- A tool where the user sets inputs and sees what they produce: a quote request and its comparison, a generator, an import with a preview, a print job.
- A record being composed step by step, with one main action at the end (Gửi hỏi giá, Tạo, In).

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A list of records with search and filters | StickyContextBar + a list or DataTable |
| A form that saves fields of one record | a form page with FormActions |
| Settings that apply to a stand-alone tool app's canvas | SidePanel |

## Import

```tsx
import { WorkspaceLayout, WorkspaceHeader, WorkspaceSection } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Quote request

Tabs, back + name, sections with counters, steppers, a drop zone, a message with @ and / hints; the comparison on the right. Below lg the panel stacks on top and its action stays at the bottom of the screen (not inside this docs frame, which scrolls sideways: sticky needs a page that scrolls vertically).

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { Badge, Button, DropZone, HintTextarea, SegmentedControl, Stepper, WorkspaceHeader, WorkspaceLayout, WorkspaceSection } from "@semi/ui";

const LINES = [
  { id: "l1", name: "Tiêu đen 500 g/l", spec: "Độ ẩm ≤ 13%, sạch 99,5%" },
  { id: "l2", name: "Quế chẻ", spec: "Dài 30–40 cm, dầu ≥ 3%" },
];
const QUOTES = [
  { supplier: "Gia vị Tây Nguyên", days: 12, prices: [4120, 2890], best: [false, true] },
  { supplier: "HTX Tiêu Chư Sê", days: 15, prices: [4090, 2950], best: [true, false] },
];
const SUPPLIERS = [
  { value: "@taynguyen", label: "Gia vị Tây Nguyên", hint: "Đắk Lắk" },
  { value: "@chuse", label: "HTX Tiêu Chư Sê", hint: "Gia Lai" },
  { value: "@yenbai", label: "Hương Quế Yên Bái", hint: "Yên Bái" },
];
const TEMPLATES = [{ value: "/fob", label: "Hỏi giá FOB", hint: "Giá FOB Hải Phòng, hạn giao" }];
const usd = (n: number) => `${n.toLocaleString("vi-VN")} USD`;

export default function WorkspaceRequest() {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<"lines" | "suppliers" | "terms">("lines");
  const [qty, setQty] = useState([12, 4]);
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState("Chào anh chị, bên em cần báo giá FOB Hải Phòng, giao trước 15/12.");
  return (
    <WorkspaceLayout
      header={
        <WorkspaceHeader
          backHref="/components/workspace-layout/"
          backLabel="Về Mua hàng"
          title="YC-014 Tiêu đen cho Seoul Spice"
          description="Cần hàng trước 15/12 · Trần Thu Hà"
          headingLevel={2}
          tabs={
            <SegmentedControl
              label="Phần của yêu cầu"
              value={tab}
              onChange={setTab}
              options={[
                { key: "lines", label: "Mặt hàng" },
                { key: "suppliers", label: "Nhà cung cấp" },
                { key: "terms", label: "Điều khoản" },
              ]}
            />
          }
        />
      }
      panel={
        <>
          <WorkspaceSection label="Mặt hàng" count={LINES.length} max={8} action={<Button size="sm" variant="ghost" icon="plus">Thêm</Button>}>
            {LINES.map((l, i) => (
              <div key={l.id} className="rounded-card bg-card p-3 flex flex-col gap-2">
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <div className="text-ui font-medium text-strong">{l.name}</div>
                  <div className="text-ui text-muted truncate">{l.spec}</div>
                </div>
                <Stepper label={`số tấn ${l.name}`} unit="tấn" min={1} value={qty[i]} onChange={(v) => setQty(qty.map((q, j) => (j === i ? v : q)))} />
              </div>
            ))}
          </WorkspaceSection>
          <WorkspaceSection label="Quy cách đính kèm" count={0} max={5}>
            <DropZone title="Kéo tệp quy cách vào đây" hint="PDF, ảnh mẫu hoặc Excel, tối đa 10 MB" accept={[".pdf", "image/*", ".xlsx"]} maxSize={10_000_000} onAdd={() => undefined} />
          </WorkspaceSection>
          <WorkspaceSection label="Lời nhắn">
            <HintTextarea
              label="Lời nhắn gửi nhà cung cấp"
              rows={3}
              value={msg}
              onChange={setMsg}
              triggers={[
                { char: "@", hint: "để nhắc nhà cung cấp", items: SUPPLIERS.map((s) => ({ ...s, icon: "truck" })) },
                { char: "/", hint: "để chèn mẫu", items: TEMPLATES.map((t) => ({ ...t, icon: "fileText" })) },
              ]}
            />
          </WorkspaceSection>
        </>
      }
      action={
        <div className="grid grid-cols-[auto_minmax(0,1fr)] gap-2">
          <Button>Lưu nháp</Button>
          <Button variant="primary" icon="send" fullWidth>
            Gửi hỏi giá (2)
          </Button>
        </div>
      }
      result={
        <>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
            <h3 className="flex-1 text-lead font-title font-medium text-strong">So sánh báo giá</h3>
            <span className="text-ui text-muted">2/2 nhà cung cấp đã trả lời</span>
          </div>
          <div className="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-group">
            {QUOTES.map((q) => (
              <article key={q.supplier} className="rounded-card bg-card p-card flex flex-col gap-3">
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <div className="text-ui font-medium text-strong truncate">{q.supplier}</div>
                  <div className="text-ui text-muted">FOB · {q.days} ngày</div>
                </div>
                <div className="flex flex-col divide-y divide-divider">
                  {LINES.map((l, i) => (
                    <div key={l.id} className="flex items-center gap-2 py-2">
                      <span className="flex-1 text-ui text-body">{l.name}</span>
                      {q.best[i] && (
                        <Badge tone="emerald" size="sm">
                          Tốt nhất
                        </Badge>
                      )}
                      <span className="text-ui tabular-nums text-strong">{usd(q.prices[i])}</span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-1">
                  <span className="text-ui text-muted">Tổng ({qty[0] + qty[1]} tấn)</span>
                  <span className="text-lead font-figure font-medium text-strong tabular-nums">{usd(q.prices[0] * qty[0] + q.prices[1] * qty[1])}</span>
                </div>
              </article>
            ))}
          </div>
        </>
      }
    />
  );
}
```

### In the app shell

AppShell with the phone tab bar (mobileNav="tabs"): the main action stays above the tab bar. Full screen at /demo/workspace/.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { AppShell, Button, Stepper, WorkspaceHeader, WorkspaceLayout, WorkspaceSection } from "@semi/ui";

const LINES = ["Tiêu đen 500 g/l", "Quế chẻ", "Hồi khô", "Thảo quả", "Gừng sấy"];

// In the app's shell: AppShell (here with the phone tab bar, mobileNav="tabs") renders in layout.tsx, the workspace in
// the page. On a phone the main action stays above the tab bar while the panel is in view.
export default function WorkspaceInShell() {
  const [qty, setQty] = useState(LINES.map(() => 2));
  return (
    <AppShell
      productName="Sales Hub"
      logoIcon="bag"
      mobileNav="tabs"
      mobileTabIds={["inbox", "purchasing", "suppliers"]}
      activeId="purchasing"
      sections={[
        {
          items: [
            { id: "inbox", label: "Hộp thư", icon: "mail", href: "/demo/workspace/" },
            { id: "purchasing", label: "Mua hàng", icon: "bag", href: "/demo/workspace/" },
            { id: "suppliers", label: "Nhà cung cấp", icon: "truck", href: "/demo/workspace/" },
          ],
        },
      ]}
    >
      <WorkspaceLayout
        header={<WorkspaceHeader backHref="/demo/workspace/" backLabel="Về Mua hàng" title="YC-014 Tiêu đen cho Seoul Spice" description="Cần hàng trước 15/12" />}
        panel={
          <WorkspaceSection label="Mặt hàng" count={LINES.length} max={8}>
            {LINES.map((name, i) => (
              <div key={name} className="rounded-card bg-card p-3 flex flex-col gap-2">
                <div className="text-ui font-medium text-strong">{name}</div>
                <Stepper label={`số tấn ${name}`} unit="tấn" min={1} value={qty[i]} onChange={(v) => setQty(qty.map((q, j) => (j === i ? v : q)))} />
              </div>
            ))}
          </WorkspaceSection>
        }
        action={
          <Button variant="primary" icon="send" fullWidth>
            Gửi hỏi giá
          </Button>
        }
        result={<div className="rounded-card bg-card p-card text-ui text-muted min-h-60">Báo giá của nhà cung cấp hiện ở đây khi về.</div>}
      />
    </AppShell>
  );
}
```

### Minimal

No header: just sections, the action and the result.

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, Stepper, WorkspaceLayout, WorkspaceSection } from "@semi/ui";

export default function WorkspaceMinimal() {
  const [copies, setCopies] = useState(2);
  return (
    <WorkspaceLayout
      panel={
        <WorkspaceSection label="Số bản" count={copies} max={10}>
          <Stepper label="số bản in" value={copies} min={1} max={10} onChange={setCopies} />
        </WorkspaceSection>
      }
      action={
        <Button variant="primary" icon="printer" fullWidth>
          In {copies} bản
        </Button>
      }
      result={<div className="rounded-card bg-card p-card text-ui text-muted min-h-40">Bản xem trước của nhãn hiện ở đây.</div>}
    />
  );
}
```

### Read-only viewer

Omit `action` when the viewer cannot commit: no pinned bottom bar is rendered.

```tsx
"use client";

import { Card, WorkspaceHeader, WorkspaceLayout, WorkspaceSection } from "@semi/ui";

export default function WorkspaceReadOnly() {
  // Read-only viewer: omit `action` so no empty pinned bar is rendered at the bottom of the panel.
  return (
    <WorkspaceLayout
      header={<WorkspaceHeader title="YC-014 Tiêu đen" description="Chỉ xem · Sale Member" backHref="#requests" backLabel="Về Mua hàng" headingLevel={2} />}
      panel={
        <>
          <WorkspaceSection label="Mặt hàng" count={2}>
            <Card className="flex flex-col gap-1">
              <span className="text-ui font-medium text-strong">Tiêu đen 550g/l</span>
              <span className="text-chrome text-muted tabular-nums">12 tấn · Giao tại Cát Lái</span>
            </Card>
          </WorkspaceSection>
          <WorkspaceSection label="Người phụ trách">
            <p className="text-ui text-body">Nguyễn Minh An</p>
          </WorkspaceSection>
        </>
      }
      result={
        <Card className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          <h3 className="text-lead font-medium text-strong">Bảng so sánh báo giá</h3>
          <p className="text-ui text-muted">3 nhà cung cấp đã gửi giá. Chờ quản lý chốt đơn.</p>
        </Card>
      }
    />
  );
}
```

## API

### WorkspaceLayout

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `header` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Top of the panel: a `WorkspaceHeader` (back + tool name), segmented tabs above it when the tool has parts. |
| `panel` * | `React.ReactNode` |  | The controls: `WorkspaceSection`s. Scrolls inside the panel on `lg+`. |
| `action` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Optional main action (one primary `Button` or `SplitButton` with `fullWidth`, a secondary beside it at most). Pinned to the panel's bottom; omit for a read-only viewer so no pinned bar is rendered. |
| `result` * | `React.ReactNode` |  | What the controls produce: a preview, a comparison, a list. Its headings start at h2 (the tool name is the h1). |
| `panelLabel` | `string` |  | Name of the panel region (default "Bảng điều khiển"). |
| `resultLabel` | `string` |  | Name of the result region (default "Kết quả"). |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

### WorkspaceHeader

Back + tool name (+ one meta line) at the top of the workspace panel; `tabs` (a `ToggleGroup`) sit above it.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` * | `React.ReactNode` |  | The tool or record name ("YC-014 Tiêu đen cho Seoul Spice"). The page's h1 by default. |
| `description` | `React.ReactNode` |  | One muted line under the title (due date, owner). |
| `backHref` | `string` |  | Where the round back button goes (a `next/link`). |
| `onBack` | `() => void` |  | Back without a URL (closes the tool); ignored when `backHref` is set. |
| `backLabel` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the back button: where it goes ("Về Mua hàng"). Default "Quay lại". |
| `tabs` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Segmented tabs of the tool's parts, full width above the title (`<ToggleGroup className="w-full" …/>`). |
| `headingLevel` | `1 \| 2` | `1` | 1 (default): the tool name is the page title. 2 when the page already has an h1. |

### WorkspaceSection

A section of the workspace panel: a `text-overline` label, a counter ("3/8") and an optional action on its right.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` * | `string` |  | Section name in sentence case ("Mặt hàng"); shown in `text-overline`. |
| `count` | `number` |  | How many items the section holds. |
| `max` | `number` |  | The limit, shown as "count/max". |
| `action` | `React.ReactNode` |  | A small text button on the right ("Thêm"). |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- Two named regions (panel and result: “Bảng điều khiển”, “Kết quả”, override with panelLabel / resultLabel); each WorkspaceSection is a group named by its label.
- WorkspaceHeader's title is the page h1 by default; headings in the result start at h2. The back button is a link named by backLabel (where it goes).

## Notes

- The panel is 380px wide on lg+, sticky under the top of the scrolling area, and scrolls inside; the result scrolls with the page. On phones the action sticks at `bottom: var(--semi-bottom-bar, 0px)`: AppShell sets it to the tab bar's height in tabs mode, so the action sits above MobileTabBar.
- One primary in the action bar (`fullWidth` on `Button` or `SplitButton`), a secondary beside it at most (Lưu nháp). Omit `action` for a read-only viewer. Section labels are the only uppercase text (text-overline, written in sentence case in code).
- Record as WorkspaceLayout vs DetailOverlay: use WorkspaceLayout when a stored record has its own route and a large live result (e.g. a quote comparison matrix); use DetailOverlay for a quick look from a list. Keep inputs and context in the panel and move history/activity below the main result so phone panels stay short.
- Do not put WorkspaceLayout inside an overflow-x-auto / overflow-hidden box: that box becomes the sticky container and the phone action no longer stays on screen.
