<!-- docs/components/accordion.md -->

# Accordion

A list of sections where one (or several) open at a time: FAQs, settings groups, help.

## When to use

- FAQs and help; long settings split into groups.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| One section | Collapsible |
| Switch whole panels | Tabs |

## Import

```tsx
import { Accordion } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### FAQ

```tsx
import { Accordion } from "@semi/ui";

export default function AccordionFaq() {
  return (
    <Accordion
      defaultValue={["petg"]}
      items={[
        { key: "petg", title: "Vì sao PETG bị kéo sợi?", content: "Giảm nhiệt độ 5–10°C, tăng retraction và bật Z-hop." },
        { key: "warp", title: "Bản in bị cong góc?", content: "Lau bàn bằng cồn, dùng brim 5 mm và tắt quạt ở 3 lớp đầu." },
        { key: "clog", title: "Đầu phun bị tắc phải làm sao?", content: "Chạy cold pull 2–3 lần; nếu vẫn tắc, thay đầu phun." },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

### Several open

```tsx
import { Accordion } from "@semi/ui";

export default function AccordionMultiple() {
  return (
    <Accordion
      type="multiple"
      defaultValue={["network", "storage"]}
      items={[
        { key: "network", title: "Mạng", content: "Wi-Fi: Xuong-A · IP 192.168.1.42" },
        { key: "storage", title: "Bộ nhớ", content: "Đã dùng 12,4 / 32 GB" },
        { key: "firmware", title: "Firmware", content: "1.08 (mới nhất)", disabled: true },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

## API

### Accordion

A list of sections, one (type="single", default) or several (type="multiple") open at a time. ↑/↓ move between
headers, Home / End jump; each header is a button inside a heading (level), its panel a labelled region.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` * | `AccordionItem[]` |  |  |
| `type` | `'single' \| 'multiple'` | `"single"` |  |
| `value` | `string[]` |  | Open item keys (controlled). |
| `defaultValue` | `string[]` | `[]` |  |
| `onChange` | `(open: string[]) => void` |  |  |
| `headingLevel` | `2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5 \| 6` | `3` | Heading level of the headers in the page outline. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- Each header is a button inside a heading (headingLevel), with aria-expanded; ↑/↓ Home End move between headers; panels are labelled regions.

<!-- docs/components/aspect-ratio.md -->

# Aspect ratio

Keeps media at a fixed ratio while its width follows the layout (images, video, maps, 3D previews).

## When to use

- Thumbnails and media that must not jump while loading.

## Import

```tsx
import { AspectRatio } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### 16:9 and square

```tsx
import { AspectRatio } from "@semi/ui";

export default function AspectRatioBasic() {
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-3 grid-cols-2 max-w-md">
      <AspectRatio className="rounded-card border border-line bg-field">
        <div className="flex h-full items-center justify-center text-ui text-muted">16 : 9</div>
      </AspectRatio>
      <AspectRatio ratio={1} className="rounded-card border border-line bg-field">
        <div className="flex h-full items-center justify-center text-ui text-muted">1 : 1</div>
      </AspectRatio>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### AspectRatio

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ratio` | `number` | `16 / 9` | Width / height: 16 / 9 (default), 4 / 3, 1, 3 / 4. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Radius / border / background of the frame. |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  | Usually an <img> or <video> with "w-full h-full object-cover". |

## Accessibility

- A plain wrapper; give the image its own alt text.

<!-- docs/components/avatar.md -->

# Avatar & LetterAvatar

A person or team: their image, two initials on a stable tone (`Avatar`), or one upper-cased letter (`vi` locale, "?" when empty) on a neutral fill (`LetterAvatar`, or `Avatar initials={1}`).

## When to use

- Owners, assignees, customers in rows and cards (`Avatar`).
- Neutral one-letter account or sender marks without a photo (`LetterAvatar`, used by the route header's account menu).

## Import

```tsx
import { Avatar, LetterAvatar } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Sizes

```tsx
import { Avatar } from "@semi/ui";

export default function AvatarSizes() {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
      <Avatar name="Hoàng Huỳnh" size="lg" />
      <Avatar name="Semi Team" />
      <Avatar name="Lan" size="sm" />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### One-letter neutral avatar

LetterAvatar draws the first letter upper-cased with the vi locale (Đ, Á, or ? when empty) on a neutral fill.

```tsx
import { LetterAvatar } from "@semi/ui";

export default function AvatarLetter() {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
      <LetterAvatar name="Đặng Minh Anh" size="lg" />
      <LetterAvatar name="Hoàng Huỳnh" />
      <LetterAvatar name="ánh dương" size="sm" />
      <LetterAvatar name="" size="sm" />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### Avatar

Person or team mark: photo, else initials on a tone picked from the name (stable per name).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` * | `string` |  |  |
| `src` | `string` |  |  |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `"md"` |  |
| `initials` | `1 \| 2` | `2` | Number of initials to draw: `2` (default) uses the last two words; `1` uses the first letter (`vi` locale, "?" when empty). |
| `tone` | `'auto' \| 'neutral'` | `"auto"` | `auto` picks a stable category tone from the name; `neutral` uses the neutral raised fill (as in LetterAvatar). |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

### LetterAvatar

One-letter neutral avatar: the name's first letter upper-cased with the `vi` locale ("?" when empty) on a neutral fill; accessible name = the full name.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` * | `string` |  |  |
| `src` | `string` |  |  |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `"md"` |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- The full name is the accessible label (`role="img"` + `aria-label`); mark `aria-hidden` when placed next to the same visible name.

<!-- docs/components/badge.md -->

# Badge

A read-only status or tag in a tone (10% fill, 20% border, theme-safe text; one fixed palette for every brand), and the attention marks in the brand colour: CountBadge (unread, to approve; 99+ cap) and NewTag ("Mới").

## When to use

- Status of a row or card (Đã thanh toán, Lỗi), a plan or role tag.
- Something waits for the user (unread, to approve): CountBadge, or Button badge on an icon button.
- A new feature or item in a menu: NewTag.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Something clickable | Chip |
| A count next to a title that is not an alert | COUNT_PILL or CountBadge tone="neutral" |

## Import

```tsx
import { Badge, CountBadge, NewTag } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Tones

```tsx
import { Badge } from "@semi/ui";

export default function BadgeTones() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
      <Badge tone="emerald" dot>
        Hoàn thành
      </Badge>
      <Badge tone="amber" dot>
        Đang xử lý
      </Badge>
      <Badge tone="rose" dot>
        Thất bại
      </Badge>
      <Badge tone="sky" icon="server">
        Đồng bộ
      </Badge>
      <Badge tone="purple" icon="sparkles">
        Pro
      </Badge>
      <Badge tone="gray" size="sm">
        Nháp
      </Badge>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Attention marks

CountBadge in the brand fill (99+ cap; tone="neutral" for a plain count), Button badge at a button's corner (the count goes in an icon button's aria-label; a button with text and no aria-label gets it as screen-reader text), NewTag: the brand at 18% behind brand text, or the strong text where the brand is not AA on it.

```tsx
import { Button, CountBadge, NewTag } from "@semi/ui";

export default function BadgeAttention() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
      <Button variant="ghost" iconOnly icon="bell" aria-label="Thông báo, 3 chưa đọc" badge={3} />
      <Button variant="ghost" iconOnly icon="mail" aria-label="Hộp thư, hơn 99 chưa đọc" badge={240} />
      <Button size="sm" icon="check" badge={2}>
        Duyệt
      </Button>
      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-ui text-body">
        Chờ duyệt <CountBadge count={5} />
      </span>
      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-ui text-body">
        Tất cả <CountBadge count={128} tone="neutral" max={999} />
      </span>
      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-ui text-strong">
        Báo cáo tồn kho <NewTag />
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### Badge

Standard Bento Tag/Badge primitive with dual-theme tonal matching.
Uses 10% alpha fill + 20% alpha border + high-contrast text adapted for dark and light modes.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tone` | `SemanticTone` | `"gray"` | Chromatic tone matching the theme. Defaults to "gray". |
| `icon` | `IconName` |  | Optional leading icon from the Semi standard registry. |
| `dot` | `boolean` |  | Optional leading status dot in the tone's color. |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` | `""` |  |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | `"md"` |  |

### CountBadge

A count in the brand colour (text-badge, 700), "99+" cap. A plain count that is not an alert passes tone="neutral".

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `count` * | `number` |  | The count. 0 or less renders nothing. |
| `max` | `number` | `99` | Above it the badge shows `max+` (99+). |
| `tone` | `'neutral' \| 'attention'` | `"attention"` | `attention` (default): the brand fill, for something that waits for the user (unread, to approve). `neutral`: a plain count that is not an alert. |
| `corner` | `boolean` | `false` | Pinned to the top-right corner of a `relative` parent (an icon button). Button's `badge` prop uses it. |

### NewTag

"Mới" / "New" tag: the brand colour at 18% behind brand text (or the strong text where the brand text is not AA on it).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` | `the locale's "Mới" / "New"` | The text. |

## Accessibility

- Text, not colour alone, carries the meaning; it never wraps.
- A count on an icon button is said in the button's aria-label.

<!-- docs/components/card.md -->

# Card

The bento content card: the card surface (bg-card, separated from the page by tone: no border, no shadow, rounded-card). bordered frames a dense data view; interactive adds hover / press, active marks the selected or running item.

## When to use

- Group the content of a page in cards; nested facts in TILE (bg-card-field).
- bordered for a dense data view (a table or rows that need an edge).

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A metric | KpiCard |
| A tinted callout | Alert or TONAL_CONTAINER |

## Import

```tsx
import { Card, CARD, CARD_BORDERED, CARD_HOVER, CARD_ACTIVE, TILE } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Content card

```tsx
import { Badge, Card } from "@semi/ui";

export default function CardBasic() {
  return (
    <Card className="space-y-2 max-w-sm">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <span className="text-ui font-medium text-strong">X1 Carbon · Xưởng A</span>
        <Badge tone="emerald" dot>
          Online
        </Badge>
      </div>
      <p className="text-ui text-muted">Đang in: vỏ hộp điều khiển · còn 42 phút</p>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

### Interactive and active

```tsx
import { Card, TILE } from "@semi/ui";

export default function CardStates() {
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 max-w-xl">
      <Card interactive className="space-y-2">
        <div className="text-ui font-medium text-strong">P1S · Xưởng B</div>
        <div className={`${TILE} p-2 text-ui text-body tabular-nums`}>Đầu phun 220°C · Bàn 60°C</div>
      </Card>
      <Card interactive active className="space-y-2">
        <div className="text-ui font-medium text-strong">A1 Mini · đang in</div>
        <div className={`${TILE} p-2 text-ui text-body tabular-nums`}>Tiến độ 64%</div>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Bordered (dense data)

```tsx
import { Card } from "@semi/ui";

export default function CardBordered() {
  return (
    <Card bordered padding="none" className="max-w-xl overflow-hidden">
      <div className="px-card py-2.5 border-b border-divider text-ui font-medium text-strong">Đơn mua gần đây</div>
      {["PO-1042 · Nhựa PLA 1kg", "PO-1041 · Đầu phun 0.4", "PO-1040 · Bàn in PEI"].map((row) => (
        <div key={row} className="px-card py-2.5 border-b border-divider last:border-0 text-ui text-body">
          {row}
        </div>
      ))}
    </Card>
  );
}
```

## API

### Card

With `onClick` the card is a button for keyboards and screen readers too: role="button", in the tab order, Enter and
Space click it, FOCUS_RING shows focus (a plain <div onClick> is mouse-only). `active` is then its pressed state.
With `selectable`, the outer element stays a plain container and renders sibling Checkbox + open button controls
so checking and opening never nest interactive elements.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `interactive` | `boolean` | `false` | Clickable card (opens a detail view): hover border + press scale. |
| `active` | `boolean` |  | "On" / selected card: outline border, no glow. On a non-selectable card with onClick it is also its pressed state (aria-pressed). |
| `bordered` | `boolean` | `false` | Framed card for dense data views (a table or rows that need an edge): panel fill + 1px line instead of the borderless card surface. |
| `padding` | `'card' \| 'panel' \| 'none'` | `"card"` | Inner padding: `"card"` = p-card (16px at regular density, the default), `"panel"` = p-card sm:p-panel (a roomy card, 24px from sm), `"none"` for an image or a table that runs to the edge. A padding class in `className` (p-*, px-*, py-*) replaces it. |
| `selectable` | `boolean` | `false` | Selection mode (#149, #127): renders a corner checkbox as a sibling of the card's open button (zero nested interactive controls) so the card can be checked separately from opening it, by pointer or keyboard. |
| `checked` | `boolean` | `false` | Checked state in selection mode (`bg-item-checked`). |
| `onCheckedChange` | `(checked: boolean) => void` |  | Called when the card's selection checkbox toggles. |
| `selected` | `boolean` | `false` | Open / active record state (`bg-item-selected`, `border-outline-line`). |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the card's open action (also used to build the default checkbox name `"Chọn <label>"`). |
| `selectLabel` | `string` |  | Override accessible name of the selection checkbox. |
| `ref` | `React.Ref<HTMLDivElement>` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- With onClick the card is a button for keyboards and screen readers (role="button", tab order, Enter / Space, focus ring); active becomes aria-pressed. Never a div with onClick (semi-lint click-target).
- A card that opens another page puts a next/link on its title instead of onClick.

## Notes

- It pads itself: padding="card" (p-card, default), "panel" (p-card sm:p-panel) or "none" for an image or table to the edge. Never tighter than p-card (card-padding); a p-* in className replaces the default.
- Pass padding and layout only: no bg-* or shadow-* on <Card> (card-class-override).
- Light: the card is recessed one step below the app; dark: one step above the panel. A block meant as a card uses bg-card (or Card), never bg-panel: panel is the sidebar / modal step.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/card/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/carousel.md -->

# Carousel

Slides in a row that scroll by swipe, trackpad, arrow keys, buttons or dots (CSS scroll-snap, no library). Phones show one slide and a peek of the next.

## When to use

- Product photos, featured items, onboarding steps.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Content people must not miss | a grid or a list |
| Steps of a task | a form with sections |

## Import

```tsx
import { Carousel } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Products, 3 per view

```tsx
import { AspectRatio, Card, Carousel } from "@semi/ui";

const ITEMS = ["Giá đỡ điện thoại", "Hộp đựng tai nghe", "Móc khoá logo", "Chậu cây mini", "Kệ sách nhỏ"];

export default function CarouselProducts() {
  return (
    <Carousel label="Sản phẩm nổi bật" perView={3}>
      {ITEMS.map((name, i) => (
        <Card key={name} className="space-y-2">
          <AspectRatio ratio={4 / 3} className="rounded-control bg-field">
            <div className="flex h-full items-center justify-center text-tab-xl font-normal text-muted">{i + 1}</div>
          </AspectRatio>
          <div className="text-ui font-medium text-strong">{name}</div>
          <div className="text-ui text-muted tabular-nums">{(89 + i * 30).toLocaleString("vi-VN")}k ₫</div>
        </Card>
      ))}
    </Carousel>
  );
}
```

## API

### Carousel

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` * | `string` |  | Accessible name of the carousel ("Ảnh sản phẩm"). |
| `perView` | `1 \| 2 \| 3 \| 4` | `1` | Slides visible at once from sm up (phones always show one and a peek of the next). |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  | One child per slide. |

## Accessibility

- aria-roledescription="carousel" with a label; slides are labelled groups (“2 / 5”); the track is focusable and ←/→ move; no auto-play.
- Slides off screen are inert; arrow keys move slides when the track has focus, never while typing in a slide.

<!-- docs/components/chart.md -->

# Chart

Charts in SVG on Semi tokens, no library: BarChart (grouped or stacked columns), LineChart (optional area wash), DonutChart (parts of a whole) and Sparkline (a trend in a tile). Series use the fixed chart-1…8 colours (validated for colour-blind readers in both themes); every chart has a legend for 2+ series, a hover / keyboard tooltip and a table view.

## When to use

- Compare categories (BarChart), show change over time (LineChart), parts of a whole with ≤ 5 parts (DonutChart), a trend next to a KPI (Sparkline).

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| One headline number | KpiCard (optionally with a Sparkline) |
| Exact values to compare and sort | DataTable |
| Two measures with different units | two charts, never a second y axis |
| More than 8 series | fold into “Khác”, or small multiples |

## Import

```tsx
import { BarChart, LineChart, DonutChart, Sparkline, type ChartSeries, type DonutSlice } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Grouped columns

```tsx
import { BarChart } from "@semi/ui";

const DATA = [
  { month: "T6", pla: 120, petg: 80 },
  { month: "T7", pla: 150, petg: 96 },
  { month: "T8", pla: 132, petg: 118 },
  { month: "T9", pla: 178, petg: 104 },
  { month: "T10", pla: 196, petg: 140 },
];

export default function ChartBar() {
  return (
    <BarChart
      label="Bản in theo vật liệu, 5 tháng"
      data={DATA}
      index="month"
      series={[
        { key: "pla", label: "PLA" },
        { key: "petg", label: "PETG" },
      ]}
      format={(v) => `${v} bản`}
    />
  );
}
```

### Stacked columns

```tsx
import { BarChart } from "@semi/ui";

const DATA = [
  { day: "T2", web: 32, shop: 18, partner: 9 },
  { day: "T3", web: 41, shop: 22, partner: 12 },
  { day: "T4", web: 28, shop: 25, partner: 8 },
  { day: "T5", web: 47, shop: 19, partner: 14 },
  { day: "T6", web: 53, shop: 31, partner: 16 },
  { day: "T7", web: 61, shop: 44, partner: 20 },
  { day: "CN", web: 38, shop: 40, partner: 11 },
];

export default function ChartStacked() {
  return (
    <BarChart
      stacked
      label="Đơn hàng theo kênh, 7 ngày"
      data={DATA}
      index="day"
      series={[
        { key: "web", label: "Website" },
        { key: "shop", label: "Cửa hàng" },
        { key: "partner", label: "Đối tác" },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

### Lines with an area wash

```tsx
import { LineChart } from "@semi/ui";

const DATA = Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, i) => ({
  week: `Tuần ${i + 1}`,
  revenue: Math.round(40 + i * 4 + 10 * Math.sin(i / 1.6)),
  cost: Math.round(28 + i * 2 + 6 * Math.cos(i / 2)),
}));

export default function ChartLine() {
  return (
    <LineChart
      area
      label="Doanh thu và chi phí, 12 tuần (triệu ₫)"
      data={DATA}
      index="week"
      formatIndex={(w) => w.replace("Tuần ", "T")}
      series={[
        { key: "revenue", label: "Doanh thu" },
        { key: "cost", label: "Chi phí" },
      ]}
      format={(v) => `${v} tr ₫`}
    />
  );
}
```

### Donut

```tsx
import { DonutChart } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ChartDonut() {
  return (
    <DonutChart
      label="Đơn theo trạng thái"
      centerLabel="Tổng đơn"
      data={[
        { label: "Đã giao", value: 812 },
        { label: "Đang in", value: 164 },
        { label: "Chờ thanh toán", value: 96 },
        { label: "Huỷ", value: 31 },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

### Sparkline in a KPI row

```tsx
import { KpiCard, Sparkline } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ChartSparkline() {
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-3 @2xl:grid-cols-2">
      <div className="relative">
        <KpiCard label="Doanh thu tuần" value="61,8 tr ₫" sub="+12% so với tuần trước" tone="good" />
        <Sparkline label="Doanh thu 8 tuần" values={[42, 45, 44, 50, 48, 55, 58, 62]} className="absolute right-4 bottom-4" />
      </div>
      <div className="relative">
        <KpiCard label="Tỉ lệ lỗi" value="1,8%" sub="-0,4 điểm" tone="good" />
        <Sparkline label="Tỉ lệ lỗi 8 tuần" values={[3.1, 2.9, 3.4, 2.6, 2.4, 2.2, 2.0, 1.8]} className="absolute right-4 bottom-4" />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### BarChart

Columns per category: grouped (default) or `stacked`. ≤24px columns with 4px rounded tops, a 2px gap between stacked
segments. Hover or ←/→ on the focused chart shows every series of a category; the table view lists all values.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` * | `Row[]` |  |  |
| `index` * | `string` |  | Field holding the category / date of each row (the x axis). |
| `series` * | `ChartSeries[]` |  |  |
| `label` * | `string` |  | Accessible name; also the table view's caption. Put the visible title in your card heading. |
| `height` | `number` |  | Plot height in px (default 240). |
| `format` | `(value: number) => string` |  | How values read (tooltip, table, labels); axis ticks are compacted (1,2K). |
| `formatIndex` | `(value: string) => string` |  | How an index value reads ("2026-10" → "T10"). |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `stacked` | `boolean` |  |  |

### LineChart

Lines over an index (usually time), 2px with an end dot; `area` adds a 10% wash under each line. A crosshair snaps
to the nearest index on hover or ←/→ and lists every series.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` * | `Row[]` |  |  |
| `index` * | `string` |  | Field holding the category / date of each row (the x axis). |
| `series` * | `ChartSeries[]` |  |  |
| `label` * | `string` |  | Accessible name; also the table view's caption. Put the visible title in your card heading. |
| `height` | `number` |  | Plot height in px (default 240). |
| `format` | `(value: number) => string` |  | How values read (tooltip, table, labels); axis ticks are compacted (1,2K). |
| `formatIndex` | `(value: string) => string` |  | How an index value reads ("2026-10" → "T10"). |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `area` | `boolean` |  |  |

### DonutChart

Parts of a whole (≤ 5 slices; fold the rest into "Khác"). Slices are separated by a 2px surface gap; the centre shows
the total (or `centerLabel`); the legend lists every slice with its value and share.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` * | `DonutSlice[]` |  |  |
| `label` * | `string` |  |  |
| `format` | `(value: number) => string` | `(v) => v.toLocaleString("vi-VN")` |  |
| `centerLabel` | `string` |  | Text under the centre figure ("Tổng đơn"). |
| `size` | `number` | `180` |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

### Sparkline

A small trend line for a KPI tile or a table cell: muted line, the last point in the accent. Decorative detail:
the label states the trend for screen readers (first, last, min, max).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `values` * | `number[]` |  |  |
| `label` * | `string` |  |  |
| `width` | `number` | `96` |  |
| `height` | `number` | `28` |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- Each chart is role="img" with a label; focus it and use ←/→ (Home / End) to read every index in the tooltip; “Xem bảng” switches to a table with all values.
- Colour is never the only channel: legend (2+ series), tooltip labels and the table view carry identity; text stays in text tokens.

## Notes

- Keep a series' colour fixed per entity (color: slot) so a filter never repaints the others.
- Put the visible title in the card around the chart; label is the accessible name.

# Code block

Code to read or copy: a mono block with a copy button and an optional title (file name); long lines scroll sideways. Plain text, no highlighting.

## When to use

- API keys and commands to copy, config snippets, developer docs.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A short value inline | <code> in text, or Kbd for keys |

## Import

```tsx
import { CodeBlock } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### With a file name

```tsx
import { CodeBlock } from "@semi/ui";

export default function CodeBlockBasic() {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <CodeBlock code="npx semi-brand preview" />
      <CodeBlock
        title="app/globals.css"
        code={`@import "tailwindcss";
@import "@semi/ui/tokens.css";
@import "@semi/ui/base.css";`}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### CodeBlock

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code` * | `string` |  |  |
| `title` | `string` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- The block is focusable so keyboard users can scroll it; the copy button is labelled and says when it copied.

# Collapsible

One section that opens and closes under its trigger row (advanced options, details of a log line).

## When to use

- Hide rarely used options (“Tuỳ chọn khác”), long details.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Several sections, one open at a time | Accordion |

## Import

```tsx
import { Collapsible } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Advanced options

```tsx
import { Collapsible, Field, Input } from "@semi/ui";

export default function CollapsibleBasic() {
  return (
    <Collapsible title="Tuỳ chọn khác" className="max-w-md">
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <Field label="Nhiệt độ bàn">
          <Input defaultValue="60 °C" />
        </Field>
        <Field label="Tốc độ quạt">
          <Input defaultValue="40%" />
        </Field>
      </div>
    </Collapsible>
  );
}
```

## API

### Collapsible

One section that opens and closes under its trigger row.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` * | `React.ReactNode` |  | The trigger row (text, optionally with an icon or a count). |
| `open` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- The trigger is a button with aria-expanded / aria-controls; hidden content is out of the tab order.

<!-- docs/components/data-table.md -->

# Data table

A table that sorts, filters, selects and pages rows on the client, built on Table: give it rows and columns, it keeps the state (or you control it).

## When to use

- Admin lists: orders, customers, inventory, logs — sort by a column, search, act on several rows.
- Many columns on a tablet or beside a rail: give the less important ones a `priority`, they fold into the first column instead of being cut.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A static table with no interaction | Table |
| Entities with images and states | a grid of Card |
| Server-side paging and sorting | control sort / page, pass the current page's rows |

## Import

```tsx
import { DataTable, type DataTableColumn, type DataTableSort } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Orders: search, sort, select, page

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Badge, Button, DataTable, SearchInput, toast, type DataTableColumn } from "@semi/ui";

type Order = { id: string; customer: string; status: "paid" | "pending" | "refunded"; total: number; date: string };
const STATUS = { paid: ["emerald", "Đã thanh toán"], pending: ["amber", "Chờ xử lý"], refunded: ["rose", "Hoàn tiền"] } as const;
const ORDERS: Order[] = Array.from({ length: 23 }, (_, i) => ({
  id: `SO-${1040 + i}`,
  customer: ["Nguyễn An", "Trần Bình", "Lê Chi", "Phạm Dũng", "Hoàng Hà"][i % 5],
  status: (["paid", "pending", "refunded"] as const)[i % 3],
  total: 180_000 + ((i * 97_000) % 2_400_000),
  date: `2026-10-${String(1 + (i % 28)).padStart(2, "0")}`,
}));

const COLUMNS: DataTableColumn<Order>[] = [
  { key: "id", header: "Mã đơn", sortable: true, cell: (o) => <span className="font-medium text-strong">{o.id}</span> },
  { key: "customer", header: "Khách hàng", sortable: true },
  { key: "status", header: "Trạng thái", value: (o) => STATUS[o.status][1], cell: (o) => <Badge tone={STATUS[o.status][0]} dot>{STATUS[o.status][1]}</Badge> },
  { key: "date", header: "Ngày", sortable: true },
  { key: "total", header: "Tổng", sortable: true, numeric: true, cell: (o) => `${o.total.toLocaleString("vi-VN")} ₫` },
];

export default function DataTableOrders() {
  const [q, setQ] = useState("");
  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <SearchInput value={q} onChange={setQ} placeholder="Tìm mã đơn, khách hàng…" className="w-64" />
      <DataTable
        label="Đơn hàng"
        rows={ORDERS}
        columns={COLUMNS}
        getRowId={(o) => o.id}
        search={q}
        defaultSort={{ key: "date", dir: "desc" }}
        selectable
        bulkActions={(ids) => (
          <Button size="sm" variant="danger" icon="trash" onClick={() => toast({ title: `Đã huỷ ${ids.length} đơn`, tone: "danger" })}>
            Huỷ đơn
          </Button>
        )}
        pageSize={8}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Many columns: priority folds, sticky first column

Switch the width: at Máy tính bảng the priority 3 columns fold under the name; at Hẹp the priority 2 ones too, and the columns without a priority scroll sideways with the name kept in place and a strong line on the edge that has more columns.

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Badge, DataTable, ToggleGroup, type DataTableColumn } from "@semi/ui";

type Customer = { id: string; name: string; phone: string; city: string; source: string; owner: string; lastContact: string; orders: number; spent: number };
const CUSTOMERS: Customer[] = Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, i) => ({
  id: `KH-${2031 + i}`,
  name: ["Cửa hàng Minh An", "Nhà sách Phú Lợi", "Quán Bếp Nhà", "Tiệm bánh Hồng Phúc", "Văn phòng phẩm Sao Mai", "Siêu thị mini Thảo Điền"][i],
  phone: `090 ${String(1234567 + i * 1111).replace(/(\d{3})(\d{4})/, "$1 $2")}`,
  city: ["TP.HCM", "Hà Nội", "Đà Nẵng", "Cần Thơ", "Huế", "TP.HCM"][i],
  source: ["Facebook", "Giới thiệu", "Zalo", "Website", "Facebook", "Hội chợ"][i],
  owner: ["Lan", "Minh", "Lan", "Tú", "Minh", "Tú"][i],
  lastContact: `2026-11-${String(20 - i * 3).padStart(2, "0")}`,
  orders: 3 + ((i * 7) % 19),
  spent: 2_400_000 + ((i * 3_150_000) % 18_000_000),
}));

// priority 3 folds first, then 2, then 1; the first column and columns without a priority always stay
const COLUMNS: DataTableColumn<Customer>[] = [
  { key: "name", header: "Khách hàng", sortable: true, cell: (c) => <span className="font-medium text-strong">{c.name}</span> },
  { key: "phone", header: "Điện thoại", priority: 2 },
  { key: "city", header: "Tỉnh / thành", sortable: true },
  { key: "source", header: "Nguồn", priority: 3, cell: (c) => <Badge size="sm">{c.source}</Badge> },
  { key: "owner", header: "Người phụ trách", priority: 3 },
  { key: "lastContact", header: "Liên lạc", sortable: true, priority: 2 },
  { key: "orders", header: "Đơn", sortable: true, numeric: true },
  { key: "spent", header: "Doanh số", sortable: true, numeric: true, cell: (c) => `${c.spent.toLocaleString("vi-VN")} ₫` },
];

const WIDTHS = { full: "", tablet: "max-w-[700px]", narrow: "max-w-[400px]" } as const;

export default function DataTableColumns() {
  const [width, setWidth] = useState<(keyof typeof WIDTHS)[]>(["tablet"]);
  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <ToggleGroup
        label="Độ rộng bảng"
        value={width}
        onChange={setWidth}
        options={[
          { key: "full", label: "Đầy đủ" },
          { key: "tablet", label: "Máy tính bảng" },
          { key: "narrow", label: "Hẹp" },
        ]}
      />
      <div className={WIDTHS[width[0]]}>
        <DataTable label="Khách hàng" rows={CUSTOMERS} columns={COLUMNS} getRowId={(c) => c.id} defaultSort={{ key: "spent", dir: "desc" }} stickyFirstColumn />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Loading and empty

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, DataTable } from "@semi/ui";

export default function DataTableStates() {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <Button size="sm" onClick={() => setLoading((v) => !v)}>
        {loading ? "Xem trạng thái rỗng" : "Xem đang tải"}
      </Button>
      <DataTable
        label="Máy in"
        rows={[] as { id: string; name: string }[]}
        columns={[{ key: "name", header: "Tên máy" }]}
        getRowId={(r) => r.id}
        loading={loading}
        pageSize={4}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### DataTable

Sort by a column header (click again to reverse; aria-sort on the header), filter with `search` (every searchable
column, case and Vietnamese marks ignored), select rows with a checkbox column (select-all on the page, bulk
actions bar), page with Pagination. Shows skeleton rows while `loading` and an EmptyState when nothing is left.
When the columns do not fit its own box, columns with a `priority` fold into the first column's second line; what
still does not fit scrolls sideways, with a strong line (outline-line) on each edge that has columns past it and the table
focusable to scroll by keyboard. The sorted column never folds. Folding is measured after hydration, so a table
with priorities may shift once on first load at a narrow width.
The order it shows is `sortRows(searchRows(rows, columns, search), columns, sort)` (for DetailOverlay ‹ ›).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rows` * | `T[]` |  |  |
| `columns` * | `DataTableColumn<T>[]` |  |  |
| `getRowId` * | `(row: T) => string` |  |  |
| `label` * | `string` |  | Accessible name of the table (a visually hidden caption). |
| `search` | `string` | `""` | Filter text, usually from the toolbar's SearchInput. |
| `sort` | `null \| DataTableSort` |  |  |
| `defaultSort` | `DataTableSort` |  |  |
| `onSortChange` | `(sort: DataTableSort \| null) => void` |  |  |
| `onResultsChange` | `(rows: T[]) => void` |  | Called with the searched + sorted rows (all pages) whenever the result order changes, so a DetailOverlay's ‹ › walks the table's exact order. |
| `selectable` | `boolean` | `false` | Add a checkbox column. |
| `selected` | `string[]` |  |  |
| `onSelectedChange` | `(ids: string[]) => void` |  |  |
| `activeRowId` | `null \| string` |  | ID of the currently open record (`useDetailParam().openId`): paints that row `bg-item-selected` (`aria-current="true"`), distinct from checked rows (`bg-item-checked`). |
| `bulkActions` | `(ids: string[]) => ReactNode` |  | Shown above the table while rows are selected: buttons that act on the selection. On 1.0 list pages (#149), prefer `FilterChipRow` / `PhoneFilterBar` `selection` instead so checking a row never pushes the list down. |
| `pageSize` | `number` | `0` | Rows per page; 0 shows all rows. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `empty` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Shown when there are no rows (or none match the search). |
| `onRowClick` | `(row: T) => void` |  | Make rows clickable (open the record). Keep a link or button in the row for keyboard users. |
| `stickyFirstColumn` | `boolean` | `false` | Keep the first column (and the checkbox column) in place while the table scrolls sideways, so every row stays named. The table then sits on `bg-card`. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- Sortable headers are buttons with aria-sort on the header cell; the caption names the table; row checkboxes and select-all are labelled; aria-busy while loading.
- A folded value keeps its header for screen readers (“Nguồn: Facebook”) on the first cell's second line; when the table still scrolls sideways its scroll box is a named, focusable region, so the arrow keys scroll it.

## Notes

- Folding is measured on the table's own box (not the viewport), from each column's one-line width: a table in a split view or next to the rail folds as soon as it is too narrow. Folding happens after hydration: the server HTML shows every column, so a table with priorities may shift once on first load at tablet width.
- The order the table shows is `sortRows(searchRows(rows, columns, search), columns, sort)` (or read it from `onResultsChange`): use it to step through the results in a DetailOverlay (‹ ›, “n / N”), see the detail-overlay docs.
- Pass `activeRowId` to highlight the open record's row (`bg-item-selected`, `aria-current="true"`); checked rows use `bg-item-checked`.
- A table wider than its box draws a 2px strong line (outline-line) on each edge that has columns past it (in every table; with `stickyFirstColumn` the left line is the pinned column's edge) and keeps the first column (and the checkbox column) in place with `stickyFirstColumn`; the table then sits on `bg-card`. The sorted column never folds: its header is the only sort control.

<!-- docs/components/icon.md -->

# Icon

The semantic icon registry (stroke 1.75, 24px grid). IconTile is the rounded tinted square that leads cards and dialogs.

## When to use

- Every icon in the UI: pick the semantic name (trash = delete, close = dismiss, refresh = reload). See docs/ICONS.md.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A missing icon | add it to ICONS in @semi/ui (/semi-propose), never an inline <svg> |

## Import

```tsx
import { Icon, IconTile, ICONS, suggestIcon } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Icons and tiles

```tsx
import { Icon, IconTile } from "@semi/ui";

export default function IconBasic() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
      <Icon name="printer" className="w-5 h-5 text-body" />
      <Icon name="trash" className="w-5 h-5 text-danger-fg" title="Xoá" />
      <Icon name="refresh" className="w-5 h-5 text-strong" />
      <IconTile name="box" tone="green" />
      <IconTile name="camera" tone="sky" size="lg" />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### Icon

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` * | `IconName` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` | `"w-4 h-4"` |  |
| `strokeWidth` | `number` | `1.75` |  |
| `title` | `string` |  |  |

### IconTile

Rounded square with an icon: the leading visual of cards, list rows and dialogs.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` * | `IconName` |  |  |
| `tone` | `TileTone` |  |  |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `"md"` |  |
| `className` | `string` | `""` |  |

## Accessibility

- Decorative by default (aria-hidden); pass title when the icon alone carries meaning.

<!-- docs/components/item.md -->

# Item

A list row — leading icon / avatar / image, title and description, meta on the right, actions — and ItemGroup, which stacks rows in a card with dividers.

## When to use

- Settings lists, files, members, notifications, linked records.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Rows compared column by column | Table or DataTable |
| Entities with images and status in a grid | Card |

## Import

```tsx
import { Item, ItemGroup } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Settings list

```tsx
import { Badge, IconTile, Item, ItemGroup, Switch } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ItemSettings() {
  return (
    <ItemGroup label="Cài đặt máy in" showLabel className="max-w-lg">
      <Item media={<IconTile name="printer" tone="green" size="sm" />} title="X1 Carbon 03" description="Xưởng A · Online" meta={<Badge tone="emerald" dot size="sm">Online</Badge>} href="#printer" />
      <Item icon="bell" title="Thông báo" description="Khi in xong hoặc gặp lỗi" actions={<Switch checked onChange={() => undefined} label={<span className="sr-only">Thông báo</span>} />} />
      <Item icon="fileText" title="Nhật ký in" description="Lưu 30 ngày" meta="2,4 GB" />
    </ItemGroup>
  );
}
```

## API

### Item

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `icon` | `IconName` |  | A leading icon (or pass `media` for an Avatar, IconTile or image). |
| `media` | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `title` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `description` | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `meta` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Right-aligned detail: a value, a Badge, a time. |
| `actions` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Buttons or a Menu at the end (stay clickable on a linked row). |
| `href` | `string` |  | Make the whole row a link (next/link). |
| `onClick` | `() => void` |  | Make the whole row a button. |
| `selectable` | `boolean` | `false` | Show a leading selection checkbox as a sibling control (never nested inside the row link / button). |
| `checked` | `boolean` | `false` | Checked state in selection mode (`bg-item-checked`). |
| `onCheckedChange` | `(checked: boolean) => void` |  | Called when the selection checkbox changes. |
| `selectLabel` | `string` |  | Accessible name for the selection checkbox (defaults to `"Chọn <title>"` when `title` is text). |
| `selected` | `boolean` | `false` | Open / active record state (`bg-item-selected`, `aria-current="true"`). |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

### ItemGroup

Rows in a card with dividers; `label` names the list for screen readers (and shows above it when visible).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` * | `string` |  |  |
| `showLabel` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- A linked row is one link (the whole row is clickable through a stretched link); actions stay separate buttons; ItemGroup is a labelled section.

# Kbd

A key or a shortcut (⌘ K, Ctrl Enter) as key caps, for menus, tooltips, the command palette and help text.

## When to use

- Show the shortcut of an action next to it.

## Import

```tsx
import { Kbd } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Keys and shortcuts

```tsx
import { Kbd } from "@semi/ui";

export default function KbdBasic() {
  return (
    <p className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-ui text-body">
      Mở bảng lệnh <Kbd keys={["⌘", "K"]} /> · Gửi <Kbd keys={["Ctrl", "Enter"]} /> · Đóng <Kbd>Esc</Kbd>
    </p>
  );
}
```

## API

### Kbd

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `keys` | `string[]` |  | Several keys of one shortcut: ["⌘", "K"] renders two key caps. |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` |  | One key when `keys` is not given. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- Rendered as <kbd>; screen readers read the key names.

<!-- docs/components/kpi-card.md -->

# KPI card

A metric card: label, a large tabular figure in the style's figure font, a sub line coloured good / danger. One featured card leads the row; icons are optional and neutral.

## When to use

- The metric row at the top of a dashboard (2–4 per row), with the screen's main number as the featured card.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A colour per card for decoration | none: iconTone only when the colour means a status |

## Import

```tsx
import { KpiCard } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Dashboard row with a featured figure

```tsx
import { KpiCard } from "@semi/ui";

export default function KpiCardRow() {
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-3 grid-cols-2 @3xl:grid-cols-4">
      <KpiCard featured label="Doanh thu tháng" value="48,2 tr ₫" sub="+8,6% so với tháng trước" tone="good" />
      <KpiCard label="Đơn mới" value="1.842" sub="+12% so với tuần trước" />
      <KpiCard label="Đơn trễ" value="14" sub="3 đơn quá 2 ngày" tone="danger" icon="clock" iconTone="amber" />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### KpiCard

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` * | `string` |  |  |
| `value` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `sub` | `React.ReactNode` |  | A line under the figure (trend, comparison); coloured by `tone`. |
| `tone` | `'danger' \| 'good'` |  | Colour of the figure when it is good or bad news. Leave unset for a neutral figure. |
| `hint` | `string` |  | Becomes the card's title (tooltip). |
| `icon` | `IconName` |  | Optional icon before the label. Most KPI rows read better without one. |
| `iconTone` | `TileTone` |  | Colour of the icon. Unset = neutral (text-muted). Give a colour only when it means something (a status), never one decorative colour per card. |
| `featured` | `boolean` | `false` | The screen's main number: larger figure, spans two columns of the grid it sits in. Use one per row at most. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | Show a shimmer skeleton in place of the value while loading. |
| `className` | `string` | `""` |  |

## Accessibility

- hint becomes the card's title (tooltip); the figure uses tabular-nums.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/kpi-card/ and the types in src/ -->

- Bật \`Z-hop\` khi di chuyển

Xem thêm tại https://example.com/petg-guide`;

<!-- docs/components/qr-code.md -->

# QR code

A scannable QR code as one SVG: VietQR / EMVCo payment payloads, receipts (print variant), links. Fixed black modules on white with a 4-module quiet zone in both themes, four error-correction levels, optional caption and copy button.

## When to use

- Show a payment QR (VietQR) in a payment dialog, or print one on a receipt.
- Share a short link or a code a phone must scan.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A value to copy, no scanning | CodeBlock |
| A logo in the centre of the code | Not supported: a centre mark covers modules. Put the logo beside the code |

## Import

```tsx
import { QRCode } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### VietQR payment

```tsx
import { QRCode } from "@semi/ui";

// A VietQR (EMVCo) payload from the payment provider: transfer 185.000 ₫ to account 0123456789, note DH1042.
const VIETQR = "00020101021238540010A00000072701240006970422011001234567890208QRIBFTTA530370454061850005802VN62100806DH1042630444F9";

export default function QRCodePayment() {
  return (
    <QRCode
      value={VIETQR}
      label="Mã VietQR thanh toán đơn DH1042"
      caption="185.000 ₫ · DH1042"
      copyValue="0123456789"
      onError={(e) => console.error(e)}
    />
  );
}
```

### Receipt (print)

```tsx
import { QRCode } from "@semi/ui";

// On a receipt: no frame, no button, pure black on white in either theme (the printer decides, not the theme).
const VIETQR = "00020101021238540010A00000072701240006970422011001234567890208QRIBFTTA53037045407125000005802VN62200816HD0007 Cafe Semi6304DEE9";

export default function QRCodeReceipt() {
  return (
    <QRCode print value={VIETQR} size={160} errorCorrection="Q" label="Mã VietQR thanh toán hoá đơn HD0007" caption="HD0007 · 1.250.000 ₫" />
  );
}
```

### Error correction levels

```tsx
import { QRCode, type QRCodeErrorCorrection } from "@semi/ui";

const VIETQR = "00020101021238540010A00000072701240006970422011001234567890208QRIBFTTA530370454061850005802VN62100806DH1042630444F9";
const LEVELS: QRCodeErrorCorrection[] = ["L", "M", "Q", "H"];

export default function QRCodeLevels() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-4">
      {LEVELS.map((level) => (
        <QRCode key={level} value={VIETQR} errorCorrection={level} size={140} label={`Mã VietQR, mức sửa lỗi ${level}`} caption={`Mức ${level}`} />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Link or text (UTF-8), small size clamped

```tsx
import { QRCode } from "@semi/ui";

// Any UTF-8 text works (a link with Vietnamese letters). `size` below 120 is clamped to 120 so the code stays scannable.
export default function QRCodeText() {
  return <QRCode value="https://semi.vn/hoa-don/HD0007?khach=Nguyễn Văn Á" size={100} label="Mã QR mở hoá đơn HD0007" caption="Quét để xem hoá đơn" />;
}
```

### Value too long

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { QRCode } from "@semi/ui";

export default function QRCodeTooLong() {
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <QRCode value={"A".repeat(4000)} size={140} label="Mã QR" onError={(e) => setError(e.message)} />
      {error && <p className="text-ui text-muted">onError: {error}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### QRCode

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` * | `string` |  | The text to encode (a VietQR / EMVCo payload, a URL). UTF-8. |
| `size` | `number` | `200` | Edge in px including the quiet zone. Default 200, minimum 120 (smaller is clamped). |
| `errorCorrection` | `'L' \| 'M' \| 'Q' \| 'H'` | `"M"` | Error correction: L 7%, M 15% (default), Q 25%, H 30% of the code can be damaged. Higher levels hold less. |
| `label` * | `string` |  | Accessible name of the image ("Mã VietQR thanh toán đơn #1042"). Required: a QR code has no text of its own. |
| `caption` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Text under the code (amount, order number, the encoded string). Tabular numbers. |
| `copyValue` | `string \| boolean` |  | Adds a copy button. `true` copies `value`; a string copies that text instead (an account number, a link). |
| `onError` | `(error: Error) => void` |  | Called with the error when `value` cannot be encoded (too long for the error correction level). Nothing is thrown. |
| `print` | `boolean` |  | For receipts and print: no frame, no copy button, pure black on white (caption included), crisp edges. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- The SVG is role="img" named by `label` (required): a QR code has no text of its own, so say what it pays or opens. Put the readable data (amount, order number) in `caption`.
- Modules are always black on white, in the dark theme too: scanners need dark-on-light and the quiet zone. Do not recolour them.
- A value too long for the level shows a short message (role="alert") and calls `onError`; nothing throws.

## Notes

- Encoded with the `uqr` package (MIT, no dependencies, no network). The payload is not validated: pass what the payment provider gave you, unchanged.
- Level M (default) suits screens; Q or H for printed codes that may get scuffed. Higher levels hold less data.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/qr-code/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/separator.md -->

# Separator

A thin divider between groups of content: horizontal, vertical, or with a short label in the middle (“hoặc”).

## When to use

- Split groups inside a card or menu; “hoặc” between two ways to sign in.
- A vertical rule between toolbar groups.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Space between sections | a gap (space-y-*) — most layouts need no line |

## Import

```tsx
import { Separator } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Horizontal, label and vertical

```tsx
import { Button, Separator } from "@semi/ui";

export default function SeparatorBasic() {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-4 max-w-sm">
      <p className="text-ui text-body">Thông tin máy in</p>
      <Separator />
      <Button variant="primary" fullWidth>
        Đăng nhập bằng email
      </Button>
      <Separator label="hoặc" />
      <Button fullWidth>Đăng nhập bằng Google</Button>
      <div className="flex h-6 items-center gap-3 text-ui text-muted">
        <span>Máy in</span>
        <Separator orientation="vertical" />
        <span>Vật liệu</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### Separator

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `orientation` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `"horizontal"` |  |
| `label` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Short text in the middle of a horizontal line ("hoặc"). |
| `decorative` | `boolean` | `true` | true (default): purely visual, hidden from screen readers. false: announced as a separator. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- Decorative by default (hidden from screen readers); decorative={false} announces a separator.

<!-- docs/components/table.md -->

# Table

A dense table for rows compared column by column. Cells stay on one line (the table scrolls sideways on phones); TD wrap for a long-text column, numeric for figures.

## When to use

- Orders, invoices, logs: rows compared by column.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Entities with images or many states | a grid of Card |

## Import

```tsx
import { Table, THead, TBody, TR, TH, TD } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Orders

```tsx
import { Avatar, Badge, Table, TBody, TD, TH, THead, TR } from "@semi/ui";

const ORDERS = [
  { id: "SO-1042", customer: "Nguyễn An", status: ["emerald", "Đã thanh toán"], total: 1_250_000 },
  { id: "SO-1043", customer: "Trần Bình", status: ["amber", "Chờ xử lý"], total: 480_000 },
  { id: "SO-1044", customer: "Lê Chi", status: ["rose", "Hoàn tiền"], total: 2_100_000 },
] as const;

export default function TableOrders() {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-card border border-line overflow-hidden">
      <Table>
        <THead>
          <TR>
            <TH>Mã đơn</TH>
            <TH>Khách hàng</TH>
            <TH>Trạng thái</TH>
            <TH align="right">Tổng</TH>
          </TR>
        </THead>
        <TBody>
          {ORDERS.map((o) => (
            <TR key={o.id}>
              <TD className="font-medium text-strong">{o.id}</TD>
              <TD>
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Avatar name={o.customer} size="sm" />
                  {o.customer}
                </span>
              </TD>
              <TD>
                <Badge tone={o.status[0]} dot>
                  {o.status[1]}
                </Badge>
              </TD>
              <TD numeric>{o.total.toLocaleString("vi-VN")} ₫</TD>
            </TR>
          ))}
        </TBody>
      </Table>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### Table

No props of its own.

### THead

No props of its own.

### TBody

No props of its own.

### TR

A clickable row (onClick) gets the hover fill and a pointer; give it a link or button inside for keyboard users.

No props of its own.

### TH

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `align` | `'left' \| 'right' \| 'center'` | `"left"` |  |

### TD

`numeric` right-aligns and sets tabular-nums (money, counts, dates); `wrap` lets long text wrap (min 12rem wide).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `align` | `'left' \| 'right' \| 'center'` |  |  |
| `numeric` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `wrap` | `boolean` | `false` |  |

## Accessibility

- Real <table> semantics; a clickable TR is reachable by keyboard (Enter).

<!-- docs/components/typography.md -->

# Typography

The 1.0 type scale (text-tag 10 … text-hero 36, text-ui 14 for content, text-chrome 12 for the shell chrome, font-display for hero and big titles) and Prose, which styles long-form text — headings, paragraphs, lists, links, quotes, inline code — from that scale.

## When to use

- Help articles, release notes, policies, long AI answers (wrap Markdown in Prose).

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Page title | PageTitle |
| UI text in cards and forms | the type classes directly (text-ui for content: rows, labels, fields, buttons, copy; text-chrome for shell chrome and meta) |

## Import

```tsx
import { Prose } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Type scale

```tsx
export default function TypographyScale() {
  // A type specimen shows every size on purpose: data-density-skip keeps it out of the type-mix budget.
  return (
    <div data-density-skip className="space-y-1.5">
      <div className="font-display text-tab-xl text-strong">Tab lớn 28</div>
      <div className="text-section text-strong">Tiêu đề mục 20</div>
      <div className="text-figure text-strong">Tiêu đề trang trong thẻ 18</div>
      <div className="text-lead text-strong font-medium">Tiêu đề thẻ 15</div>
      <div className="text-ui text-body">Nội dung 14: dòng, nhãn, nút, đoạn văn</div>
      <div className="text-chrome text-muted">Khung ứng dụng 12: điều hướng, đường dẫn, thông tin phụ</div>
      <div className="text-tag text-muted">Thẻ 10</div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Prose

```tsx
import { Prose } from "@semi/ui";

export default function TypographyProse() {
  return (
    <Prose>
      <h2>Bảo quản vật liệu</h2>
      <p>
        Nhựa PETG và TPU <strong>hút ẩm nhanh</strong>. Giữ cuộn trong hộp kín có gói hút ẩm, hoặc sấy ở <code>65°C</code> trước khi in.
      </p>
      <ul>
        <li>PLA: để nơi khô ráo, tránh nắng</li>
        <li>PETG: sấy 4 giờ nếu mở hơn một tuần</li>
      </ul>
      <blockquote>Bản in bị rỗ bề mặt thường là do nhựa ẩm.</blockquote>
      <p>
        Xem thêm <a href="#guide">hướng dẫn sấy nhựa</a>.
      </p>
    </Prose>
  );
}
```

## API

### Prose

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- Keep a real heading order (h2 → h3); Prose caps the line length (max-w-prose) for reading.

<!-- docs/components/alert.md -->

# Alert

A message that stays on the page: info, success, warning, danger, with a title, an action and an optional dismiss.

## When to use

- State the user must see while working (firmware update, low material, failed print).

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A passing confirmation | toast() |
| Ask before acting | confirmDialog() |

## Import

```tsx
import { Alert } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Tones

```tsx
import { Alert, Button } from "@semi/ui";

export default function AlertTones() {
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-3 @2xl:grid-cols-2">
      <Alert tone="info" title="Bản cập nhật mới">
        Firmware 1.08 đã sẵn sàng cho 3 máy.
      </Alert>
      <Alert tone="success" title="Đã kết nối">
        Máy X1 Carbon đang online.
      </Alert>
      <Alert tone="warning" title="Sắp hết nhựa" action={<Button size="sm">Đặt thêm</Button>}>
        Cuộn PLA đen còn khoảng 80 g.
      </Alert>
      <Alert tone="danger" title="In thất bại">
        Đầu phun bị tắc ở lớp 132.
      </Alert>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Dismissible

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Alert, Button } from "@semi/ui";

export default function AlertDismiss() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(true);
  return open ? (
    <Alert tone="warning" title="Mất kết nối camera" onDismiss={() => setOpen(false)}>
      Ảnh sẽ cập nhật lại khi máy online.
    </Alert>
  ) : (
    <Button size="sm" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
      Hiện lại
    </Button>
  );
}
```

## API

### Alert

Callout inside a page or form (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §3b): tinted surface, tone icon, optional action / dismiss.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tone` | `'danger' \| 'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning'` | `"info"` |  |
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `icon` | `IconName` |  | Override the tone's icon. |
| `action` | `React.ReactNode` |  | A button or link shown under the text. |
| `onDismiss` | `() => void` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- role="status" (role="alert" for danger); the dismiss button is labelled.

<!-- docs/components/empty-state.md -->

# Empty state

What an empty list or page shows. `first-use`: one icon, one sentence, the one primary action that fills it. `no-results`: a search or filter matched nothing, with its own title and a “Xoá lọc” action.

## When to use

- First use: no items yet, a feature not set up (variant first-use).
- A search or filter matched nothing (variant no-results, with onClearFilters).

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| The page or the data failed to load | ErrorState |
| A wrong URL or a page the user cannot open | NotFound / Forbidden |
| Data is still loading | Skeleton in the shape of the content |

## Import

```tsx
import { EmptyState } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Plain

```tsx
import { Button, EmptyState } from "@semi/ui";

export default function EmptyStateBasic() {
  return (
    <EmptyState
      icon="printer"
      title="Chưa có máy in nào"
      description="Thêm máy in đầu tiên để theo dõi tiến độ và nhiệt độ."
      action={
        <Button variant="primary" icon="plus">
          Thêm máy in
        </Button>
      }
    />
  );
}
```

### First use

One icon, one sentence, one primary action.

```tsx
import { Button, EmptyState } from "@semi/ui";

export default function EmptyStateFirstUse() {
  return (
    <EmptyState
      variant="first-use"
      icon="printer"
      title="Chưa có máy in nào"
      action={
        <Button variant="primary" icon="plus">
          Thêm máy in
        </Button>
      }
    />
  );
}
```

### No results

A filter matched nothing: different title, “Xoá lọc” clears it.

```tsx
import { EmptyState } from "@semi/ui";

export default function EmptyStateNoResults() {
  return <EmptyState variant="no-results" title="Không có máy in khớp bộ lọc" onClearFilters={() => {}} />;
}
```

## API

### EmptyState

Empty list / first-run state (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §13).
- `first-use`: nothing exists yet. One icon, one sentence (the title), one primary action (`action`).
- `no-results`: a search or filter matched nothing. Own title, and `onClearFilters` adds a "Xoá lọc" button.
Below `sm` it takes at most 40% of the viewport (compact padding, scrolls inside if a long text still overflows).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `icon` | `IconName` |  | Defaults: `search` for no-results, `box` otherwise. |
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Defaults: "Không có kết quả" for no-results, "Chưa có dữ liệu" otherwise. |
| `description` | `React.ReactNode` |  | One short hint. A `first-use` state needs none: the title is its one sentence. |
| `action` | `React.ReactNode` |  | The one primary action (a filled Button) that fills the list. Not used by `no-results` when `onClearFilters` is set. |
| `variant` | `'first-use' \| 'no-results'` |  | `first-use` (nothing yet, one primary action) or `no-results` (a search / filter matched nothing). Omit for the plain state. |
| `onClearFilters` | `() => void` |  | no-results: clears the search and filters; renders a secondary "Xoá lọc" button. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- The action is a normal button; below sm the state takes at most 40% of the viewport.

## Notes

- When the list is empty and the state shows its own primary action, hide the primary button in the page's title row (one filled button per view, §13).
- Keep the title and toolbar on screen around a no-results state: the user must be able to change the filter.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/empty-state/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/states.md -->

# Error, not found, no access

The page-level states every app needs: ErrorState (what failed, with a retry), NotFound (a wrong URL) and Forbidden (no access), each with a link home, plus the route-file recipe (loading.tsx, error.tsx, not-found.tsx) that uses them.

## When to use

- A route or a fetch failed: ErrorState with onRetry (route error.tsx passes Next.js's reset).
- An unknown URL or notFound(): NotFound. A signed-in user without the role: Forbidden.
- Every Next.js route group ships loading.tsx (PageSkeleton), error.tsx (ErrorState) and not-found.tsx (NotFound).

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| A list with nothing in it | EmptyState variant first-use or no-results |
| A form field or action failed | Field error text, Alert or a danger toast |
| Content is loading | PageSkeleton / Skeleton in the shape of the content |

## Import

```tsx
import { ErrorState, NotFound, Forbidden } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Error with retry

```tsx
import { ErrorState } from "@semi/ui";

export default function StatesError() {
  return <ErrorState onRetry={() => {}} message="Không tải được danh sách đơn hàng. Kiểm tra kết nối rồi thử lại." detail="Mã lỗi 3871042" />;
}
```

### Not found

```tsx
import { NotFound } from "@semi/ui";

export default function StatesNotFound() {
  return <NotFound />;
}
```

### No access

```tsx
import { Forbidden } from "@semi/ui";

export default function StatesForbidden() {
  return <Forbidden />;
}
```

### Route error.tsx

The error boundary of a route group: Next.js gives it error and reset.

```tsx
"use client";

// app/(app)/error.tsx: Next.js renders it inside the layout, so the shell stays and only the content is replaced.
// A route error is the whole page, so its title is the h1. It does not catch errors in its own layout: see root error.tsx.
import { ErrorState } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ErrorPage({ error, reset }: { error: Error & { digest?: string }; reset: () => void }) {
  return <ErrorState headingLevel={1} onRetry={reset} detail={error.digest} />;
}
```

### Route not-found.tsx

Shown for notFound() and for URLs that match no route.

```tsx
// app/(app)/not-found.tsx (also app/not-found.tsx for URLs that match no route group): shown for notFound() and unknown URLs.
import { NotFound } from "@semi/ui";

export default function NotFoundPage() {
  return <NotFound />;
}
```

### Route loading.tsx

PageSkeleton in the shape of the page (list, cards or detail).

```tsx
// app/(app)/loading.tsx: the shell stays and the content shimmers in the shape of the page (list, cards or detail).
// `inShell` drops the full-page height and padding, because the shell's content slot already gives them.
import { PageSkeleton } from "@semi/ui";

export default function Loading() {
  return <PageSkeleton shape="list" inShell />;
}
```

### Root global-error.tsx

The net for an error in the root layout; it renders its own html and body.

```tsx
"use client";

// app/global-error.tsx: the last net, for an error in the ROOT layout (which app/error.tsx cannot catch). It replaces the
// whole document, so it renders its own <html> and <body>, and cannot use the shell or ThemeProvider.
import { ErrorState } from "@semi/ui";

export default function GlobalError({ error, reset }: { error: Error & { digest?: string }; reset: () => void }) {
  return (
    <html lang="vi">
      <body>
        <ErrorState headingLevel={1} onRetry={reset} detail={error.digest} />
      </body>
    </html>
  );
}
```

## API

### ErrorState

Something failed to load or run (route `error.tsx`, a failed fetch). Says what failed and offers a retry; keep any
data already loaded on screen and show this in place of the failed part only (§13c).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Defaults to "Có lỗi xảy ra". |
| `message` | `React.ReactNode` |  | What failed and what to do next, in the product's voice. Defaults to a generic Vietnamese sentence. |
| `detail` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Small technical line (an error digest or code) for support, never the raw stack. |
| `onRetry` | `() => void` |  | Shows a primary "Thử lại" button. In `error.tsx` pass the `reset` Next.js gives you. |
| `retryLabel` | `string` |  |  |
| `action` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Extra action beside the retry (a link home, "Báo lỗi"). |
| `icon` | `IconName` | `"alert"` |  |
| `headingLevel` | `1 \| 2 \| 3` |  | Heading level of the title: 2 inside a page (default), 1 when this is the whole page (a route `error.tsx`). |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

### NotFound

A wrong or removed URL (route `not-found.tsx`, `notFound()`): one sentence and a link home.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `message` | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `homeHref` | `string` | `"/"` | Where "Về trang chủ" goes. |
| `homeLabel` | `string` |  |  |
| `headingLevel` | `1 \| 2 \| 3` | `1` | Heading level of the title: 1 (default, a not-found page is the whole page) or 2 inside a page. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

### Forbidden

Signed in but not allowed (a 403, or a page the role cannot open): say so and link home; do not offer a retry.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `message` | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `homeHref` | `string` | `"/"` |  |
| `homeLabel` | `string` |  |  |
| `headingLevel` | `1 \| 2 \| 3` | `1` | Heading level of the title: 1 (default) or 2 inside a page. |
| `action` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Extra action beside the link home (a mailto to the admin, "Đổi tài khoản"). |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- ErrorState is role="alert", so screen readers announce it; the retry is a normal button.
- NotFound and Forbidden have one heading and a link home; Forbidden offers no retry.
- A route-level state is the page's h1 (headingLevel={1}); inside a page keep ErrorState at h2. Below sm the state is capped at 40% of the viewport and, if its content overflows, becomes a focusable, scrollable region.

## Notes

- Recipe: per route group put loading.tsx, error.tsx and not-found.tsx beside layout.tsx (the route-* examples), titles as h1 (`headingLevel={1}`; NotFound and Forbidden default to h1). A fully static (prerendered) site needs no loading.tsx: it would wrap every page in a Suspense boundary, so the HTML ships the page inside a hidden segment that a script swaps in. Put app/not-found.tsx at the root for URLs that match no group. A group's error.tsx does not catch errors in its own layout: add a root app/error.tsx for the root layout's children and app/global-error.tsx (it renders its own html and body) for the root layout itself.
- Keep data already loaded: when a refetch fails, show ErrorState in place of the failed part only and leave the rest on screen.
- Show a code or digest in `detail` for support, never the stack. Texts are Vietnamese by default and come from SemiLocaleProvider; pass title / message for product wording.
- 403 means signed in but not allowed (Forbidden, no retry); not signed in goes to the login page, not to Forbidden.

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.mjs from examples/states/ and the types in src/ -->

<!-- docs/components/guided-empty-state.md -->

# Guided empty state

The EmptyState variant “guided” (L13): the first use of a page that needs a few steps before it is useful. A step carousel (“Bước 1 / 4”, a visual, ‹ ›) or numbered steps, the one primary action, a link to the full guide, and rows of ready starting points by category, each with “Xem tất cả”.

## When to use

- First use of a page whose value needs setup in a few steps (suppliers before quotes, a catalogue before orders).
- A first use with ready starting points (import from Excel, find in DataHub, templates by category).

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| First use that one action fills | EmptyState variant="first-use" |
| A search or filter matched nothing | EmptyState variant="no-results" |
| Introduce a new feature to people who already use the page | FeatureIntro |

## Import

```tsx
import { GuidedEmptyState, type GuideStep, type GuideTemplate, type GuideTemplateGroup } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Carousel and starting points

```tsx
import { Button, GuidedEmptyState } from "@semi/ui";

export default function GuidedCarousel() {
  return (
    <GuidedEmptyState
      title="Chưa có nhà cung cấp nào. Thêm nhà cung cấp đầu tiên để hỏi giá."
      tutorial={{ label: "Xem hướng dẫn đầy đủ", href: "/components/guided-empty-state/" }}
      action={
        <Button variant="primary" icon="plus">
          Thêm nhà cung cấp
        </Button>
      }
      steps={[
        { icon: "upload", title: "Nhập danh sách bạn đang có", body: "Kéo tệp Excel hoặc CSV vào đây. Sales Hub nhận cột tên, vùng, mặt hàng và email." },
        { icon: "search", title: "Tìm thêm trong DataHub", body: "Lọc theo mặt hàng và vùng trồng, chọn nhà cung cấp rồi thêm vào danh sách một lần." },
        { icon: "send", title: "Gửi hỏi giá", body: "Chọn nhiều nhà cung cấp, gửi một yêu cầu báo giá. Thư trả lời tự về đúng hồ sơ." },
        { icon: "layers", title: "So sánh và chốt", body: "Giá từng mặt hàng đặt cạnh nhau, giá tốt nhất được đánh dấu. Chọn một báo giá để lập đơn." },
      ]}
      templates={[
        {
          category: "Bắt đầu nhanh",
          onSeeAll: () => undefined,
          items: [
            { icon: "fileSpreadsheet", tone: "emerald", title: "Nhập từ Excel", hint: "Mẫu cột có sẵn, 2 phút" },
            { icon: "database", tone: "sky", title: "Tìm trong DataHub", hint: "1.240 nhà cung cấp gia vị" },
            { icon: "mail", tone: "amber", title: "Lấy từ hộp thư", hint: "Người đã gửi báo giá cho bạn" },
          ],
        },
        {
          category: "Theo mặt hàng",
          seeAllLabel: "Tất cả mặt hàng",
          seeAllHref: "/components/guided-empty-state/",
          items: [
            { icon: "package", title: "Tiêu đen, tiêu trắng", hint: "Gia Lai, Đắk Lắk, Bình Phước" },
            { icon: "package", title: "Quế, hồi", hint: "Yên Bái, Lạng Sơn, Quảng Ngãi" },
            { icon: "package", title: "Thảo quả, gừng sấy", hint: "Lào Cai, Đắk Nông" },
          ],
        },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

### Numbered steps

layout="steps": every step at once, for two to four short steps.

```tsx
import { Button, GuidedEmptyState } from "@semi/ui";

export default function GuidedSteps() {
  return (
    <GuidedEmptyState
      layout="steps"
      title="Chưa có mặt hàng nào. Thêm mặt hàng để nhận đơn."
      action={
        <Button variant="primary" icon="plus">
          Thêm mặt hàng
        </Button>
      }
      steps={[
        { icon: "box", title: "Thêm mặt hàng", body: "Tên, quy cách và đơn vị bán." },
        { icon: "tag", title: "Đặt giá", body: "Giá theo số lượng, theo khách." },
        { icon: "send", title: "Gửi bảng giá", body: "Khách nhận một liên kết để đặt." },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

## API

### GuidedEmptyState

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` * | `React.ReactNode` |  | The one sentence: what is missing and what to do ("Chưa có nhà cung cấp nào. Thêm nhà cung cấp đầu tiên để hỏi giá."). |
| `steps` * | `GuideStep[]` |  | Two to five steps. |
| `layout` | `'carousel' \| 'steps'` | `"carousel"` | `carousel` (default): one step at a time with a visual, ‹ › and "Bước n / N". `steps`: every step as a numbered list. |
| `action` | `React.ReactNode` |  | The one primary action that fills the page (a filled Button). Hide the page's own primary while this shows. |
| `tutorial` | `{ label: string; href: string; }` |  | Link to the full guide, top right from `sm`. |
| `templates` | `GuideTemplateGroup[]` |  | Rows of ready starting points under the guide. |
| `headingLevel` | `1 \| 2 \| 3` | `2` | Level of the title (2 inside a page, default); category headings are one below. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- The guide is a region named by the title (an h2, headingLevel to change); a step change is read from a polite live region. At an end the pressed arrow turns disabled and focus moves to the other one.
- Starting points are links (href) or buttons in a list under an h3 per category; “Xem tất cả” is a link or a button.

## Notes

- One filled button on the screen: hide the page's own primary while the guided state shows (§13).
- Below sm the guide card follows the phone cap (at most 40% of the screen, the visual hidden, scrolls inside); the starting points become one row that scrolls sideways.

<!-- docs/components/progress.md -->

# Progress

A determinate bar with value, or an indeterminate one when the end is unknown; tones for success and danger.

## When to use

- Print progress, upload, storage used.

## Use something else when

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Content still loading | Skeleton |

## Import

```tsx
import { Progress } from "@semi/ui";
```

## Examples

### Values and tones

```tsx
import { Progress } from "@semi/ui";

export default function ProgressBasic() {
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4 @2xl:grid-cols-2">
      <Progress label="Tiến độ in" value={64} showValue />
      <Progress label="Dung lượng" value={92} tone="danger" showValue />
      <Progress label="Đang xử lý" />
      <Progress label="Đã tải" value={30} tone="success" size="sm" />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## API

### Progress

Determinate or indeterminate progress bar (uploads, quotas, print progress).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `number` |  | Omit for an indeterminate bar. |
| `max` | `number` | `100` |  |
| `tone` | `'danger' \| 'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'accent'` | `"accent"` |  |
| `label` | `React.ReactNode` |  | Visible label above the bar (also its accessible name). |
| `showValue` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | `"md"` |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  | Accessible name when there is no string `label` (the bar's text is elsewhere). |

## Accessibility

- role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow / max; the label names it.
